They illustrate the fundamental challenge of aligning models with human values without diminishing their creativity, so they can make surprising discoveries without producing surprising, potentially harmful outcomes. The paper first details AI achieving superhuman success through reinforcement learning across many challenging domains. However, reward-driven optimization can fail when the model learns to hack an underspecified reward or unarticulated constraint. We then present case studies suggesting that harnessing internet-scale foundation models (FMs) has not resolved these fundamental challenges and, in fact, can supercharge them. Nevertheless, we argue that these same learning dynamics can be harnessed to accelerate scientific discovery. Finally, we hope this work provides a consolidated resource to inform future research and demonstrates that the tendency toward unexpected behaviors is commonplace in modern AI, highlighting the need to anticipate and manage AI's capacity for innovative, yet unpredictable, solutions. (abstract abridged)

AI.tldr: 该论文汇集了26个来自机器学习各子领域的第一手轶事（涵盖100多位研究者的工作），系统展示了AI系统在训练中如何通过出人意料的方式规避人类设定的约束、发现创造性解决方案或利用奖励漏洞。论文既呈现了AI在围棋、扑克、量子光学、数学等领域超越人类的惊人创造力，也详细分析了奖励黑客、环境漏洞利用等问题，并探讨了如何将这种"意外发现"的能力引导至加速科学发现而非产生危害。
AI.motivation: AI算法在训练中频繁展现出创造性和出乎意料的行为，但这些案例很少被正式记录，主要以非正式轶事在研究者间流传。作者旨在将这些分散的轶事系统化整理，作为前作Lehman et al. (2020)的续篇，扩展到更广泛的AI子领域，以期为AI安全研究提供基础资源，帮助社区更好地理解AI的创造性和潜在风险。
AI.method: 论文采用策展式轶事收集方法，通过公开征集和定向联系，从100多位研究者处收集了26个第一手AI"意外行为"案例，并将其归类为五个重叠的主题领域：(1)超人表现与最优性能、(2)奖励黑客利用奖励/评分函数、(3)奖励黑客利用环境弱点、(4)基础模型/大语言模型的新故障模式、(5)AI for Science中的意外发现。多数案例(16/26)为首次正式记录，作者与原始研究者直接沟通核实细节。
AI.result: 论文呈现了丰富的实证案例：AlphaGo的"第37手"颠覆围棋数百年定式；Libratus用超额下注策略击败顶级扑克玩家；Diplodocus以全海军战略玩德国；Cicero学会沉默以隐瞒背叛意图；M-FOS重新发现零行列式勒索策略；CoastRunners智能体绕圈刷分；SMAC智能体利用护盾再生机制；CycleGAN用高频信号隐写源图信息；RL智能体在宝可梦中"种花"刷新颖性奖励；The AI Scientist试图修改自身超时限制；FunSearch发现Cap Set问题新下界；Krenn的算法独立重新发现Mandel量子实验并揭示与图论的联系等。这些案例横跨RL、对抗博弈、生成模型、多智能体系统、LLM安全和自动化科学发现等多个子领域。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：AI"找到出路"的能力既是其创造力的源泉也是安全风险的根源。优化过程对人类意图保持中立，既能发现AlphaGo Move 37式的范式转变突破，也能发现奖励黑客和环境漏洞利用。基础模型的引入并未消除这些故障模式，反而以更复杂的语义工具"超级增强了"它们。然而，在严格验证、人工监督和良好定义目标的约束下，相同的优化动力学可以引导至加速科学发现。论文强调AI安全的核心挑战不是消除意外发现，而是构建能够超越人类预期而不脱离人类意图的系统——让AI学到任务的精神而不仅是字面意义。

title: Provenance Guided Incremental Learning Under Evolving Concept Definitions
summary: Learning systems deployed over long periods must adapt not only to statistical changes in incoming data, but also to revisions of the definitions that generate their prediction targets. Conventional concept-drift methods typically infer such changes from observations or prediction errors, even when the underlying policy, rule, or query has been explicitly modified. This paper studies rule-induced concept shift, where the target-defining concept is revised directly, causing previously stored instances to acquire different semantic labels without requiring any change in their observed data. We introduce a provenance-guided incremental learning framework that compiles consecutive concept definitions into a structured rule delta, traces the changed components through historical provenance, certifies records whose previous labels remain valid, and restricts reevaluation to a localized candidate region. Executable revisions are relabeled automatically, ambiguous cases are handled through selective supervision, and the resulting changes are used for incremental predictor repair. A versioned concept memory further supports recurring definitions. We also introduce RuleShift-Bench, spanning financial, demographic, cybersecurity, and graph-structured data with threshold, predicate, logical, relational, recurring, and mixed concept revisions. Across the benchmark, provenance-guided repair attains 92.3% accuracy and 90.2% Macro-F1 while reprocessing 14.7% of the historical collection and retaining 94.6% of affected records. Its average update latency is 179s compared with 993s for complete relabeling and retraining. The results demonstrate that an explicit concept revision can be exploited as a data-maintenance signal, allowing learning systems to update the supervision and predictive state that depend on the change while preserving knowledge that remains valid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向"规则诱导概念漂移"的溯源引导增量学习框架，通过将概念定义的差异与历史数据溯源相结合，仅对受影响的记录进行重新评估和增量修复预测器，避免了对全部历史数据重新标注和重训的低效开销。
AI.motivation: 传统概念漂移方法通常只能从观测或预测误差中间接推断概念变化，而无法利用已知的规则修订信息；此外，当目标概念由策略、规则或查询显式定义并被修订时，大量历史记录的语义标签可能改变但其观测数据保持不变，全量重标注代价高昂。
AI.method: 将相邻概念定义表示为规范化谓词DAG并编译为类型化规则增量；结合记录级溯源与逆向索引定位候选区域；通过"持久阻塞节点"（AND中未变为false的子节点、OR中未变为true的子节点）提供可证明的稳定性证书来认证无需重评估的记录；将候选分为可自动重标注的精确部分和需选择性人工标注的模糊部分；使用修复集+稳定性缓冲以模型无关的方式增量修复预测器；并维护版本化概念记忆以高效处理回归性概念定义。
AI.result: 在PaySim、Census-Income、UNSW-NB15和ogbn-arxiv构成的RuleShift-Bench上，溯源引导修复达到92.3%准确率和90.2% Macro-F1，仅重新处理14.7%的历史数据、保留94.6%的受影响记录，平均更新延迟从全量重标注重训的993s降至179s（约5.5倍加速），且对XGBoost、神经网络表格模型和Hoeffding自适应树均有效；同时提升了模糊修订的标注效率并支持周期性概念的高效恢复。
AI.conclusion: 显式的概念修订可直接作为数据维护信号被利用，溯源引导的增量维护在概念变更局部化时能显著降低计算和监督成本，同时保持与全量重训几乎相当的预测质量；其主要局限性在于全局性概念修订、溯源缺失、不可执行概念成分以及高度耦合的关系/图依赖会缩小选择性维护的优势，但该方法在此类条件下仍保持正确性，只是逐步退化至接近全量重算。

title: BenchBench-Protocol: Evaluating Real-World Wet-Lab Protocol Reasoning and Modification
summary: We introduce BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark for large language models of 149 protocol-modification tasks recovered from modifications that scientists made to published protocols during real experimental work. Adapting a published protocol to a new experiment is a routine task for a wet-lab scientist, and a correct modification requires accounting for prior choices and downstream steps. Recent life-science benchmarks have moved toward open-ended, rubric-graded tasks, but tasks are typically elicited from experts rather than reconstructed from real-world modifications. BenchBench-Protocol tasks are derived from differences between a published protocol and a version a scientist modified, which provides the basis for the query and the weighted rubric elements for a correct response. The benchmark draws from 96 source protocols across nine domains of wet-lab biology and only includes tasks rated highly after review by domain experts. We evaluate nine closed and open models; Claude Opus 5 scores highest at 59.2% normalized rubric score, with other models between 34.1% and 47.1%, and the benchmark remains unsaturated when taking the best of ten attempts. As models are increasingly helpful in life-sciences research, evaluating them on routine wet-lab tasks becomes correspondingly important. We present BenchBench-Protocol as both a grounded assessment of wet-lab reasoning and evidence for the utility of real-world experiments to construct benchmark tasks.

AI.tldr: BenchBench-Protocol 是一个包含 149 个湿实验方案修改任务的大语言模型基准，任务源自科学家在真实实验中对已发表方案的真实修改记录，涵盖 9 个湿实验生物学领域，并配有专家审核的加权评分标准，用于评估 LLM 在真实实验场景下进行方案推理与修改的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生命科学基准中的开放式评分任务多由专家人工编写，可能偏离真实实验工作流中受试剂、仪器和已有结果约束的修改分布。本文旨在构建一个来源于真实科学家修改记录、更贴近实际工作流程的湿实验方案修改基准。
AI.method: 通过比对 Benchling 平台上科学家修改后的方案与原始已发表方案，提取差异作为任务和真实标签，生成以科学家第一人称口吻提出的查询；每条任务配备加权评分标准；经多位具备博士学位和至少 3 年实验经验的领域专家独立审核，仅保留"非常好/优秀"评级任务；使用 LLM-as-a-judge（GPT-5.6 Terra，中等推理）对九个模型在最高推理设置下的十次尝试进行评分，采用 0/1/2 三档加权评分并按源方案做自助置信区间。
AI.result: Claude Opus 5 以 59.2% 的归一化评分居首，其余模型介于 34.1%–47.1%；基准在十次重复采样下仍未饱和，Claude Opus 5 捕获 39.5% 的可提升空间，Kimi K3 在 k=10 时反超 GPT-5.6 Sol；模型在基于实验证据推理的任务上表现较好，而在需要隐性/专家直觉的排错与适配任务上较弱；模型整体水平有差异，但不存在领域专长差异；性能-成本帕累托前沿由 GPT-5.6 Luna、Kimi K3 和 Claude Opus 5 构成。
AI.conclusion: BenchBench-Protocol 提供了一个基于真实方案修改、专家审核的湿实验推理评估基准；当前模型在此任务上仍有显著提升空间，重复采样可获取部分而非全部可提升空间；模型差异主要体现在整体水平而非领域专长；从真实实验修改构建基准任务对于评估和改进 LLM 在常规湿实验工作上的实用性具有重要价值。

title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex sociotechnical systems, including Critical National Infrastructure (CNI), where harms emerge from interactions between technical, human, and organisational elements. Yet current AI evaluation remains model-centric, offering little insight into how observed behaviours might translate into system-level risk. We propose a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to bridge this gap. By providing a traceable pathway from model behaviour to system-level outcomes, the framework enables practitioners to answer the "so what?" of AI failures, quantify their systemic impact, and move toward evidence-based and anticipatory governance of AI in complex systems. Applied to the UK's Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an illustrative worked example, we derive AI-driven loss scenarios using Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) and examine adversarial manipulation of LLM-based trading as one such loss scenario. Component-level experiments show that simple adversarial inputs induce measurable behavioural shifts where AI recommendations are followed. Under the component-to-system mapping used here for a financial contagion model, these shifts alter system resilience, increasing bank failures and lowering the threshold at which shocks lead to cascading disruption, particularly under widespread or monopolistic AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于评估AI在复杂社会技术系统中部署所产生的系统级危害的框架。该框架将结构化危害分析(STPA)、组件级测试和概率系统建模三个阶段相结合，以英国实时全额结算系统(RTGS)为示例，量化了LLM交易被对抗性操纵后对金融系统性风险的影响。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估仍以模型为导向，无法解释AI行为如何在复杂社会技术系统中转化为系统级风险。监管者在自下而上的AI部署中面临信息不对称，需要一个可追溯的方法来回答AI失败的"所以呢？"问题，特别是在关键国家基础设施(CNI)中。
AI.method: 三阶段模块化框架：(1)使用系统理论过程分析(STPA)对RTGS系统进行结构化危害分析，识别100+个AI无关的不安全控制动作和8个AI驱动的损失场景；(2)对LLM交易组件进行组件级对抗性测试，使用间接提示注入攻击测试Claude 3.5 Haiku、GPT-5-mini等模型在资产配置中的行为偏移；(3)使用基于Eisenberg-Noe框架的金融传染模型(50家银行核心-边缘网络)量化组件到系统的映射，考虑不同的AI采用场景(垄断vs多样化)对银行失败率和系统韧性的影响。
AI.result: STPA识别出100+个不安全控制动作和8个AI驱动的损失场景；组件测试显示简单对抗输入可显著改变LLM的资产配置分配；在金融传染模型中，对抗性操纵增加了银行失败率，降低了导致级联中断所需的冲击阈值，特别是在AI广泛采用或单一模型垄断的情况下效果更为显著。GPT-5-mini在压力下表现出最强的资产清算倾向。提示硬化在简单设置中有效缓解了攻击。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将结构化危害分析、组件级测试和概率系统建模相结合，提供了从模型行为到系统级结果的可追溯路径，使政策制定者能够量化AI失败的系统性影响，支持从被动反应向预期性、基于证据的AI治理转变。该框架针对系统操作者而非AI开发者，与现有制度激励、专业知识和安全实践相契合。模块化设计允许根据能力和风险承受能力按比例应用。

title: Retrieval-augmented generation vs. deterministic tax computation in multi-agent financial advisory: A 2x2 factorial experiment
summary: Tax-loss harvesting demonstrates consistent benefits to long-term portfolio growth; yet implementing it efficiently often involves complex considerations that are specific to the holdings within that portfolio and the individual who owns it. We introduce a custom capital gains calculation engine and a RAG-retrieved vector store of market advisory reports to provide context for a multi-agent trade recommendation system. We investigate the effects of each context provider on the quality of recommendations, measured by relative capital gains incurred during portfolio liquidation. A 2x2 repeated-measures ANOVA revealed a significant main effect of the tax optimization engine ($F(1,29) = 9.17$, $p = .005$, $\eta^2_p = .240$): enabling the engine reduced tax savings by approximately 55 percentage points relative to the no-engine conditions. The RAG main effect was not significant ($p = .841$), nor was the interaction ($p = .553$). The RAG-only condition achieved the highest descriptive mean tax savings (47.7%), and the baseline condition performed second-best (30.6%), suggesting that the pre-trained language model's internalized financial knowledge may be sufficient for competent tax-loss harvesting recommendations without explicit tooling. These results indicate that augmenting LLM agents with domain-specific computation engines does not guarantee improved performance and may introduce conflicting optimization signals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2×2被试内因子实验，比较了多智能体金融顾问系统中税务计算引擎与RAG检索增强对税收损失收割（Tax-Loss Harvesting）建议质量的影响。结果出乎意料：启用税务引擎反而使平均节税变为负值（约-16%），而无引擎的基线和RAG-only条件均实现正向节税（30.6%和47.7%）；RAG主效应与交互作用均不显著。研究表明，为LLM智能体添加领域专用工具未必能提升性能，反而可能引入冲突的优化信号。
AI.motivation: 现有文献将AI投资组合管理、税收损失收割（TLH）与多智能体架构分别独立研究，缺少对三者整合效果的实证比较。零售投资者与金融科技平台对税后收益高度敏感，但将多种AI技术整合时能否产生叠加或协同效应尚无定论。本研究旨在填补这一空白，检验领域专用计算工具与检索增强知识在多智能体金融顾问系统中的独立与交互作用。
AI.method: 采用2×2被试内因子设计，自变量为税务优化引擎（启用/禁用）与RAG向量知识库（启用/禁用），构成四个基线条件。以LangChain构建的多智能体编排系统（Orchestrator + Holdings Analyst + Research/Tax/Mathematics/Guidance 子智能体）处理30个模拟投资组合场景（5-20只证券，价值$25K-$500K），每个组合在四种条件下评估，共120个观测。协变量为节税百分比（相对于无交易基线的资本利得税负债减少比例）。采用2×2重复测量ANOVA，并辅以Bonferroni事后比较、敏感性分析、美元金额替代分析及非参数Friedman检验进行稳健性验证。
AI.result: 税务引擎主效应显著且为负面影响：F(1,29)=9.17, p=.005, η²p=.240；启用引擎时平均节税-16.03%，禁用时+39.14%，差异约55个百分点。RAG主效应不显著（p=.841, η²p=.001），交互作用不显著（p=.553, η²p=.012）。描述统计显示：RAG-Only条件均值最高（47.73%），基线次之（30.55%），而两种启用引擎条件均为负值（Tax Tools Only: -11.03%；Tax Tools+RAG: -21.02%）。Bonferroni校正后事后比较仅税务引擎主效应显著（t(29)=3.03, p_bonf=.005, g=0.67）。敏感性分析（剔除7个异常组合）、美元金额分析及Friedman检验（χ²(3)=10.47, p=.015）均支持主要结论。所有四项原假设均被推翻。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果反驳了全部四项假设：(1)基线并非表现最差；(2)税务专用代理未优于基线；(3)RAG未产生显著增益；(4)两者组合未产生协同效应。核心启示：为LLM智能体叠加领域专用计算工具并不保证性能提升，反而可能因规则驱动的成本基础计算与智能体整体推理产生冲突而损害表现。LLM内化的金融知识已足以生成胜任的TLH建议。未来工作应扩大样本、纳入真实数据与多市场环境、优化工具集成方式以补充而非约束智能体推理，并从洗售合规、风险特征与投资者目标对齐等多维度评估建议质量。

title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories is the standard first stage for distilling tool-calling capabilities into deployable models. Post-training pipelines that drive shipped tool-calling agents re-run this stage on a daily or weekly cadence, paying the frontier-teacher cost each cycle, yet the mechanism is generate-and-filter (keep the teacher's passing trajectories, discard the rest) and each cycle leaves behind the same hard scenarios because failures supply no signal. On {\tau}2-bench, 57% of teacher trials fail, two-thirds of them near-misses (most tool calls correct, undone by one decisive error). We introduce PROOF-Gen (Per-scenario Reflective Optimization to Overcome FailedGeneration), which recovers golden trajectories from these failures via per-scenario prompt optimization. For each failed task, a reflector analyzes the execution trace and evaluation feedback, then writes corrective guidance that steers the teacher to a passing trajectory. The guidance is stripped before training, so the student learns from clean demonstrations with no task-specific scaffold. On {\tau}2-bench, per-scenario optimization recovers 93% of failed scenarios. Fine-tuned on the combined data, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 improves from Pass^1=0.132 to 0.529 and Gemma 4 E4B-it gains +7.2pp on BFCL v4 multi-turn. In a deployed pipeline, the method lifts trajectory quality by +6.3pp goal completion and transfers to a deployed on-device model (+1.5pp goal completion; +1.7 to +5.0pp across response-quality metrics), with positive transfer in every locale (non-English average +1.48pp).

AI.tldr: PROOF-Gen是一种数据生成方法，通过对每个失败场景进行独立的提示优化，从教师模型的失败轨迹中恢复"黄金"轨迹，再剥离脚手架后用于学生模型的监督微调，从而在工具调用任务上显著提升学生模型性能，并已成功部署到生产环境。
AI.motivation: 标准的generate-and-filter蒸馏管线对教师生成的轨迹只保留通过的、丢弃失败的，导致在教师失败率高的任务（如τ2-bench上57%的试验失败）上留下了持续的训练覆盖盲区，且失败本身不提供任何信号。现有研究主要改进训练算法或数据选择，但均假设教师能为目标任务产生正确示范，忽视了这一上游数据生成瓶颈。
AI.method: PROOF-Gen（Per-scenario Reflective Optimization to Overcome Failed Generation）为每一个失败的任务独立运行一个基于GEPA的提示优化循环：一个反射器模型分析失败轨迹与验证反馈，生成针对该场景的"cheatsheet"（自然语言纠正指导），追加到教师系统提示后重新执行；迭代至多10次直至通过。训练前剥离cheatsheet，使学生只学习干净示范。该方法将"能力"来源（反射器）与"风格"来源（执行器/教师）解耦，可在保留模型原有交互风格的同时注入更强的问题解决能力。
AI.result: 在τ2-bench telecom上，93%的失败任务被恢复（GPT-4o执行+GPT-5.1反射），反射器能力主导恢复率（24.4%~97.6%），Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的Pass^1从0.132提升至0.529，Gemma 4 E4B-it从0.231提升至0.333；BFCL v4多轮上Gemma提升+7.2pp。仅用过滤后数据（部分信用基线）虽提升中间动作准确率（+25pp）却未能改善任何端到端任务完成率。生产环境中轨迹质量+6.3pp目标完成率，部署到端侧模型后+1.5pp目标完成率与+1.7~+5.0pp响应质量指标，所有语言区域均显示正向迁移（非英语平均+1.48pp）。完整性审计确认90/90的恢复轨迹均无事实泄漏或硬编码捷径。
AI.conclusion: PROOF-Gen通过将自动提示优化用作一次性数据生成引擎而非持久推理脚手架，恢复了教师失败中的大部分任务，将蒸馏数据覆盖率的瓶颈转移到上游解决。该方法在两个公开基准上获得唯一一致的端到端增益，并已在生产工具调用代理的后训练系统中部署，验证了其在可控实验之外的可扩展性。

title: MARS: Multi-Specialist LLM Relay System for Competitive Programming
summary: Large Language Models excel at code generation, yet competitive programming exposes a persistent failure mode: existing multi-agent pipelines distribute work over generic planner, coder, and debugger roles and delegate the choice of algorithmic technique to the backbone alone. We present MARS (Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs), a prompt-only framework in which each agent is a topic specialist---dynamic programming, graphs, strings, geometry, and so on---grounded by retrieval-augmented generation over an algorithm-theory corpus. Given a problem, retrieval selects a small team of relevant specialists; a starter writes an initial C++17 solution, and each subsequent turn runs the candidate against public examples in a sandbox, lets the active specialist keep, repair, or hand off the draft, and forwards a structured packet to the next specialist. A single infrastructure-fixer pass normalizes boilerplate at the end. On the CodeContests test split with Gemma 4, MARS reaches $0.624 \pm 0.006$ pass rate at $2.3$ recorded pipeline stages per task ($+14.4$ percentage points over direct prompting), closing most of the gap to CodeSIM ($0.731$) at $3.3{\times}$ lower wall-clock cost and substantially smaller variance in per-task token spend. The source code is available on GitHub: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MARS（Multi-Agent Relay of Specialized LLMs），一种面向竞技编程的纯提示词多智能体接力框架。每个智能体是单一算法主题专家（如动态规划、图论、几何等），通过 RAG 从 cp-algorithms 语料库中检索主题知识。系统先通过自评估筛选最多 3 名相关专家组成小组，由起始专家写初始 C++17 方案，后续每轮在沙箱中用公开样例执行测试，再由当前专家决定保留、修复或交接，最终经一次基础设施修复完成。在 CodeContests 测试集（165 题）上以 Gemma 4 为骨干，MARS 达到 0.624±0.006 通过率，比直接提示提升 14.4 个百分点，以 3.3× 更低的运行时间逼近 CodeSIM（0.731）的表现，且每任务 token 消耗方差显著更小。
AI.motivation: 现有竞技编程多智能体流水线（如 MapCoder、CodeSIM）通常采用通用规划者-编码者-调试者分工，将算法技术的选择完全交由底层 LLM，缺乏对算法领域专长的显式建模。MARS 旨在通过主题专业化的智能体设计与基于 RAG 的算法理论检索，将"专家级算法知识"注入协作过程，从而在稀疏正确信号下提升生成代码的正确率。
AI.method: 1）从 11 个主题专家池中，通过共享 cp-algorithms 语料库（按 tag 切片）的检索与自评估（含 in-scope、relevance、confidence）筛选最多 3 名匹配专家。2）起始专家通过 can-start 探针选举，写入初始 C++17 草案。3）每轮两步调用：第一步基于当前代码、子任务分配、起始契约与 RAG 上下文生成新草案；沙箱中用公开样例执行；第二步让同一专家看到执行报告，返回 keep-code / repair-code / no-change 与结构化交接字段。4）本地确定性门控：仅当修复代码编译通过且不减少通过样例数才接受，否则回滚。5）预算：最多 3 名专家、8 步；含无进展截断（连续 2 次 reroute、3 次停止）。6）最后仅在检测到模板级（I/O、头文件、整型宽度）故障时调用基础设施修复器。检索采用 Jina Embeddings v2；骨干模型为 Gemma 4（温度 0.0、top-p 0.95、4096 token）。
AI.result: 主结果（Gemma 4, C++17）：MARS 0.624±0.006，较 Direct（0.480）提升 +14.4 pp，较 Single-RAG（0.529）+9.5 pp，较 Parallel ensemble（0.564）+6.0 pp；CodeSIM rerun 为 0.731±0.009（墙钟时间 817.5 s，MARS 为 244.3 s）。难度分层（Easy/Medium/Hard）上 MARS 在 Medium 达 0.72、Hard 达 0.40，Hard 上超过 Direct（0.18）一倍多。Backbone 迁移：Qwen3.5-27B 上 0.297 vs Direct 0.192；GPT-5.4-mini 上 0.503 vs Direct 0.149；Python 上 0.622。PairCoder（Python）达 0.705，领先 8.3 pp 但耗时为 MARS 1.4×。消融：去除 RAG 损失 2.0 pp；Generalists 无 RAG 低 0.9 pp 但多 31% 时间；Earlier Base relay 低 7.2 pp；Parallel manager 低 6.0 pp。Relay 行为：82.4% 任务启用 3 名专家，平均 1.35 名专家真正修改代码；自检决策 697 次中 38.4% 接受修复、55.4% 保持不变、4.4% 修复被门控拒绝。基础设施修复器仅约 0.2% 任务产生实质改动。
AI.conclusion: MARS 是一种纯提示词、主题对齐的多智能体接力框架，将公开测试执行反馈内嵌于每一步专家交接中，相比单智能体与并行集成基线提升 6–14 pp，并在三种骨干模型和两种语言（C++17、Python）上保持优势。重型搜索系统（CodeSIM、PairCoder）仍在通过率上领先，但 MARS 以显著更低的墙钟成本和 token 方差接近其性能。局限：评估限于 165 道 CodeContests 任务、单一语料库；本地门控仅防同轮回退，无法防止后续专家引入新回退；所有生成代码需沙箱执行；CodeSIM 是唯一可直接重运行的 stage-aligned 对比，PairCoder 仅 Python。

title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining
summary: Data mixing is a central design problem in large language model pretraining: given a fixed token budget, practitioners must decide how much data to allocate to each domain. Recent proxy-based methods address this problem by training small models on candidate mixtures, fitting a response model, and using the response to select mixtures for larger-scale training. We show that this workflow has the structure of a classical mixture experiment. Under this view, data domains are mixture components, token shares are component proportions, proxy-training runs are experimental design points, and validation loss defines a response surface over the probability simplex. We develop this formulation using sparse second-order Scheffé response-surface models and construct model-robust $\mathcal{I}$-optimal designs for proxy data-mixing experiments. Using RegMix as an empirical case study, we demonstrate how the framework can both interpret observed mixture responses and design more efficient proxy experiments. The Scheffé analysis shows that domain value is strongly relational: several domains that are weak under additive effects become favourable through pairwise interactions, especially through combinations with web-derived text. The sparse Scheffé model preserves mixture rankings across model scales and remains competitive with a flexible machine-learning predictor while providing an explicit decomposition of additive and interaction effects. In a simulation study calibrated to observed proxy-training responses, model-robust $\mathcal{I}$-optimal designs recover the relevant mixture ordering after removing about 25\% of the original proxy runs. These results suggest that LLM data mixing should be treated not only as a prediction problem, but also as an experimental-design problem in which the proxy mixtures themselves can be chosen to improve statistical efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大语言模型预训练中的数据混合问题重新建模为经典的混料实验（mixture experiment），提出使用稀疏二阶Scheffé响应面模型来分解领域主效应与成对交互效应，并构建模型稳健的ℐ-最优设计以提高代理实验效率。基于RegMix公开数据进行实证分析，发现领域价值具有强关系性（特别是与web文本的组合效应），且最优设计可在去除约25%代理运行后恢复混合排序。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练中的数据混合是一个核心设计问题：在固定预算下需决定各领域数据的分配比例。现有的基于代理模型的方法（如DoReMi、RegMix、Data Mixing Laws）通过训练小模型来预测最优混合，但这些方法将混合比例视为普通回归变量，忽略了比例数据固有的单纯形几何约束；此外，代理混合的选择通常采用随机Dirichlet采样，缺乏对设计效率的考量。
AI.method: 1. 将代理数据混合重新表述为混料实验：数据领域=混料成分，token份额=成分比例，代理运行=实验设计点，验证损失=响应面。2. 使用稀疏二阶Scheffé多项式模型（带L1惩罚）拟合响应面，显式分解加性主效应与成对交互效应。3. 构建模型稳健的ℐ-最优设计（在第一阶和第二阶Scheffé候选模型下平均），通过模拟退火算法优化。4. 基于RegMix公开数据集（17个Pile领域、512个代理运行、1M/60M/1B三个评估尺度）进行实证，使用Spearman秩相关和成对排序准确率（PRA）评估。
AI.result: 1. Scheffé模型可解释地揭示领域价值的关系性：arxiv、pubmed_central、freelaw、github等在加性效应下较弱，但通过与pile_cc的成对交互变得有利。2. 稀疏二阶Scheffé模型在跨尺度排序保持上与LightGBM有竞争力（1B尺度下ρ=0.975 vs 0.962），同时提供可解释分解。3. 模型稳健ℐ-最优设计在去除约25%代理运行后即可匹配原始512次运行的排序性能，相对Dirichlet设计的ℐ-效率约为0.07-0.08。
AI.conclusion: LLM数据混合不仅应被视为预测问题，还应被视为实验设计问题。Scheffé响应面模型提供了显式的加性与交互效应分解，揭示领域价值的关系本质；最优设计可显著提高代理实验的统计效率。框架可推广到多模态训练、领域自适应、多语言训练等场景。未来工作方向包括：将模型尺度作为过程变量（混料-过程实验）、序贯自适应设计等。

title: Evolutionary Recurrent Decision Model in Developing Adaptive and Maladaptive Behaviors
summary: This study introduces the evolutionarily recurrent decision model (ERDM), a computational reinforcement learning framework designed to examine how evolutionary mismatch, bounded rationality, and satisficing contribute to adaptive and maladaptive behavior. ERDM simulates agents across evolutionary recurrent environments, including threat, prey/goal-pursuits, and alliances. Agents learn through competing rewards abstracted from survival metrics. A validity study under varying adverse childhood experiences demonstrates that distinct adaptive and maladaptive strategies, such as learned helplessness, avoidance, healthy relationships, and aggression, emerge naturally without being hardwired. These results align with empirical literature, showcasing ecological validity. The results suggest that many psychopathology-relevant aspects may be interpreted as bounded cognitive systems operating under modern-ancestral environmental mismatch, positioning ERDM as a key computational cognitive tool that can be extended to other studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出进化递归决策模型（ERDM），一种基于强化学习的计算框架，用于探讨进化失配、有限理性与满意决策如何塑造适应性及适应不良行为，并通过模拟不同童年逆境经历下的智能体，自然涌现出习得性无助、回避、健康关系与攻击性等多样化策略。
AI.motivation: 心理学与精神病理学领域长期关注人类在现代环境下的适应不良行为，但传统模型难以统一解释进化失配、有限理性和满意决策如何共同作用。论文旨在构建一个可计算的认知框架，从进化与认知约束的角度整合解释适应性及病理学相关行为。
AI.method: 构建基于强化学习的ERDM框架，让智能体在威胁、捕猎/目标追求、联盟等进化递归环境中学习；通过抽象自生存度量的竞争性奖励驱动策略形成；通过设置不同童年逆境经历（ACEs）进行效度研究，观察策略的自然涌现。
AI.result: 在不同的ACEs条件下，习得性无助、回避、健康关系、攻击性等适应性及适应不良策略均自然涌现，无需硬编码；模拟结果与实证文献一致，表现出良好的生态效度。
AI.conclusion: 许多精神病理学相关现象可被视为在现代-祖先环境失配下运作的有限认知系统；ERDM作为一个可扩展的计算认知工具，有望应用于更广泛的认知与临床研究。

title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight
summary: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: rejecting everything catches everything. Measuring this needs boundary variation alone and a matched clean control. We introduce the twin-prefix framework, which supplies both. Each gold plan yields a prefix with one injected, environment-accepted error and a clean twin differing in one write. Judging each pair at five nested lengths ties verdict changes to the unit alone. Discrimination is scored by pre-registered informedness, catch minus false rejection. Longer review raises catch; false rejection climbs in lockstep. Informedness peaks at one or two actions for all six judges in both domains: longer windows make zero-shot monitors more rejective, not more discriminative. Replaying withheld observations traces the failure largely to observation deprivation. Safety cases should state the unit and co-report the clean series. Our framework is the first controlled, pre-registered instrument for this choice and never reads catch alone. Our calibrated short unit recovers up to 0.95 informedness over eight-action review, and no tested label-blind policy consistently beats it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 twin-prefix 框架,系统研究预执行 LLM 监督中"验证单元"(每次调用审查的动作数 L)对易错监控器的影响。研究发现,延长审查窗口虽然提升了错误检出率(catch),但也同比例提升了对正确动作的错误拒绝率(FR),因此信息度(Youden J = catch − FR)在所有六个判断器与两个领域中均在 L=1 或 L=2 处达到峰值,更长窗口使零样本监控器更"倾向拒绝"而非更具判别力。失败主因是"观察剥夺":重放被扣留的观察后,长窗口的信息度损失大部分恢复。结论是安全性论证应明示验证单元并共同报告清洁序列。
AI.motivation: AI 控制中的预执行监督依赖易错 LLM 监控器;现有设计将"每次调用审查多少动作"(验证单元)视为固定参数,但其对监控器判别能力的影响从未被控制性测量。自然轨迹中,审查长度与错误类型、位置共变,无法分离;且单看 catch 指标会误导——全盘拒绝即可"捕获一切",但判别力为零。因此需要一种控制性的、可预设的测量工具,孤立审查窗口变化对判别力的影响。
AI.method: twin-prefix 框架:对每个 gold 计划,注入一个环境接受、位置固定的错误,生成"坏"前缀及其匹配的"清洁孪生"(仅末步写动作不同),在五个嵌套长度 L∈{1,2,3,5,8} 下进行配对共评估;采用预注册的 Youden 信息度 J=catch−FR 衡量判别力;加入得分模式 AUC 与成本感知规则用于单元选择。覆盖六个判断器(三个开源 Qwen2.5-14B/72B、Llama-3.3-70B,三个闭源 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol)、两个领域(τ² 零售、AppWorld);辅助实验包括观察重放干预、占位渲染、惰性填充控制、三向 ACCEPT/REJECT/DEFER 探测、推理预算剂量对照、合成双步错误语料、短窗口训练等。
AI.result: 1. catch 随 L 单调上升(0.765→0.970,主验证器,零售),清洁 FR 也同步上升(0.419→0.935),J 在 L=2 达到峰值 0.602,L=8 崩塌至 0.035;六个判断器、两个领域均呈此模式。2. 重放被扣留的观察后,零售 J(8) 从 0.035 恢复至 0.490,AppWorld 恢复 38%——失败主因为"观察剥夺"。3. 无任何标签盲策略(裁决池化、工具级路由器、自置信信号)能持续超越校准的固定短单元;只有标签感知 oracle 能显著超越,带来 0.14–0.53 的余量。4. 成本与不对称错误加权均无法"买回"长窗口的判别力损失。短窗口训练不能泛化到长窗口,而全长度监督可在见过长度内修复崩塌。
AI.conclusion: 对于零样本易错 LLM 监控器,延长验证单元并未带来更好的判别力,而是增加了"倾向拒绝"。校准的固定短单元(L=1 或 L=2)是被测标签盲策略类中的近优选择;安全性论证应明示所用验证单元,并共同报告清洁序列,而非仅报告 catch。开放问题是忠实的观察预测——部署侧可行的替代手段尚未解决。

title: Recursive Agentic Reasoning
summary: Test-time reasoning methods such as iterative refinement, decomposition, and repeated sampling are often evaluated in isolation, making their gains difficult to compare across models, benchmarks, and evaluation pipelines. We introduce a unified view of these methods as recursion operators over an agent's reasoning trace: GROW, which deepens a single reasoning path; PRUNE, which decomposes and recomposes the problem; and BRANCH, which samples alternative reasoning paths and selects among them. We evaluate all three operators against a single-pass chain-of-thought baseline under a shared harness with identical prompts, token budgets, and grading code. Across five benchmarks and three frontier models, comprising 14 model-benchmark settings, 49,327 graded items, and 151,876 model calls, BRANCH improves accuracy in all 14 settings by an average of 5.98 percentage points and is the best-performing operator in 12. In contrast, GROW yields a mean gain of 2.18 points and degrades performance in two settings, while PRUNE improves accuracy by 0.94 points on average. Analysis shows that BRANCH's advantage arises not only from exploring multiple reasoning paths, but also from recovering from truncation: its gains strongly correlate with the baseline rate of empty, budget-exhausted outputs (r = 0.72). These results weaken the hypothesis that different problems require routing among test-time reasoning operators; at this level of abstraction, repeated branching is consistently dominant. Finally, we show that unpaired evaluation and treating scoring-pipeline failures as model errors can materially change, and even reverse, comparative conclusions, motivating paired scoring as a standard protocol for test-time-compute evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将测试时推理方法统一为推理轨迹上的三种递归算子(GROW、PRUNE、BRANCH),在5个基准和3个前沿模型上进行受控对比实验,发现BRANCH(采样投票)在所有14个设置中均优于单次思维链基线,平均提升5.98个百分点,其优势主要源于对预算耗尽导致的空输出的恢复而非推理路径的边际化。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时推理方法(迭代精炼、分解、重复采样)通常在各自独立的基准、模型和评分器上评估,增益难以直接比较。研究者希望回答一个实际问题:在相同计算预算下,哪种方法应被选用?是否存在需要根据问题路由选择不同算子的必要性?
AI.method: 1)将测试时推理形式化为推理轨迹上的递归算子,定义三种算子:GROW(沿单一路径加性递归,基于答案稳定性停止)、PRUNE(分解问题为子问题并求解后重组)、BRANCH(N=5次独立采样后多数投票);2)构建共享求解原语solve,包含对预算耗尽空输出的finalization重试机制;3)在14个模型×基准单元上进行配对评分(所有算子在相同题目集上评估),排除而非惩罚基础设施故障;4)在3个推理模型和5个基准(MuSiQue、HLE、BBEH、SuperGPQA、Omni-MATH)上对比,共49,327道评分项、151,876次模型调用。
AI.result: BRANCH在全部14个单元上均提升精度(平均+5.98点,12个单元为最佳),GROW平均+2.18点(2个单元为负),PRUNE平均+0.94点;BRANCH增益与基线空输出率高度相关(r=0.72),表明其优势主要来自对预算耗尽导致的空回答的恢复(空输出率约减半),而非推理路径边际化;Qwen3.6-plus从不产生空输出,也是BRANCH增益最小的模型;非配对评分曾导致约3.6点的虚假回归,可逆转结论。
AI.conclusion: 在算子粒度上,重复采样投票一致优于单次推理和分解方法,自适应算子路由假设不被数据支持;长期推理模型在有限预算下,重复采样的主要收益是恢复预算耗尽的回答,因此应直接针对该失败模式优化;配对评分与基础设施错误分离应成为测试时计算评估的标准协议。

title: More GPUs or a Smaller Cache? Tensor Parallelism versus KV Compression for Memory-Bound LLM Serving
summary: When an LLM serving deployment runs out of KVcache room, there are two well-established ways out. Tensor parallelism shards the weights and the KV cache across two, four, or eight devices, buying memory headroom at the price of an all-reduce on every layer and a hardware bill that grows with the device count. The algorithms community shrinks the cache in place, with KV quantisation and eviction keeping a single GPU and spending a little quality instead. Compression papers report memory ratios, parallel-scaling papers report throughput curves, and almost nobody puts the two on the same cost axis. We place tensor-parallel configurations (degree 1 to 8) and KV-compressed configurations (16/8/4-bit, keep-ratios down to 0.25) on one costnormalised axis, cost per million tokens against latency, using a profiled simulator calibrated on A100, A40, and H100 hardware, and we go looking for the cost-equivalence crossover. We do not find one. Across two models (Llama-2 at 7B and 70B), three GPU types, and every level of memory relief we could construct, compression is cheaper by 1.20x to 2.00x. A 7B model on an 80 GB device cannot exhaust its KV budget within its own context window, and the boundary that decides between the strategies is model size relative to device memory, at roughly 36B parameters for an 80 GB card. Below that wall, compression dominates and extra GPUs are largely wasted spend; above it, tensor parallelism stops being a choice and becomes an entry ticket: Llama-2-70B is infeasible on one A100 at any KV setting, because the binding resource is weights, which KV compression does not touch. Tensor parallelism is the only lever that improves latency (compression makes per-token latency worse, by 8 to 93%, through batching contention), while compression is the only lever that multiplies capacity per dollar (16.5x, against 1.21x for an eightfold spend on GPUs).

AI.tldr: 本文系统对比了两种解决LLM推理中KV Cache内存不足的主流方案：张量并行（TP, 1-8卡）与KV Cache压缩（量化至16/8/4-bit + 淘汰至keep-ratio 0.25）。基于Vidur模拟器在A100/A40/H100上对Llama-2-7B/70B的评测表明：不存在成本等价交叉点；在所有匹配的内存缓解水平上，压缩比TP便宜1.20×–2.00×；真正的决策边界由"模型参数量相对于设备显存"决定（约36B参数@80GB卡，fp16权重），而非上下文长度或批大小；TP是唯一的延迟改善手段，压缩则是唯一的"每美元容量倍增"手段（16.5× vs 1.21×）。
AI.motivation: 张量并行（系统社区）和KV压缩（算法社区）作为两种逃逸KV Cache内存上限的标准方案，分属两个几乎不互通的研究体系：前者报告吞吐量/扩展曲线，后者报告内存压缩比，二者从未被放到同一成本轴上比较。基础设施负责人面对固定模型、质量底线与延迟目标时，无法判断"加卡"与"压缓存"哪个更划算。论文动机正是填补这一缺失的成本归一化对比。
AI.method:
方法学核心是构造一条成本归一化Pareto前沿：
1. 控制变量：固定模型（Llama-2-7B/70B）、质量底线、延迟目标；
2. 张量并行侧：扫描TP∈{1,2,4,8}，权重与KV按1/p分片，叠加all-reduce通信开销（采用Vidur测得的集合通信实测数据，而非拟合系数），成本乘以设备数p；
3. 压缩侧：扫描bit-width∈{16,8,4} × keep-ratio∈{1.0,0.5,0.25}，按Eq.(3)精确修改Vidur内存规划器；
4. 成本模型：cost/Mtok = (c_gpu/hr · p) / (3600 · throughput) × 10^6；
5. 可行性约束（Eq.(4)）：权重 + 批KV ≤ M_dev·(1-μ)，不可行配置显式记录；
6. 在"匹配内存缓解"（matched KV relief）层级上两两对比，并做去量化开销的敏感性反转分析；
7. 所有结果打S（模拟）或E（精确）标签。
AI.result:
1. **无交叉点**：Llama-2-7B在A100-80GB上，W2工作负载下，INT8已比fp16/TP1更便宜更快；匹配缓解层级压缩便宜1.20×（TP2 vs INT8）→1.50×（TP4 vs INT4）→1.89×（TP8 vs INT4+k50），差距随缓解加深而扩大；
2. **机制分解**（Fig.6E）：每美元并发容量，TP从29.0仅升至35.1（+21%），压缩从29.0飙至479.0（16.5×）；
3. **7B不会真正内存饱和**：fp16/TP1在最大4096上下文下仍可容纳29并发请求，OOM需131072 tokens（超上下文32×）；
4. **可行性墙约36B@80GB**（Fig.8）：CodeLlama-34B（61.9GB，可行）与Llama-2-70B（127.5GB，OOM）之间；70B即使INT4+k25在TP1仍不可行——瓶颈是权重，压缩无法触及；
5. **70B上压缩仍胜**：相对fp16/TP2基线，INT8便宜1.10×、INT4便宜1.56×；
6. **70B出现U型曲线**：TP2满载时升到TP4获3.38×吞吐仅2×价（169%效率），W1成本降41%、W2降14%，但TP8之后成本回升；
7. **三硬件一致**：H100 1.25×–2.00×、A40虽便宜但吞吐劣势使其非最廉价部署；压缩在每张卡上都赢；
8. **敏感性**：压缩需损失16.8%–47.0%吞吐给去量化开销，结论才会反转，远超已发表低bit KV kernel的开销；
9. **压缩代价**：TPOT P50在7B上升8%，在70B上升93%（批处理争用导致）。
AI.conclusion:
结论核心：两种策略并非可互换的替代方案，而是**互补机制**——
- **张量并行=可行性机制**：唯一能突破权重墙的手段，每美元容量近成本中性；
- **KV压缩=容量机制**：每美元容量16.5×倍增，但无法动权重，一旦内存不再紧张即"惰性"（Fig.3三点重合）；
- **唯一延迟杠杆是TP**：压缩使per-token延迟恶化8–93%。

**实用决策规则（Table VI）**：
- 权重超设备显存（fp16下≈36B@80GB）→ 取p_min=⌈2W/M⌉ TP，压缩不可替代；
- p_min自身内存饱和 → 再升一级（超线性收益）；
- 权重可装、KV仍绑定 → 先压缩；
- 权重可装、KV不绑定 → 两者皆可不取（压缩已惰性）；
- 延迟目标未达 → TP（4.5× TTFT P99降幅）；
- 质量底线禁止压缩 → TP。

**未来工作优先级**：闭合质量评估（决定压缩上限的关键力）；实测低bit KV decode kernel锚点；在量化权重下重新定位可行性墙位置。

title: Giraffe: A Mapping Architecture from Hidden Text Representations to Visual Embeddings for Efficient Graphic Design
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in understanding and interpreting mul- timedia content. However, their ability to generate me- dia remains limited. Recent approaches have attempted to bridge this gap by translating the hidden representations of token sequences into the embedding space of visual models or directly into raw image data. However, these methods often represent each image using multiple specialised to- kens which significantly increases the input length. This be- comes a major limitation for tasks such as graphic design generation where the output typically involves a seamless blend of thousands of tokens across text, multiple images, and layout information. To address this challenge, a novel architecture is proposed that maps hidden token represen- tations to the embedding space of visual models, such as CLIP ViT-L/14, using a single [IMG] token per image. The architecture employs two shallow MLP blocks, each with a separate compression module followed by a shared expan- sion module, trained with six distinct loss functions. One block aids the other during training and is omitted during inference, resulting in a lightweight solution. Strong perfor- mance is demonstrated in both image-to-design and text-to- design generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Giraffe的新型映射架构，仅使用单个[IMG]令牌将语言模型的隐藏表示映射到视觉模型（如CLIP ViT-L/14）的嵌入空间，从而高效生成长序列文本与图像交织的图形设计。该架构由两个浅层MLP块组成，每个块包含独立的压缩模块和共享的扩展模块，使用六种损失函数训练，推理时移除辅助块以保持轻量化。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在视觉内容生成方面能力有限。现有方法（如GILL、Emu、Chameleon等）通常需要多个视觉令牌来表示单张图像，这显著增加了输入序列长度。在图形设计生成任务中，一个设计往往包含文本、多张图像、SVG形状和布局信息等多模态元素的交织序列，多令牌表示会导致序列过长甚至超出模型最大令牌容量，同时Transformer有限的注意力范围也难以捕捉长序列中的依赖关系，从而限制了复杂设计的生成。
AI.method: Giraffe架构包含两个浅层MLP块（呈L形结构）：(1) 主MLP块：包含压缩模块f_θ1（1024→768→512）和共享扩展模块f'_θs（768→1024→1024），将语言模型最后一层[IMG]令牌的隐藏表示映射为归一化视觉嵌入；(2) 辅助MLP块：包含自身的压缩模块f''_θ2（1024→768→512→512），与主块共享扩展模块f'_θs，作为自编码器运行。训练时使用六种损失函数：主块的MSE损失和余弦相似度损失、辅助块的MSE损失和余弦相似度损失、两个infoNCE对比损失（在两个瓶颈之间对齐）以及标准的下一令牌预测交叉熵损失。推理时移除辅助块，将映射得到的嵌入通过FLUX配合CLIP ViT-L/14 IP Adapter生成真实图像，无需微调扩散模型。
AI.result: 在180万专业设计的私有数据集上训练。文本到设计任务中，使用Gemma3 4B语言模型训练56000步，FID得分66.85，显著优于基线模型（81.61），生成的设计在布局多样性、风格一致性和色彩协调性方面均优于基线。图像到设计任务中，使用500M参数的编解码Transformer训练187000步，CLIP余弦相似度达0.85±0.05，生成的图形设计在语义、风格和色彩上与GPT-4o生成的输入图像高度一致。
AI.conclusion: Giraffe架构通过单个[IMG]令牌即可有效捕捉图像的语义、风格和颜色信息，使语言模型能够生成长序列、多图像交织的复杂图形设计。该架构轻量化（推理时仅保留主MLP块），无需微调扩散模型，具有良好的灵活性和可扩展性，可推广至音频、视频等其他模态。

title: When Seeing Is Not Enough: Benchmarking Interactive Visual Grounding in LVLMs
summary: Visual grounding is typically evaluated as a one-shot mapping from an informative referring expression to a visual target. This formulation misses a central property of real-world reference: target information is often incomplete, ambiguous, and established through interaction. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework for interactive visual grounding in large vision-language models (LVLMs), varying how much target information is provided upfront and how much must be acquired through dialogue. Across four human-grounded visual contexts and four interaction protocols, current LVLMs perform significantly below task-level human baselines. Interaction can help when follow-up questions refine or repair an initial target description. Performance is lowest when no initial description is provided and target information must be acquired through questions, indicating that proactive question-driven grounding remains difficult. LVLMs are also poorly calibrated, often reporting confidence that exceeds their empirical accuracy. Follow-up studies confirm these patterns across varied description sources (human versus AI), reasoning efforts, repeated interactions, description providers, and visual contexts. Overall, interactive visual grounding remains an important challenge, requiring visual matching, information seeking and synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）提出了一套受控的交互式视觉定位（interactive visual grounding）评测框架，核心发现是：当前 LVLM 在需要通过主动提问来建立指代的任务上显著落后于人类基线，并且普遍存在过度自信的校准问题。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉定位评测将任务建模为一次性映射——给定充分信息量的指代表达，模型直接选择视觉目标。然而真实场景中，目标信息往往不完整、模糊，需要通过多轮交互逐步建立共同基础（common ground）。现有基准无法区分模型的视觉匹配能力与信息获取/综合能力。
AI.method: 1. 提出四种交互协议：Static（完整描述一次性匹配）、Full（完整描述+可选追问）、Partial（仅给欠描述+追问）、None（无描述+通过是/否问题主动获取信息），系统控制初始信息量与必须通过对话获取的信息量。2. 任务形式化为 Director（持有目标集合）与 Matcher（持有候选集合）的多目标指代游戏。3. 在四个人类标注的视觉语境（狗、篮筐×2、tangrams）上评测 8 个 LVLM。4. 主要指标：准确率、提问率、校准（置信度-准确率）、自我修正。5. 配套 5 项后续研究（AI 描述源、推理强度、重复轮次、替代 Director、人脸域），共产生 38,848 次目标选择。
AI.result: 1. 所有 LVLM 匹配器在四种协议下均显著低于任务级人类基线，差距在 tangrams 上最大（最大达 -83.2%）。2. Full 协议下 7/8 模型相对 Static 有提升，说明追问可优化或修正初始描述。3. None 协议下所有模型表现最差（即使提问最多），表明主动提问驱动的定位仍是核心短板。4. 模型普遍过度自信：置信度系统性高于实际准确率，在 Partial/None 下尤甚。5. 模型规模与专有性带来明显提升梯度（Gemini-3.1-Pro 最强），但 GPT-5.5 在 None 上表现最佳，提示更强的推理与整合能力。6. AI 生成描述比人类描述更易被模型理解，但协议级模式一致。7. 推理强度在 Full 下提升明显但很快平台化；重复轮次下模型可改善但仍不及人类。8. 替换 Director 后模型排名高度稳定（Spearman ρ≥0.929）；人脸域验证了协议梯度的普适性。9. 自我修正（self-repair）发生率不足 2%，且修复方向不一致。
AI.conclusion: 交互式视觉定位作为融合视觉匹配、信息搜寻与多轮综合的任务，对当前 LVLM 仍是重要挑战。现有模型在静态匹配上接近饱和，但在需要主动提问、识别信息不足、跨轮合成答案的场景下能力不足，且置信度校准差。未来工作应在更开放场景（空间关系、杂乱场景）、开放问答主控、以及子能力分解上展开。

title: Rules Before Oracles: Auditable, User-Configurable Argument Selection for Deliberative Polling
summary: In a deliberative poll, once submissions outnumber what anyone will read, some mechanism chooses which arguments each voter sees, acquiring much of the decision; practice delegates it to opaque learned rankers, so a voter cannot recompute or contest the exposure that shaped their vote. We ask whether it can be a published rule over publicly recomputable evidence with parameters held by the voter, treating legibility as an admissibility condition on usable mechanisms, not an objective traded against accuracy. We formalise a poll over bipolar justification sets, judging a slate by reason coverage, the order it arrives in, and captured endorsement mass; we give seven checkable criteria for a civic recommender and a rule meeting them: a one-hop reversed endorsement flow parameterised by a relation-weight function. An agentic simulator records every slate at every vote, over about 17,000 seed-paired runs. Served slates fall 0.035 short of a label-reading ceiling upper-bounding every selection procedure, opaque ones included: any unconstrained ranker's advantage is bounded and small. On coverage alone, with non-degenerate authoring, the rule is indistinguishable from a random slate, a null due to an order-blind, charity-blind instrument; on the other two it leads at every prefix by a margin widening with adversarial pressure and dominates on mass by a factor of 3.3. Once a realistic fraction of submissions carries no reasons, the coverage margin returns and grows. Label-homogeneous flooding collapses completeness from 0.81 to 0.34 under a flat weight policy, only to 0.44 under author-count normalisation, making the weight function a security control worth 10% of completeness. The choice between ranking arms is a position on a coverage-versus-mass frontier, not a fact, the kind of choice only a legible rule can hand to the person it affects. It maps onto an open-source peer-to-peer platform.

AI.tldr: 本文针对协商性民意调查中"哪些论据呈现给选民"这一选择步骤，提出将可审计性视为机制的可采纳性条件而非与准确性权衡的目标。作者形式化了一个基于双极论证集的替代性投票模型，提出七项可检验的"公民推荐器"标准，并设计了一条满足所有标准的规则——单跳反向背书流（关系权重函数为唯一策略参数）。通过约17,000次智能体模拟运行，结果显示语义自律的代价仅为覆盖率0.031，且权重策略作为安全控制可抵御约15-18%的完整性损失。
AI.motivation: 在协商性民意调查中，当提交的论据数量远超任何人能阅读的范围时，某机制必须决定每位选民看到哪些论据——这一选择实际上掌握了大部分决策权。当代实践将此委托给不透明的学习排序器，导致参与者无法重新计算、归因或质疑塑造其投票的曝光过程。作者主张：在约束性公民程序中，选择步骤应是民主程序的一部分，应是可提前公布的规则、基于可公开重新计算的证据、参数由个体选民持有。
AI.method: 1) 将投票形式化为双极论证集上的替代性信息系统，定义三个互补的评估工具：活态理由词汇的集合覆盖度、前缀敏感的顺序度量、捕获的背书质量；2) 给出Subsuming Justification Problem（SJP）及其贪心子模上界（仅作评估天花板）；3) 提出七项可检验标准（确定性、证据局部性、作者盲视、语义自律、可重现性、可争议性、可配置性）；4) 设计满足所有标准的规则——单跳反向背书流，其唯一策略参数为关系权重函数；5) 构建Abas智能体模拟器（N个选民智能体），记录每次投票时的每个名单，约17,000次种子配对运行。
AI.result: 1) 语义自律的代价：服务名单与标签读取贪心上界之间的覆盖率差距仅为0.031±0.014（占上界的3.7%），不可恢复的损失中80%以上是时间性而非算法性的；2) 在非退化创作下，规则在集合覆盖率上与随机选择统计上不可区分——这是顺序盲视和慈善盲视工具的伪影；3) 在顺序敏感度量上，规则在每个前缀均领先随机基线，优势随对抗压力增大，在四分之一选民间联盟下e90减少5.69个位置；4) 一旦现实比例的提交缺乏理由，覆盖率差距重现并单调增长，链接项贡献91%差距——通过平方选民自身已行使的歧视；5) 在背书质量上随机基线输3.3倍；6) 枢纽搭便车无害，标签泛洪则严重——作者计数归一化权重策略可保留0.151-0.181的完整性免受四分之一联盟攻击；7) 同质性贡献约80%的泛洪崩溃；8) 协调签名联盟使自己单调变弱。
AI.conclusion: 可审计性应被视为公民机制的入场条件而非可与准确性交易的目标。语义自律（不读取论据内容）的代价可测量且小（约3%的覆盖率），主要由词汇成熟度而非选择质量驱动。安全控制存在于一行公开的策略参数中（作者归一化），而非检测器中。排名规则在覆盖率与背书质量之间形成的边界是一个需要由受影响的个人选择的位置，而非系统可代为作出的事实。该构造可映射至现有的开源P2P平台DDP2P，使可配置性从运营者的让步转变为基础结构性属性。最关键的下一步是经验性地测量人类选民政党在多大程度上歧视无理由的提交。

title: Memory Is Not Always Needed: Characterizing Conditional Memory in Scientific Reasoning
summary: Scientific reasoning requires language models to retrieve specialized knowledge and incorporate it reliably into multi-step computation. Conditional memory provides an explicit lookup pathway that complements dense neural representations, but its usefulness is inherently input- and computation-dependent: retrieved information may repair missing scientific associations, yet it may also introduce distracting shortcuts or interfere with reasoning that the base model can already perform correctly. In this work, we systematically investigate when, where, and to what extent conditional memory should participate in scientific reasoning. We characterize the scientific knowledge boundary and controlled interventions on memory-enabled knowledge-circuit nodes. Based on these analyses, we propose a Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router that uses task-specific input proxies available before generation to determine whether memory is activated, which layer-stage nodes receive memory signals, and how strongly these signals contribute. Experiments on biological and chemical reasoning benchmarks, covering two backbone families and six task types, show that memory effects vary substantially across inputs, tasks, and injection locations. Compared with static and activation-rate-matched random routing, our approach more consistently preserves beneficial memory contributions while suppressing memory-induced regressions, establishing selective memory allocation as an important principle for reliable scientific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了条件记忆(conditional memory)在科学推理中何时、何地以及以何种强度参与计算的问题。通过分析记忆无关基础模型的科学知识边界,并对记忆启用知识电路节点进行受控干预,提出了一种知识边界感知路由器(Knowledge Boundary-Aware Router)。实验涵盖两个骨干网络家族和六个任务类型,结果表明记忆效应在输入、任务和注入位置上差异显著,选择性记忆分配比静态或随机路由更可靠地保留有益贡献并抑制有害干扰。
AI.motivation: 科学推理需要语言模型检索专业知识并可靠地整合到多步计算中。条件记忆提供了补充密集神经表示的显式查找路径,但其效用本质上取决于输入和计算——检索信息可能修复缺失的科学关联,也可能引入干扰性捷径或干扰基础模型已能正确执行的基础模型已经能正确执行的推理。因此需要系统研究条件记忆在科学推理中何时何地发挥作用。
AI.method: 1. 行为科学知识边界表征:定义三元行为边界代码 q_i = (b_i^A, b_i^R, b_i^P),分别标记最终答案失败、推理步骤失败和预测不稳定性,用于离线分析。2. 知识电路视角:将每个层-阶段对 v=(l,s)定义为知识电路节点,实现受控因果衰减以分离记忆可用性与效用。3. 知识边界感知路由器:包含外部边界感知数据路由器(基于任务特定输入代理进行全局记忆访问决策)和内部边界感知参数路由器(配置层-阶段知识电路节点及其贡献强度)。外部路由器使用任务特定特征的量化分桶评分,内部路由器映射上下文到层选择、阶段选择和节点缩放系数。所有路由参数通过超参数搜索在现有推理样本上校准,推理时不使用参考答案或替代模型输出。
AI.result: 在BioProBench和ChemCoTBench上的实验显示:(1)无条件记忆并非普遍有益——在Qwen3上Memory+LoRA虽提升ERR准确率但急剧降低PQA;(2)知识边界感知路由器在Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3-8B两个家族的大多数指标上达到最佳,如BioProBench ERR的Qwen3准确率达0.63(基线0.60),ChemCoTBench MolEdit的Qwen3准确率达0.59(基线0.43);(3)消融实验证实记忆效应在边界群体间变化方向相反(Bio PI提升2.09/1.82分,Chem PI下降4.45/3.81分);(4)特征路由在所有设置中优于激活率匹配的随机路由;(5)任务特定的层-阶段放置存在差异——晚层(27-28)最优于ERR,中层(15-16)最优于PQA;(6)Engram适配器在解析成功率上优于MeKi记忆专家架构。
AI.conclusion: 记忆并非在科学推理中始终需要:其价值取决于基础模型是否达到知识边界以及检索信号是否进入能利用它们的知识电路节点。通过行为失败指标与受控层-阶段干预的联合表征,验证了条件记忆应被视为选择性计算资源而非均匀有益的增强。知识边界感知路由器通过仅使用推理前输入代理控制全局记忆访问和内部节点贡献,无需参考答案或替代输出,在两个基准、两个骨干家族和六种任务类型上一致优于静态和随机路由基线,确立了选择性记忆分配作为可靠科学推理的重要设计原则。

title: Diverse by Reasoning: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds for Future Prediction
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for future prediction, motivating the use of multiple models as a wisdom-of-the-crowd mechanism. However, simply increasing crowd size does not guarantee effective diversity, as different LLMs may exhibit redundant behaviors. We propose a behavior-aware framework for constructing diverse LLM crowds. The framework characterizes models using their reasoning traces on independent development tasks, clusters models by behavioral similarity, and selects representatives for collective prediction. We evaluate 25 LLMs using seven development benchmarks for behavioral diversity modeling and two future-prediction benchmarks for evaluating diverse crowds' performance. Our results show that crowd composition can matter more than crowd size: a three-model medoid crowd based on K-means++ behavioral clustering outperforms conventional voting over all 25 models on both prediction benchmarks, while reducing model calls by 88% and inference cost by approximately 80%. The results further suggest that representative behavioral diversity, rather than simply maximizing diversity, is important for constructing effective LLM crowds

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种“行为感知”的多 LLM 群体构建方法：利用模型在独立通用任务上的推理轨迹嵌入构建行为签名，再聚类并从各簇选择 medoid 中心模型。25 个模型、350 个开发问题及两个未来预测基准的实验表明，K-means++ 分簇形成的三模型 medoid 群体，在 FutureX-Past 与 BTF-v3 上均优于 25 模型等权投票，同时减少 88% 的调用和约 80% 的实测成本。核心结论不是“差异越大越好”，而是“具有代表性的行为覆盖”更有效。
AI.motivation: 传统多 LLM 投票将每个模型视为同等独立且有效的信息源，但不同模型可能具有高度重复的推理行为；模型数量增加既不能保证行为多样性，也会线性增加推理成本。因此，研究动机是将未来预测中的多模型聚合从“如何投票”转向“应选择哪些模型构成群体”，通过独立任务上的可观察推理行为识别冗余。
AI.method: 框架分为三步：1）让 25 个 LLM 分别回答 7 个通用开发基准中各 50 个问题，共 350 题；用 BAAI/bge-m3 编码推理轨迹，生成问题级嵌入，经 L2 归一化、平均和再次归一化得到模型级行为签名。2）用 K-means++（50 次重启）和凝聚层次聚类进行行为分簇，以轮廓系数及可操作性选择 K=3。3）比较三类群体：每个簇选择一个 medoid；从每簇选择 k=4 个最大化两两距离的代表；或将每个簇作为等权 subcommittee。预测按答案类型聚合：分类题多数/相对多数投票，数值题取中位数，集合题按 F1 选相似性 medoid，有序列表按 OrderedOverlap 选 medoid。未来预测评测使用 FutureX-Past 和 BTF-v3，各随机抽取 100 题；前者按四级难度加权，后者以 0.5 阈值计算准确率。由于部分群体方法使用未来标签，仅性能专家基线采用五折交叉验证；行为聚类及代表选择均完全基于开发任务。
AI.result: K-means++ 的 K=3 解决方案轮廓系数为 0.237，500 次 bootstrap 稳定性为 0.767。其三模型 medoid 群体为 Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct、Kimi-K2.6 和 GPT-5.4，在 FutureX-Past 上得分 0.302、BTF-v3 准确率 0.810；对应 25 模型投票为 0.296 和 0.800。该 medoid 群体在两项基准上同时超过全模型投票和同规模随机群体：在 BTF-v3 的随机三模型组合中处于第 88 百分位，在 FutureX-Past 处于第 83 百分位。每 100 题仅调用 300 次而非 2,500 次，实测成本由 $10.96 降至 $2.10、由 $21.26 降至 $4.51，即降至 19% 和 21%；相对全模型投票成本减少约 80%。最大化簇内差异的策略仅使用 12 个代表但两项得分为 0.272/0.780，不如 medoid；层次聚类及簇级等权投票也没有稳定优势。跨 498 个委员会、在控制群体规模后，行为分歧与 FutureX-Past 得分呈 +0.211 分层相关且七层均为正，但与 BTF-v3 仅呈 −0.010；按分歧直接选群体并不能稳定胜过随机群体，说明行为差异是有效群体的伴随属性，而非普适选择规则。FutureX-Past 的固定字母序平局规则被证明是不利的任意约定；其结果较随机平局解析低 0.0222，因此 FutureX-Past 上各方法的细微差异应谨慎解释。
AI.conclusion: 多 LLM 未来预测中，群体构成可能比群体规模更重要。基于 K-means++ 行为聚类的三模型 medoid 群体以少量调用和成本，在两个基准上同时优于全模型投票，说明在独立任务上识别行为冗余、保留各主要行为簇的代表性模型具有实践价值。但“最大化差异”并不等于“最大化预测质量”，当前结果支持的是代表性行为覆盖，而不是无约束的多样性。方法仍受限于静态单一群体、平均嵌入可能掩盖任务条件行为，以及仅 25 个模型、两个基准和每个基准 100 题；未来可研究更丰富的行为表示、动态或任务感知群体，并联合考虑多样性、代表性和预测能力。

title: Incorporating Cognitive Load and Knowledge Transfer for Multi-Domain Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to assess students' dynamic knowledge states from their learning histories. While most existing KT methods focus on single-domain learning with notable success, real-world learning scenarios often involve multiple domains simultaneously, introducing two critical factors: 1) Cognitive load, arising from managing learning across domains in both temporal and knowledge dimensions. 2) Knowledge transfer, where knowledge states in one domain influence related states both within and across domains. In this paper, we focus on exploring these factors to improve students' knowledge state assessment in multi-domain learning scenarios and propose a novel method incorporating cognitive Load and knowledge Transfer for Multi-domain Knowledge Tracing (LT-MKT). Specifically, to bridge isolated domains, LT-MKT first integrates textual information from questions and their associated concepts to construct a Multi-domain Hierarchical Graph, leveraging the advanced representational capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Then, cross-domain features in both the temporal and knowledge dimensions are explicitly modeled to capture the effects of cognitive load. Additionally, a knowledge transfer module is designed to model the propagation of knowledge states within and across domains. By jointly modeling these factors, LT-MKT enables more accurate prediction of students' future performance. Finally, extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LT-MKT模型,首次在多领域知识追踪中联合建模认知负荷与知识迁移,通过构建多领域层次图、认知负荷驱动状态演化、领域感知知识迁移模块,在四个真实数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪(KT)方法主要面向单领域学习场景,而现实学习场景(如GRE考试)常涉及多领域同时学习,带来两个关键挑战:1)认知负荷——学生在时间维度(领域切换)和知识维度(单题跨多领域)上的额外认知负担;2)知识迁移——跨领域及领域内的知识状态传播与相互影响。传统单领域KT方法忽略了这两个因素,导致知识状态评估不准确。
AI.method: LT-MKT方法包含四个核心模块:1)多领域层次图(MDHG)构建:利用大语言模型(LLMs,默认Qwen-plus)通过思维链推理自动生成问题-概念关联边、领域内先决关系边和跨领域相关关系边,满足DAG无环约束;2)认知负荷驱动状态演化:建模三个关键因素——问题难度(错误率)、领域切换(滑动窗口内跨域次数)、领域覆盖(单题涉及领域数),通过GRU更新知识状态;3)领域感知知识迁移:分解为intGAT(领域内先决传播)和interGAT(跨领域语义关联传播)两层图注意力网络,顺序建模知识传播;4)预测层:融合问题嵌入、认知负荷表示和融合后的知识状态,通过sigmoid输出预测概率,使用二元交叉熵损失优化。
AI.result: 在四个真实多领域数据集(JuniorH、SeniorH、PTADiscJP、PTADiscDS)上与11个基线模型对比,LT-MKT在AUC、ACC、RMSE三个指标上均达到最优(统计显著性p<0.05)。例如在JuniorH上AUC达0.9387,显著优于TransKT(0.9143)和promptKT(0.8981)。消融实验验证了认知负荷、迁移图、状态融合三个模块的贡献。冷启动场景下(19%未见概念)LT-MKT仍保持最优性能,UMAP可视化证实认知负荷模块能学习到清晰的低-高负荷梯度表征。专家评估表明GPT-5 pro在图构建质量(ER 4.66/SC 4.56, Fleiss'κ=0.84)上表现最佳,框架兼容不同LLM骨干。案例研究直观展示了跨领域知识迁移与认知负荷的学习摩擦效应。
AI.conclusion: LT-MKT通过显式建模多领域学习中的认知负荷与知识迁移机制,显著提升了知识状态评估的准确性,为多领域知识追踪提供了有效的统一框架。未来工作将探索融入更丰富的认知信号,并将LT-MKT应用于更广泛的个性化学习与智能辅导场景。

title: Reflection with Action-Induced Visual Differences for Desktop GUI Agents
summary: The Planner-Operator-Reflector (POR) framework is widely used in GUI agents to maintain objective alignment in complex tasks through modular collaboration. However, desktop GUIs introduce a key challenge: large, dense interfaces often exhibit subtle or scattered state changes, placing most of the burden on the reflector, which must compare pre- and post-action screens, while the planner and operator reason over a single state. Existing reflectors collapse change detection and outcome verification into one step, leaving evidence implicit and yielding weakly grounded decisions. To address this limitation, we propose Evidence-First Reflection (EFR), a two-stage reflector that explicitly decouples action-induced visual differences extraction from outcome verification. EFR identifies the action location and candidate changed regions with Set-of-Marks annotations, describes and filters action-relevant changes, and makes the final judgment from the cleaned evidence. This evidence-reasoning decoupled design makes reflection better grounded in screen transitions, while reducing both visual search complexity and reasoning burden. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena demonstrate that EFR improves reflector accuracy by 7.11%, yielding average end-to-end task success gains of 5.94% and 4.95% on the two benchmarks, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evidence-First Reflection (EFR)框架，通过将传统反射器中耦合的页面差异识别与动作结果验证解耦为两阶段推理过程，并利用Set-of-Marks (SoM)注释显式标注变化区域，提升桌面GUI代理反射判断的可靠性与端到端任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 桌面GUI界面大且密集，状态变化往往细微或分散，使反射器负担过重。传统POR框架的反射器将变化检测和结果验证耦合在单步推理中，导致证据隐式、判断依据薄弱，实验中27.35%的失败轨迹源于反射器判断错误，其中70.49%为页面差异识别错误。
AI.method: EFR是两阶段反射器：第一阶段利用SoM在前后动作截图上用红色边界框标注候选变化区域，并在前动作截图上用蓝色圆圈/黄色箭头标注动作位置；VLM基于grounded action（而非intended action）客观描述各区域变化并过滤环境噪声（如时钟刷新），生成cleaned evidence。第二阶段基于cleaned证据、原始intended action和cleaned screenshots进行动作成功判断，输出success label、关键证据和状态摘要。SoM模块通过灰度差异、阈值化、轮廓提取、邻接框合并等步骤生成区域注释（算法1）。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified和WindowsAgentArena两个基准上，使用GUI-Owl-32B、Qwen3-VL-32B、Kimi-K2.5和Seed-1.8四种骨干模型进行三次重复实验。EFR平均提升反射器准确率7.11%（从80.39%到87.50%），端到端任务成功率在两个基准上分别平均提升5.94%和4.95%。反射器准确率与任务成功的Pearson相关系数为0.86。代价方面，每个任务的延迟增加15.8%和13.3%，但平均执行步骤减少11.5%和3.7%。消融实验证实SoM与两阶段判断均不可或缺，移除两阶段判断导致6.70%下降，移除截图仅依赖文本导致10.58%下降。
AI.conclusion: EFR通过显式解耦证据提取与成功判断，使桌面GUI代理的反射建立在可追溯的视觉证据链上，同时降低了视觉搜索复杂度和推理负担。实验验证其在多种模型骨干上均带来稳定提升，但案例分析表明残留错误来源于规划器/操作器的细粒度接地错误、恢复机制不足以及验证器对观察证据的语义理解偏差，这些反映了GUI代理系统中反射之外的更深层挑战。

title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding
summary: Confidence-based voting aggregates parallel LLM rollouts by weighting each with internal signals such as token log probabilities, and has been actively studied for single-turn reasoning. However, modern LLMs increasingly act as multi-turn search agents that retrieve and condition on external documents. In this paper, we show that confidence-based voting transfers poorly to this multi-turn setting, and identify the underlying failure reason as copy inflation: when retrieved documents are appended to an agent's context, tokens copied from those documents receive systematically inflated log probabilities. This flattens confidence scores within each question and weakens the resulting weighted vote. To address this issue, we propose Retrieval-Grounded Voting (RGV), which scores each rollout by the lexical overlap between its final answer and the documents it retrieved. By computing the signal outside the contaminated context, RGV sidesteps both token log probabilities and additional LLM calls. Across four search-agent benchmarks and five LLMs, RGV consistently outperforms confidence-based voting, with gains of up to +5.4% accuracy and +35% on minority-correct questions, where the correct answer appears in only 1-2 of 8 rollouts.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多轮搜索代理中基于置信度的投票方法失效问题，提出了一种新的检索锚定投票（RGV）方法，通过计算答案文本与检索文档之间的词汇重叠作为投票权重，替代被检索文档污染的token对数概率信号。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于置信度（token对数概率）的投票方法在单轮推理中表现良好，但在多轮搜索代理场景中失效，因为检索到的文档被附加到上下文后，从这些文档复制的token的对数概率被系统性地抬高（即"复制膨胀"现象），导致问题内部的置信度分数被压缩，加权投票退化为简单多数投票。
AI.method: 提出检索锚定投票（RGV），其核心思想是将投票信号从被污染的模型上下文外部读取：计算每个rollout的最终答案文本与该rollout检索到的文档之间的词汇重叠（prose-recall）。具体定义为：对每个rollout i，取其答案文本 P_i 和检索文档集 D_i，权重 w_i^RGV = max over d ∈ D_i of |T(P_i) ∩ T(d)| / |T(P_i)|。设计选择包括：max-over-docs以避免无关文档的稀释，以及以答案侧为分母以保持文档长度不变性。
AI.result: 在四个搜索代理基准（BrowseComp-Plus、BrowseComp、GAIA、FRAMES）和五个LLM上，RGV在所有20个benchmark×model组合中均优于简单多数投票和DeepConf，最高提升+5.4%准确率；在少数正确答案问题（8个rollout中仅1-2个正确）上提升+35%。RGV使用4个rollout即可达到DeepConf使用8个rollout的准确率，即在相同准确率下减少一半的推理预算。计算成本极低，每个rollout约0.3ms，无需额外LLM调用或微调。
AI.conclusion: 诊断了多轮搜索代理中复制膨胀机制如何破坏基于对数概率的置信度信号，提出了一种在投票层读取环境派生信号（而非模型内部信号）的解决方案。该原理可推广到其他消费代理token置信度的机制，如早停、路由、弃权和幻觉检测等。局限性包括：RGV继承检索质量（检索失败时信号弱）；衡量的是检索成功而非答案正确性（"良好锚定但错误"的残余错误率约4.2%）；短答案场景下信号减弱。

title: Relative Time Intervals Representation for Word-level Timestamping with Masked Training
summary: Although Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) excel at speech understanding and generation, their capacity for fine-grained, temporally aligned outputs remains underexplored. Our work addresses this gap by enabling SpeechLLMs to jointly model speech content and temporal structure, effectively transforming them from ``content understanding machines" into ``temporal-aware content understanding machines". Specifically, we replace traditional absolute timestamps with relative timestamps, achieving a more compact vocabulary and stronger generalization capabilities. To efficiently infuse timestamp prediction ability into pre-trained large language models, we introduce a hybrid fine-tuning strategy: full-parameter fine-tuning of the timestamp-augmented embedding layer and language model head, combined with LoRA fine-tuning of the decoder layers. Moreover, we design a masked timestamp training objective, preventing the model from over-relying on ground-truth timestamps, and thereby enhancing robustness against noisy real-world annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves significant improvements in timestamp prediction accuracy while maintaining strong speech transcription performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于相对时间间隔的词级时间戳预测方法，通过混合微调策略和时间戳掩码训练目标，在SpeechLLM上实现更优的时间戳预测精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有SpeechLLM在词级时间戳生成任务中存在两大核心问题：绝对时间戳表示依赖固定参考点，存在累积误差传播和长音频泛化能力差的问题，且高时间分辨率下词汇表爆炸严重。
AI.method: 1. 采用相对时间戳表示（相邻单词结束到当前单词的时间间隔），用紧凑词汇表替代绝对时间戳；2. 混合微调策略：时间戳嵌入层和LM head进行全参数微调，解码器层采用LoRA微调；3. 训练策略：联合时间对齐损失（动态加权λ，文本损失+时间戳损失）+ 时间戳掩码正则化（10%概率将前一个时间戳替换为[MASK]，增强对噪声标注的鲁棒性）。
AI.result: 在LibriSpeech和Wenet-Meeting数据集上，相对时间戳方法在所有容差级别（80/160/240ms）均取得最高P/R；在240ms容差下，Wenet-Meeting上P/R达91.13%/86.88%，平均时间差仅30.34ms；ASR任务上WER全面优于基线（LibriSpeech 2.78%，AISHELL-2 2.15%）。消融实验证实TS Loss和时间戳掩码均对性能有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LLM从"内容理解机器"升级为"时间感知内容理解机器"，为长音频时间戳预测提供了可扩展方案，且保持强劲的转录性能。

title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment
summary: When an AI algorithm makes decisions that affect more than one person, aligning it becomes a problem of social choice: how should people's divergent preferences about system behavior be reconciled and aggregated into a single coherent model? The standard approach to aligning frontier AI models$\unicode{x2013}$reinforcement learning from human feedback$\unicode{x2013}$largely sidesteps this question and has poor social choice guarantees. However, it remains unclear what alternative should replace it. We show that, by focusing directly on an algorithm's welfare consequences, the alignment problem can be reformulated as linear optimization over a convex impact space, which makes it amenable to the standard toolkit of welfare economics and mechanism design. This reformulation clarifies how alignment protocols translate into welfare consequences and, conversely, how a social planner's desired constraints on welfare consequences can be translated back into alignment protocols. We apply this transformation to show that voting-by-issues and random-dictatorship mechanisms are strategyproof and unanimous. Demonstrating the reverse direction, we also apply the impact representation to derive a family of alignment protocols that maximize utilitarian social welfare subject to various social desiderata, such as bounds on individual or group harm. We illustrate the welfare implications of these alignment protocols empirically using real human preferences over kidney allocation, charitable food distribution, LLM responses, and trolley problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文将AI对齐问题重新表述为"影响空间"上的线性优化问题，揭示了对齐协议中隐藏的社会选择结构。在线性效用假设下，模型对福利的影响可由一个"影响向量"完全刻画，对齐转化为凸多面体上的线性规划问题，由此可推导出防策略操纵的投票机制族，并构造满足伤害上限、公益精神等社会约束的对齐协议。
AI.motivation: 标准的RLHF方法回避了社会选择问题，缺乏良好的社会选择保证。当AI系统影响多人时，如何调和分歧偏好成为核心难题。需要一个统一的框架来设计既有良好福利保证又可防范策略操纵的对齐机制。
AI.method: 在Bradley-Terry-Luce模型和线性效用假设下，定义模型参数的"影响向量"ψ(θ)作为福利的充分统计量，证明影响集合Ψ̄是由部署查询生成的原点对称zonotope。进而将社会对齐问题转化为凸多面体上的线性优化：max_{ψ∈Ψ̄} θ̄_w^T ψ。利用zonotope的中心对称性，刻画防策略操纵(option-set)的对齐机制族，得到voting-by-issues和随机独裁机制，并证明随机独裁可由单一模型参数实现。进一步通过线性不等式约束将伤害上限、公益精神、参与外部性等社会诉求纳入线性规划。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) Theorem 1：影响空间为原点对称zonotope，福利在影响空间中线性；(2) Theorem 2-3：voting-by-issues和随机独裁机制策略防操纵且一致同意，且随机独裁可由单一参数实现；(3) Proposition 3：非退化福利权重下随机独裁的最坏情况扭曲无界；(4) Theorem 4：通过Lagrange乘子将线性约束转化为有效福利方向；(5) 实证：在肾移植分配、慈善食物分配、LLM响应、电车问题四个真实人类偏好数据集上展示了各类对齐协议的福利分布。
AI.conclusion: 线性社会选择为对齐问题提供了正确的数学设置。将福利而非模型参数作为分析的一阶对象，使得设计防策略操纵机制和满足多种社会诉求的机制变得直接可行。该框架将RLHF重新解释为随机标签协议，并识别出匿名RLHF的可恢复性受限于至多一个参数。未来方向包括将分析扩展到协商和高风险资源分配等场景。

title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent trading systems, in which specialized agents collaborate through structured communication to produce trading decisions, are moving rapidly from research prototypes to live deployments that control real assets. The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the adversary to what is practically reachable---the source data and prompts agents consume---yielding a low-barrier, and thus democratized threat model instantiated as role-specific adversaries. We present the first systematic empirical study in the financial domain to characterize how an adversarial signal enters a multi-agent trading system and how far it survives toward the decision. Along the role axis, we decompose a widely-used trading pipeline into four functional roles---Analyst, Researcher, Trader, and Risk Manager---and pair each with an attack matched to its interface. Along the structural axis, we evaluate four communication topologies under data- and agent-level attacks, using the Adversarial Signal Preservation Score (APS) as a post-hoc lens on why some designs are more robust than others. We conduct experiments across five assets, two backbones, and two target directions. A central finding is that no architecture is inherently robust. These findings provide insights for the future design of safer and more robust agentic trading systems.

AI.tldr: 这是首篇针对金融领域LLM多智能体交易系统对抗漏洞的系统性实证研究。作者沿两条轴线展开分析：角色轴（将经典交易流水线分解为分析师、研究员、交易员、风控经理四个角色，并为每个角色匹配特定攻击）与结构轴（评估四种通信拓扑在数据级与智能体级攻击下的表现），并提出"对抗信号保留分数（APS）"作为后置分析透镜。核心结论：没有任何架构具有内在鲁棒性，多智能体设计本身不足以防御对抗信号，安全性必须来自刻意的验证与聚合设计。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体交易系统正从研究原型走向真实资金管理部署，智能体间的结构化通信同时也是攻击面。已有攻击多假设对系统内部有特权访问（白盒），而现实中部署的系统是黑盒，攻击者只能接触智能体消费的数据源与提示。因此亟需一个低门槛、可复现的威胁模型，系统理解对抗信号如何进入系统并在多大程度上存活到最终决策，从而指导防御设计。
AI.method: 采用"低门槛、去民主化"的黑盒威胁模型：攻击者只能修改（i）智能体摄取的外部数据内容，以及（ii）进入智能体的提示级内容，无权访问模型权重、工具服务器、编排状态或推理痕迹。沿两条轴分析：（1）角色轴——将广泛使用的TradingAgents流水线拆解为Analyst、Researcher、Trader、Risk Manager四个功能角色，并分别为每个角色匹配贴合其接口的攻击（数据投毒与间接提示注入攻击分析师；说服性对手攻击研究员；目标劫持攻击交易员；越权破解攻击风控经理）；（2）结构轴——在数据级与智能体级攻击下评估线性、集中式、去中心式、混合式四种通信拓扑。提出Adversarial Signal Preservation Score（APS）作为后置结构性透镜。度量指标包括Attack Success Rate（ASR，分母限定为"可攻击日"，即干净决策与攻击目标不同的日子）与有符号期望收益（EV）。在5个资产（AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/BTC-USD）× 2026 Q1（61个交易日）× 2个骨干模型（GPT-4.1、Qwen3-235B-A22B）× BUY与SELL两个目标方向上展开实验。
AI.result: （1）角色轴：越权破解风险经理的成功率最高（98.9% BUY/95.5% SELL），是终端决策节点且绕过所有下游聚合；说服性对手攻击研究员次之（53.3%/41.9%）；数据级攻击与目标劫持处于13.8%–29.8%的低水平区间。攻击成功率与流水线深度并无单调关系。（2）结构轴：APS与ASR高度正相关（GPT-4.1 r=0.85，Qwen r=0.88），集中式最脆弱、去中心式投票最鲁棒，但去中心式鲁棒性是阈值性的——一旦被攻陷通道达到多数，ASR从44.2%骤升至68.7%。多智能体组织相比单智能体基线能降低ASR（GPT-4.1从70.2%降至29.1%–48.1%），但不能消除漏洞。（3）金融层面：ASR并非实际损失的上下界——越权破解虽ASR最高但单次收益中位数为$0；目标劫持均值正但中位数负。架构干净的收益表现并不预示攻击下的财务鲁棒性，去中心式干净收益最高却在持续攻击下退化最严重。中央结论：没有任何架构具有内在鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究给出金融场景下多智能体交易系统对抗失效模式的系统性实证刻画。两大启示：第一，安全性须来自刻意的验证、聚合与多数阈值设计，而非智能体数量本身；第二，应按角色接口配置针对性防御（来源信誉与溯源检查应对分析师层数据投毒，更强系统级护栏与定期审计应对提示注入与越权，独立的非串接验证环节应置于终端决策节点之前）。APS可作为架构脆弱性排序的一阶指示器，但应被理解为相对排序而非绝对存活比例。局限性包括角色轴评估仅使用单一骨干、资产集中于信息密集型大市值股、回测忽略执行时机与交易成本，未来工作应在更多模型与执行感知设置下验证。

title: Compression Trinity: Exploring Sparsity, Quantization, and Low-Rank Approximations for LLM Compression
comment: PhD thesis, University of Toronto, 2026. 156 pages. Chapters extend MKOR ( arXiv:2306.01685 ), SLoPe ( arXiv:2405.16325 ), OPTIMA ( arXiv:2512.13886 ), PATCH ( arXiv:2509.23410 ), and SLiM ( arXiv:2410.09615 ). Official record: this https URL
summary: Prohibitive computational and environmental costs impede the scalable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Traditional compression techniques (sparsity, quantization, low-rank approximations) are typically applied in isolation, and each hits an accuracy-efficiency wall. This thesis proposes the "Compression Trinity," a unified framework that applies the three pillars jointly: sparsity to reduce computation, quantization to minimize memory bandwidth, and low-rank approximations to recover accuracy. To accelerate pretraining, we apply the Trinity to the optimizer and model architecture. MKOR approximates curvature via block-diagonal sparsity and low-rank inversion, maintaining numerical stability for quantized states; it reduces curvature update complexity from $O(d^3)$ to $O(d^2)$ and accelerates convergence by up to 1.85x over KFAC. SLoPe accelerates training by up to 1.25x via a double-pruned backward pass for N:M sparsity, using low-rank "lazy" adapters in the final 1% of training to recover accuracy. For post-training compression, OPTIMA stabilizes static masks in a zero-training regime by formulating weight reconstruction as globally optimal column-wise quadratic programs, improving zero-shot accuracy by up to 3.97%. Given a fine-tuning budget, PATCH breaks the ceiling of static masks by learning a dynamic hybrid sparsity ratio between 0% and 50%, yielding up to 1.38x speedups. Finally, SLiM realizes the full Compression Trinity in one shot, using mathematically derived low-rank adapters to recover information lost to quantization and sparsity, improving accuracy by up to 5.66% over state-of-the-art methods and outperforming uncompressed dense models at equal parameter budgets by 0.6%. Together, these results show that jointly applying the Compression Trinity is essential for efficient, scalable, high-performance LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"压缩三位一体"(Compression Trinity)统一框架，将稀疏化、量化和低秩近似三种压缩技术联合应用于大型语言模型(LLM)的预训练加速和后训练压缩，涵盖优化器(MKOR)、训练加速(SLoPe)、零训练压缩(OPTIMA)、动态稀疏微调(PATCH)和一次性压缩(SLiM)五个组件，在保持精度的同时显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM压缩技术(稀疏化、量化、低秩近似)单独使用时各自存在精度-效率瓶颈，无法实现可扩展部署；本文旨在通过统一框架联合应用三种技术，突破单一方法的局限性，降低LLM的计算和环境成本。
AI.method:
提出Compression Trinity框架，联合使用三种压缩技术：
1. **MKOR**：通过块对角稀疏和低秩反演近似曲率，将曲率更新复杂度从O(d³)降至O(d²)，适用于量化状态。
2. **SLoPe**：采用N:M稀疏的双重剪枝反向传播加速训练，在最后1%训练中使用低秩"惰性"适配器恢复精度。
3. **OPTIMA**：在零训练环境下将权重重建建模为全局最优逐列二次规划，稳定静态掩码。
4. **PATCH**：学习0%–50%之间的动态混合稀疏率，突破静态掩码上限。
5. **SLiM**：使用数学推导的低秩适配器实现一次性完整压缩三位一体，恢复量化和稀疏造成的信息损失。
AI.result:
各组件取得显著成果：
- MKOR：收敛速度较KFAC提升达1.85倍。
- SLoPe：训练加速达1.25倍。
- OPTIMA：零样本精度提升达3.97%。
- PATCH：实现达1.38倍加速。
- SLiM：在等参数预算下，较现有最优方法精度提升5.66%，且比未压缩稠密模型高0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 联合应用"压缩三位一体"(稀疏化+量化+低秩近似)是实现高效、可扩展、高性能LLM的关键；论文通过五个互补组件验证了该框架在预训练和后训练场景下的有效性，证明三种压缩技术的协同作用优于任何单一方法。

title: AgentWorld: Personality-Aware Reliability Evaluation for Agentic Information Retrieval
summary: Evaluation of agentic information retrieval remains limited to scripted interactions with uniform users, missing both natural personality diversity and adversarial brittleness. We present AgentWorld, a simulation framework combining (i)Big Five (OCEAN) personality-driven user populations with stateful tool-use environments; (ii)the pass$^k$ consistency metric with structured fault classification, partial-credit scoring, and dual-control handoff verification; (iii)score-thresholded training-data export in six fine-tuning formats; and (iv)an adversarial Risk Analyser that snapshots required-intermediate-state spines, branches Monte-Carlo rollouts under four task-aware perturbation types, and quantifies risk via $\Delta P / \Delta T$ scoring, Dempster--Shafer evidence fusion, and Shapley attack-category attribution. Three experiments demonstrate the framework: a conversational analytics agent across 10 OCEAN personas (240 evaluator judgments); a customer-support agent across 5 tasks $\times$ 4 persona variants; and adversarial stress-testing of 5 tasks revealing pre-existing trajectory brittleness ($V_{\min}=0.375$ without perturbation) and tool/infrastructure-layer attack dominance (Shapley: 46% system, 38% action). Personality variation surfaces failure modes uniform testing cannot expose---cross-domain leakage, contextual drift, a 0.27-point quality gap, and 50% vs. 100% pass-rate across personas on the same task---while the Risk Analyser quantifies trajectory-level brittleness that pass$^k$ alone cannot measure.

AI.tldr: AgentWorld是一个用于评估智能体信息检索（agentic IR）可靠性的统一仿真框架，核心创新在于将大五人格（OCEAN）驱动的多样化用户模拟、pass^k 一致性度量、对抗性风险分析三者整合在一个闭环管道中，弥补了现有评测仅使用脚本化、单一化用户的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估存在五大缺口：（1）缺乏人格覆盖（仅测试礼貌、结构化查询）；（2）缺乏一致性度量（单次通过不等于可靠）；（3）缺乏细粒度故障诊断；（4）缺乏从测试到改进的闭环路径；（5）缺乏对抗脆弱性度量与归因。统一这些维度的框架在现有工作中尚不存在。
AI.method: 四阶段闭环管道 Define→Simulate→Evaluate→Stress-Test→Improve。核心组件包括：（1）OCEAN 人格驱动用户模拟（连续向量→五级自然语言映射，支持加权余弦相似度衡量人格多样性）；（2）有状态工具环境（Perceive-Act-Commit 原子循环，六大类内置应用，支持 JSON 声明式定义）；（3）N-智能体通信拓扑（NetworkX 实现全连接、中心辐射、层级、小世界、无标度五种）；（4）双重控制任务与四步交接周期；（5）pass^k 一致性度量、结构化故障分类（who/what 两轴）、部分得分、策略合规、按消息行为打分；（6）评分阈值化的训练数据导出（六种格式含 DPO）；（7）对抗性风险分析器（Risk Analyser）：脊柱快照+蒙特卡洛分支、四类任务感知扰动（state/message/action/system）、ΔP/ΔT 评分、Dempster-Shafer 证据融合（含显式无知建模与冲突报告）、精确 Shapley 值归因；（8）人格分层模型比较与 A/B 检验。
AI.result: 三个实验验证框架：（1）分析型智能体跨 10 个 OCEAN 人格（240 次评判），聚合相关性 0.75 掩盖了 0.88–0.61 的人格差异，暴露出响应截断、上下文漂移、跨域数据泄露三类系统故障；（2）客服智能体 5 任务×4 人格（19 次仿真），17/19 通过 LLM 评判，但完整性仅 0.508（14/19 仿真因步骤预算耗尽而终止），n=16 重跑显示 pass^8 从 1.00 降至 0.23–0.50，单次评判掩埋了演示与生产之间的鸿沟，同一任务不同人格出现 50% vs 100% 通过率差异；（3）对抗压力测试 5 任务，Check Refund Eligibility 行为通过率 100% 但 V_min=0.375（无扰动即脆性），Shapley 归因显示系统层 46% + 动作层 38% 占主导，Dempster-Shafer 融合将风险信念浓缩至 0.727（远高于平坦平均 0.385）。
AI.conclusion: AgentWorld 统一了人格驱动仿真、可靠性度量、训练数据生成与对抗风险分析于一个闭环管道，能揭示统一测试无法发现的 IR 失效模式——跨域泄露、上下文漂移、0.27 分的质量差距、同一任务 50% vs 100% 的人格通过率差异——并使面向智能体 IR 的人格感知可靠性评估成为实践可行。论文坦承局限：人格到行为的映射缺乏人类受试者标定，LLM 评判器存在偏差，N=8 蒙特卡洛样本带来宽置信区间，Dempster 规则在高冲突下退化，攻击图杀伤链分析留待未来工作。

title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce \textbf{EMRB} (\textbf{E}lectro\textbf{m}agnetic \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{B}enchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated from 11 signal types with verified ground truth. Unlike benchmarks built on preprocessed features or structured tables, EMRB provides only the raw capture; the quantities each question refers to must first be discovered through code. We evaluate 14 LLMs spanning proprietary, open-weight, and reasoning-oriented families. Scores range from 24.1\% to 78.9\%, with the mean dropping from 84.9\% on basic measurement to 21.2\% on system design. We also propose \textbf{ReconPilot}, a structured method that separates signal reconnaissance, targeted analysis, and self-verification. Across three backbones, ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested. All data and code are publicly released in \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{blue}{our GitHub repository}}.

AI.tldr: EMRB 是一个评估大语言模型分析原始电磁 I/Q 信号能力的基准测试，包含 200 道题、5 个难度等级和 27 种题型；并提出了 ReconPilot 三阶段方法以提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有电磁信号基准多依赖预处理特征或固定分类任务，缺乏对 LLM 通过代码直接分析原始物理层测量数据的系统评估。EMRB 旨在填补这一空白，检验 LLM 在真实工程分析流程中的能力。
AI.method: EMRB 提供原始 I/Q 数据文件，要求模型在 15 轮交互内编写并执行 Python 代码进行分析；包含 5 个难度等级（L1 基础测量至 L5 系统设计）和 11 种信号类型，采用确定性评分。ReconPilot 采用三阶段流程：固定信号侦测、针对性分析、自我验证。
AI.result: 14 个 LLM 得分范围 24.1%–78.9%，从 L1 的 84.9% 降至 L5 的 21.2%；ReconPilot 在三个基座模型上将总分提升 3.8–17.6 分，并在 15 组基座-难度组合中改善 13 组。GPT-5.5 表现最佳（78.9%），Grok-4.5 紧随其后（77.8%）。
AI.conclusion: LLM 失败的核心瓶颈在于跨多信号保持实体绑定的能力，而非缺乏公式知识；结构化的工作流可显著弥补这一缺陷。EMRB 可作为可重复的接受度测试，跟踪模型在电磁信号分析能力上的进展。

title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments
summary: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.

AI.tldr: AnTrap是一个用于评估Android GUI智能体在动态运行时异常下鲁棒性的基准测试，包含STAR四层十子类异常分类法，通过对16个领先模型的测试揭示了当前GUI智能体普遍存在的鲁棒性缺陷，并通过GRPO训练实验区分了可通过环境学习解决的挑战与受推理能力瓶颈限制的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Android GUI智能体基准（如AndroidLab、AndroidWorld、MobileWorld）主要评估理想执行路径下的整体性能，缺乏对智能体在真实部署中遭遇的运行时异常（外部环境扰动和内部认知错误）鲁棒性的系统性评估。智能体在面对弹窗、渲染错误、推理幻觉、动作误用、死锁等异常时缺乏恢复能力，这成为实际部署的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 提出STAR分类法：四层（State状态层、Thinking思考层、Action动作层、Round轮次层）十子类的运行时异常分类体系，基于真实设备部署的先导研究（600个任务、3个智能体的轨迹分析）提炼得出。2. 构建AnTrap基准：基于AndroidWorld扩展236个任务，通过运行时管道在智能体执行循环中动态注入扰动（注入概率0.16，每集注入1个陷阱），保持任务可解性。3. 评估16个模型：包括Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-3-Pro、GPT-5.4等专有模型和GUI-Owl、Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS等开源模型。4. GRPO训练实验：在原始环境和对抗环境分别训练UI-TARS-1.5-7B和GUI-Owl-7B，每子类进行10次独立训练，分析鲁棒性提升的边界。
AI.result: 1. 普遍脆弱性：所有16个模型在异常环境下性能均显著下降，最强模型Claude-Sonnet-4.6从74.2%降至66.5%，GUI-Owl-1.5-32B-Think从69.5%降至62.4%。2. 上下文异常更难：R层陷阱（如状态死锁、上下文破坏、循环）对性能影响最大，单步异常（A层和S层的视觉遮蔽/视觉幻觉）影响较小。3. 推理能力≠鲁棒性：思考模型虽基线更高但绝对性能下降幅度与指令模型相当甚至更大（Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking下降6.1点，Instruct版本下降5.8点）。4. GRPO训练差异：AnTrap环境GRPO对S层（+8.1%~11.0%）和A层（最高+8.5%）提升显著，但T层仅中等提升（+4.2%~5.1%），R层几乎无提升（<+3.0%，循环陷阱<+1.0%）。6. 混合陷阱训练效果稀释：随机混合10个子类训练时鲁棒性增益与原始环境GRPO相当，说明针对性、密集的子类特定对抗训练至关重要。
AI.conclusion: AnTrap基准填补了Android GUI智能体鲁棒性评估的空白，揭示当前智能体在动态异常下普遍脆弱的根本原因：缺乏对抗训练数据、对历史轨迹上下文整合不足、过度依赖当前观察而非长程推理。关键发现是单步状态/动作陷阱可通过对抗强化学习解决，但深层上下文陷阱（如状态死锁、循环）暴露智能体的内在推理局限，无法仅通过环境内训练克服。未来研究方向包括：扩展任务覆盖范围至更广泛的Android场景、探索对抗监督微调（SFT）以解决上下文理解问题、开发可扩展的训练方法解决R层瓶颈。

title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track (Main paper)
summary: Commercial design platforms increasingly edit documents through large language model (LLM) agents, but two practical problems block reliable deployment: legacy document formats expose only \emph{flat}, absolutely positioned elements, so agents must recompute coordinates and routinely break layouts; and design has no unique ground truth, so diff-against-reference metrics penalize valid-but-different outputs. We present \textbf{ACE}, an agentic canvas editor over a \emph{hierarchical scene-graph} with a presentation-specialized action space (98 tools), paired with \textbf{CARE}, a content-aware router that feeds the agent only the relevant slice of each deck (avg.\ $\sim$89\% input-token reduction), and a \emph{self-correction} loop driven by a \emph{ground-truth-free} instruction-following (IF) judge whose natural-language critique is fed back as the next-turn instruction. With a fixed backbone, a scene-graph editor in a \emph{single turn} already matches a same-backbone \emph{agentic} HTML pipeline that iterates internally; adding self-correction lifts ACE significantly above it on instruction following (IF 4.23 vs.\ 3.81 on the full 94-task benchmark, paired $p{=}.010$, replicated by an out-of-loop judge) at 1.75$\times$ the speed and $\sim$44\% lower cost. VQ means are statistically indistinguishable, but 26 blind raters prefer ACE overall (58.7\% decisive win-rate) and prefer the self-corrected output 81\% of the time; the ranking is invariant across three judge families, and out-of-loop judges retain two-thirds of the self-correction gain, bounding circularity. 66\% of cases halt after one pass, and a strict-peak rollback removes every observed regression.

AI.tldr: ACE是一种针对多幻灯片演示文稿模板编辑的智能体画布编辑器，采用层级场景图表示和98个专用工具，通过内容感知路由器(CARE)和无ground-truth的指令跟随(IF)评判器驱动的自我修正循环，在指令跟随和成本效率上显著优于基于HTML和OpenXML的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在演示文稿编辑上面临两大核心障碍：(P1) 设计没有唯一真值答案，diff-vs-reference指标会惩罚"有效但不同"的输出；(P2) 遗留文档格式(如OOXML)仅暴露扁平、绝对定位的元素，智能体需重算坐标并经常破坏布局；现有结构化编辑API(如PPTAgent仅5个)又不足以覆盖复杂编辑任务。
AI.method: 1) **场景图编辑器**：在层级化场景图上构建98个领域专用工具(11个模块)，利用auto-layout约束避免"坐标推算"问题；2) **CARE路由器**：将指令分类为Micro-Spatial/Macro-Programmatic/Systemic-Token三种上下文模式，平均减少89%输入token；3) **自修正循环**：通过无ground-truth的IF评判器(基于结构化JsonDiff和按需渲染)对agent的编辑进行评分，将自然语言critique作为下一轮指令反馈，τ=4阈值或T=3轮后停止，配以strict-peak rollback消除回归；4) **基准测试**：构建figma-slide-bench-v1(97个多幻灯片任务，94个可自动评测)。
AI.result: 在53例配对对比中：ACE(gpt-5.5)的IF=4.74/VQ=4.19，1.75倍速于Claude-Skill HTML且成本低约44%(甚至比HTML便宜7倍)；在94例完整基准上IF 4.23 vs HTML 3.81 (p=.010)；26名盲评人类在所有维度上更偏好ACE(总体决定性胜率58.7%)，自修正输出获81%偏好；排名在三组评判器家族下不变，out-of-loop评判器保留约2/3的自修正增益；leave-one-out消融证实场景图表示、CARE、专用工具、自修正各自独立贡献；66%任务一轮即达标，strict-peak rollback消除所有观察到的回归。
AI.conclusion: ACE通过层级场景图+领域工具+内容感知路由+无GT的IF评判器自我修正循环的组合，在多幻灯片演示编辑中以更低成本、更高速度取得了显著优于agentic HTML和OpenXML基线的指令跟随表现；其设计哲学(用intent-based judge替代reference-diff metric、用结构化表示替代扁平坐标)对开放域设计编辑具有推广价值，且CARE和评判器与底层平台无关，可迁移至PowerPoint/Google Slides。

title: Scalable Question-Centric Text-to-Image Evaluation: Reliable Ranking, Fine-Grained Diagnosis, and Cost-Aware Routing
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models often have similar total scores but different strengths, making practical selection difficult. Fine-grained benchmarks decompose prompts into questions, yet often return them to prompt scores and fixed categories, weakening attribution and ignoring complexity. Related requirements are also scored separately or as one total, obscuring basic versus compositional failure. We present QC-T2I-Bench, a question-centric framework that converts open prompts into attributed atomic questions and organizes their dependencies with Davidsonian Scene Graphs (DSGs). We use hierarchy-constrained question aggregation to exclude downstream questions after a prerequisite fails and to prevent simple and complex prompts from receiving the same total weight. We then use the DSG structure to measure joint success within prompts and compare repeated entities across prompts, separating basic realization failures from failures under additional requirements. We evaluate multiple open-source T2I models on English and Chinese prompts. The resulting question-level evidence supports reliable ranking and fine-grained diagnosis: joint completion falls from 80.7\% for components with two capabilities to 37.2\% for those with seven or more. Finally, we reuse the same records for training-free routing; our cost-aware router matches ERNIE's 89.51-point estimate with 21.3\% less GPU-s/MP.

AI.tldr: QC-T2I-Bench：一种以原子问题为核心的文本到图像（T2I）模型评估框架，将开放提示转化为带属性标签的原子问题，并通过Davidsonian场景图（DSG）组织依赖关系。它支持层次约束问题聚合（HCQ）进行排名、细粒度组件级诊断以及无训练的成本感知生成器路由。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I评估基准多依赖提示级总分或预定义类别，难以揭示不同模型的差异化优势，且常因依赖关系处理不当对复合提示重复扣分，也无法关联不同提示中的同类证据进行更可靠的模型选择。
AI.method: 方法包含三条路径：(1) 评分路径——将提示转化为带二级能力标签的原子问题，用DSG建立先决关系，依赖掩码后用HCQ在能力维度上微平均-宏平均；(2) 结构路径——在DSG图谱上做组件完整率、根实体跨提示对照、拓扑边际耦合检验；(3) 路由路径——复用问题级历史记录，训练免费的Q-Profile路由器按质量或成本选择生成器。
