AI.result: 在13个开源T2I模型上，FLUX.2-dev英文领先、ERNIE-Image中文领先；自举检验显示68/78的模型对差异显著，但前两名差距0.042分未确定性分离；组件完整率从2标签的80.7%降至7+标签的37.2%；直接DSG边的耦合残差+1.10分显著大于非祖先对的+0.38分；Q-Profile-C路由器匹配ERNIE 89.51分同时节省21.3% GPU-s/MP。
AI.conclusion: QC-T2I-Bench将原子问题记录与DSG结构整合到同一可审计证据库，同时支持可靠排名、细粒度诊断和无训练的成本感知路由，但作者强调任何单一标量分数都不应被视为通用结论，未来工作需在更多领域校准问题构建与判官。

title: AHEAD: Adaptive Hindsight with Environment-Augmented Distillation for Agentic RL
summary: Training multi-turn LLM agents with reinforcement learning typically relies on trajectory-level rewards, which assign a uniform advantage to every step and cannot identify which decisions led to success or failure. Self-distillation methods can provide finer-grained supervision by augmenting RL with privileged information. However, existing approaches usually apply the same type of privileged information to every step in an indistinguishable manner, ignoring a key asymmetry: routine steps need little additional guidance, while critical error steps require corrective direction that environment feedback alone cannot provide. We propose AHEAD, a step-aware framework that matches different supervision sources to different step types. The teacher receives environment feedback on all steps as a grounded dense signal, and additionally receives LLM-generated corrective hints on error steps to supply the direction that environment feedback lacks. The method introduces minimal changes to the standard GRPO algorithm. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, and across three model scales, AHEAD raises task success (+13.3 points on ALFWorld and +11.0 on WebShop at 7B over GRPO), reaches a given success rate in fewer training steps, and solves tasks within tighter interaction budgets than outcome-only RL and prior self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: AHEAD提出了一种步级感知的自蒸馏框架，通过为多轮LLM智能体训练中不同类型步骤（常规步骤与错误步骤）匹配不同的特权信息来源（环境反馈+LLM纠正提示），解决GRPO轨迹级奖励的信用分配问题，仅需对GRPO做极小改动，在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA三大基准、三个模型规模上均显著优于GRPO及现有自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 多轮LLM智能体的RL训练（如GRPO）依赖轨迹级奖励，将同一优势值均匀分配到轨迹中所有token，无法识别哪些步骤导致了成功或失败。现有自蒸馏方法对所有步骤不加区分地施加同一种特权信息（如检索技能、参考答案），而忽略了步骤间的关键不对称性：常规步骤仅需确认性信号，错误步骤则需要方向性纠正，而环境反馈本身只能报告"发生了什么"而无法给出"应该做什么"。
AI.method: AHEAD为失败轨迹构造步级感知特权信息：(1) 常规步骤注入环境反馈作为基础PI（密度大、接地性强）；(2) 由LLM分析器识别出的错误步骤额外注入LLM生成的纠正提示（提供环境反馈缺失的"应该做什么"的方向）。通过教师-学生log-prob差δ_{t,ℓ}计算token级自蒸馏信号，将其指数化并裁剪后对GRPO优势进行有界重加权（保持符号不变，奖励始终控制更新方向）。仅对失败轨迹施加PI，成功轨迹保留原始优势。混合系数λ_k从0.5线性衰减至0，避免训练后期过度依赖PI。所有PI/LLM调用仅在训练时使用，推理时无需任何特权信息。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-3B/7B和Qwen3-1.7B三个模型规模上，AHEAD在ALFWorld上较GRPO提升+12.5至+21.1个百分点，WebShop成功率提升+10.1至+26.5个百分点，Search-QA平均准确率在所有规模上均有提升；7B时ALFWorld达到94.5%、WebShop成功率达83.6%，均显著超过SDAR、Skill-SD、RLSD等自蒸馏基线。训练效率方面，AHEAD以更少训练步达到GRPO最终性能，并在更少交互步数内完成任务（1.7B时用12步即可匹配GRPO 54步预算的覆盖率）。消融实验验证了纠正提示、失败轨迹过滤、多步检测、衰减调度四个组件均不可或缺。δ信号分析显示错误步骤的平均|δ|为0.37，显著高于常规步骤的0.17（AUROC=0.87），且裁剪后仍能定位错误步骤（AUROC=0.70）。通用性方面，换用不同LLM分析器（Claude Sonnet 5、Kimi、GLM-5）均仍优于GRPO，小模型对分析器质量不敏感。未见房间布局的泛化性能同样提升（7B Unseen-134提升+16.4点），排除过拟合可能。
AI.conclusion: AHEAD通过将环境反馈（覆盖所有步骤的接地性密集信号）与LLM纠正提示（仅作用于错误步骤的方向性信号）结合，实现了无需显式门控或每步系数的自适应token级监督，验证了"异质PI按步类型分配"这一设计原则的有效性。该方法以极小改动集成到GRPO中，推理时无额外开销，在三个智能体基准上均取得一致且显著的改进，为多轮智能体RL的细粒度信用分配提供了新思路。局限性包括：依赖LLM分析器质量（训练时有额外推理成本）、需要错误步骤可清晰辨识的环境、以及评估范围限于较短轨迹与二值成功信号的基准。

title: Robust Code RL via Faulty-Code-Driven Test case Synthesis and Dense Reward Shaping
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal technique for enhancing the code generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the efficacy of RLVR in coding implementations is fundamentally limited by the comprehensiveness of test cases, because insufficient test coverage in code validation often causes false positives, further leading to reward hacking and policy degradation. To mitigate the reward bias stemming from the suboptimal quality of current automated generation methods, we propose the RobustTests framework, which introduces a faulty-code-driven test case synthesis strategy that leverages "near correct" faulty codes to guide the model in precisely capturing latent logical discrepancies and further integrates validator agents with behavioral feature clustering to facilitate the granular filtering of invalid and redundant test cases. To address false negatives caused by inherent hallucination noise in synthetic test cases, RobustTests also incorporates a stepwise dense reward function based on pass rates, bolstering training robustness through fine-grained feedback. By employing this pipeline, we construct a high-quality dataset that augmented the test cases in CodeContests, encompassing a broader spectrum of faulty code scenarios and significantly enhances diagnostic utility. Experimental results demonstrate that, by leveraging a moderately challenging subset of problems from CodeContests for training, RL fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B via RobustTests achieves an absolute 3% performance gain on the LiveCodeBench benchmark compared to baseline methods, confirming the effectiveness of the RobustTests framework in advancing the code generation proficiency of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RobustTests框架,通过"近正确"故障代码驱动的测试用例合成和基于通过率的逐步密集奖励机制,解决了RLVR代码生成中因测试用例覆盖不足导致的奖励偏差和策略退化问题。
AI.motivation: RLVR在代码生成中面临两大瓶颈:(1)测试用例覆盖不足导致误报(false positives),引发奖励黑客和策略退化;(2)合成测试用例不可避免的幻觉噪声产生漏报(false negatives),在稀疏二值奖励下误导优化方向。现有方法在测试质量与奖励机制的联合设计方面存在不足。
AI.method: RobustTests包含三大模块:(1)故障代码驱动的测试用例合成——利用LLM生成"近正确"故障代码(满足0<通过率<1的筛选条件),并以其为负面示例引导LLM定向生成能触发特定逻辑缺陷的测试用例;(2)测试用例验证与筛选——通过可执行验证器(Validator Agent)剔除违反约束的无效用例,再利用基于行为特征向量(对故障代码的通过/失败模式)的K-means聚类与轮询选择策略,最大化失败模式覆盖的同时保证测试集精简;(3)逐步密集奖励函数——以通过率为连续反馈(全通过得1.1、全失败得-0.1、部分通过按比例得分),替代稀疏0/1奖励,缓解漏报带来的噪声梯度。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-32B上采用GRPO微调,在LiveCodeBench基准上获得约3%的绝对性能提升(68.39 vs 最佳基线66.21),Codeforces评分(Rating)从84.35提升至85.99,百分位从91.81%提升至94.67%。消融实验表明测试用例合成与多样性选择各自贡献约1.5%增益,且具有互补性;密集奖励在多种训练集上一致提升性能,并对验证器失效情形更具鲁棒性。新提出的TSP(测试用例空间极化度)指标较原CodeContests+提升7%,且与下游性能呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: RobustTests验证了"故障代码驱动合成+密集奖励"的联合设计在RLVR代码生成中的有效性,确立了测试用例诊断覆盖度(TSP)与模型性能的关联。框架具有广泛适用性,可推广至软件工程的自动化变异测试及自主科学发现中的实验规划与结论分析。局限性在于依赖参考解,且仅在竞赛编程基准上验证,领域泛化有待探索。

title: OmniJudge or OmniBias? Diagnosing Multimodal Judges through Balanced, Decoupled Lenses
summary: Multimodal understanding models that can jointly judge text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V) and text-to-speech (TTS) generation are increasingly used as "OmniJudges" for evaluation and automatic annotation. How reliably they understand what they score remains unclear, since existing benchmarks and training data tend to overemphasize positive examples and to conflate distinct failure modes, so a judge may score well without recognizing failures while its capability gaps stay hidden. Motivated by this, we introduce D3-Omni, a balanced and decoupled benchmark for diagnosing fine-grained multimodal understanding, covering 53 orthogonal binary dimensions (17/22/14) and 10,671 samples (3,526/1,998/5,147) across the three tasks. Rather than re-generating outputs, which may leak information across dimensions, we fix verified fully positive seeds and derive negatives through controlled prompt rewriting and atomic, dimension-isolating perturbations. The resulting D3 design is Dual-balanced, which helps alleviate negative-sample scarcity and per-dimension label imbalance; Decoupled, so that each error is attributable to a single capability; and Dynamic, steering construction toward under-represented regions of the label distribution as generative models this http URL suite reaches near 1:1 per-dimension parity and a uniform distribution over all total-score levels. Under this balanced view, even strong OmniJudges tend to struggle on modality-related dimensions, to confirm satisfied requirements far more reliably than they detect violated ones, and to treat nominally distinct attributes as largely a single decision, suggesting that aggregate accuracy may hide systematic blind spots that a balanced and decoupled lens can help expose and, in turn, address.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D3-Omni基准，用于诊断多模态理解模型（OmniJudges）在文本到图像、文本到视频、文本到语音评估中的细粒度能力不足问题。该基准通过平衡、解耦的设计揭示了现有模型在识别生成内容失败模式时的系统性盲点。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态评估基准和训练数据过度强调正样本，且混淆不同的失败模式，导致评判模型虽然评分表现良好但无法识别真实失败，其能力缺陷被掩盖。需要一个能细粒度诊断评判模型真实理解能力的诊断工具。
AI.method: 1. 构建涵盖T2I、T2V、TTS三个任务、53个正交二元维度、10,671个样本的D3-Omni基准。2. 不重新生成输出，而是基于已验证的完全正样本种子，通过受控的提示重写和原子化、维度隔离的扰动来推导负样本。3. D3设计原则：Dual-balanced（双重平衡，缓解负样本稀缺和每维度标签不平衡）、Decoupled（解耦，每个错误归因于单一能力）、Dynamic（动态，根据生成模型的进展引导构建向标签分布的欠代表区域倾斜）。4. 实现近乎1:1的逐维度平等和总分数各等级的均匀分布。
AI.result: 在平衡的D3-Omni基准下，即使是强大的OmniJudges也存在以下问题：在模态相关维度上表现挣扎；在确认已满足的要求方面远比为检测被违反的要求更可靠；将名义上不同的属性视为基本上是单一决策。这表明聚合准确率可能掩盖系统性的盲点。
AI.conclusion: 聚合准确率可能隐藏评判模型系统性的能力盲点。D3-Omni提供的平衡且解耦视角有助于暴露并进而解决这些盲点，为多模态评判模型的细粒度能力诊断和改进提供了有效工具。

title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling
summary: Recent studies on GUI agents have increasingly focused on outcome reward modeling, which assigns outcome rewards by judging whether an executed trajectory satisfies the success criteria implied by the user instruction. Existing GUI reward verifiers, however, often under-specify how these criteria should be constructed for each task instance. Whether using generic rubric structures or implicit model reasoning, their judging criteria are not sufficiently task-adaptive: they can transfer checks across tasks, overlook concrete constraints in the current instruction, or become overly strict by enforcing unstated requirements. To address this limitation, we propose AdaptRubric, a Coarse-to-Fine Rubrics Framework that constructs task-adaptive judging criteria through a category-level coarse stage and an instance-level fine stage. AdaptRubric performs category-level coarse rubric retrieval by routing the instruction to a GUI task family and retrieving reusable task-family criteria, then conducts instance-level fine rubric generation to surface compact cues for concrete values, scopes, and constraints in the current instruction. Across offline reward evaluation and online reinforcement learning optimization, AdaptRubric consistently outperforms prior reward agents, improving F1 by 3.6 points over the baseline average under a matched image budget and yielding a 4.23-point task-success gain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AdaptRubric框架，通过"粗到细"的Coarse-to-Fine两阶段方法为GUI智能体构建任务自适应的结果奖励评判标准，显著提升了离线和在线场景下的奖励验证性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI奖励验证器在构建评判标准时存在不足：静态模板方法过于泛化，无法适配每个任务实例的具体约束；隐式推理方法则可能忽略指令细节或施加未声明的要求。因此需要一种能够同时保持任务类别验证边界并适配具体指令要求的标准构建方法。
AI.method: AdaptRubric采用两阶段框架：(1)类别级粗标准检索——通过任务路由器将指令路由到8个GUI任务类别（信息查询、创建修改、删除清理、通信、传输、状态导航、复合工作流、通用）之一，并从预构建的标准库中检索可复用的类别级标准；(2)实例级细标准生成——基于当前指令生成最多2条紧凑的细粒度标准项，覆盖具体数值、范围和约束。两阶段通过融合操作Φ(Rc, Rf)合并为最终评判标准，输入VLM验证器进行二值奖励预测。
AI.result: 在OGRBench离线奖励判别上达到86.7%准确率和86.6 F1，较基线平均F1提升3.6点；在MAI-UI-8B的在线强化学习（GRPO+MobileWorld）上获得4.23点的任务成功率绝对提升；在AndroidWorld的奖励引导测试时缩放（EarlyStop@7和BestOfN@8）上也取得最优结果；在效率上以低于OS-Themis和ZeroGUI的调用成本取得最高质量。消融实验验证粗细两阶段互补，移除任一组件F1均下降2.0点。
AI.conclusion: 任务自适应的标准构建能有效提升GUI结果奖励建模的可靠性。AdaptRubric通过显式组合类别级验证边界与实例级细粒度要求，在跨平台（Ubuntu、Mobile、Windows、macOS、Web）、离线评估、在线强化学习训练和测试时缩放等多种场景下均验证了其有效性和良好的质量-成本权衡。

title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it emits already appear in its input, holding at 96.2% on held-out SWE-bench Lite output. It is intent-conditioned: told the agent's current task, it acts chiefly inside a retained segment, selecting which lines survive (retained lines are +0.067 more intent-relevant than removed ones, paired 95% CI [+0.056, +0.078]) rather than changing how much is retained. We distil a gpt-4.1-mini teacher over 67,074 real OpenHands trajectories into 40,606 validated examples and fine-tune Qwen3-4B. On all 300 SWE-bench Lite instances, Paritok-4B compresses agent context to 25.7% of its size, 2.0x harder than a gpt-4.1-mini compressor (50.2%) and 2.4x harder than gpt-5 (61.9%), while retaining 86.5% of uncompressed single-shot solve quality. Fed the cat -n line-numbered input real agents produce, it compresses slightly less (27.8%) and retains more (89.3%); there the paired test is informative, with 30 instances solved only uncompressed and 17 only compressed, an exact McNemar p=0.079, so at this sample size compressing context to roughly a quarter of its size does not significantly reduce the solve rate. The model is a 264 MB adapter that self-hosts on one 24 GB GPU with no per-token compressor fee, which at list prices decides the economics: gpt-5 as a compressor is net-negative, costing more than the downstream tokens it saves. Weights, data, and evaluation scripts are open (Apache 2.0).

AI.tldr: Paritok-4B 是一个面向编码代理的 4B 参数 LoRA 上下文压缩器，采用抽取式(intent-conditioned extractive)方法，通过意图条件化选择代码片段而非改写，在 SWE-bench Lite 上将代理上下文压缩至 25.7% 原始大小，同时保留 86.5% 的单轮解题质量，且以 264 MB 适配器在单卡 24GB GPU 上自托管，无需按 token 计费。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM 驱动的编码代理每轮都会重新发送大量文件读取和工具输出到模型，上下文主导了 token 账单。通用的 prompt 压缩器在散文上训练，不适合代码——它们会改写标识符并删除代理编辑所需的精确片段。因此需要一个专为编码代理轨迹设计的压缩器，兼顾抽取式保真和意图感知选择性。
AI.method: 1) 五阶段数据流水线：从 67,074 条 OpenHands 轨迹经分段、过滤、标注(pool)、蒸馏得到 40,606 个验证样本，用 gpt-4.1-mini 作为教师；2) 以 Qwen3-4B 为基座，采用 LoRA (r=32, α=64) 进行 SFT 训练；3) 网关按段切分代理请求(类型与级别)，每段独立压缩，输入为意图字符串与段内容，输出用 [SEG] 标记包裹的抽取结果；4) 设计两大承诺：抽取式(96% 输出标识符已在输入中)与意图条件化(段内行级选择)；5) 闭集结构标记词汇表替代被删内容。
AI.result: 在 OOD 段保留测试中格式可靠性达 100%，压缩率 0.236，但 drop 准确率 0.49 低于 always-keep 基线 0.59；标识符保留率与教师无显著差异(0.385 vs 0.287)。在全部 300 个 SWE-bench Lite 实例上：压缩至 25.7%(raw source)/27.8%(line-numbered)，分别保留 86.5%/89.3% 的解题质量；行号模式下配对 McNemar 检验 p=0.079，无显著下降。压缩率比 gpt-4.1-mini 强 2.0 倍，比 gpt-5 强 2.4 倍。在 SWE-bench Lite 输出上 96.2% 的标识符已存在于输入。经济性上 gpt-5 作压缩器净亏 $6.30/百万 token，Paritok-4B 在自托管成本低于 $2.23/百万 token 时即优于无压缩方案。
AI.conclusion: 编码代理的上下文压缩不是散文 prompt 压缩的同一问题——代理需要精确字符串，而"重要"每轮都在变。Paritok-4B 通过抽取式与意图条件化两个承诺应对这两点，在约 1/4 上下文大小下保持接近无损的解题能力。剩余主要差距是欠丢弃(under-dropping)而非保真度。所有数据流水线、训练配方、评估脚本和权重均以 Apache 2.0 开源。

title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models
summary: Aligning large language models to human preferences is crucial for real-world deployment but frequently incurs an alignment tax, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained general capabilities. While previous works primarily frame this problem as an optimization or architectural challenge, the inherent characteristics of preference data that drive this degradation remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy that explicitly mitigates catastrophic forgetting while optimizing alignment efficacy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses of the preference optimization gradient, we identify three key data-centric features that dictate parameter drift: the reference model's log-probability margin, the token length difference between chosen and rejected responses, and the TF-IDF similarity to general capability corpora. By aggregating these orthogonal features into a unified composite risk score, BALIGN systematically filters out high-risk preference samples that disrupt intrinsic model parameters or provide minimal alignment utility. Extensive experiments on standard human preference datasets demonstrate that BALIGN strongly preserves foundational capabilities without compromising alignment gains, consistently achieving the optimal Pareto frontier with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BALIGN，一种基于偏好优化梯度分析的数据选择策略，通过三个数据特征（参考模型对数概率边际、选中与拒绝响应间的token长度差、与通用能力语料的TF-IDF相似度）构建复合风险分数，在DPO对齐中过滤高风险样本，以同时缓解灾难性遗忘并保持对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型对齐人类偏好时常伴随"对齐税"——预训练通用能力的灾难性遗忘。已有方法多从优化或架构角度解决该问题，而偏好数据本身的特征如何驱动能力退化尚未得到充分探索。本文从数据中心的视角，分析偏好数据特性与参数漂移之间的关系。
AI.method: 1) 对DPO损失梯度进行理论分解，识别每个偏好样本的权重与方向贡献；2) 推导三个关键数据特征——参考边际（reference margin，衡量参考模型对偏好对的固有倾向）、token长度差（chosen与rejected响应间的长度不对称性）、TF-IDF相似度（样本与通用能力语料的词汇重叠度）；3) 为每个特征定义风险分数（采用pinball loss处理非对称风险），归一化后聚合为复合风险分数；4) 按预算比例ρ过滤低分样本用于DPO训练。
AI.result: 在HH-RLHF数据集上以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct为基模型，仅使用5%数据即可实现：通用能力遗忘最低（如Llama Helpfulness仅0.86%，Qwen Harmlessness仅0.13%），对齐增益达到最优或次优（4.61%~10.82%）。在MMLU、IFEval、ARC、HumanEval、GSM8K五项基准上整体保持基模型能力，且通过调整β参数可有效控制稳定性-可塑性权衡，持续占据Pareto前沿。消融实验证实三特征互补，计算开销远低于基于梯度的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: BALIGN是一种高效的数据中心框架，通过基于梯度理论分析的三维风险评分（参考边际、长度差、TF-IDF相似度），在偏好数据预处理阶段实现稳定性与可塑性的联合优化。该方法计算轻量（仅需对参考模型进行一次前向传播），为缓解对齐税提供了可扩展且实用的解决方案，无需牺牲基础模型能力即可完成对齐。

title: MetaRAG: Belief-Action Aligned Policy Optimization for Agentic RAG
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires language models to decide when to continue searching and when to answer. Existing RL-based methods rely on external supervision and overlook the agent's internal belief about whether the current evidence is sufficient. To address this problem, we reformulate the search decision quality as belief-action alignment and propose MetaRAG, a belief-action aligned policy optimization framework for agentic RAG. MetaRAG uses Verify-first Action Generation to elicit an explicit verification process before each actual action, and Internal Belief Probing to estimate the policy model's own answerability belief from the same question-history context. Based on these, MetaRAG derives a consistency reward that is further gated by answer correctness, avoiding reinforcement of internally consistent but incorrect trajectories. The belief probe is used only during training and introduces no inference-time overhead. Experiments on seven public QA benchmarks show that MetaRAG consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over strong RL-based agentic RAG baselines, with gains that transfer to deep research settings, different optimizers, and multiple model backbones.

AI.tldr: MetaRAG提出了一种"信念-动作对齐"的策略优化框架，通过让策略模型在每次决策前先验证候选动作、并在相同问题上内部探查其"可回答性信念"，将Search/Answer决策质量形式化为信念与动作的一致性，并仅在最终答案正确时对该一致性信号加以门控奖励，从而在无需外部评判器的前提下同时抑制过度检索和过早回答。
AI.motivation: 现有RL-based agentic RAG方法在Search/Answer决策边界上存在过检索（over-search）和欠检索（under-search）两类失配：过程监督方法多依赖外部LLM评判器或反事实干预，开销大且可扩展性差；结果监督方法只给最终答案的稀疏奖励，难以校准中间决策。作者观察到，所有现有方法都从外部施加监督，却忽略了驱动该决策的内部信号——策略模型对当前证据是否充分的"可回答性信念"。当动作与该信念偏离时，无论外部奖励如何，都属于边界校准失误。
AI.method:
MetaRAG = Verify-first Action Generation + Internal Belief Probing + Belief-Action Gap Diagnosis + Consistency Reward Calculation。
(1) 任务定义：在最多T轮的agentic RAG中，策略πθ在上下文ct=(q,ht)上输出动作αt∈{Search, Answer}，若为Answer则终止。
(2) Verify-first Action Generation：先采样一个候选动作α̃t∈{Search, Answer}，用"先验证再行动"的提示让模型先检查该候选是否合适，最后输出实际动作at；该机制在训练和推理时均使用。
(3) Internal Belief Probing：在同一(q,ht)上额外做一次前向，要求模型只输出Yes/No，对Yes/No的下一token logits做softmax得到bt=P(Yes)−P(No)∈[-1,1]，bt越大表示模型越认为当前上下文可回答；只用同一策略模型，不依赖外部判官，且仅在训练时使用，推理时无额外开销。
(4) Belief-Action Gap Diagnosis：设定margin m，将信念与动作匹配关系分为四类——bt>m且Answer为Optimal，bt<-m且Search为Optimal，bt>m但Search为Over-search，bt<-m但Answer为Under-search，|bt|≤m为Margin Zone（inconclusive）；引入二值一致性指标ot。
(5) Consistency Reward Calculation：R_consist(τ)=(1/Tτ)∑ot，R_outcome(τ)=𝕀[EM(ŷ,y*)]，最终R_total=R_outcome·(1+λ·R_consist)；其中R_outcome起门控作用——答案错误则总奖励为0，避免强化"内部一致但答错"的轨迹，λ控制信念-动作对齐强度。
算法复杂度：训练时仅增加一次yes/no前向和一次verify-first生成；推理时无需信念探查。默认设置：m=0, λ=0.1, 候选动作均匀随机采样, GRPO, rollout组大小N=5, 最长4轮, Wikipedia2018 + E5, top-3段落。
AI.result: 在NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2Wiki, MuSiQue, Bamboogle七个QA基准上，Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct平均EM从GiGPO的39.8%提升到MetaRAG的41.7%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct从43.9%提升到45.4%，且平均搜索次数更少/相当，呈现更优的精度-效率权衡。零样本迁移到BrowseComp-Plus（BM25检索器）时，7B模型准确率从GiGPO的2.65%升至3.49%，证据召回从3.10升至3.73，接近Qwen3-32B基线。消融：(a) 去掉一致性奖励则搜索次数从1.60升至2.14；去掉verify-before-action准确率降至40.4%；(c) 仅用Over-search信号使模型过于保守(Acc 41.3, Searches 1.33)，仅用Under-search信号搜索次数飙升至2.56；将错误轨迹也纳入一致性奖励则准确率跌至39.6%，证明结果门控必要。超参：λ∈{0,0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4}和m∈{0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8}几乎都优于GiGPO，对超参不敏感。归因分析：在GSM8K/SciQ/TriviaQA上用perplexity和attention entropy做知识边界感知评估，Search-R1/HiPRAG/GiGPO相对base model均下降，而MetaRAG AUROC由59.5→60.2、PRR由20.5→21.8均上升，说明其增益来源于强化了"何时需要检索"的知识边界。外部LLM评判（GLM-5.1）验证：MetaRAG将GiGPO的外部under-search率从35.6%降至30.1%。鲁棒性：与DAPO/PPO优化器以及Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-14B等backbone结合均稳定优于GiGPO；与GiGPO step级credit分配结合时平均准确率进一步提升到43.1%/47.0%；用Internal Confidence替代P(Yes)−P(No)做信念探查准确率升至42.5%。效率：训练每步281s（介于GiGPO 249s与HiPRAG 525s之间），推理每查询0.1453s，无信念探查开销。案例研究：可视化展示了Over-search（已正确证据却继续Search而误答）和Under-search（信念为负仍Answer）的诊断，以及MetaRAG如何在第二步识别候选Answer不当后改Search而正确作答。
AI.conclusion: MetaRAG将agentic RAG的Search/Answer决策问题重新定义为信念-动作对齐：动作应匹配模型自身对"当前证据是否充分"的可回答性信念，over-search与under-search被统一为同一失配的两个方向。借助verify-first推理与内部信念探查，模型在不引入外部评判器的前提下获得轻量级决策级监督；由答案正确性门控的一致性奖励避免了"自信地做错事"的奖励作弊。实验证明该框架在精度-效率权衡、欠检索缓解、知识边界感知、深度研究零样本迁移、跨优化器与跨backbone泛化方面均有效，且训练-推理开销可控。论文还指出局限：未直接监督搜索查询的词汇质量、生成依据的忠实度以及超出检索/回答之外的更复杂工具动作，未来工作应将信念-动作对齐扩展到多工具、长程规划的开放环境。

title: Constraint-Guided Enterprise Data Mapping with Large Language Models
comment: 20th International Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning. NeSy 2026
summary: Enterprise entity alignment must handle semi-structured records, implicit attributes, and unit or granularity mismatches. Manual matching is still common in practice, but does not scale as schemas and providers evolve. LLM-only matching improves semantic recall, yet can violate structural and physical invariants, producing fluent yet operationally invalid correspondences. We propose constraint-guided mapping (CGM), a neuro-symbolic method with three stages: (i) schema-grounded admissibility constraints with metadata mc = <tau_c, delta_c>, where tau_c denotes the constraint type and delta_c provides executable relation and normalization logic; (ii) constraint-restricted candidate generation with cascade relaxation to guarantee a nonempty feasible set under noise; and (iii) neural ranking with bounded LLM disambiguation restricted to that feasible set. Methodologically, constraints operate as hypothesis-space operators rather than post-hoc validators, enabling controlled degradation under relaxation and auditable, human-guidable decisions. On a controlled structural-decoy benchmark, hard admissibility shrinks the candidate space by ~480x without dropping the GT, and a layer-by-layer ablation shows this gate, not the LLM, is the decisive lift (F1 0.08 to 0.66). The benefit is model-independent and adds no extra inference cost: a small model with constraints matches a frontier LLM used without them at ~28x lower cost. The method, not a single tuned configuration, transfers across seven enterprise makes (macro F1 0.70), each under its own automatically discovered, expert-refinable constraints, and lowers expert effort by ~7x versus spreadsheet workflows. Public Valentine results add an external ranking sanity check and mark the boundary: constraints should be hard only where structural invariants are match-determining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为约束引导映射（CGM）的神经符号方法，用于企业实体对齐任务。该方法通过将硬约束作为假设空间算子，在神经推理之前定义候选匹配的可接受性空间，从而解决LLM单独匹配时违反结构和物理不变性的问题。核心思路是把硬约束当作"前置筛选器"而非"后置验证器"，结合级联松弛机制保证在噪声环境下可行集非空，再由神经排序和有界LLM消歧在受限空间内完成最终选择，从而在结构正确性上获得by construction的保证，且不增加推理成本。
AI.motivation: 企业实体对齐面临三大异质性挑战：表示异质性（组合/隐式字段）、结构异质性（单位与粒度不匹配）和语义异质性（缩写、多语言变体、时间漂移）。现有方法存在明显局限：手动匹配无法随schema演化扩展，纯LLM方法虽提升语义召回率，但因缺乏结构约束而输出"流畅但操作无效"的对应关系，纯规则方法在释义、元数据稀疏场景下脆弱。论文动机在于：企业对齐必须同时满足受控的语义分解、显式的单位/粒度兼容性、约束不完整时的优雅降级、以及决策可审计性，而这些需求单独依赖神经或符号方法均无法同时满足。
AI.method: CGM采用三阶段漏斗式流水线，将约束作为假设空间算子在神经推理之前运作。阶段一为schema基础的约束定义：每条约束c=<a_si, m_c, a_tj>关联源/目标属性，元数据m_c=<τ_c, δ_c>指定约束类型（硬/软）和可执行的关系与归一化逻辑；硬约束通过可执行谓词定义可接受性，软约束提供排序证据；LLM可根据代表性样例从专家骨架中提议可执行δ_c，专家可直接编辑以修正归一化错误；当约束无法预枚举时，采用LLM无关的recall×selectivity子集搜索自动发现硬约束。阶段二为约束限制的候选生成：对源实体e_s首先执行硬约束（包括值依赖的单位检查），若严格执行结果为空则应用级联松弛（按优先级顺序丢弃约束直至可行集非空），若最优可接受候选相似度低于阈值则额外施加相似度松弛（适用于碰撞码场景）。阶段三为软约束神经排序与有界LLM消歧：在可接受集H(e_s)内用编码器（如text-embedding-3-large）计算余弦相似度并叠加软约束得分得到s(e_s, e_t) = sim(e_s, e_t) + Σw_c·c(e_s, e_t)，取Top-k形成短列表M̂(e_s)；LLM仅在该短列表上进行消歧，返回的键与短列表相交，保证预测M̃(e_s) ⊆ M̂(e_s) ⊆ H(e_s)由结构而非模型保证。此外，专家可提供自然语言属性优先级（作为软审计工件注入提示）以残差优化部分匹配。方法论上，约束被视为假设空间操作器而非后置验证器，从而具备受控降级和人类可引导的可审计决策能力。
AI.result: 在受控合成结构诱饵基准上：硬可接受性将候选空间缩小约480倍（从~12k缩至~0.2%），在不丢失GT的前提下达到100% recall；逐层消融显示硬门控层将F1从0.08提升至0.66（提升0.58），是该方法的决定性提升而非LLM本身；在不同异质性类别（单位不一致、粒度不匹配、版本/标识符、隐式属性编码）上CGM全面优于未约束LLM（complete 42-72%对0-4%），所有CGM配置使valid-match达100%而未约束LLM仅约10%（与模型规模无关）。在成本上，前沿gpt-5.4与小型gpt-5.4-nano在CGM内均达100%有效性，相同候选数下小型模型比无约束前沿模型成本低约28倍。SOTA匹配器Magneto在该结构诱饵场景下Recall@5仅约0.05（基准为0.62），是检索层面失败，其GPT重排器因Recall@50仅0.17而上界受限于0.17。在公开Valentine（列级schema匹配）上CGM具竞争力（MRR 1.00对比Magneto 0.93），刚性类型门控会使MRR降至0.94，表明约束应在结构不变性决定匹配时才设为硬约束。在企业部署中：CGM在7个车型make上以相同流水线在各自自动发现的约束下达到宏平均F1 0.70（Make A 0.855、Make B 0.793、Make C 0.711、Make D 0.654、Make E 0.634、Make F 0.400、Make G 0.857），Make A上标识符约束将候选池缩小约18倍且recall近100%；专家工作量从电子表格工作流的10.5天/车型降至1.5天/车型（约7×降幅），交互次数从>100降至31，每车型仅需2条硬约束+1条软约束。
AI.conclusion: CGM作为一种约束引导的神经符号方法，将硬约束作为神经推理之前的假设空间操作器，而非后置验证器，从而在企业实体对齐中同时获得语义灵活性与结构正确性（by construction）。逐层证据链表明：硬可接受性门控是性能提升的决定性层（而非LLM能力），且具备模型无关、零额外推理成本的特性；级联松弛机制在噪声和碰撞码场景下保证优雅降级和可审计性；该方法在7个企业make上以通用约束原语（模型名软约束+标识符/代码硬约束+排量）成功迁移，平均F1达0.70，专家工作量降低约7×。论文识别出适用边界：硬约束应在结构不变性决定匹配时启用，在lexico-semantic可分的列级场景（如Valentine）应退化为软提示。剩余性能瓶颈源于约束覆盖率（即源端缺少判别性键时约束无法触发）而非嵌入或LLM规模，未来工作方向为自动约束归纳、不确定性校准和跨领域（金融、生命科学、地理空间）验证。

title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage
summary: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. The benchmark is built from carefully selected real-data tasks where both output quality and task-relevant distinctness can be checked automatically and reproducibly, without model-based judges. VTC measures how many distinct useful results are obtained within $k$ attempts. Across multiple models and inference settings, the benchmark leads to different conclusions from conventional evaluation: configurations that look strongest from single-draw quality are not necessarily those with the best coverage, and simple measures of output variation do not reliably recover task-relevant coverage. These results show that finite candidate sets can be evaluated directly as objects of interest, revealing differences in model behavior that are not apparent from conventional per-output evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTC-Bench基准和Validated Task Coverage (VTC)评估指标，用于直接评估LLM在固定尝试预算下生成多个候选输出时的有效覆盖能力，揭示传统单次输出质量评估无法捕捉的模型差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注单次输出的质量（如pass@k、自一致性、best-of-N），或将多样本压缩为单一成功指标，这忽略了候选集中是否包含多个真正不同的有用结果。用户在实际应用中常常需要比较、验证或组合多个候选输出，因此候选集本身才是有意义的评估对象。
AI.method: 1) 定义VTC：经k次尝试后，通过任务特定的验证函数τ_x检查输出有效性并映射到有用结果，通过覆盖函数u_x取并集得到不同有用结果的数量；2) 构建VTC-Bench：包含5个真实数据任务（分子设计、代码仓库修复、缺陷发现、鉴别诊断、证据检索），每个任务有自动可复现的质量校验和确定性的有用结果映射，无需模型评判器；3) 评估24种模型-推理配置（4个模型×3个温度×2种思考模式）；4) 比较独立采样与链式生成的效果。
AI.result: 1) 在5个任务中的4个上，k=1时的最优配置并非预算H时的最优配置（如分子设计中Qw-27B T=1.0领先于k=1，但GLM-4.7 T=1.2在H=20时反超0.502个不同骨架）；2) 按单次质量选取的Top-5配置平均VTC遗憾达12.1%，与VTC Top-5仅10/25重合；3) 表面多样性选取的遗憾为11.0%，重合11/25；4) 温度从0.6升至1.2在38/40的比较中提升VTC，但其中25次单次质量反而下降；5) 思考模式对覆盖的改善不如对单次质量一致；6) 链式生成（显式多样性提示）效果因任务而异，对证据检索有益但对代码修复有害。
AI.conclusion: VTC-Bench证明了有限候选集本身是可被直接评估的对象，其行为展现出与单次质量评估不同的模型差异。验证覆盖率随尝试预算呈现不同轨迹，预算依赖的排名变化和任务依赖的推理选择效应表明：在多次生成场景下，传统质量评估不足以指导模型选择，VTC提供了更合适的评估框架。

title: TRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate intermediate reasoning traces that may contain unsafe content, even when their final responses appear safe. Guardrail models are designed to detect and block unsafe content, yet existing benchmarks for unsafe content detection focus primarily on prompts and final responses, leaving reasoning traces largely unexamined. Moreover, these benchmarks typically provide only binary safety labels, without evidence annotations that justify the judgments. To address these limitations, we introduce TRACE, an evidence-grounded safety evaluation benchmark that covers the entire LRM inference pipeline: prompts, reasoning traces, and final responses. TRACE includes prompts in two languages spanning nine risk categories and ten attack strategies. For each prompt, four LRMs generate reasoning traces and final responses, and we annotate the safety of each component and extract supporting evidence from the corresponding source text. Evaluating 18 guardrail models on TRACE reveals that safety judgment for reasoning traces is substantially more challenging than for prompts or final responses, and that current models struggle to accurately extract supporting evidence. These findings highlight the need for guardrail models that can reliably detect and precisely localize unsafe content across the LRM inference pipeline.

AI.tldr: TRACE是首个面向大推理模型（LRM）全推理流程的证据驱动安全评估基准，揭示了当前护栏模型在推理轨迹安全性判断和证据定位方面面临的重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有不安全内容检测基准主要关注提示词和最终响应的安全性，而LRM生成的中间推理痕迹即使在最终响应安全的情况下也可能包含不安全内容。此外，现有基准仅提供二元安全标签，缺乏支撑判断的证据标注，无法评估护栏模型精确定位不安全内容的能力。
AI.method: TRACE基准的构建流程包括：（1）从S-Eval和WildChat两个公开数据集中分层采样1993条提示词，覆盖9类风险类别、10种攻击策略和中英两种语言；（2）使用4个LRM（包括安全对齐版本和去对齐版本）生成推理痕迹和最终响应，得到5000个有效三元组；（3）使用3个强大的LRM对提示词、推理痕迹、最终响应的安全性进行多维度标注，并通过多数投票确定安全标签，仅保留可验证为源文本连续子串的证据；（4）采用FPR、FNR、F1分数评估安全判断正确性，采用TokenF1评估证据归因准确性。论文评估了18个代表性护栏模型。
AI.result: 主要实验结果：（1）18个模型中14个在提示词安全判断上表现最佳，推理痕迹安全判断最具挑战性（平均F1为66.31%，低于提示词的75.75%和最终响应的70.53%）；（2）YuFeng-XGuard-8B在推理痕迹安全判断上取得最高F1分数84.26%，PolyGuard-8B为82.57%；（3）证据归因能力普遍较差，最佳模型YuFeng-XGuard-8B在提示词、推理痕迹、最终响应上的TokenF1仅分别为11.68%、14.88%、13.71%；（4）17/18的模型在中文内容判断上优于英文；（5）指令加密（IE）攻击导致所有模型性能严重下降，Qwen3Guard-0.6B和4B在IE攻击下推理痕迹判断F1为0.00%；（6）基于Qwen系列的护栏模型普遍优于基于Llama、Mistral、Gemma的同规模模型。
AI.conclusion: TRACE揭示了当前护栏模型在LRM全推理流程中进行安全判断的两大核心不足：推理痕迹安全性判断难度显著高于提示词和最终响应，以及证据归因能力普遍薄弱。研究强调了开发能够在LRM推理流程各阶段可靠检测并精确定位不安全内容的护栏模型的必要性。未来工作将扩展至更多语言，并通过更大规模的人工评估进一步提升标注质量。

title: STRIVE: Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
summary: Longitudinal radiology report generation (LRRG) requires identifying both current findings and their changes relative to a prior study. Existing methods jointly model diagnosis, attribute estimation, temporal comparison, and language generation within implicit representations, which can cause task interference, obscure the evidence underlying each decision, and limit error traceability. They also model progression states as independent labels, ignoring their ordered structure and thus treating missed changes and direction reversals equally. We present STRIVE, Multi-Agent Structured Temporal Reasoning with Integrated Verification for LRRG, which decomposes clinical reasoning into specialized Diagnosis, Attribute, and Temporal Change Agents that produce explicit intermediate evidence. In particular, the Temporal Change Agent is further post-trained using Progression-Aware GRPO, a verifiable, shaped reward that assigns partial credit to direction-preserving errors while scoring direction reversals lowest. STRIVE performs verification at two stages: a deterministic Consistency Gate reconciles the agent outputs before report generation, and a Validation Agent checks whether the generated report is supported by the aggregated clinical evidence. On Longitudinal-MIMIC, STRIVE attains the best clinical efficacy among recent methods and more than doubles Longitudinal Change Concordance (LCC), a measure of temporal agreement with the reference report, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: STRIVE是一个用于纵向放射学报告生成的多智能体框架，通过分解临床推理任务并引入渐进感知强化学习奖励，在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上显著提升了纵向变化描述的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有纵向放射学报告生成方法将诊断、属性估计、时间比较和语言生成耦合在隐式共享表示中，导致任务干扰、证据不透明和错误难以溯源；此外，现有方法将进展状态建模为独立标签，忽略了其有序结构，对漏检变化和方向反转同等对待。
AI.method: STRIVE将纵向报告生成分解为三个专门智能体：诊断智能体（判定14项发现的当前存在性）、属性智能体（估计阳性的严重程度和位置）和时间变化智能体（利用先验报告、诊断状态和图像概率判定六种变化标签）。时间变化智能体通过Progression-Aware GRPO进行后训练，使用三级成形奖励（检测、粗粒度方向、细粒度标签）。框架包含两阶段验证：报告生成前的确定性Consistency Gate协调诊断与变化状态冲突，生成后的Validation Agent检查报告是否得到结构化临床证据支持。
AI.result: 在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上，STRIVE在所有NLG指标（除ROUGE-L外）和全部CE指标上取得最佳成绩；LCC-C达到0.394、LCC-F达到0.283，是最强基线的两倍以上，置信区间不重叠。消融实验表明时间变化智能体是纵向正确性的主要贡献者，移除后LCC-C从0.394降至0.148。变化遗漏率从基线的0.71-0.87降至0.46。
AI.conclusion: STRIVE通过多智能体分解将临床推理与语言生成分离，使结构化临床证据显式可追溯；Progression-Aware GRPO有效建模进展状态的序数结构；两阶段验证机制保证最终报告与临床证据一致。实验证明该框架在报告质量、临床效能和纵向变化准确性三方面均显著优于现有方法，且改进具有统计显著性。

title: SA-Bench: Evaluating Semantic Alignment in LLM-Based Paper Reproduction
summary: LLM agents can generate paper reproduction code, yet often produce scientifically unfaithful implementations. We define this failure mode as semantic drift, where generated code silently diverges from the paper's specifications. We introduce SemanticAlign-Bench(SA-Bench), a diagnostic benchmark covering 30 papers from ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025. For each paper, we decompose its specifications into atomic and verifiable implementation claims, which we call Semantic Alignment Units (SAUs) and evaluate repositories along four diagnostic dimensions spanning numerical, methodological, protocol and ordering drift. In total, we construct 1,491 SAUs across five ML domains and evaluate 12 generator configurations (4 models $\times$ 3 scaffolds). Even the strongest configuration (Claude+PaperCoder) achieves a mean SAU score of only 0.301 out of 1.0, with an overall mean of 0.221 across 360 evaluations. A failure taxonomy reveals that agents attempt most requirements but implement them incorrectly, with implementation mismatch and stubs accounting for the majority of zero-scored claims. Our analysis further indicates that scaffolds optimized for executability provide limited leverage for scientific reproduction; narrowing the gap requires scaffolds that prioritize semantic specification verification. The benchmark, annotations and evaluation pipeline are publicly available.

AI.tldr: SA-Bench 是一个诊断性基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在论文复现代码生成中的语义对齐程度。它将论文规范分解为原子化的"语义对齐单元"(SAU)，并沿四个维度(数值、方法、协议、顺序)系统诊断"语义漂移"。在 30 篇论文、12 种生成配置上的评估显示，当前最强的配置(Claude+PaperCoder)平均 SAU 得分仅为 0.301，表明现有智能体生成的代码虽常可执行但与论文规范存在系统性偏离，而面向可执行性优化的现有脚手架对科学复现帮助有限。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体在论文复现任务中生成的代码虽然可执行，但常常未忠实实现论文的科学规范（即"语义漂移"）。现有基准（如 PaperBench）仅评估端到端复现结果是否一致，缺乏对代码与论文规范之间偏差的系统分类与细粒度诊断。需要一个以规范为基础(specification-grounded)、按可验证声明粒度评估的诊断基准。
AI.method: 1. **任务形式化**：将论文复现评估建模为静态(不执行代码)、声明级别的打分问题：输入论文 P 与智能体生成的代码仓库 R，输出基于 SAU 的逐条诊断评分。2. **SAU 提取流水线**：(a) 规则式代码优先过滤剔除不可实现内容；(b) 三个并行专科代理(D1 数值匹配器、D2 方法解析器、D3 协议枚举器)按维度提取各子代理 1–3 节，避免长上下文注意力衰减；(c) D4 步骤排序在合并阶段从 D2/D3 排序标注派生；(d) 强制人工审核(1–2 小时/论文)过滤与精化，舍弃率约 17%。3. **四维漂移分类法**：D1 数值精度、D2 方法/公式、D3 实验协议、D4 步骤排序。4. **五级评分标准**（0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1），GPT-5.5 作为评判器，在自动检索代码证据后逐条 SAU 打分并附文件:行号引用与自然语言解释；并通过 200 条样本的人工核对验证评判一致性(约 87%)。5. **评估规模**：30 篇 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 2025 论文、5 个 ML 领域、1,491 个人工审核 SAU、4 个模型(Claude-Sonnet-4.6、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Gemini-2.5-Flash、GPT-4o)× 3 个脚手架(BasicAgent/PaperCoder/OpenHands)=12 种配置，360 次论文级评估，约 17,892 条声明级判断。
AI.result: **总体性能**：12 种配置在 30 篇论文上的平均 SAS 为 0.221（中位数 0.237），最强配置 Claude+PaperCoder 仅达 0.301；17,892 个判断中的得分分布严重右偏。**模型主导**：Claude-Sonnet-4.6 边际均值 0.283，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 0.263，Gemini-2.5-Flash 0.217，GPT-4o 仅 0.120；模型选择影响大于脚手架选择。**维度层级普遍成立**：D1>D2>D4>D3，D3（实验协议）成为普遍瓶颈（满分率仅 0.7%，零分率 44.8%）。**脚手架效应依赖基础能力**：PaperCoder 对弱模型(GPT-4o +0.116)增益最大，对强模型(Claude +0.029、DeepSeek -0.027)增益有限甚至退步。**零分归因**：实现错配 40.8%、占位符/桩代码 16.2%、外部知识缺口 8.0%、仅提及关键词 3.7%。**领域与范式影响**：领域间总 SAS 极差仅 0.030，小于配置间 0.219 差距；生成器质量主导领域效应。最难的论文分布在多个段落、以散文叙述为主（如 SAM 2，SAS=0.158）。
AI.conclusion: 语义漂移在所有测试配置中普遍存在：智能体尝试了大部分需求但实现不正确，现有可执行性导向的脚手架（CodeAct 式执行反馈、PaperCoder 一次性分析-编码流水线）对科学复现帮助有限。OpenHands 依赖执行信号，PaperCoder 缺乏语义规范验证闭环；缩小差距需要专门做"语义规范验证"的新型脚手架。此外，约 17% 抽取候选被人工拒绝，主要失效模式包括：基线方法污染（将引用文献误当作本文贡献）、结果数值当作规范提取、D1–D4 类型误分类、过细拆解以及附录协议遗漏。该基准、注释与评估流水线已公开。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Dual-Judge Evaluation Protocol for Vision-Language Models in Legally Grounded Tasks
comment: Accepted and presented at the AI for Law Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: AI systems are increasingly evaluated for legally accountable settings, where correct outputs must also be justifiable against an applicable legal standard. Existing legal-AI benchmarks and LLM-as-judge protocols provide important infrastructure for measuring task performance and open-ended response quality. We contribute one additional evaluation signal: a dual-judge protocol that pairs a standard 0-10 quality judge with a strict binary semantic-equivalence judge against a human-curated reference. We study a controlled, visually grounded regulatory task - UK traffic-sign interpretation, whose meaning is a codified question with a known reference for every input - and measure not merely whether the two judges disagree (by construction they must) but how much and where. On 4,680 evaluations under seven visibility levels and two occlusion modes, the two judges are moderately associated (point-biserial r = 0.644), while revealing an asymmetric Type II pattern affecting 8.0% of all evaluations. Its distribution is instructive: the marginal rate peaks at high visibility (14.2% at v = 0.8) simply because high-scoring answers are common there, but conditioned on the answer already scoring above 7, the rate is highest under heavy occlusion (54-63% at v <= 0.3), so a high quality score is least trustworthy when the input is most degraded. We are explicit that the signal is a property of this judge and reference: a 49-row human check shows the 0-10 judge aligns closely with everyday-reader judgement (Pearson r = 0.81; r = 0.80 with the LLM accuracy sub-score), while the equivalence judge is fairly but one-directionally stricter. The protocol adds one LLM call per evaluation and surfaces a signal single-judge protocols do not report. We release the prompt template, occluded variants, and full evaluation results.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在法律可问责场景下的评估方法，提出了一种"双裁判评估协议"（Dual-Judge Protocol），将标准的0-10质量裁判与严格的是否与人类参考语义等价的二元裁判配对使用。以英国交通标志识别为受控视觉法规任务，在4680次评估（30个标志×7个可见度等级×2种遮挡模式×3次重复）中，发现两个裁判中度相关（点二列相关r=0.644），并揭示了8.0%的"II型不对称分歧"——即质量裁判评分高于7但语义等价裁判拒绝的情况。关键发现是：边际分歧率在高可见度时最高（v=0.8时达14.2%），但在高分答案中条件性分歧率却在重度遮挡时最高（v≤0.3时达54–63%），意味着输入退化越严重，高质量分越不可信。49行人工评估验证了0-10裁判与日常读者判断高度吻合（Pearson r=0.81），而等价裁判则单向更严格。
AI.motivation: 在法律可问责的AI部署场景中，输出不仅需要"正确"，还需"可对适用法律标准证明其正当性"。现有法律AI基准（如LexGLUE、LegalBench）和LLM-as-judge协议仅报告单一质量评分，无法区分"听起来正确"与"与参考标准匹配"之间的差异。本文旨在补充这一评估信号。
AI.method: 1. 测试任务：英国交通标志识别（TSRGD法规下的编码化、视觉规则任务），采用30个标志、7个可见度等级（100%至10%）、2种遮挡模式（随机块遮挡、自底向上遮挡）。2. 系统配置：四个基于Azure GPT-4o的VLM系统——单智能体（SA）、SA+思维链（CoT）、SA+推理链（CoI）、多智能体（MA）。3. 双裁判协议：标准0-10质量裁判（Zheng et al., 2023风格，三维度：准确性、完整性、相关性）+ 二元语义等价裁判（与人类参考描述是否语义等价）。4. 方法审计修正：发现并修正了单裁判标签匹配伪影（label-matching artefact），引入强制SIGN_TYPE结构化输出。5. 人工评估验证：49行分层抽样由第一作者按固定评分标准注释。
AI.result: 1. 共4680次评估，两裁判点二列相关r=0.644。2. 91.4%评估落在非分歧象限；0.6%为I型分歧（裁判低估语义等价的）；8.0%为II型分歧（裁判高估但未通过语义等价检验，373行）。3. 系统排名在两裁判下不同：CoT在质量评分上领先（5.33），而CoI在等价率上领先（0.279）；MA在两裁判下均最差（3.41, 0.078）。4. II型边际率在v=0.8时峰值14.2%；条件性率（在overall>7的答案中）则在v≤0.3时达54-63%。5. 49行人工验证：0-10裁判与人工Pearson r=0.81（p<10⁻¹²），Spearman ρ=0.73；LLM准确性子分与人工Pearson r=0.80；等价裁判Cohen's κ=0.38（仅单向更严格）。
AI.conclusion: 双裁判协议通过仅增加一次LLM调用，能够揭示单一质量裁判无法报告的可见度依赖型不对称分歧信号。在法律可问责部署中，相关的问题是输出能否在对参考的审计中存活——而标准质量裁判衡量的是流畅性和信息性，二者不同。该协议与LexGLUE、LegalBench互补，不替代准确性评分；适用于参考存在但精确标签匹配不自然的开放式响应场景。论文明确将经验性发现在范围上限定为视觉法规任务，并指出共享模型偏差、数据集小、单一VLM骨干、参考为作者释义而非法规文本等局限性。已发布等价裁判提示模板、遮挡变体和完整评估结果以促进后续工作。

title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
summary: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models. However, existing synthesis methods typically rely on handcrafted rules to simulate changes, where limited coverage of class transitions restricts the diversity of synthesized data, while predefined transition designs limit their flexibility in accommodating varied change types. In this work, we introduce KnowChange, a knowledge-guided change data synthesis framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models as knowledge sources to reason about plausible change locations and class transitions from pre-change scenes and desired change types. By integrating knowledge-guided change simulation with generalizable synthesis models, KnowChange enables flexible synthesis of diverse change types within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KnowChange-generated data consistently outperforms existing synthetic datasets in both synthetic-to-real transfer and synthetic data augmentation, despite being generated at a compact scale. Further analyses show that the knowledge-guided change simulation can be seamlessly integrated into existing synthesis pipelines and enhance the downstream utility of synthesized data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KnowChange框架，利用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为知识源，引导遥感变化数据合成，解决了传统基于手工规则的方法中类别转换覆盖有限、灵活性不足的问题。通过VLM推理变化位置和类别转换，并结合可泛化的布局到掩码（L2M）和掩码到图像（M2I）模型，实现了多样化变化类型的灵活合成，并在合成到真实迁移和数据增强实验中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的变化数据合成方法依赖手工设计的规则来模拟变化，存在两个根本性局限：一是类转换覆盖范围有限，限制了合成数据的多样性；二是预定义的转换设计难以灵活适应不同的变化类型（如城市发展、交通监控等不同应用场景），需要重新设计规则。手工枚举和编码真实世界变化知识以应对多样化、不断演化的变化场景本质上是困难的。
AI.method: KnowChange框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 知识引导的变化模拟：利用预训练VLM（如Qwen3-VL）从变化前场景和用户指定的变化类型推理出合理的实际变化（包含形状保持型和形状改变型两种转换模式）和伪变化，生成变化布局；(2) 可泛化的语义引导合成：包括布局到掩码（L2M）模型（基于FLUX.1-Fill）和掩码到图像（M2I）模型（基于SD-v1.5+ControlNet）。使用从6个数据集整理的138K样本（含1000+类别）训练两个模型，并设计了实例级、区域级和全局级三种掩码策略以及类别感知实例掩码和随机区域掩码策略。
AI.result: 在4个建筑变化检测基准（LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD、DSIFN-CD、SEC-BCD）和2个语义变化检测基准（SECOND、HRSCD）上，KnowChange合成的数据集（Know-BCD、Know-SEC、Know-HR，每个仅10K样本）均优于现有合成数据集。BCD平均IoU提升6.64点，SCD平均F1提升6.78点。消融实验验证了VLM引导、形状改变型转换、形状保持型转换和伪变化模拟各组件的贡献。将知识引导的变化模拟作为即插即用模块集成到HySCDG和Changen2中也带来了显著提升。FID/KID指标显示KnowChange生成数据与真实数据分布更接近。
AI.conclusion: KnowChange提出了一种知识引导的变化数据合成范式，利用VLM替代手工规则进行变化模拟，结合通用语义引导合成模型，在紧凑规模下实现了多样化、高质量的遥感变化数据生成。该方法在合成到真实迁移和少样本数据增强场景中均表现出色，且可即插即用地集成到现有合成管线中。此外，该框架还可扩展到语义分割、建筑物提取等更广泛的遥感任务，以及长时间序列的城市演化模拟。

title: Eating for a Sustainable Planet: Personalized Sustainable Diet Recommendation via Constraint-Aware Decision-Making Modeling
summary: A sustainable diet represents a multi-dimensional synergy among four essential pillars: nutrition adequacy, economic affordability, cultural acceptability, and environmental respect. Despite the prevalence of population-level sustainability modeling, practical implementation relies on effective individual-level adoption. This transition is often hindered by inter-individual heterogeneity, posing a formidable challenge in aligning sustainable diet requirements with individual preferences. To address this issue, we propose a personalized sustainable diet recommendation model based on a constraint-aware decision-making mechanism, where sustainability is incorporated through learnable constraints rather than modeled as user preferences. To systematically evaluate the proposed approach, we construct a sustainable diet dataset named SusDiet with about 150k recipes, characterized by broad coverage of sustainability indicators. Experimental results on this dataset show that our method promotes more sustainable choices without compromising individual preference. This work establishes a framework for aligning individual dietary choices with planetary health, offering quantitative evidence to guide future sustainable diet interventions and policy-making for sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于约束感知决策机制的个性化可持续饮食推荐框架，将可持续性建模为可学习的用户特定约束（而非用户偏好），并构建了包含约15万食谱的大规模数据集SusDiet，涵盖营养、环境、经济和动物福利四个可持续性维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的可持续饮食研究主要在宏观（人口/国家）层面进行优化建模，忽视了个人层面的异质性；而现有的个性化推荐系统又通常将可持续性视为显式的用户偏好维度，这与现实中用户较少基于可持续性意识做出饮食决策的实际情况不符。因此需要在个体决策框架下，将可持续性作为约束而非偏好来建模。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于混合专家（MoE）Transformer的食谱可持续性表示模块，通过4个专家网络编码多维可持续性信号（营养、环境、经济、动物福利），采用不确定性加权多任务学习进行训练；(2) 多兴趣注意力机制，从食谱ID、成分和地域三个视图捕获用户异质性偏好；(3) 个性化约束感知权衡模块，学习用户特定的可持续性约束阈值λ_u和拉格朗日乘子α_u，通过约束函数F(u,r) = ŷ_{u,r} - α_u^T(s_r - λ_u)在推荐排序中动态惩罚超出用户可持续性边界的食谱。整体优化目标联合考虑评分损失、排序损失、可持续性惩罚损失和L2正则化。
AI.result: 在自建的SusDiet数据集（149,036个食谱、179,869个用户、744,138条交互）上，方法在NDCG和Recall指标上达到最优或接近最优水平，同时在营养、经济和动物福利维度均取得最优改善（虽环境指标非最优但实现了更平衡的权衡）。多任务可持续性预测在所有四个维度上R²均≥0.987。消融实验验证了三个组件的必要性：去除约束机制会导致可持续性指标显著恶化；高冲突场景分析表明该方法对最不可持续用户群体（Top 10%）仍能有效改善所有四个维度的可持续性，仅推荐精度有轻微损失。案例研究显示该方法能为偏好红肉的推荐更可持续的替代菜品。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将个性化可持续饮食推荐重新定义为约束感知决策问题，通过将可持续性建模为可学习的用户特定约束而非偏好，更好地反映了现实中的饮食决策方式。框架为个性化推荐系统中的可持续性融入提供了原则性基础，对可持续饮食干预和政策制定具有参考价值。局限性包括：约束从历史交互推断可能受曝光偏差影响；假设静态偏好和约束；可持续性指标本身存在不确定性；仅进行了离线实验评估。

title: RePolicy: Reinforcement Learning for Safety-Policy Invocation in Agent Safeguards
summary: Safeguarding language model agents requires assessing complete execution trajectories under context-dependent safety policies. Existing policy-aware safeguards mainly rely on prompting or supervised fine-tuning, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen trajectories and changing policy contexts. We propose RePolicy, an agent safeguard that learns safety-policy invocation through reinforcement learning. Given an agent trajectory and a dynamic policy library, RePolicy invokes the applicable policy and uses its content to produce a policy-grounded rationale and safety judgment. We construct PolicyTraj-20K to support supervised initialization, followed by GRPO with verifiable rewards and policy-context perturbation. Experiments across six agent safety benchmarks show that RePolicy achieves strong overall safety-detection performance and robust policy invocation under varying policy contexts.

AI.tldr: RePolicy提出了一种通过强化学习（GRPO）学习安全策略调用（policy invocation）的LLM智能体安全护栏方法，基于Qwen3-4B构建，在六个智能体安全基准上达到最优整体性能（Unsafe F1 88.15%）。
AI.motivation: 现有的策略感知型智能体护栏主要依赖提示工程或监督微调，难以适应未见过的执行轨迹和动态变化的安全策略上下文，无法有效判断应调用哪条策略以及如何应用其条款。
AI.method: 1. 数据构建：构建PolicyTraj-20K数据集，包含2万多条按"操作场景"组织的策略标注轨迹；2. 冷启动SFT：先通过监督微让模型学会"调用策略→获取策略内容→推理→安全判断"的序列结构；3. GRPO强化学习：使用可验证奖励（格式奖励0.1 + 策略调用奖励0.3 + 准确性奖励0.6）优化完整rollout；4. 策略上下文扰动（policy-context perturbation）：在候选策略库中混入无关策略和诱饵策略，防止模型依赖表面关联；5. 基于Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507实现，最终得到RePolicy-4B。
AI.result: 在6个智能体安全基准（ATBench、R-Judge、OpenAgentSafety、ASSEBench、HINTBench、AgentHazard，共7,369条轨迹）上，RePolicy-4B Overall Unsafe F1达到88.15%，超越最强外部基线3.98点、最强专用护栏8.46点，在4个基准上排名第一；策略调用准确率R_pol从冷启动的94.4%提升至98.5%；消融实验验证了冷启动SFT（+28.48点）、显式策略调用（+2.32点）、策略上下文扰动各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将安全策略视为可调用的"能力"而非被动上下文，通过agentic强化学习直接优化策略调用与安全判断的完整序列，使护栏能更准确、可解释地适配动态变化的策略上下文，为构建更灵活可解释的智能体护栏提供了可行方向。

title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction
summary: Paper-to-code reproduction asks scientific AI agents to turn research papers into executable repositories that preserve the paper's method, protocol and artifacts. This is difficult because the specification is split: explicit paper content such as algorithms, metrics and artifacts is often lost across long agent trajectories, while implicit details such as framework defaults and conventions inherited from related work are absent from the paper. We introduce ReproAgent, a four-stage Prepare--Plan--Generate--Repair pipeline built around a persistent implementation contract with two channels: an implementation-requirement channel that turns paper snippets into code obligations, and a reference-evidence channel that retrieves content and structure evidence from related repositories. Both are bound to work packages, projected into file-level contracts, and consumed across generation and repair. On PaperBench Code-Dev, ReproAgent reaches the highest mean score among same-backbone scaffolds under both Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and Gemini-3-Flash. End-to-end channel ablations and per-paper cases support the contribution of both channels. Code and experimental artifacts are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ReproAgent 提出了一种"合同引导"的论文到代码复现流程，通过持久化的双通道实现合同（实现需求通道+参考证据通道），在 PaperBench Code-Dev 基准上取得当前最优性能。
AI.motivation: 论文到代码复现中存在"分叉规范"问题：论文中明确的实现需求（算法、指标、产物）在长轨迹中容易丢失，而隐含的实现细节（框架默认、参考仓库约定）又不存在于论文中。现有方法缺乏一种持久化的审计对象来同时承载显性义务和隐性依据，导致生成的代码虽然可运行但忠实度不足。
AI.method: ReproAgent 采用四阶段 Prepare-Plan-Generate-Repair 流水线，核心是"实现合同"对象，包含两个通道：(1) 实现需求通道：从论文片段提取代码义务（结构化 unit 记录），通过保留不变量（所有权、文件投影、来源、判定）保证不被静默丢弃；(2) 参考证据通道：从相关仓库检索内容证据（公式/接口复用）和结构证据（文件布局/入口），绑定到工作包后再投影到文件级合同。验证阶段产生两类报告（需求审查+运行时验证），失败时通过修复票据进行有针对性的局部修复而非整体重生成。
AI.result: 在 PaperBench Code-Dev 的全部 20 篇论文上：(1) 全套对比：ReproAgent（Claude-Sonnet-4.5）平均分 73.7，超过 DeepCode（73.5）、Deep-Reproducer（63.2）、AutoReproduce（49.6）等；(2) 同 backbone 对比：Gemini-3-Flash 下达到 39.7，超过 AiScientist（30.5）、IterAgent（20.6）、BasicAgent（19.3）；(3) 通道消融：去除参考证据平均下降 18.1 分，去除实现需求平均下降 14.1 分，且在全部 20 篇上全合同均优于任一消融。逐案例分析表明两通道互补——实现需求通道保留论文特有的命名义务（如基线、消融），参考证据通道提供仓库级脚手架（产物路径、配置、训练回路）。
AI.conclusion: 论文级义务与参考仓库证据在以合同形式持久化后才最具效用——一旦绑定，两者即可同时为规划提供锚点、暴露覆盖失败、并限定修复范围。ReproAgent 的两通道合同机制是一种通用的设计模板，可推广到其他复现设置、模态和评估协议。

title: VideoHarness-RSI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Video Understanding with Frozen Vision-Language Models
summary: Long-video understanding depends critically on how a limited model context is constructed from a much longer video. Existing approaches improve this process through compression, retrieval, memory, and agentic evidence acquisition, but these mechanisms are typically introduced as part of a manually designed inference system or optimized together with other components. This makes it difficult to isolate a simpler question: how much can be gained by improving the executable context-construction program alone? We study this question through VIDEOHARNESS-RSI, a controlled baseline for recursively searching executable context constructors around a frozen vision-language model (VLM). An outer-loop proposer uses prior programs, evaluation outcomes, and execution traces to generate candidate harnesses, which are executed and evaluated end to end before successful variants are retained for further search. This makes long-video understanding a controlled instance of automated harness design: the searchable object is executable program structure, while the answering model and interface remain fixed. Starting from uniform sampling, recursive harness search consistently finds room for improvement and surpasses several weaker hand-crafted baselines. Starting instead from a stronger hand-crafted baseline, the same RSI process yields a further improvement. The selected harness also transfers to additional long-video benchmarks without further search. Together, these results establish executable context construction as a distinct optimization layer and provide a reproducible baseline for studying harness discovery and transfer around frozen VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VideoHarness-RSI，一个围绕冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）递归搜索可执行上下文构建程序（harness）的受控基线。通过外层 proposer 生成候选 harness，在开发集上端到端评估并保留更优程序，将长视频理解任务转化为自动化 harness 设计的受控实例。实验表明，从均匀采样或更强的手工基线出发，递归搜索均能稳定提升性能，且选出的 harness 可无需重新搜索直接迁移到其他长视频基准。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法通过压缩、检索、记忆和智能体证据获取等机制提升性能，但这些机制通常作为手动设计的推理系统的一部分引入，或与其他组件联合优化，难以隔离"仅改进可执行上下文构建程序"能带来多少收益。本文旨在回答：在 VLM 及其接口保持冻结的情况下，仅通过改进上下文构建程序本身能获得多大提升。
AI.method: 将 harness 形式化为可执行程序 H(V,q;K)，将视频-问题对映射到有界多模态上下文 C_H，再由冻结 VLM 给出答案。提出 Write–Read–Pack 分析分解：Write 构建可寻址表示（视频流、字幕列表、嵌入索引），Read 执行问题条件证据检索，Pack 排序并格式化有界上下文。递归搜索：外层 proposer（Claude Opus 4.6）根据当前前沿 F_t 和归档 A_t 生成 m 个候选 harness；每个候选经过冒烟测试后在 LVBench 开发集（350 题）端到端评估；仅当开发准确率严格提升时才更新前沿。两个搜索协议：从 Uniform-40 出发的均匀起点搜索和从 AKS 出发的强起点搜索。冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 作为回答模型，上下文预算 K=40 帧。
AI.result: 在 LVBench 上：从均匀起点出发，搜索依次接受 CaptionNavigate（43.4%）和 EmbedNavigate-Hybrid（48.6%），最终 EmbedNavigate-Hybrid 在保留集上达到 45.4%，优于 CLIP-kNN（41.7%）等检索基线；从 AKS 强起点出发，Timestampsed-AKS 在保留集上达到 50.3%（对比 AKS 的 46.5%）。机制分析表明，CaptionNavigate 的增益主要来自上下文组织和局部密度而非新增证据窗口；EmbedNavigate-Hybrid 的增益则来自更广泛的证据覆盖和稳健打包。直接迁移到 Video-MME（59.9→61.5）和 MLVU（63.2→65.9）均有一致提升。高容量搜索协议暴露了开发-测试选择差距。
AI.conclusion: 可执行上下文构建是一个独立且有意义的优化层。实验证明，仅通过改进 harness 程序即可在不修改底层模型的情况下提升长视频理解能力，且改善具有可迁移性。但搜索存在过拟合开发集反馈的风险，容量增大并不保证选择质量提升。该框架为围绕冻结 VLM 研究自动 harness 发现、迁移和搜索-评估差距提供了可复现的受控基线。

title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning
summary: Search-augmented reasoning remains difficult for small language models. On-policy distillation (OPD) from trained teachers offers a promising direction, but suffers from two issues: (1) high-quality multi-turn search trajectories depend on dynamic retriever responses, making SFT data prohibitively expensive to collect at scale; (2) task-specifically trained teachers incur substantial training cost, while directly applying OPD with an off-the-shelf teacher without task-specific fine-tuning constrains the student to the teacher's performance ceiling and suffers from severe training instability. We propose OPDSearch+, the first distillation paradigm that requires no teacher fine-tuning for search-augmented reasoning. We investigate the role of a frozen off-the-shelf instruct model as the teacher in on-policy distillation, and reveal a key insight: the teacher reshapes the student's policy distribution so that subsequent RL converges to a superior solution that RL alone cannot reach. In stage one, the student interacts with a live search engine and is distilled via a per-position forward KL objective, transferring reasoning decomposition and evidence integration skills without any task-specific teacher training. In stage two, RL refines the distilled student from a richer behavioral foundation, achieving performance that RL alone cannot reach from scratch. Across seven QA benchmarks, OPDSearch+ with a 3B model consistently outperforms all prior 3B RL baselines, achieving gains of 13.1% on HotpotQA and 8.5% on 2WikiMultihopQA.

AI.tldr: OPDSearch+提出了一种两阶段框架(策略内蒸馏+强化学习),将冻结的现成指令模型用作教师,无需针对任务微调教师模型,在搜索增强推理任务上以3B学生模型在七个QA基准上取得了当前3B模型中的最优性能,尤其在多跳推理任务上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有针对搜索增强推理的策略内蒸馏(OPD)存在两大问题:(1)高质量多轮搜索轨迹依赖动态检索器的响应,大规模SFT数据采集成本极高;(2)任务特定训练的教师模型成本高昂,而直接使用现成教师又会受限于教师性能上限并面临训练不稳定。论文旨在解决如何以低成本、可扩展的方式将搜索-推理能力蒸馏到小型语言模型中。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段(OPD):学生模型(Qwen2.5-3B)与实时搜索引擎交互生成在线策略轨迹,冻结的现成指令教师模型(Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct)在这些轨迹上计算token级对数概率,学生通过per-position forward KL目标(带裁剪的重要性加权估计)进行蒸馏,并使用KL正则化项防止偏离初始参考策略。第二阶段(RL):从最佳OPD检查点初始化,使用GRPO配合EM奖励+格式奖励进行强化学习微调。理论上建立了三个性质:(1)前向KL梯度分解提供隐式多级监督(推理/查询/答案token);(2)裁剪后的二阶矩有界,优于反向KL的方差控制;(3)在线策略评估消除了离线训练的分布偏移。
AI.result: 在七个QA基准(NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle)上,3B学生模型平均EM达到0.4402,超越所有3B基线(包括之前的最佳GiGPO-Instruct的0.421)。多跳任务提升尤为显著:HotpotQA +13.1%、2WikiMultihopQA +8.5%(均超过AutoRefine-Base)。消融实验表明:两阶段优于联合训练(0.4402 vs 0.3660)、优于纯OPD(0.3655)与纯RL(0.3524)、优于离线SFT+RL(0.4185);7B教师两阶段亦达0.4205。前向KL目标在稳定性(400+步不崩溃)和最佳EM(0.493)上均优于所有反向KL变体。OPD使策略熵从0.82提升至1.35,平均搜索轮次从3.5降至2.7。
AI.conclusion: OPDSearch+是首个面向交互式检索的、无需任务特定教师训练的策略内蒸馏框架。其核心洞见在于:教师的作用不是为模仿设定性能上限,而是通过重塑学生策略分布,使后续RL收敛到从零开始RL无法达到的更优解。前向KL目标提供稳定的、token级的密集监督,有效传递推理分解与证据整合能力,两阶段顺序训练避免目标干扰。总训练成本与Search-R1相当(约48 GPU小时,4×H200)。

title: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Voice-Agent Evaluation: Reliability, Calibration, and Human Oversight
comment: Extends LLM-as-a-Judge to voice agents across telecom and retail, testing GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 against human raters across 10 safety and efficiency metrics. A correlation-based calibration analysis reveals domain-dependent reliability and identifies Recovery Turn Count and safety-recall metrics as unreliable for fully automated judging
summary: Evaluating conversational voice agents at scale re- quires reliable assessment methods that capture both observ- able interaction quality and the contextual judgment typically provided by human evaluators. We investigate LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation by comparing human judgments with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 on telecom and retail voice-agent conversations, across conversational quality and safety dimensions. The same interac- tions are scored under three evaluation configurations, p0, p1, and p2, to test whether automated judgments are sensitive to the evaluation setup and whether observed patterns generalize across configurations and judge models. Beyond aggregate agreement, we examine metric-level correlations, evaluator consistency, and systematic human-LLM disagreement to identify which conver- sational attributes can be judged reliably by automation and which remain sensitive to interpretation and context. Effective voice-agent evaluation is also shaped by pipeline-level factors such as speech generation, streaming, and error propagation across ASR, reasoning, and tool-calling stages, motivating our focus on comparing how human and LLM judges score the same interactions end to end. Our results show that LLM- based evaluation can serve as an effective component of large- scale voice-agent assessment, but that its reliability is metric- and configuration-dependent rather than uniform. This pro- vides an empirical framework for identifying which metrics suit automated evaluation and supports hybrid pipelines in which LLM judges handle scalable assessment while human evaluators remain engaged for metrics that demand contextual interpretation and higher-confidence judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了人类评估者与GPT-4.1、GPT-5对242段电信和零售语音客服对话的评分，涵盖三种用户上下文配置及会话质量、目标达成和安全性指标。研究发现，LLM评审适合作为可扩展的首轮评估工具：跨配置和模型的趋势总体稳定，且对话效率、确认召回、用户努力等指标与人类较一致；但绝对分数仍存在明显、依赖指标与领域的校准偏差。最大风险集中在安全召回、不可逆操作安全和恢复轮数，LLM会漏判情境性风险并低估多轮恢复成本。GPT-4.1与GPT-5不存在统一优劣，应按指标选模或集成。论文因此主张“LLM初筛+人类复核”的混合流程。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体包含语音生成、流式传输、ASR、推理、工具调用与错误传播等多阶段过程，且需要规模化、兼顾交互质量与安全性的评估。传统人工评估成本高、难扩展；纯文本自动指标又难以覆盖语境判断。作者因此检验LLM评审能否可靠替代或补充人工评估，以及其结论在不同用户上下文配置、领域和指标间是否稳定。
AI.method: 研究使用242段对话：零售120段、电信122段，并分别置于p0（无用户上下文）、p1（静态人物设定）和p2（动态情境注入）三种配置。每段对话由3名训练有素的人类标注者按统一量表独立评分，分歧较大的案例交由第四名高级标注者裁决；最终取均值。GPT-4.1和GPT-5采用相同量表评分。分析指标包括CFA、CP、CR、IAS、SR、ARGA、TE、UES、ERR和RTC。比较方法包括人/机分数比、跨配置的稳定性、Pearson相关和Spearman秩相关。由于原文表格标注存在口径不清晰，相关性似乎主要以10个指标的汇总分数进行计算，而非逐案例估计，因此应谨慎解释。
AI.result: 跨p0、p1、p2及两个评审模型，指标趋势总体较稳定，说明适合进行指标级校准；GPT-4.1与GPT-5也会因指标而互换优劣。电信中，TE、CR、UES与人类相对一致，GPT-4.1的r=0.295（不显著），GPT-5的r=0.592；零售中两者分别达到r=0.912和0.943（均p<0.001）。IAS和SR出现最大人机分歧，尤其在电信，人类分数常为LLM的3–6倍，LLM会漏判高风险操作及必要升级。RTC方面，LLM难以追踪原始错误到真正恢复的完整多轮过程，评分偏低且跨配置波动很大。ARGA在两领域均低于1（电信0.117–0.265，零售0.383–0.657），表明LLM在存在ASR错误时比人类更宽松地认定目标已达成。CP和ERR在零售尤其不稳定，其中CP在p2下从GPT-4.1的0.492跳至GPT-5的1.934；ERR的人/机比最高达6.024。零售整体相关性强于电信，说明线性校准在零售更有依据，而电信可能还需修订量表和评分流程。ASR错误主要集中在姓名、订单号、电话号码、邮箱和URL等字母数字实体，直接造成重复澄清、信息捕获失败和不必要转人工。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审可有效承担大规模、趋势判断和首轮筛查任务，尤其适合较直接、定义清晰的指标；但不能被视为人工评估的全面替代。安全指标和高风险升级、错误恢复轮数等复杂多轮判断应保留人工复核；最佳实践是按领域和指标进行校准并选择评审模型，必要时采用多模型集成或“人机回退”机制。零售中按指标线性校准较有希望，电信中单纯缩放分数可能不足。后续工作应扩充数据集与任务，直接纳入音频、时间戳、沉默、打断、重叠语音和抢占失败等文本转写无法捕捉的现象，并进一步验证校准的跨领域泛化能力。

title: Can a Dynamic Internal Field Govern a Transformer's Cognition? Certifiability, not Superiority, in Homeostatic Compute Control
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Companion paper: "Where Cognition Lives" ( arXiv:2608.22347 ). Code, preregistrations and results: this https URL
summary: An intelligent system does not merely reason: it governs its own reasoning - how much to compute, when to stop, which module to activate. Can that role be played by a dynamic internal field - a low-dimensional homeostatic state with explicit physics and certified stability - that modulates cognition without performing it? Ours is a field on the module graph governed by a family of PDEs on the graph Laplacian, advancing with an adaptive-depth reasoner. We certify the stability of the integrator of the whole family - an integrator certificate, not a closed-loop one. New, and proved here: a discrete Schur-Cohn criterion for Verlet with velocity coupling, necessary and sufficient per latent root, with no commutation hypothesis. The answer is threefold: substance no, structure only in part, certifiability yes. The type of the field's physics is irrelevant for accuracy: wave, diffusion, gated mixtures and a 2D Navier-Stokes substrate tie. A twenty-seed preregistered deconfounding campaign bounds the structural claim: at equalized caps the second-order effect is strong in one family (+0.087 [+0.042, +0.132], t=4.0) but is not detected in the other (+0.014 [-0.013, +0.040], n.s.), so part of the original contrast was capacity, not order; and a matched-interface GRU is indistinguishable in the first and nominally exceeds the field in the second (-0.035 [-0.067, -0.002]). What distinguishes the field is not capability but that its one-step operator admits an exact runtime stability check - a difference of kind, not of existence: learned recurrences carry certificates too, sufficient and conservative ones. A kill-gate with a positive control finds no evidence for the field as evidence accumulator (Delta AUC +0.0007 [-0.0065, +0.0079] vs a 0.03 threshold). A dynamic internal field is a viable, certifiable compute governor, but not an enhancer of cognition: it modulates, it does not think.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Homeostatic Background Processor" (HBP)——一种基于图拉普拉斯上PDE族（波、扩散、KdV等）的低维动态场，用作Transformer的自适应推理的"元认知计算调控器"。核心结论是：场的物理类型对精度无影响（substance no）；二阶动力学的OOD计算分配稳健性仅在一个生成元族中成立且可被匹配接口的GRU复现（structure only in part）；场的独特价值在于其单步算子具备精确的运行时稳定性证书（certifiability yes）。新成果是证明了带速度耦合的Verlet积分器的离散Schur-Cohn判据（无需交换性假设）。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer固定深度计算，在对数精度下属TC⁰，需依赖"捷径"且不能外推。已有自适应计算方法（ACT、PonderNet等）的终止策略均为端到端学习，易在训练分布上过拟合。本文受生物稳态/神经调节系统启发，提出用具有显式物理和可证明稳定性的动态内部场来锚定计算分配决策。
AI.method: 1) 架构：在Transformer模块图上定义HBP场，节点持有VEI状态，通过图拉普拉斯耦合的PDE族（阻尼波、KdV型、扩散）演化，通过通用接口（内感受si、调制mi）调节推理器；2) 稳定性分析：证明反称算子的放置二分律（陀螺型vs位置型）、IMEX核的无条件收缩性，以及新的带速度耦合Verlet积分器的复系数离散Schur-Cohn判据（必要充分、无交换假设）；3) 实验：在NC¹-难的S₅状态跟踪任务上，进行预注册协议（n=10，含BF16精度bug的A/B），并展开20颗种子的去混杂活动（含匹配接口GRU对照）。
AI.result: 物质（物理类型）方面：波、扩散、KdV、非局部泊松耦合乃至2D Navier-Stokes流基底在精度上均无差异（|Δ|≤0.012），可能因梯度将时序需求粗粒化为准静态设定点；不可压缩流因∇·u=0无法向点集中信息。结构（阶数）方面：原始二阶效应在adjacent族显著（+0.087 [+0.042, +0.132], t=4.0），但cycle_transp族不显著（+0.014 [-0.013, +0.040]），匹配接口GRU在第一族无差异、在第二族名义上超过场（-0.035 [-0.067, -0.002]）。可证性方面：场拥有精确的运行时谱半径检查，而GRU等学习递归需专门机制获得充分但保守的ISS证书。证据累积器角色经kill-gate验证被拒绝（ΔAUC=+0.0007 vs 0.03阈值）。
AI.conclusion: 动态内部场可作为Transformer认知的可行且可证明稳定的计算调控器（"脑干"层），但不能增强认知——它调制而非思考。场对精度的贡献为零，其在OOD计算分配上的稳健性仅限于一个生成元族且非物理独有。场的独特贡献是可证明的稳定性（积分器证书），而非能力或优越性。该工作将HBP定位在认知架构的元认知/自主神经调节层。

title: SonarLLM: A Native Sonar--Optical Multimodal Large Language Model for Underwater Perception
summary: Reliable underwater perception requires complementary sensing under variable visibility. Optical cameras capture appearance and semantics but degrade rapidly with turbidity, whereas imaging sonar preserves geometry while exhibiting distinct range-azimuth structure and acoustic artifacts. Existing MLLMs, built primarily on optical encoders, are therefore ill-suited to model sonar or adaptively exploit sonar-optical complementarity. We propose SonarLLM, a sonar-optical MLLM that treats sonar as a native perceptual modality. It combines a sonar-specific encoder, modality-specific physics-aware feature enhancement, and reliability-aware hierarchical fusion to align acoustic structure with optical semantics and dynamically adjust their contributions as sensing quality changes. We also introduce SonarBench, a paired benchmark that spans four tasks: recognition, counting, visual question answering, and captioning; and, across the benchmark, three input settings: sonar-only, optical-only, and fusion. By fixing the scene and sonar observation while varying optical degradation, SonarBench enables controlled measurement of cross-modal complementarity. SonarLLM achieves 72.0% macro accuracy across sonar-only recognition, counting, and VQA, outperforming the strongest baseline by 34.4 percentage points, and 68.7% under fusion, exceeding the best baseline by 25.1 points. For recognition and counting, the fusion-over-optical gain grows from 6.0 to 36.0 points as turbidity increases, indicating the increasing complementary value of sonar under controlled optical degradation. Together, these results show that robust heterogeneous perception depends not only on adding sonar, but on representing and weighting it according to its sensing characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出SonarLLM，一种将声呐作为原生感知模态的多模态大语言模型，结合SonarBench基准，通过配对控制实验验证了声呐-光学异构融合在水下感知中的互补价值。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM主要基于光学编码器，无法有效建模声呐或自适应利用声呐-光学互补性；水下浑浊度变化使光学退化，而声呐几何结构不受光照影响但具有独特的距离-方位几何和声学伪影。需要一种能处理异构感知、感知质量依赖的融合方法。
AI.method: SonarLLM包含四个核心组件：(1) 极坐标感知声呐视觉Transformer（PSVT），配备多尺度Sonar Stem和距离-方位位置编码；(2) 模态特定视觉特征增强（Optical-VFE/Acoustic-VFE），分别针对散射和混响/距离衰减进行特征空间校正；(3) 自适应门控融合模块（AGFM）+双流DeepStack分层注入至语言模型第8/16/24层；(4) 四阶段渐进训练：声呐域适应→声学语义学习→跨模态对齐+可靠性学习→多模态指令微调。同时构建SonarBench基准，固定场景和声呐观测、仅改变光学退化强度，实现可控的跨模态互补性评估。
AI.result: SonarLLM在声-only任务（识别、计数、VQA）宏平均准确率达72.0%，超越最强基线34.4个百分点；融合输入下达68.7%，超越最强基线25.1个百分点。融合相对光学的增益随浊度增加从+6.0提升至+36.0点。声呐门控权重随光学退化从0.491升至0.795（Spearman ρ=0.749）。结构消融表明极坐标位置编码贡献最大（移除后融合/声呐宏准确率下降13.5/10.1点），VFE呈现预期模态特异性，AGFM主要起退化缓冲作用。代价：参数量增加17.4%，显存增加22.0%，预填充延迟增加78.1%，解码吞吐下降45.1%。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒的声呐-光学推理需要针对各模态观测过程定制表示，并按观测质量加权融合。SonarLLM的原生声呐建模提供了模型规模扩展和指令微调无法恢复的能力，可靠性感知的融合在光学证据退化时愈发重要。控制协议未完全验证自然浑浊，未来工作将扩展至真实配对数据、任务感知路由和时序声呐-光学推理。

title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning
comment: Large Language Model, Test-Time Decoding Technique, Reasoning, 20 pages; Submitted to ARR
summary: Inference-time decoding methods improve LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate trajectories, yet treat each trajectory as atomic: either retaining it whole or discarding it irreversibly. This wastes computation on partially promising candidates whose high-quality prefixes are abandoned alongside degraded suffixes. We introduce Selective Regenerative Decoding (SRD), which routes each candidate to discard, keep, or refine only the degraded portion of the suffix while preserving the useful prefix of borderline candidates, without requiring a larger target model. Under mild assumptions, SRD achieves a provable 1.28-to-1.36-fold gain in sample efficiency over rejection sampling with strictly higher expected trajectory quality, with the gain growing as the candidate pool grows. Across MATH500, GPQA Diamond, HotpotQA, and AlpacaEval with multiple generation-reward model pairs, SRD matches Best-of-N accuracy with substantially fewer generated tokens and outperforms speculative rejection in low-compute regimes. By enabling segment-level intervention rather than whole-trajectory selection, SRD opens a previously underexplored region of the accuracy-compute tradeoff for inference-time reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"选择性再生解码"（Selective Regenerative Decoding, SRD）的推理时解码方法，通过对候选轨迹进行段级干预来提升LLM推理的效率与质量。SRD打破了传统方法将轨迹视为不可分割整体的范式，能够在保留优质前缀的同时，仅对退化的后缀进行重新生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时解码方法（如Best-of-N和Speculative Rejection）将轨迹视为原子单位，要么整体保留，要么完全丢弃。Best-of-N延迟决策导致冗余计算；Speculative Rejection过早做出不可逆的拒绝决策，导致具有高质量前缀但后缀退化的轨迹被永久浪费。对于长链推理任务，这种浪费尤为严重。
AI.method: SRD采用三阶段流程：1）生成阶段：独立采样n条候选轨迹；2）路由阶段：基于奖励模型的秩归一化分数u(τ)，通过阈值θ_low和θ_high将每条轨迹分配至Keep、Refine或Discard三个等级；3）再生阶段：对路由到Refine的边界候选，按固定间隔m检测奖励退化边界j，仅使用高温采样重新生成τ_{j+1:k}后缀，保留高质量前缀。算法通过最大再生次数N_refine和最大再生跨度L_max保证终止性。
AI.result: 理论上，SRD在温和假设下比拒绝采样获得1.28–1.36倍的样本效率增益（公式1+ρ·p_M/p_H），且期望轨迹质量严格更高。在MATH500、GPQA Diamond、HotpotQA和AlpacaEval四个基准上的实验表明，SRD以显著更少的生成token达到Best-of-N的准确率，并在低计算量时优于Speculative Rejection。在MATH500上，N=10时仅用2166个输出token即达到0.544准确率，N=100时达到0.640。消融实验显示：在奖励信号稳定时保守的全局重路由策略最佳，而在噪声较大的过程奖励模型下，局部自比较策略更稳健。
AI.conclusion: SRD通过实现段级干预而非整体轨迹选择，开辟了推理时推理中精度-计算权衡的一个此前被低估的区域。其保证仅相对于奖励模型R成立，而非任务正确性；当R与目标目标不一致时，SRD可能放大奖励偏差。该方法固定路由阈值和启发式边界选择是当前局限，未来可探索端到端学习这些组件。此外，SRD与推测解码及前缀价值函数互补，可与之组合使用。

title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
summary: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了长程编码智能体在任务中途切换不同能力/成本模型时的"交接税"现象。在Claude和GPT两个模型家族的LC-HC配对上，实验覆盖58种配置、58,000次运行和360亿token，发现原始全轨迹升级仅恢复不到一半的质量差距且成本极高，而降级则提供有利的成本-质量折中；最关键的是，最优交接界面随方向反转——减少LC轨迹信息可改善升级质量，而删除HC轨迹则会严重损害降级质量。
AI.motivation: 当前编码智能体在单次任务中常需数十到数百次模型调用，用户面临实际的成本-质量权衡：在廉价模型遇到困难时升级到强模型，或在困难推理完成后降级以节省成本。主流产品（如Kiro、Codex、Claude Code）已通过/model命令支持这种切换，但长程智能体中模型能力切换的代价-质量后果尚未被系统理解。每次切换都要求接收方继续另一模型生成的"非原生"轨迹，该轨迹可能包含接收方本不会产生的推理或错误，其影响方向未知。
AI.method: 研究基于SWE-bench Verified基准（500个GitHub问题），统一使用mini-swe-agent脚手架。在Claude家族（Haiku 4.5 / Opus 4.7）和GPT家族（GPT-5.6 Luna / Sol）内分别考察两个切换方向（升级LC→HC和降级HC→LC）。三个核心变量：(1)方向；(2)切换时机——以前缀模型步数分布的难度校准百分位（p5到p50）定义；(3)交接界面——包括Raw（全轨迹传递）、Compact_pre（由发送方压缩）、Compact_suf（由接收方压缩）、Traj-drop（仅保留工作树，无轨迹）。为公平比较，所有策略在共同的"切换子集"上评估（交集任务）。引入两个指标：QRec（恢复HC质量差距的百分比）和CSRet（保留LC成本优势的百分比）。实验规模：每家族58种配置共58,000次智能体运行、200万次API调用、360亿token。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：(1)原始全轨迹升级在两个家族中仅恢复不到一半（Claude 47%、GPT 36%）的LC-HC质量差距，却带来4.0×-6.1×的成本溢价；在Claude配对上，原始升级甚至被"放弃LC前缀后重启HC"严格支配（成本$1.61 vs $0.90，质量也更高）。(2)降级呈现有利的中间点：Claude保留80% LC成本优势，GPT保留79% HC质量优势。(3)交接界面最优解随方向反转——升级时减少LC轨迹（Traj-drop恢复64%-84%质量差距）更佳，降级时保留HC轨迹（Raw恢复50%-79%）更佳。机制分析揭示：原始升级的税负源于接收方HC每次调用成本膨胀2.2×（Claude）/1.6×（GPT）；Traj-drop降级的代价则源于LC需多走1.6×/2.0×步骤重建缺失上下文。扩展实验表明：交接价值还取决于任务信息动态——在LiC（需求逐步揭示）中升级因晚期任务才能完全定义而获益；在BrowseComp（证据累积）中升级可恢复95.8%质量但仍不省钱。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统揭示长程编码智能体中模型能力切换的本质：交接不仅仅是路由问题，而是一个需要联合优化界面设计、接收方选择与切换时机的新型推理问题。研究发现"交接税"——在两种模型家族中均稳健存在的方向不对称性：升级是糟糕的买卖（全轨迹仅恢复不到一半质量），而降级是有利的成本-质量中间点。最优交接界面在两个方向上恰好反转，揭示出"方向二元性"：HC轨迹引导LC接收方，而LC轨迹拖累HC接收方。这一发现对未来智能体系统的设计具有重要指导意义：在长程任务中，模型切换的成本-质量权衡远非直观，简单的全轨迹传递往往是次优策略，应根据切换方向选择性地保留、压缩或丢弃轨迹信息。

title: Adaptive Influence Graphs for Failure Attribution in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where failures can be costly and difficult to localize. Despite growing efforts to automate failure attribution, diagnosing failed runs still largely relies on human engineers. Yet engineers rarely debug complex systems by reading raw logs end to end. Instead, observability tools organize traces around components, actions, and dependencies to support targeted navigation. We hypothesize that modern LLMs can benefit from the same paradigm. To test this hypothesis, we introduce Adaptive Influence Graphs (AIGs), a two-stage agentic framework that first transforms a failed trace into a structured graph and then navigates it to identify the critical error. Across multiple models, we show that richer trace representations consistently improve failure attribution, with adaptive graph construction and agent-directed traversal yielding the strongest results. AIGs establish a new state of the art on Who&When, the standard benchmark for multi-agent failure attribution. This affirms our hypothesis that attribution depends not only on the diagnosing model, but also on how the trace is represented and explored.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应影响图（Adaptive Influence Graphs, AIGs），一种用于多智能体系统失败归因的两阶段智能体框架。该方法将失败执行轨迹转化为结构化图，再由智能体阅读器进行导航以定位关键错误，在Who&When基准上达到新的最优水平。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在真实应用中部署日益增多，但失败诊断仍主要依赖工程师人工排查原始日志。作者受可观测性工具的启发，提出假设：失败归因不仅取决于诊断模型，还取决于轨迹的表示方式与遍历方式——即将归因视为"接口设计"问题。
AI.method: 方法分为两阶段：(1) 构建阶段（Builder）——将失败轨迹转化为自适应影响图（Adaptive Influence Graph），包含四个递进层次的表示阶梯：原始日志、结构化日志（按智能体分组）、影响图（添加摘要、输入输出及继承边）、自适应影响图（智能体构建器自适应选择节点边界和拓扑结构，并经批评者-优化者循环审计）；(2) 阅读阶段（Reader）——智能体阅读器在图上反向回溯继承边，并按需查阅原始日志进行验证。系统基于Strands Agents SDK实现，无任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准的Algorithm-Generated分区上，使用Opus-5达到55.20%的步骤准确率和71.20%的智能体准确率，创下新最优，超过此前最佳结果（51.60%）3.6个百分点。表示阶梯消融实验表明：步骤准确率从原始日志的46.40%提升至结构化日志48.80%、影响图52.00%，自适应构建配合智能体遍历进一步达55.20%。模型跨多个骨干（Opus-5、Sonnet-4、GPT-5.6-sol、DS-V3.2）均保持优势。在Hand-Craft分区达到29.31%步骤准确率，并列最佳。松弛窗口（±3步）下定位率达84.00%。
AI.conclusion: 失败归因是接口设计问题，取决于轨迹的表示方式与遍历方式。自适应影响图通过将原始日志转化为可导航的结构化表示，使LLM能像工程师使用可观测性工具一样高效定位失败根源，为多智能体系统的自动诊断提供了新的范式。

title: From State to Action: OODA-Tool for Reliable Multi-Turn Tool Use
summary: Reliable multi-turn tool use requires an agent to preserve an evolving task state and ensure that each action remains consistent with it. However, direct function-calling and ReAct-style policies learn state tracking and action generation within the same autoregressive trajectory. This coupling creates state-action competition: the pressure to produce the next call can overwrite or ignore information accumulated earlier in the interaction. Inspired by Boyd's Observe-Orient-Decide-Act cycle, we introduce OODA-Tool, a typed closed-loop policy designed to mitigate this competition by separating state preservation from action realization. Rather than generating an action directly from the interaction history, OODA-Tool routes each decision through controller-checked intermediate states, ensuring that the final output remains grounded in the current task state. Specifically, Observe reconstructs the task state, Orient determines whether execution is warranted, Decide forms an admissible action structure, and Act realizes the external output. We evaluate OODA-Tool against direct function-calling and ReAct policies using Qwen3 models ranging from 0.6B to 14B across multi-turn, multi-tool, and incomplete-information settings. OODA-Tool consistently improves task success across model sizes, with larger gains on smaller models and on tasks whose actions depend strongly on information accumulated across turns and prior tool results. Controlled variants, stage-level ablations, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate the robustness of these improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OODA-Tool，一种受 Boyd OODA 循环启发的类型化闭环策略，通过将状态重建(Observe)、执行就绪判断(Orient)、动作结构选择(Decide)与动作实现(Act)解耦，缓解多轮工具调用中状态追踪与动作生成耦合所导致的"状态-动作竞争"问题。在 Qwen3 系列(0.6B–14B)上的跨规模实验表明，该方法在任务成功率上持续优于直接函数调用、ReAct 和 α-UMi 等基线，且小模型与状态密集型任务上增益最大。
AI.motivation: 多轮工具使用中，现有方法(直接函数调用、ReAct)在单一自回归轨迹中同时进行状态追踪和动作生成，产生"状态-动作竞争"：模型在生成下一步调用时可能覆盖或忽略早期累积的状态信息，导致最终输出与任务当前状态不一致。
AI.method: 将决策过程拆分为四个类型化阶段：Observe 重建溯源感知的任务状态；Orient 判断是否应执行(五种响应模式)；Decide 在就绪状态约束下选择合法动作结构；Act 将其实现为合规的工具调用或回复。中央控制器在各阶段间执行类型校验。三种参数化变体：Joint(单次序列化生成)、Shared(四阶段共享一个 LoRA)、Specialized(四阶段各用独立 LoRA)。默认保留历史访问，另设类型化状态瓶颈实验以检验状态充分性。
AI.result: 在 ToolDial 上，Specialized OODA 在 0.6B–14B 各规模均取得最高任务成功率，较 Direct-LoRA 提升 4.48–6.99 分；增益随模型增大而缩小，在长历史/缺失信息/状态变化/约束激活/工具依赖等状态密集型切片上最大，在并行调用切片上最小。消融显示 Orient 阶段贡献最大，Decide-Act 分离次之，类型化状态在长历史/缺失信息回合上不可省略。FAIL-TaLMs、MTU-Bench、BFCL 零样本迁移显示 BFCL 增益最明显、随规模缩小；Specialized OODA 延迟约为 Direct-LoRA 的 2.36 倍。状态-动作矛盾率由 Joint 的 7.8% 降至 Specialized 的 3.9%，去掉 Decide-Act 分离则升至 10.7%。
AI.conclusion: OODA-Tool 通过类型化、控制器校验的四阶段解耦有效缓解状态-动作竞争，提升多轮工具调用的可靠性与状态一致性，对小模型和状态密集型场景尤为有效；并行调用下的动作展开与跨调用参数绑定仍是其主要局限。

title: Do Recipes Have Personas? Characterizing and Generating Creator Style in Attributed Procedural Graphs
comment: Accepted at the 29th International Conference on Discovery Science (DS 2026). 15 pages, 2 figures
summary: While large language models (LLMs) possess vast zero-shot procedural knowledge, their tendency to produce homogenized logic often obscures the unique, idiosyncratic execution processes of individual human creators. In this paper, we investigate the computational discovery of procedural personas from unstructured data. To achieve this, we introduce ViralRecipesTrans, a new dataset of procedurally aligned execution flow graphs extracted from popular culinary video transcripts and explicitly mapped to specific creators. We formulate procedural stylometry as a graph learning and process discovery task, revealing a fundamental duality: while traditional lexical classifiers overfit via semantic leakage, discrete topological metrics successfully capture the rigid physical constraints of a creator's workflow. Building upon this characterization, we extend our framework into a novel generative task--predicting a creator's exact structural execution graph for unseen dishes. We expose a fundamental dichotomy in style generation between global macro-planning and local structural execution. Our results demonstrate that few-shot LLMs dominate semantic assignment but suffer from persistent macro-planning deficits, whereas our structured two-stage model achieves superior topological control via rigid Markovian priors. Together, an ensemble approach to procedural generation combines the strengths from both sides, dynamically synthesizing global semantic reasoning with localized topological footprints to automate the discovery and generation of personalized workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"程序化风格测量"(procedural stylometry)概念，将食谱视为可执行DAG，研究创作者的工作流拓扑指纹而非词汇特征。构建ViralRecipesTrans数据集，对比词汇分类器与拓扑分类器在作者归属上的表现，发现拓扑特征虽无法完美分类但AUC稳定接近0.78，表明风格是概率性排名信号而非硬边界。进而提出基于创作者persona的菜谱执行图生成任务，并提出结构化两阶段生成模型(S2S)，通过贝叶斯先验分离拓扑骨架与语义填充，与少样本LLM形成互补，集成方法在nEF1上取得最优。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM具备丰富的零样本程序化知识，但其生成的逻辑趋于同质化，无法体现个体创作者独特的工作流特征。现有计算风格测量主要依赖词汇特征(N-gram、TF-IDF等)，易因"词汇泄露"(lexical leakage)而过拟合，无法区分创作者的"做什么"与"怎么做"。食谱作为可执行DAG，其拓扑结构(深度、分支、并行度)承载了创作者真实的物理操作习惯，是未被充分挖掘的风格信号。
AI.method: 1) 构建VRT数据集：从YouTube通过分层种子查询与多阶段过滤(订阅、格式、菜品多样性、转录质量)获取97个创作者、5000+视频的英文转录，并通过GPT-5.4提取执行DAG；2) Archetype级拓扑分类：使用19维纯拓扑特征(深度-宽度比、平均出度、成分分支率等)的随机森林区分书面/长视频/短视频；3) 作者归属扩展性实验：K=2至50的5折随机试验，对比绝对准确率与AUC；4) 生成基线：Zero-shot、Few-shot(检索历史图为示例)、自回归逐步预测、N-gram拓扑引导；5) 结构化两阶段S2S模型：先通过beam search与组合对数目标(转移先验P_trans、语义先验P_sem、位置先验P_pos、唯一性P_uni、循环惩罚λ)生成动作序列，再通过二部图映射分配成分；6) 集成方法：基于特征的学习选择器动态路由。评估指标为IF1、nEF1(归一化动作-成分边F1)、StepErr、Action Jaccard、LCS Ratio。
AI.result: 拓扑分类Macro F1达0.783，书面食谱被完美隔离(F1=0.999)，证明视频工作流具有独特结构。词汇TF-IDF在50类归属上Top-1达0.9357，但纯拓扑特征AUC≈0.78且随K增大保持稳定，说明风格是概率性信号。生成任务中：Few-shot LLM在IF1最优(长0.344/短0.385)，S2S在StepErr最优(长0.350/短0.332)，两者nEF1接近(约0.46-0.48)；集成方法在nEF1上达到长0.485/短0.479的最优。消融实验表明LLM规模无法解决宏观规划缺陷，上下文窗口在k=9后饱和。
AI.conclusion: 程序化风格作为拓扑足迹而非词汇，是概率性排名信号。生成任务中存在语义分配(LLM占优)与宏观规划(S2S占优)的根本权衡，两者通过互补机制达到可比的操作保真度。集成框架动态合成全局语义与局部拓扑控制，实现两全。Future work指向神经-符号融合、后验物理约束校准器，以及将"拓扑风格测量"推广至其他程序化领域(教学、DIY等)。

title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping
summary: The efficiency of Large Language Model (LLM) serving is fundamentally limited by the sequential nature of autoregressive decoding. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by using a lightweight draft model to speculate future tokens, which are then validated by the LLM in a single parallel forward pass. To further boost efficiency, multi-candidate schemes propose diverse candidate sets to increase the likelihood of token acceptance. However, we show that these schemes are bottlenecked by Residual Drift: a phenomenon where the rejection of initial candidates causes the residual target distribution to diverge from the draft model's predictions. This shift renders subsequent candidates ineffective and forces the system into expensive resampling. To resolve this, we propose ResiSpec, a framework that strategically reforms the proposal distribution during verification to anchor the residual target mass within the draft model's high-confidence regions. By mathematically re-aligning the verification process without compromising output exactness, ResiSpec prevents candidate obsolescence and achieves up to 1.92$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art multi-candidate methods. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResiSpec，一种基于残差分布整形的多候选推测解码框架，通过引入辅助代理分布将拒绝残差重新对齐到草稿模型的高置信区域，解决现有方法中“残差漂移”导致的接受率骤降问题，同时保持输出分布的精确性，并实现了相对当前最优多候选方法高达1.92倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 多候选推测解码（如基于树的并行验证）虽然通过扩展搜索空间提升了LLM推理效率，但作者发现其存在根本性的可扩展性瓶颈——“残差漂移”：由于顺序验证时拒绝会导致目标分布转移至草稿模型的低置信区域，使得后续预采样候选几乎不可能被接受，导致额外候选带来的边际接受率收益急剧递减，限制了该范式的进一步扩展能力。
AI.method: ResiSpec在验证阶段引入一个辅助代理分布k(x)替代原始草稿分布q(x)，通过设计满足局部对齐（k(x_i)=q(x_i)）和不相交支撑约束的残差整形机制，将拒绝残差质量重新拉回草稿模型的高密度区域。具体包括：(1) 通过Global Mass Identity维持概率归一化；(2) 通过Capacity Bound确定理想整形预算Z的上界；(3) 鉴于理论理想不可达（长尾问题导致预算退化），采用最小预算启发式策略结合"裁剪-再分配"（water-filling）方式构造实用代理分布，从而在保持分布精确性（无偏采样）的前提下，让后续候选在验证中保持统计相关性。
