AI.tldr: 本文指出当前解耦表示学习方法普遍假设生成因子具有均匀欧几里得几何结构，这一假设在现实中往往不成立。作者提出"因子空间结构"（factor-space structure）形式化框架，涵盖因子定义域、生成器诱导的等价关系以及位置相关的局部尺度，并证明统计独立的因子（如色相和尺度）因渲染机制不同而产生位置依赖的各向异性，无法通过固定重缩放消除。基于此，提出 FactoMap（Factor-Space Topographic Map），通过地形组织学习在因子空间格点上排列可解释原型，使格点的周期性、折叠和非均匀范围传递到表示中。实验在合成数据集 FactoShapes 上验证，匹配的几何结构（锥形格点）显著优于不匹配的矩形格点。
AI.motivation: 现有解耦表示学习方法隐含假设生成因子空间是均匀欧几里得的（局部等距），但真实的生成过程往往具有非均匀、位置依赖甚至非平凡拓扑的因子几何。统计独立不等于几何可分——例如色相通过面积、尺度通过边界影响图像，二者增长率不同，导致位置依赖的各向异性。这种结构信息无法仅靠统计独立假设或拓扑信息捕获，需要更丰富的因子空间先验。
AI.method: 1. 因子空间结构形式化：定义三元组 (Z, ≈_g, c_g)，其中 Z 为因子定义域乘积（区间或圆），≈_g 为生成器诱导的等价关系，c_g 为位置相关的局部尺度函数。2. 命题证明（Proposition 2.1）：在 HSV 渲染模型下，色相和尺度的局部尺度比 κ(s) ∝ s^(1-γ)，导致度量矩阵 G 不可通过固定对角重缩放变为 C²I。3. FactoMap 模型：给定有限格点 (Λ_F, d_F) 作为输入，包含三部分——因子空间格点（含分析距离以编码周期/折叠/非均匀范围）、可学习原型场 W、地形学习目标（SOM 目标函数 L_t(W)，通过邻域核 H_σ_t 鼓励相邻格点表示相邻观测）。4. 实验设计：构建 FactoShapes 数据集（色相、尺度、x/y 位置四个因子），对比匹配锥形格点与不匹配矩形格点。
AI.result: 1. 拓扑匹配：在周期因子（色相）上，环形格点将端点距离从 Δ=39 降至 Δ=1，恢复闭合性；线形格点则在端点处引入人为割裂。2. 各向异性验证：实测图像空间速率 c_h^meas(s) ∝ s^1.05、c_s^meas(s) ∝ s^0.56，与理论预测 s^1 和 s^0.5 吻合。3. 解耦性能（InfoMEC 指标）：匹配锥形格点 InfoM=0.953、InfoE=0.822、InfoC=0.950；不匹配矩形格点 InfoM=0.272、InfoE=0.544、InfoC=0.025，匹配格点在三项指标上均显著优于不匹配格点。4. 视觉上，锥形格点上色相沿环向排列、尺度沿轴向排列；矩形格点上两因子混合无法恢复。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明均匀局部等距假设在一般生成过程中不成立，统计独立因子可能因渲染机制不同而几何耦合。引入因子空间结构（结合定义域、生成器诱导等价、位置相关尺度）可区分同胚但几何不同的空间。FactoMap 通过将结构化格点作为先验并用地形学习实现，能在因子具有非平凡几何（周期性、折叠、非均匀范围）时实现有效解耦。匹配因子空间结构对解耦至关重要，为超越标准均匀欧几里得假设的解耦方法提供了新路径。

title: Automatic Model Card Generation Using an LLM
summary: Model cards are structured documents that summarize key information about machine learning models to improve transparency, usability, and accountability. However, they often lack a consistent structure, and many models provide no model cards, making comparison and interpretation difficult. This paper presents two contributions. First, we propose MCTidy, an LLM-based approach that reorganizes existing model cards into a standardized template to improve clarity and comparability. Second, we introduce MCGenie, an LLM-based system that generates model cards directly from model repository data. We apply MCTidy to 48 Hugging Face model cards and evaluate information retention, section alignment, hallucination, and stability. Our findings show high information retention with minimal textual loss, accurate section assignment, rare hallucinations primarily in descriptive sections, and strong stability across runs. We assess MCGenie by generating model cards for the same 48 models and assessing semantic similarity, factual correctness, and sensitivity to input resources. The generated model cards achieved high semantic similarity (mean around 0.9); over half were fully correct, and most remaining errors were minor. Generation quality depended strongly on the availability of supporting resources, particularly associated papers. Overall, our findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-based methods to enable scalable, standardized model card documentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于LLM的模型卡自动化方法：MCTidy（重组现有模型卡为标准模板）和MCGenie（从模型仓库数据直接生成模型卡）。基于48个Hugging Face模型卡的实验表明，两种方法在信息保留、语义相似度（均值≈0.9）、事实正确性（54.17%完全正确）和稳定性（语义相似度0.97）方面表现优异，其中论文是影响生成质量的最关键资源。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型日益部署于医疗、金融、司法等高风险领域，但许多模型缺乏标准化文档，存在结构不一致、文档缺失或质量低下的问题，导致模型误用和透明度不足。现有自动化文档生成方案受限于特定环境（如ML Metadata或计算笔记本），难以规模化推广，因此需要一种基于自然产生的开发资源（如仓库文件和论文）来自动生成和标准化模型卡的方法。
AI.method: 采用Mitchell等人(2019)的模型卡模板作为标准，包含"How to Use"和"Memory and Hardware Requirements"两个扩展章节。(1) MCTidy：将原始模型卡和标准模板及章节描述输入LLM（Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking），重新组织内容到标准结构；(2) MCGenie：从模型仓库文件（如README、配置文件、tokenizer文件、关联论文等）生成模型卡。评估指标包括信息保留率、章节对齐准确性、幻觉率、多次运行的语义相似度稳定性、生成内容的语义相似度与事实正确性，以及输入资源对生成质量的影响分析。实验对象为48个Hugging Face模型。
AI.result: MCTidy：信息清单缺失项仅4.5%（中位数），章节内容错放率仅1.9%，幻觉集中在描述性章节，三次运行的语义相似度中位数为0.97（87.5%的章节≥0.90）。MCGenie：生成模型卡与原模型的语义相似度均值≈0.9；54.17%完全正确，其余多数仅有1个不准确子节；论文是影响生成质量的最关键资源，配置文件和tokenizer文件影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的方法能够实现可扩展、标准化的模型卡文档生成。MCTidy可有效重组现有模型卡，MCGenie可从仓库数据生成新模型卡，尤其在论文资源可用时表现最佳。两者均发布为开源复现包，为未来自动模型卡生成研究提供了基准数据集。改进方向包括加强源对齐与事实校准以减少生成内容中的推测性错误。

title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型语言模型作为AI分析师存在"检索-整合鸿沟"：能够检索到的财务披露信息未必能影响其投资判断。当上下文从2,000增长至128,000 token时，风险披露对判断的影响降至噪声水平，但直接检索准确率保持不变。该现象在多个模型族中复现。机制研究表明这是信息传输失败而非理解失败：固定容量的运行摘要和注意力查找两条通道共同承载披露信息。解决方案是工作流架构而非计算量：定向、结构化的提取-后决策工作流可将128k时的留存率从12%提升至67%。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被部署为AI分析师处理财务披露并辅助投资决策，现有评估方法仅测试模型能否检索到信息，而未检验检索到的信息是否影响其最终判断。文章将这一委托任务的评估问题与披露处理成本框架结合，区分"机器可读性"与"机器决策有用性"，提出"检索-整合鸿沟"概念。
AI.method: 固定焦点公司信息集，仅改变经济无关的上下文长度（2k至128k token）。对每家公司构建一个可验证的风险披露段，通过差分目标版本与5个中性替代版本的判断来测量"边际决策影响"。使用经验零分布（10个伪目标插入）进行随机化推断。机制层面采用词汇空间探针和稀疏自编码器特征字典，在披露位置和决策位置测量内部表征；通过运行摘要通道移植和注意力访问干预进行因果识别。测试四种工作流架构（分块聚合、提取后决策、原文重述、扩展推理）。
AI.result: 9B模型在2k token时披露使卖出概率提高3.2个百分点，至128k时降至0.4个百分点（与中性插入无统计差异）。生产模型在128k时延迟但未消除衰减。直接检索在所有长度均保持准确（Qwen模型12/12家公司）。严重程度阶梯响应范围压缩5.6倍，但排序能力仅部分下降。两个传输通道（运行摘要和注意力查找）各承载约44-65%的披露影响力。提取-后决策工作流将128k留存率从12%提升至67%（12/12家公司方向一致），分块-聚合工作流则完全消除披露影响力。实验者书写的提取与模型自提取效果相当。
AI.conclusion: AI分析师性能由模型能力与工作流架构共同决定。检索准确率不能保证决策有用性。基于检索的评估可能认证那些投资判断忽略其已检索信息的系统。设计原则：决策关键信息应被提取为定向、结构化表示置于决策点附近，而非通过通用、容量受限的摘要路由。委托给AI的内部任务执行阶段会产生独立于可观察中间操作成败的故障，这要求评估必须达到判断阶段。

title: A Survey of Timing Variability in Microservice-Based Software-Defined Vehicles
comment: Submitted to ACM Computing Surveys, 33 pages, 17 figures
summary: Microservice-based systems are modular and adaptable, but their distributed structure makes their timing behavior difficult to analyze and guarantee. Because latency emerges from interactions among service dependencies, shared resources, and coordinating middleware, local timing disturbances can propagate into system-level effects. This survey examines the sources, propagation mechanisms, and observable impacts of timing variability in microservice-based systems, using software-defined vehicles as a motivating example. It compares major classes of timing models by their assumptions about workload stability, execution structure, resource sharing, observability, and guarantee admissibility, and summarizes their limitations within microservice-based software-defined vehicles.

AI.tldr: 该综述论文系统研究了基于微服务的软件定义车辆（SDV）系统中时序可变性的来源、传播机制及可观察影响，比较了主要时序模型在动态、异构、部分可观测的微服务环境中的适用性与局限性。
AI.motivation: 微服务架构虽具备模块化与可适应性优势，但其分布式特性使得时序行为难以分析与保证。传统时序模型多基于稳定执行环境与可预测流量模式假设，无法直接适用于动态、异构且部分可观测的微服务系统，尤其是混合关键级的软件定义车辆平台，因此亟需对时序可变性的来源、传播与影响进行系统性梳理，并评估现有模型的适用边界。
AI.method: 该综述将时序变异性来源按执行上下文划分为本地、网络与中间件三类；通过依赖图、资源共享、反馈控制环路和放大效应等机制分析传播路径；从尾部主导行为、队列传播、系统不稳定性、因果模糊性与非线性时序行为等方面归纳可观察影响；并从工作负载稳定性、执行结构、资源共享、可观测性与保证可接受性五个维度，对解析模型（网络演算、实时演算）、概率模型（随机流量模式、尾部延迟、概率保证）、状态模型（Petri网、马尔可夫模型）与确定性模型（WCET、可调度性分析）进行比较。
AI.result: 论文揭示了微服务SDV平台中局部时序扰动可通过依赖关系、共享资源争用、控制反馈环路及非线性放大效应跨越服务边界传播，形成尾部延迟主导、热点队列、系统不稳定、因果模糊等涌现行为；并指出网络演算、实时演算等解析模型在动态负载与异步交互下保证趋于保守；概率模型虽契合长尾分布但依赖经验观测且保证较弱；状态模型表达能力强但状态空间爆炸限制其在线应用；确定性模型仅适用于子系统级硬实时保证，难以组合为系统级保证。整体而言，各组成部件可单独分析，但因运行时的动态性、不确定性与部分可观测性，组件级分析无法直接组合为系统级时序保证。
AI.conclusion: 微服务SDV的时序行为本质上是服务依赖、共享资源与协调控制相互作用的涌现属性；现有时序模型在动态、部分可观测与异构环境下的适用性受限，组件级保证难以直接组合为系统级保证。因此应基于对执行结构、共享资源、传播路径、工作负载、运行时动态与可观测性的明确假设推导时序保证，使时序分析在时序约束严格且高度动态的分布式环境中更具可靠性。

title: Memory-Sovereign Inference: Output-Exact Execution Beyond Full Residency
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure. Artifact: this https URL
summary: Storage-backed inference is easy to overclaim: process RSS excludes charged page cache, process-local device readings exclude board-wide use, and successful generation does not establish correct asynchronous reuse. We present a falsifiable certificate separating representation, semantic demand, scheduler requests, and traffic while naming resource authorities, exactness horizons, and tested reuse transitions. At one Qwen3-Next identity, the stock router selects all 48 x 512 managed layer-expert objects during 32K prefill. Their duplicate-free, overlap-free canonical union gives a 43.59375 GiB semantic-demand lower bound, exceeding the declared 34 GiB full-residency envelope and the 11 GiB host-hard plus physical 24 GiB-device envelope. LRU64 execution stays within its host-hard/GPU-audited contract. Against one prespecified zero-cache oracle, all 64 token IDs, every byte of 64 complete 151,936-float logit rows, 3,408 route events, response bytes, and recorded consumer and destination identities are exact. Recurrent-state and upstream-runtime equality are excluded. In a matched source campaign, the buffered path completes exactly but reaches the 11 GiB host ceiling and records 33,481 this http URL events. The blocking one-window direct path and complete eight-window asynchronous component are exact with positive margin and zero limit events. Across six counterbalanced pairs, the complete asynchronous component takes 32.3% of the blocking direct path's wall time at identical physical source bytes per output; the comparison jointly changes queue depth, overlap, and lifecycle implementation. Separately, fourteen prespecified control/fault cells pass across later Qwen3-Next and Gemma 4 binaries, supporting fail-closed behavior only for the named transitions. The principal experiment is one fixed model, workload, runtime, device, and 64-output horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"内存主权"(Memory Sovereignty)概念及其可证伪的执行证据证书架构，用于存储后端（Storage-backed）的LLM推理。核心贡献是在Qwen3-Next模型上演示了：当工作负载的语义需求下界(43.59 GiB)超过声明的完整驻留包络(34 GiB)及主机硬限+设备物理包络时，仍能实现64输出范围内的完全输出精确性(全对数行、令牌ID、路由事件、消费者与目标身份等字节级一致)，并通过匹配源实验证明八窗口异步组件在墙钟时间上为单窗口阻塞直读的32.3%(3.10×加速比)。
AI.motivation: 存储后端推理（如CPU卸载、内存映射、SSD流式加载、专家缓存、推测解码）常以容量换流量或延迟，但"成功运行"难以证明什么：进程RSS不能约束页缓存、单进程设备读数不能反映整板占用、缓存命中在槽位被回收后可能失效、最终令牌匹配可能掩盖过时读取。论文主张需要更强属性——内存主权——以分离表征所有权、物理驻留、稳定执行地址与调度，并明确证据证书应包含哪些可证伪字段。
AI.method: 提出证书元组 C=(I,B,A,E,L)：I为不可变清单，区分表征T_repr、语义需求下界U_sem^LB、调度请求U_sched、累计流量Q_run；B为分层边界向量；A为权威等级（硬限/物理容量/仪器水位/采样审计）；E为精确性关系与时间范围；L为重用不变量与测试转换集合。声明类别R/W分别断言完整表征/语义需求在边界下不可驻留，E[E,h]命名精确关系与时间范围，L[F]命名已测试转换集合。架构上分离规范张量范围→固定主机窗口→可复用GPU槽→稳定地址，原生模型图保持权威性，共享Plan核心统一跨适配器（Qwen3-Next与Gemma 4）。生命周期分窗口状态机（Free→Reading→HostReady→Copying→Free）与GPU槽状态机（Vacant→Loading→DeviceReady→InUse→Recyclable→Vacant），通过纪元、代次、票据、消费者计数实现失败闭合。
AI.result: 主要结果分三类：(C1) Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B Q4_K_M在32K预填+64输出下，T_repr=45.08 GiB，U_sem^LB=43.59375 GiB（48×512专家全部被路由选中的去重并集）；前者超声明34 GiB包络11.08 GiB，后者超主机硬11 GiB+物理GPU 24 GiB之和8.59375 GiB；零缓存预言机下所有64个完整151,936浮点对数行、所有令牌ID、3,408路由事件、响应字节、七字段消费者与双条目目标身份记录均字节级精确；cgroup过程树内存峰值1.497 GiB，整板GPU峰值13.22 GiB，零swap/OOM/memory.max事件。(C2) 匹配源P/D/F三臂实验（同模型、图、采样器、LRU64、8K+128，11 GiB cgroup，23 GiB GPU）：P精确但触达11 GiB上限并产生33,481次memory.max事件（未通过预定义通过条件）；六对配对D/F均精确且生命周期平衡，F完成时间均值32.852 s，D为101.739 s，6对F/D墙钟比落在[0.3211, 0.3283]，几何均值0.3229，曝光源等待比0.535，解码速率比1.542，每输出物理源字节比1.0；F在峰值深度8下发55,520次源操作，动态直接分配为零。(C3) 后期故障注入二进制在Qwen3-Next与Gemma 4两适配器上覆盖14个预定确定性控制/故障单元（短读、EIO、乱序有效完成、过时完成、错误对象、持有消费者、复位时存在源工作、关闭时存在活跃消费者等），均通过验证器，支持失败闭合行为但不可转移至C1可执行文件。(C8) Gemma匹配对：将缓冲源替换为8窗口有界O_DIRECT执行器，主机峰值从6.64 GiB降至2.98 GiB（降幅55.1%），14,396次提交/完成，零失败，所有窗口关闭时释放。附录报道Qwen3.6 MTP（4.913承诺输出/目标遍历，12.016端到端令牌/s）、Qwen AWQ机制（F1相等、周期降28.9%）、共享Plan奇偶校验、Qwen Plan对比（失败预设F1准则）、Gemma缓存迁移（H2D降65%、解码降77.5%）。负面结果：GPT-OSS包装优化未提升至下一实验（载体吞吐不足），Llama-3.3 4/4准入未达。
AI.conclusion: 内存容量作为系统主张只有在预算、规范字节、执行预言机与异步生命周期均明确时方可成立。该工作通过分离存储所有权、物理驻留、稳定执行地址与调度，并在C1证书中绑定45.08 GiB原生表征与43.59375 GiB语义需求下界超出声明及主机硬限/设备物理包络、E_{64-out}下完整输出精确性、硬性完整进程树cgroup计费、整板GPU余量审计与无故障闭合，从而在预设硬边界合约下建立资源可接纳性。匹配源实验证明直接源所有权将结果从"精确但触限"变为"精确且有正余量、零限事件"，并通过六对匹配显示八窗口异步组件完成时间为阻塞单窗口直读的32.3%（3.10×倒数）。14个预定确定性单元支持两适配器命名转换的失败闭合行为。失败搅动前提、并发与簿记联合对比、确定性故障调度、GPU审计（非硬分区）及狭窄的模型/硬件身份界定主张，禁止独立的Plan因果性、无竞争、服务或一般容错表述。

title: A Few Shared Random Bits Suffice for Constant-Round Almost Stable Matching
summary: We show that almost stable matching can be solved in constant distributed rounds on general bipartite graphs $G=(V,E)$ using only a few shared random bits. Specifically, in the $\congest$ model, we compute a matching whose expected number of blocking pairs is at most $\varepsilon |E|$ in $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$ rounds using $O\left(\log(1/\varepsilon)\right)$ shared random bits. Thus, for every constant $\varepsilon>0$, the round complexity is $O(1)$, independent of the number of vertices and the maximum degree. Previous algorithms achieve constant round complexity only for bounded-degree or almost-regular graphs; on general graphs, their round complexity depends polylogarithmically on $n$. Our main technical idea is a degree-guarded freezing rule that allows widely varying degrees to be handled by a single global charging argument, avoiding the $\Theta(\log n)$ successive degree thresholds used in previous work. The shared random bits are used only to select a common random output iteration. As consequences, we obtain an $O\left( \frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4} + \frac{\log n}{\varepsilon} \right)$-round $\congest$ algorithm without pre-shared randomness, via a low-diameter decomposition, and an $O\left(\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon)}{\varepsilon^4}\right)$-round algorithm in the fully-scalable Massively Parallel Computation ($\mpc$) model with linear total memory.

AI.tldr: 本文在CONGEST模型和完全可扩展MPC模型中，仅用少量共享随机比特，就在常数轮内解决了一般二部图上的近似稳定匹配问题，核心贡献是提出了"度守护冻结规则"，用一个全局充电论证替代了之前O(log n)次度阈值迭代。
AI.motivation: 精确稳定匹配在分布式模型中固有地是全局问题（LOCAL模型下界Ω(n)轮），近似稳定匹配对有界度图已是局部的，但对一般二部图其轮复杂度仍依赖n的多对数。已有Ostrovsky-Rosenbaum算法使用Θ(log n)次倍增度阈值来处理任意大的非均匀度，无法获得与n无关的常数轮复杂度。
AI.method: 1. 分位数提议框架：每个顶点将偏好列表划分为k=Θ(1/ε)个分位数；2. 度守护冻结规则：当新配对(m,w)满足d(m)>R·d(w)（R=Θ(1/ε)）时，冻结该配对并删除w的所有其他活边，使得高degree的男节点不会因置换而失去匹配；3. 用边级近似最大匹配替代完全最大匹配（残差边期望比例ρ=Θ(ε⁵)）；4. 共享随机比特仅用于从L=Θ(ε⁻³)次迭代中均匀随机选择一个输出迭代，使未被匹配男节点的度数之和P_t的期望为O(ε|E|)。去共享随机性通过Miller-Peng-Xu低直径分解实现；MPC模型中通过排序和前缀和原语实现。
AI.result: 定理1（CONGEST带共享随机）：轮复杂度O(log(1/ε)/ε⁴)，共享随机比特O(log(1/ε))，期望阻塞对数≤ε|E|。定理2（无共享随机）：轮复杂度O(log(1/ε)/ε⁴ + log n/ε)。定理3（完全可扩展MPC）：轮复杂度O(log(1/ε)/ε⁴)，总内存O(n+|E|)，每机n^δ。定理4（下界）：LOCAL模型带共享随机下界Ω(1/ε)。所有ε相关上界对常数ε达到O(1)轮，与n和最大度无关。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了只要O(log(1/ε))个共享随机比特，近似稳定匹配即可在一般二部图上以与n无关的常数轮解决，将Ostrovsky-Rosenbaum的O(log²n)轮改善至O(log n)轮（无共享随机时）。度守护冻结规则是核心技术贡献，用单一全局充电论证替代了Θ(log n)次度阈值迭代。ε相关依赖O(1/ε⁴)上界与Ω(1/ε)下界之间仍有多项式差距，共享随机比特的必要性、最优确定性复杂度均为开放问题。

title: pigzpp: Fast, Parallel, Portable Compression for the Whole Stack
summary: pigz is a widely deployed parallel gzip utility, but its process-global mutable state means that it was not designed as a reentrant, directly embeddable library. pigzpp is a from-scratch C++23 rewrite that turns the design into a thread-safe library with one accelerated DEFLATE core exposed to C++, Python, WebAssembly, Go, and Rust. As application-level conveniences built on that same core, it also provides multi-entry ZIP archives and a fast PNG codec. Its portable zlib-ng backend preserves gzip/zlib's ratio; its Intel ISA-L backend is an x86-64-only fast path that produces about 10% larger output at level 6 on our text corpus. In that configuration, zlib-ng reaches 2.1 times the CLI throughput of pigz and 16 times that of Python's in-memory gzip; ISA-L reaches 8.5 times and 50 times, respectively. Outputs remain standards-compliant and cross-decode with gzip, pigz, and unzip. The result is a self-contained, multi-platform compression stack and a case study in AI-assisted modernization under automated compatibility tests.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 pigzpp，一个用 C++23 从零重写 pigz 的线程安全压缩库。它将并行 DEFLATE 核心暴露给 C++、Python、WebAssembly、Go 和 Rust 五种语言生态，并基于该核心提供 ZIP 归档和 PNG 编码的应用层封装。便携的 zlib-ng 后端在保持与 gzip/zlib 相同压缩比的同时达到 pigz CLI 吞吐量的 2.1 倍、Python 内存 gzip 的 16 倍；x86-64 专属的 Intel ISA-L 后端输出约增大 10%，但吞吐量分别为 pigz 的 8.5 倍、Python gzip 的 50 倍。所有输出保持标准兼容，可被 gzip、pigz 和 unzip 交叉解码。
AI.motivation: pigz 虽然是广泛使用的并行 gzip 工具，但其约 60 个可变字段组成的进程全局结构体 struct g 使其本质上是一个程序而非可重入库，无法直接嵌入 Python、浏览器、Go 服务等现代调用环境。作者希望通过现代重写解决这一设计缺陷，并探索 AI 辅助代码代理在自动化兼容性测试下对基础软件进行现代化改造的有效性。
AI.method: 核心方法：1) 完全去除进程全局状态，将配置作为参数显式传递，使用 C++20 std::jthread 实现线程安全；2) 采用 128 KiB 分块并行压缩策略，块间以前一块末尾 32 KiB 作为字典以保留跨块后向引用；3) 通过 crc32_combine 以 O(log n) 复合各块 CRC，避免数据重扫；4) 后端双选：可移植的 SIMD 优化 zlib-ng（运行时 CPU 派发 SSE/AVX2/AVX-512/NEON）+ x86-64 专属的 Intel ISA-L 手写汇编 DEFLATE，最高压比可选 Google Zopfli；5) 单一稳定 C ABI 通过 nanobind 提供 Python abi3 绑定、Emscripten/Embind 提供 WASM 绑定、cgo/FFI 提供 Go/Rust 绑定；6) ZIP/PNG 作为应用层封装复用同一 DEFLATE 核心；7) 所有压缩引擎静态链接，CI 拒绝任何动态依赖。
AI.result: 在 128 MB 多语种文本语料、压缩级别 6、8 线程基准下：CLI 端 zlib-ng 后端达 2.1× pigz 吞吐量（同压缩比），ISA-L 后端达 8.5×（输出约大 10%）；Python 内存 API 分别达 16× 和 50× 标准库 gzip；Go cgo 路径达 1087 MB/s；Rust ISA-L 路径达 912 MB/s；Docker/OCI 镜像层压缩将 stdlib gzip 的 19.6 s 降至 0.5 s（42×）；WebAssembly 单线程版本超越 Node zlib、CompressionStream、fflate、pako，8 线程达 242 MB/s（5.9× 加速）；PNG 编码 fast 预设下比 Pillow 快 11.8×、比 OpenCV 快 1.6×；ZIP 写入比 Python 标准库快 12–28×；解压方面原生 CLI 达 711 MB/s（pigz 为 212 MB/s）。
AI.conclusion: pigzpp 证明了一种广泛部署、沿用数十年的格式在现代硬件上仍可显著加速：通过解耦全局状态、复用并行设计、并以 SIMD/汇编 DEFLATE 引擎加持，一个加速核心即可同时服务五种语言生态及应用层 ZIP/PNG 工作流，输出完全兼容 gzip 标准。论文同时作为一项 AI 辅助现代化案例研究，得出两点经验：1) 反馈机制（无损往返、跨工具解码、自动测试基准）越紧凑紧凑，AI 代码代理越高效；2) 全局状态而非性能是从程序转化为库的核心障碍。局限：测试仅限于单台 x86-64 WSL2 环境（10 vCPU）、单一 128 MB 文本语料及压缩级别 6，ISA-L 结果不适用于非 x86-64 平台。

title: An HPC Approach to Accelerate Tensor Decompositions
summary: Quantum systems grow in complexity so rapidly that even modest models become difficult to simulate, creating a strong need for methods that can handle high-dimensional data, also known as tensors. In this work, we investigate a novel Jacobi-type tensor algorithm for tensor decomposition and develop a CUDA-based algorithm that supports tensors of arbitrary order on a single GPU. We test the implementation on NVIDIA H100 GPUs and show that the algorithm converges correctly for diagonalizable tensors up to nine dimensions, with runtime scaling in a predictable way as tensor order grows. Finally, our general algorithm outperforms the original MATLAB reference by more than two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高阶张量对角化问题，将三阶Jacobi型张量分解算法推广到任意阶D≥3的稠密张量，并基于CUDA在NVIDIA H100 GPU上实现了并行化。相比原始MATLAB参考实现，获得了超过两个数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: 量子系统等高维问题的状态空间随粒子数呈指数增长，张量分解是处理此类高维数据的核心工具。然而，现有的Tucker分解库（如基于HOSVD/HOOI的方法）只能产生一般稠密的核心张量，无法对其进行对角化；而针对一般稠密任意阶张量的GPU加速Jacobi型对角化实现此前尚属空白。
AI.method: 1. 算法层面：将三阶Jacobi型张量对角化算法（基于Givens旋转与交替最小二乘）从三阶推广到任意阶D，利用索引替换记号A_{p→q,n}统一表达旋转角度公式，并保留基于梯度的pivot检验作为收敛保证。2. 并行化策略：利用Jacobi方法的内在并行性，将N(N-1)/2个pivot对按不相交条件分组（偶数N分成N-1组，奇数N分成N组），组内旋转可并行执行。3. GPU实现：采用CUDA，张量以连续数组加stride数组表示（stride存放于constant memory），自定义kernel结合cuBLAS、cuSOLVER、CUB完成pivot过滤（filter_pq_group）、旋转计算（set_rotations）和旋转施加（apply_rotations）三步，全程在显存内执行；工作量按一维网格线性划分，每个线程最多处理两个多索引。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA H100上的实验表明：(1) 对于维数D=3,5,7,9的可对角化张量，算法均能正确收敛到对角形式；(2) 相对非对角范数在禁用pivot检验时仍能收敛到0，且所有分解结果在10^-7容差内匹配预期；(3) 运行时随张量阶数D近似呈指数增长，随维度大小N近似呈线性增长；(4) 与MATLAB参考实现相比，在D=3、N=8/16/32时分别达到约1.8×、11.3×、551.3×的端到端加速；(5) pivot检验本身是计算最昂贵的部分，对8^9张量启用与禁用pivot检验的运行时间相差约35倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现了面向任意阶稠密张量的GPU加速Jacobi型对角化算法，填补了该领域的空白，并通过禁用pivot检验的策略显著降低运行时间。未来工作将扩展到对称/反对称张量等结构化情形，并应用于海森堡自旋链等量子化学问题的谱分析。

title: Mixed-Precision SEM-Based CFD Simulations on GPUs: A Taylor-Green Vortex case
summary: Mixed precision is a promising approach for reducing the computational cost and energy consumption of Computation Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, but its effectiveness depends strongly on where precision is reduced within the full simulation pipeline. In this work, we study Taylor-Green vortex case using Neko, a matrix-free CFD solver based on the spectral element method (SEM). Profiling shows that the fluid time step is not dominated by Krylov convergence alone: the velocity and pressure solvers require only a small number of iterations per step, while a substantial fraction of runtime is spent in other SEM operators and solver components. Motivated by this structure, we propose a three-level hierarchical mixed-precision control model. Two groups of configurations are evaluated in environments bounded by 64-bit floating-point (fp64) and 32-bit floating-point (fp32) precision, respectively. The fp64-bounded group identifies accuracy sensitive components and shows that SEM-focused fp32 computation is a promising direction for future optimization. The fp32-bounded group provides the main practical benefit. For the high Reynolds number case studied, selected configurations reduce both time- and energy-to-solution by about 34% relative to the fp64 baseline, while improving robustness compared with global fp32. Targeted fp16 kernel overrides are also explored, showing potential for selected operations but increased sensitivity in gradient-based quantities such as enstrophy. Overall, these results indicate that mixed-precision for matrix-free SEM-based CFD should be treated as a simulation-level control problem rather than solely as a Krylov-solver optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于谱元法（SEM）的CFD模拟Neko求解器，以Taylor-Green涡旋为基准，提出三层（块级/核级/步级）层次化混合精度控制模型。实验表明，将混合精度视为仿真级控制问题（而非单纯的Krylov求解器优化）可使时间与能量消耗均减少约34%，并改善全局fp32的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统细粒度混合精度研究主要聚焦于Krylov迭代求解器内部操作，假设迭代次数较多时可累积显著收益。然而在基于SEM的CFD完整仿真中，单时间步内Krylov迭代次数很少（速度求解CG约3次，压力求解GMRES约1-5次），且运行时间分散于SEM算子、投影校正等非求解器组件，导致细粒度优化空间有限。因此需要将混合精度视为仿真级问题进行整体控制。
AI.method: 提出三层层次化混合精度控制模型：1）块级（Block）：对SEM、速度、压力三个组件分别指定compute/accumulate/storage精度；2）核级（Kernel）：对热点核（如adv_dealias、ax_helm、glsc3、hsmg）覆盖块级默认精度，支持fp16覆盖；3）步级（Step）：根据仿真阶段调整精度策略。实验分为两组：A组（rp=fp64边界，fp32局部嵌入）、B组（rp=fp32边界，fp64局部嵌入），共8种配置，在Karolina超算（A100 GPU）上以Re=1600、P=8的TGV为基准测试性能，以Re=10000、P=7为精度压测评估精度。
AI.result: 性能方面：B组配置相对fp64基线减少约34%的时间和能耗；最佳配置B-0（全局fp32）时间和能耗收益最高（39.8%/38.8%），而B-1（fp32存储+关键块fp64计算）在保持约34.6%收益的同时改善数值鲁棒性。A组配置性能略低于fp64基线，因类型转换与存储开销未抵消fp32计算收益。精度方面：A组中A-2（SEM-fp32）取得最佳动能误差e_E,max=0.5462%，A-4（压力-fp32）取得最佳涡量误差e_Ω,max=2.8763%；B-6（速度侧ax_helm核fp16）动能误差最低（0.5221%），但涡量峰值误差显著增大（4.7076%），表明fp16对梯度敏感量（如涡量）风险较高。
AI.conclusion: SEM-CFD仿真的混合精度优化应作为仿真级控制问题而非单纯的Krylov求解器优化。三层层次化模型有效揭示：fp32存储结合选择性fp64计算（B组）可获得34%时间与能耗收益并改善鲁棒性；SEM聚焦的fp32计算（A-2）是未来低精度存储全驻留GPU后的重要优化方向；fp16仅适用于特定核，需谨慎处理梯度敏感量。未来工作将扩展至高雷诺数研究、步级精度自适应控制以及GPU低精度全驻留实现。

title: SatDL: Jointly Optimizing Data Redistribution and Training for Satellite-Based Distributed Learning
summary: Satellite-based distributed learning promises to train machine-learning models directly in orbit using massive, globally dispersed sensor data, thereby avoiding large-scale data downloads to ground servers. However, training convergence is significantly slowed by severe non-IID data, specifically label imbalance, as each satellite observes different geographic regions with distinct labels. This imbalance extends training duration and increases energy consumption for solar-powered satellites. Existing approaches either fully redistribute data to enforce IID conditions - accelerating convergence but incurring substantial communication delays - or avoid redistribution entirely by modifying local learning algorithms to mitigate the impact of label imbalance, which, however, still prolong training and increase energy use. Both extremes result in excessive total end-to-end learning time (data-transfer delay plus training time) and thus elevated onboard energy consumption. We present SatDL, a data-redistribution framework designed to minimize total end-to-end learning time. At its core, SatDL develops a Distributor-Critic framework that jointly models and optimizes data-transfer delay and training time. Evaluations through trace-driven simulations of a 1,584-satellite Starlink constellation and hardware emulations using NVIDIA Jetson and A100 GPUs across five datasets show SatDL reduces total end-to-end learning time by up to 18.6% and onboard energy consumption by 12.23-88.00%, while maintaining inference accuracy within a few percentage points of state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: SatDL提出了一种面向卫星星座分布式学习的选择性数据再分配框架，通过Distributor-Critic联合优化数据传输时延与训练时间，最小化端到端学习总时长，从而降低星载能耗。在1584颗Starlink卫星仿真与NVIDIA Jetson/A100硬件仿真中，跨5个数据集将端到端学习时间最多缩短18.6%，能耗降低12.23%–88.00%。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星可携带GPU进行在轨分布式学习以缓解下行带宽瓶颈，但每颗卫星仅观测固定地理区域，导致严重的标签分布非IID问题。现有方法处于两极：完全再分配以强制IID（通信开销大）或不迁移数据而仅修改本地算法（收敛慢），均导致端到端学习时间长、星载能耗高。本文动机在于找到一种联合考虑数据传输与训练时间的折中方案。
AI.method: 核心是Distributor-Critic联合优化框架：(1) Task & Data Distributor基于星间链路拓扑与带宽约束，将数据上传（x）与再分配（y）建模为最小化总时延的优化问题；(2) Strategy Critic基于分布式学习收敛界估计训练时间，关键创新是将基于数据集的梯度多样性λ重新参数化为类别条件梯度原型的加权组合（按客户端类别分布p_k(c)），将计算复杂度从O(N)降至O(|M|)，并将离散分配问题转化为可梯度下降的连续优化；(3) 通过Distributor与Critic的梯度交互迭代求解选择性再分配策略；(4) 预先计算用户接入卫星调度与静态ISL拓扑快照以适应卫星动态性。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、Flickr Mammals、Satellite Land Cover、Traffic Signs五个数据集上（Dirichlet α=0.1构造严重非IID，10个客户端）：SatDL相对最优基线（IID/Non-IID/FedProx/Hybrid-FL）将端到端学习总时间缩短3.2%–18.6%，且测试精度与基线相当（差距仅几个百分点）。基于Jetson的能耗案例显示能耗降低12.23%（vs Non-IID）至88.00%（vs Hybrid-FL）。消融实验验证了方法对Dirichlet α、数据点大小等参数的适应性。CIFAR-100优化求解耗时约90秒。
AI.conclusion: SatDL通过联合建模数据传输时延与训练收敛时间，证明了在非IID卫星分布式学习中存在显著优于"完全IID"或"完全不迁移"两端策略的折中点。该工作同时揭示了一个重要副产品——缩短端到端时间可自然降低太阳能卫星的星载能耗，对在轨持续学习具有实际部署价值。

title: Scalable datacenter replication with mostly-synchronous consensus on hardware
summary: Consistent replication of data among distributed processes -- a task involving the well-known consensus problem -- is notoriously expensive and hard to scale, affecting especially datacenter services with stringent performance requirements. To mitigate this problem, we introduce scalable replication in-hardware ( scarHW ): a network card design that improves throughput and latency of consistent replication even when increasing the number of replicas, whereas current systems operate at a small scale or with relaxed consistency guarantees. At the heart of scarHW is our novel POPUC consensus algorithm, implemented in an FPGA smartNIC to take full advantage of the "mostly synchronous" behavior of programmable network devices in the datacenter. Unlike widely-adopted "mostly asynchronous" coordination protocols such as Paxos or leaderless alternatives, POPUC implements a generalized variant of consensus dubbed collaborative consensus which allows for several simultaneous decisions, achieving great scalability without compromising availability. POPUC preserves safety guarantees in the presence of process crash-stop and message send/receive omission failures (capturing incidental asynchrony) and has been formally specified and verified in TLA+. Our FPGA prototype improves throughput and latency of widely-used services Redis and Zookeeper by up to two orders of magnitude compared to the state of the art. scarHW-based services also achieve zero downtime upon failure of a minority of replicas, offering a highly-robust, wire-speed, scalable replication system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出scarHW，一种基于FPGA智能网卡的可扩展数据中心状态机复制系统，采用"基本同步"系统模型与新型无领导者POPUC共识算法，支持并发决策，在保持与Paxos相同故障容忍度的同时显著提升吞吐与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 当前数据中心SMR服务多采用Paxos/Raft等"基本异步"协议，存在三大瓶颈：(C1) 领导者单点瓶颈；(C2) 增加副本数时性能急剧下降，迫使系统采用小规模副本组；(C3) 领导者选举与重配置期间服务不可用。这些约束使得一致复制难以扩展，限制了故障容忍能力。
AI.method: 基于"基本同步"系统模型，重新设计一致性复制：1）scarHW：将复制服务卸载到FPGA智能网卡（AMD/Xilinx Alveo U50），利用可编程网卡的数据中心低延迟特性；2）POPUC共识算法：实现名为"协作共识（CC）"的广义共识变体，允许来自多个提议的并发决策，无领导者；3）采用t+1法定人数，容忍进程崩溃停止与消息发送/接收遗漏故障（捕获偶发异步），保证安全性与活性。算法已在TLA+中形式化验证。
AI.result: FPGA原型可饱和100 Gbps网络，最坏响应延迟5.4微秒；副本数超过3时，复制吞吐量比基于Raft的Waverunner快2.5倍；扩展至59节点时，Redis的吞吐量与延迟较NOPaxos提升高达两个数量级；少数副本失败时实现零停机。
AI.conclusion: scarHW通过结合"基本同步"硬件系统模型与无领导者、并发决策的POPUC共识算法，同时解决了C1-C3三大瓶颈，在不牺牲可用性与安全性的前提下，提供了线速、可扩展、高鲁棒的一致复制方案，为延迟敏感的数据中心服务带来数量级性能提升。

title: Asynchronous Verifiable Information Dispersal with Low Space and Communication Complexity
summary: The primary goal of a distributed storage system is to ensure that clients can both write and read data in a reliable and consistent manner, even in the presence of failures. While existing asynchronous verifiable information dispersal (AVID) protocols achieve optimal space complexity for storage and communication complexity for data retrieval in a Byzantine setting, the crucial operations of data dispersal and node recovery have received less attention. We propose an efficient AVID protocol that simultaneously guarantees low complexities for dispersal, storage, retrieval, and recovery. At the core of the proposed protocol lies a novel mechanism to encode data in a two-dimensional matrix and a bespoke dispersal algorithm. The protocol maintains an optimal communication complexity for retrieval while substantially improving upon the state of the art for recovery. Additionally, we describe how the protocol can be modified in order to reduce the space complexity and the communication complexity for dispersal, at the expense of a higher communication complexity for retrieval and recovery. As the proposed protocols strike a balance across all considered metrics, they are suitable for a broad range of real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的异步可验证信息分发（AVID）协议，通过新颖的二维矩阵编码机制和定制化分发算法，在分布式存储系统中同时优化了数据分发、存储、检索和节点恢复四个关键操作的复杂度。主协议实现了3倍存储开销、最优的1.5倍检索开销，以及相比Red Stuff协议在恢复通信开销上降低40%。此外，作者还提出了一个基于最小存储再生（MSR）码的参数化变体，允许通过参数γ在存储与检索/恢复效率之间进行权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的AVID协议主要优化存储空间复杂度和数据检索的通信复杂度，但对于实际工作负载至关重要的数据分发（dispersal）和节点恢复（recovery）操作关注不足。例如，Alhaddad等人(2024)的协议虽然存储和检索最优，但分发开销高达9倍；而Danezis等人(2025)的Red Stuff协议虽然恢复高效，但需要4.5倍的存储开销。对于"暗数据"和"一次写入永不读取"的归档场景（占高度受监管行业数据的30-80%），分发、存储、恢复和检索这四项指标都至关重要，但现有研究尚缺少一种能全面兼顾这些指标并支持实际部署的协议。
AI.method: 核心方法是将数据项m编码为一个n×2n矩阵M：首先将m分割为(n-t)²个元素放入(n-t)×(n-t)矩阵A，然后对A的每一列进行(n, n-t)纠删码编码得到A'，再对A'的每一行进行(2n, n-t)纠删码编码得到M。每个节点v_i存储其行数据r_i = M[i, 1..n-t]和列数据c_i = M[1..n-t, i]，以及相应的承诺证明。分发算法的关键洞察是：收到确认的节点已自然包含其他节点行列的一个元素，因此客户端只需为未确认的节点补充行的后半部分数据，再通过节点间的row_info、column_info和Bracha风格广播完成分发。检索时客户端收集n-t个行数据解码列即可恢复m。恢复时各节点发送编码后的行列元素给替代节点，替代节点解码得到完整存储状态。变体协议则将矩阵嵌入与MSR码结合，参数γ控制存储开销与检索/恢复开销的权衡。
AI.result: 主协议(§3)实现了存储复杂度3|m|+O(n²|π|)，分发通信复杂度6|m|+O(n²|π|)，检索通信复杂度1.5|m|+O(n²|π|)（最优），恢复通信复杂度4.5|m|/n+O(n|π|)。相比Red Stuff协议，存储开销降低33%，分发开销降低14%，恢复开销降低40%；相比Alhaddad et al.(2024)，在保持最优检索复杂度的同时分发开销降低33%。协议变体(§4)通过参数γ调节，当γ=1.5时存储和检索最优且分发开销降至4.5|m|（比Alhaddad et al.降低一半），当γ=1.8时存储接近最优。具体示例：100节点网络存储1GB数据，每节点仅存30MB（vs Red Stuff的45MB）；节点修复时替代节点下载45TB（vs Red Stuff的75TB），节省约2.8天的修复流量。轮复杂度：分发7轮，检索2轮，恢复1轮。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的AVID协议在分布式存储的全操作谱上均改进了现有最优水平。通过二维编码方案与定制化分发算法的协同设计，在保证检索通信复杂度最优的前提下，显著降低了存储、分发和节点恢复的开销，并通过参数化变体支持根据部署场景进行调优。这些协议适用于广泛的实际应用场景，特别是具有高流失率或"暗数据"归档需求的系统。确定四个操作同时最优化的理论下界仍是一个开放问题，留待未来研究。

title: A Feature-Major Codebook for Memory-Efficient Sparse-Binary Self-Organizing Maps: Scaling a MEDLINE Atlas to 1.05 Million Neurons on a Single Consumer GPU
comment: 39 pages, 11 tables, 7 figures. Code, frozen results and reproduction pipeline: this https URL (tag v1.0). Corpus: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20770707 (CC0). An instruction-roofline profiling addendum is included as an ancillary file and at this https URL (tag v1.0)
summary: A self-organising map turns a large corpus into a browsable two-dimensional atlas, but building one at MEDLINE scale has been impractical: the best-matching-unit (BMU) search that dominates training is bound by the bandwidth needed to read the codebook every epoch. I show that this bottleneck is largely an artefact of codebook layout. Storing it feature-major with each feature's weights contiguous, W[v.M+i], recasts the search as a tiled sparse-dense product in which every loaded weight column is reused across a tile of samples. Varying only the layout, with implementation, precision and update rule held fixed, accelerates the BMU search by 4.5-8.5x. Because an exact-argmin BMU is invariant to how the codebook is stored, this gain costs nothing: held-out quantisation error agrees with a cuSPARSE baseline to within 0.5% at every map size. Against that baseline the advantage is a crossover rather than a constant: this http URL is faster at small maps, this http URL is 1.5x faster at 128x128 and 2.6x at 256x256, and at 512x512 it is the only one that runs at all on 24 GB. Paired with a radius-independent box-blur update and a convergence-based stopping rule, it trains a converged map over 29.9 million MEDLINE articles in about 72 s at 64x64 on one 24 GB GPU, and accommodates 262,144 neurons (512x512 edges) where every alternative algorithm I tested exceeds memory constraints. On a 141 GB H200 it reaches 1,048,576 neurons (1024x1024 edges) - to my knowledge the largest self-organising map yet reported. Held-out error follows a smooth power law with no elbow across three decades of map size, so the limit on resolution is compute rather than any breakpoint in the data. At matched work the design is ~82x faster than MedSOM, the CUDA implementation behind our earlier MEDLINE atlases and, at 128x128, 621x faster than the best available multicore-CPU library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向稀疏二进制自组织映射（SOM）的特征主序（feature-major）码本布局，通过将BMU搜索重构为分片的稀疏-稠密矩阵乘，在单卡消费级GPU上训练了目前最大的自组织映射（1,048,576个神经元，覆盖2990万篇MEDLINE文献），相比cuSPARSE基线和CPU库somoclu获得了数量级的加速，且不损失聚类质量。
AI.motivation: 在MEDLINE规模（千万级文献、万级特征）上训练自组织映射受限于BMU搜索的内存带宽瓶颈——每轮需重复读取码本，节点主序布局导致非合并访存。论文旨在通过重新组织码本内存布局来打破这一瓶颈，使全语料医学知识图谱在单块消费级GPU上可行。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 特征主序码本布局 W[v·M+i]，将每个特征的M个权重连续存储，使warp读取时可合并访存并支持tile级复用；(2) SpMM-tile BMU核，将argmin融合到同一扫描中，不物化稠密得分矩阵；(3) 与半径σ无关的分解盒式模糊（box-blur）邻域更新，运行和为O(M)；(4) PCA初始化+基于Kaski-Lagus畸变平台的收敛停止规则；(5) FP16码本+FP32累加以减半存储。
AI.result: 在RTX 4090上：仅布局改变使BMU搜索加速4.5-8.5×，且与cuSPARSE基线保持的量化误差一致（差异<0.5%）。在128×128处比cuSPARSE快1.5×、在256×256处快2.6×，在512×512（262,144神经元）是唯一能在24GB上运行的实现。29.9M文献的64×64图训练仅需72秒。端到端比MedSOM快约82×，比somoclu（CPU，28线程）在128×128处快621×。在H200（141GB）上达到1,048,576神经元（1024×1024），是已知最大的SOM。保持误差随神经元数呈光滑幂律下降（指数≈-0.06，R²=0.996），跨三个数量级无拐点。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明：在内存带宽受限的SOM训练中，码本内存布局是关键设计杠杆；特征主序+得分融合+盒式模糊更新+自适应停止规则的组合，在大映射上将BMU搜索主导的训练时间降至消费级GPU可承受范围，使得全语料MEDLINE医学知识图谱成为分钟级任务。量化误差无拐点的结果表明该语料的表征分辨率受限于计算预算而非数据本身。

title: Conditional GraphGANFed: Optimizing Graph-Structured Molecule Generation in Federated Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have garnered considerable attention in molecular discovery for their ability to generate novel and high-quality molecules. To efficiently train a GAN model while preserving data privacy, GraphGANFed has been proposed to incorporate federated learning and graph convolutional networks into GAN. Yet, GraphGANFed cannot produce synthetic molecules that only optimize a user-defined metric(s) to facilitate the new drug discovery process. To address this issue, we introduce a novel extension to GraphGANFed, namely conditional GraphGANFed (cGraphGANFed), by incorporating the critic network to assess generated molecules using user-defined metric(s). The evaluation results from both the critic network and discriminator are integrated into the loss function of the generator, guiding it to generate novel molecules that maintain similar chemical properties to real ones while optimizing user-defined metrics. Extensive simulations are conducted in two scenarios. First, cGraphGANFed endeavors to optimize all seven commonly used metrics, and the results show that cGraphGANFed significantly outperforms GraphGANFed in Validity and LogP, with a slight advantage in QED, across different settings. Second, cGraphGANFed focuses solely on optimizing QED, and the results show that the synthetic molecules produced by cGraphGANFed can achieve more than 10% improvement in QED than GraphGANFed. Also, the results demonstrate cGraphGANFed has enhanced resilience against mode collapses and performance reduction caused by non-IID data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于联邦学习的条件生成对抗网络扩展模型cGraphGANFed，用于在保护数据隐私的同时生成满足用户定义指标的新型分子。
AI.motivation: 现有的GraphGANFed虽然结合了联邦学习与图卷积网络来保护数据隐私，但其无法仅针对用户定义的指标（如QED、LogP等）生成优化的合成分子，限制了新药发现的效率。
AI.method: 在GraphGANFed的基础上引入条件critic网络，对生成分子进行基于用户定义指标的评估；将critic网络与判别器的评估结果整合到生成器的损失函数中，引导生成器在保持与真实分子相似化学性质的同时优化目标指标。
AI.result: 在两种仿真场景下：(1)同时优化七个常用指标时，cGraphGANFed在Validity和LogP上显著优于GraphGANFed，QED上略优；(2)单独优化QED时，cGraphGANFed的生成分子QED比GraphGANFed提升超过10%。此外，cGraphGANFed对mode collapse和非IID数据导致的性能下降具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: cGraphGANFed成功扩展了GraphGANFed，使其能够在联邦学习与隐私保护的设定下，基于用户定义指标生成高质量、多样化的新分子，显著提升了药物发现过程中的分子生成能力。

title: Decomposing Browser Pipeline Architectures for DOM-Sourced Particle Effects: Worker Offload, WebGL, and WebAssembly
comment: 31 pages, 11 figures. Data and code: this https URL
summary: Local optimization does not necessarily yield end-to-end optimization in layered browser architectures. Teams often treat Web Workers, WebGL, and WebAssembly as interchangeable ways to "make it faster," yet each lever targets a different layer. We present a controlled architectural decomposition--using DOM-sourced particle pipelines as a concrete workload--of five particle pipelines (P1-P5), with an additional non-particle CSS-layer baseline (P0), that isolates thread placement, renderer choice, and simulation backend. Using a reproducible harness we measure interactive pacing, high-load end-to-end stress, and a simulation-only microbenchmark, plus same-host cross-browser / dual-GPU-class replication (Firefox 153+Intel UHD; Chrome 138+NVIDIA NVK) and an independent second-host slice on Google Colab (Chrome 150, Tesla T4, n=5). Four results stand out. (1) Worker offload improves interactive pacing on paper-primary Chrome (approx. 144 vs approx. 52 FPS; Cliff's delta=1, n=10). (2) AssemblyScript speeds the Chrome update kernel by about 1.5-1.6x on the primary host and approx. 1.85x on Colab T4 (sim-only). (3) Under approx. 250k WebGL particles the Chrome sim-only WASM win need not raise product FPS (P5<=P4 on primary/Firefox; P5 approx. P4 on Colab T4); in-worker CPU phase timers show simulate still dominates the accounted budget, so the non-translation is not a simple "draw dominates CPU" story. (4) Renderer ranking and absolute margins vary across browser/GPU/host configurations. The contribution is bottleneck-aware architectural measurement: identify the dominant layer and test whether a layer win propagates to user-visible FPS.

AI.tldr: 本文对浏览器分层架构中 Web Workers、WebGL 与 WebAssembly 三种优化杠杆进行受控的架构分解，以 DOM 源粒子消散效果为工作负载（P1–P5，P0 为非粒子基线），通过交互、压力、仿真三类测量制度，结合同主机跨浏览器/双 GPU 复制与 Colab T4 第二主机副本，揭示"层级局部胜利未必转化为端到端 FPS 提升"的现象学。
AI.motivation: 业界常把 Web Workers、WebGL、WebAssembly 视为可互换的"加速手段"，但三者作用于浏览器分层的不同层级（线程、渲染、仿真内核），局部优化未必带来用户可见的端到端性能提升。本文以 DOM 源粒子流水线为可控实例，量化每条杠杆在何种制度下贡献或不贡献于产品级 FPS。
AI.method: 设计三维正交轴（线程：主线程/Worker；仿真：JS/AssemblyScript-WASM/无；渲染：Canvas2D/WebGL2/CSS 层），构造 P1–P5 五条粒子流水线加上非粒子 CSS 基线 P0。测量分三种制度：交互（600×800，密度 0.5/1/2，约 1000 ms）、压力（1200×1600，密度 1/2/4，约 250k 粒子）、仿真微基准（N=50k–500k，仅更新帧）。论文主要机为 Chrome 138 + Mesa NVK（RTX 3050 Mobile），同机 Firefox 153 + Intel UHD 复制，独立 Google Colab Tesla T4（Chrome 150）第二主机。使用 Playwright headed 模式，n=10，统计方法包括 bootstrap 95% CI、Mann–Whitney 精确检验、Cliff's δ。P4/P5 额外插入 CPU 阶段计时（simulate/viewPrep/upload/draw）与 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU 计时。合成 DOM 夹具 A/B/C 用于控制捕获复杂度。
AI.result: 四项核心结果：(1) Worker 卸载在 Chrome 主导机上将交互 FPS 从约 52 提至约 144，p95 由 21.2 ms 降至 7.0 ms（Cliff's δ=1，p<1e-4）；(2) AssemblyScript 在 Chrome 类内核上 sim-only 比等价 JS 快 1.5–1.6 倍，Colab T4 上达 1.85 倍，但 Firefox 切片上 WASM 反而慢（≈0.56 倍）；(3) 在 ~250k WebGL 粒子的压力场景下，P5（WASM+WebGL+Worker）FPS ≤ P4（JS+WebGL+Worker）——内核胜利未传导至端到端，CPU 阶段计时显示 simulate 仍占已计预算约 90%，非"绘图主导"；(4) 渲染器排序跨浏览器/GPU/主机可反转（如归档 n=5 Chrome 压力下 P3>P4）。论文提供了包含边界声明的声明纪律清单（Table 20）。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是"瓶颈感知"的架构测量方法论：识别主导层级并验证层级胜利是否传导至用户可见 FPS。实践意义：库作者应分层标注优化对象并同时发布产品级 FPS；性能工程师应先剖析主线程瓶颈再选择杠杆；实证研究应明确测量制度与引擎/GPU 配置。论文明确声明这是 Chrome 类经验结果，非通用引擎性质，并指明合成夹具外推至真实网页需谨慎。代码与原始数据公开于 GitHub（commit 99b72cd）与 Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21626647）。

title: From Traceability to Justifiability: Accountability Structures in Agentic Software Engineering
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Primary-data measurement study: a 47-platform two-pass graded documentation survey and a 30-repository depth measurement; not a literature survey. Replication package: this https URL
summary: A pipeline promoting an AI system publishes records claiming the thing evaluated is the thing deployed and that the evidence licensed the transition. We measure, from public material only, whether those records can express that claim and whether it holds where declared. First, a two-class documentation survey of 47 delivery platforms (20 CI/CD, 27 model-serving/agent) under one fixed three-label protocol, graded twice (second pass blind), every consulted page pinned by content hash and date. Across 188 double-graded cells we found no platform whose default record emits a content-addressed identity of the behavioral tuple (model version, instructions, tool definitions, retrieval and runtime configuration); the blind pass grades that column default on zero of 47. Immutable nominal versioning is meanwhile arriving as the agent platforms' default answer (16 of 27): version integers behind mutable pointers, a layer the artifact supply chain already found insufficient. Second, an instrument computes realized assurance depth from a pipeline's published exhaust alone and compares it with the declared depth. Applied to a frozen two-stratum frame of 30 public repositories graded twice from a hashed archive (second pass blind; cell-level agreement 23 and 19 of 30, both passes independently finding the same five full realizations), the sharpest result is a verifiability hole: seven of the 15 repositories chosen for adopting attestation tooling publish source-only releases, so the binding their workflows declare cannot be checked where declared. Where checkable it mostly checks out: five of seven measurable adopters realize the binding end to end; both shortfalls fall at identity binding. Together the results locate the field's records structurally short of justifiability, the one rung that can refuse a transition. The survey carries an expiry clock; we state what would falsify each finding.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对智能体软件工程中的可问责性问题，通过两项公共材料测量工具，定量评估了当前交付管线记录所能表达的"正当性"（justifiability）层级。核心结论：47个平台中没有任何平台默认发出对行为元组的内容寻址标识，承诺与可验证性之间存在结构性缺口。
AI.motivation: 现有可追溯性标准（traceability）承诺可建立实体间的关系并审计安全行为，但缺乏能"拒绝"晋升过渡的判定机制。在智能体系统交付场景下，行为依赖于源、模型版本、指令、工具定义、检索配置等多变组件，元组独立性使传统制品溯源失效。论文将"可追溯"到"可辩护"（justifiability）作为可测量问题，检验平台默认记录能否承载这一层级的断言。
AI.method: 两项测量工具：(1) 47个交付平台（20个CI/CD + 27个智能体/模型服务平台）的三标签（default/opt-in/absent）文档调查，每格双盲评分，共188格，所有页面以内容哈希固定；(2) 公开深度仪器，从管道发布产出的公开制品独立计算"已实现保证深度"，与配置声明的"意图深度"对比。30个公共GitHub仓库构成冻结两层级样本（15个采用证明工具的A级 + 15个高活跃度B级），双盲评分，原始档案SHA-256哈希归档。规范层面定义四个连续性条件（制品、行为、证据、权威）与0-4级保证深度量表，将"内容寻址 vs 名义版本"作为横切区分。
AI.result: 文档调查：47个平台中无任何平台默认发出对行为元组的内容寻址标识（content-addressed identity），仅在智能体类中以不变名义版本形式默认记录元组（27个中16个），即版本号背后仍指向可变指针。深度研究：可核查性漏洞——15个证明工具采用者中7个仅发布源码，无制品可供验证；可测量的8个中5个端到端实现声明绑定，2个缺口均落在标识绑定级别。B层级声明普遍低于意图深度1级。结果整体表明记录结构性不足，且差距可无需询问产方即可测量。
AI.conclusion: 当前领域记录结构性不足以来到可"拒绝"晋升的层级；该差距可仅凭公开产物独立测量，且每个发现均附明确反驳条件与失效时钟（2027-02前重新执行调查以检验标准化是否兑现为默认行为）。论文将研究范围坦诚分为智能体类（仅文档级）与制品级（已测量）两层，并指出已注册前瞻性研究承担行为元组层的确认性检验。

title: SDR Driver for Precise Timing Applications
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, submitted to GRCon26 conference
summary: This paper describes the development of software drivers that enable precise timing applications with the low-cost HackRF One software-defined radio (SDR). The original firmware was extended with timing functions for synchronized sampling, time-scale control, and clock-frequency adjustment. An initial implementation based on a Python wrapper was later redesigned as a SoapySDR-compatible driver. Using an AI-assisted development workflow, the new driver was generated from the existing HackRF One and SoapySDR codebases and became operational after only limited debugging. The approach reduced development effort by more than an order of magnitude while improving software maintainability.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了面向低成本HackRF One软件定义无线电（SDR）的精确计时驱动，通过扩展固件并基于AI辅助工作流生成SoapySDR兼容驱动，将开发工作量降低了一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: HackRF One作为低成本SDR，在需要精确计时（如同步采样、时标控制、时钟频率调节）的应用中缺乏原生支持；传统驱动开发流程耗时耗力，需探索更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 1. 扩展HackRF One原有固件，新增同步采样、时标控制与时钟频率调节等计时功能；2. 早期基于Python封装实现原型；3. 采用AI辅助开发工作流，以现有HackRF One与SoapySDR代码库为基础生成新的SoapySDR兼容驱动；4. 仅需少量调试即完成部署。
AI.result: 成功生成可运行的SoapySDR兼容驱动，开发工作量较传统方式减少超一个数量级，同时提升了软件可维护性。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助代码生成在SDR驱动开发中具有显著效率优势，可大幅缩短开发周期并改善维护性，为低成本SDR实现精确计时应用提供了可行路径。

title: Callability Is Not Operability: Controlled Interface Interventions for LLM Agents
summary: A tool call can be perfectly valid yet still leave an autonomous agent unable to determine what to do next. For example, if an external effect commits but its response is lost, committed and uncommitted states may become indistinguishable to the agent even though they require different continuation actions. We study this gap between callability and operability: whether a tool interface exposes the action-relevant state and semantics needed for an agent to continue safely under operational uncertainty. We operationalize tool operability through Agent-First Tooling (AFT), a set of interface mechanisms spanning selective capability discovery, execution lifecycle and recovery, explicit external-effect semantics, machine-readable results, and postcondition verification. We introduce AFT-Bench, a controlled interface-intervention framework that holds the task, backend, initial state, injected failure, agent, and language model fixed while varying the interface exposed to the agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可调用性不等于可操作性"(Callability Is Not Operability)的核心论点：工具接口即使在语法上可被正确调用，仍可能因未暴露操作相关的状态和语义而导致智能体无法安全决策。作者提出Agent-First Tooling (AFT)接口模型和AFT-Bench受控干预框架，通过冻结任务、后端、初始状态、注入故障、智能体和模型，仅改变接口语义，量化了七类机制的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有工具智能体研究主要评估模型在给定工具环境中的能力，但忽视了接口语义本身对可靠性的决定性作用。当外部效应已提交但响应丢失时，已提交与未提交状态对智能体而言不可区分，但需要不同的后续动作（重试会重复不可逆效应，不重试则任务未完成）。更强的模型推理无法弥补这一接口层的信息缺失。
AI.method: 提出AFT模型，包含七种接口机制：(1)选择性能力发现、(2)可观察执行、(3)可恢复调用、(4)持久执行状态、(5)结构化输出、(6)显式副作用语义、(7)后置条件验证。引入AFT-Bench框架：保持任务、后端、初始状态、注入故障、智能体、模型固定，仅改变接口条件。分三层实验：确定性能力感知控制器验证机制激活；SQLite持久后端复现安全性发现；三个LLM家族（Qwen 3.7 Plus、DeepSeek V4 Pro、GPT-5.6 Sol）在六个工作负载上的自适应评估。统计方法包括任务聚类95% bootstrap置信区间、配对符号置换检验（10,000次排列）和Holm多重性校正。
AI.result: 三项模型合并分析中，七项预先指定的主要对比均通过多重性校正后的推断标准：选择性发现减少约4,013个工具上下文令牌且满足召回非劣效标准（δ=0.10）；可恢复调用和持久执行状态在匹配故障下各提升恢复100个百分点；显式副作用语义分别减少重复效应56.9个百分点和不安全提交50.0个百分点；验证机制减少错误终止声明27.8个百分点。恢复机制在所有三种模型家族和留一模型分析中表现稳定，而验证机制的边际效益高度依赖模型（GPT模型边际效用为0）。
AI.conclusion: 工具可靠性由模型策略和接口语义共同决定，而非单纯的模型能力问题。部分接口机制表现为运行时保证（跨模型稳定），而其他机制则与模型策略部分替代。AFT作为协议无关的接口层可叠加于MCP、REST、CLI等多种传输之上。智能体可靠性研究应将接口语义视为第一类系统变量，而不仅是模型能力的函数。

title: FPGAgent: An LLM-Assisted Framework for Autonomous HLS Code Generation and Verification in FPGA Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown substantial promise for high-level synthesis (HLS) code generation, but most existing approaches validate only simulation or synthesis results. Because of timing and place-and-route constraints, \emph{HLS code that passes simulation and synthesis may still fail to produce deployable, runnable designs on real FPGA platforms}. Moreover, the lack of public benchmarks has limited many evaluations to small, self-curated test suites. We propose FPGAgent, a multi-agent framework tailored to real FPGA environments for autonomous HLS coding with end-to-end executability validation. To the best of our knowledge, FPGAgent is \emph{the first task-specification-to-executable HLS generation framework experimentally validated on a well-established benchmark}. Given a natural-language task specification, FPGAgent injects HLS-specific knowledge and employs evolutionary search to iteratively derive reliable HLS kernel implementations. It then generates a C++ validation program to verify functional correctness, diagnoses potential defects, and guides targeted repairs. Finally, it synthesizes host code for compilation and board-level execution on FPGA hardware. We comprehensively evaluate FPGAgent with five established LLMs on HLS-Eval, a benchmark containing 78 tasks across multiple domains, and verify board-level executability on a real FPGA platform. Compared with existing baselines, FPGAgent improves the synthesizable rate by 16.9% on average, executability by 26.7%, and functional correctness by 30.6%. These results show that FPGAgent substantially improves the practical usability of LLM-based HLS generation and demonstrates the value of end-to-end validation.

AI.tldr: FPGAgent是首个面向真实FPGA平台的端到端HLS代码生成与验证多智能体框架，在HLS-Eval基准（78个任务）上实现了合成率、可执行率和功能正确性的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辅助HLS代码生成方法仅在仿真/综合层面验证，缺少真实FPGA板级执行验证，且缺乏在公认基准上的评估。FPGA存在时序收敛和布局布线约束，通过仿真/综合的代码未必能生成可部署的可执行设计。
AI.method: 三模块多智能体框架：(1) Kernel Code Implementation模块——基于进化算法（EoH启发）的迭代式HLS核代码生成，结合多级错误反馈机制（含Error Pool错误案例库）；(2) Functional Reflection模块——C/C++级功能验证、错误诊断与定向修复；(3) Compilation & Execution模块——生成FPGA主机端代码，调用Vitis工具链编译为xclbin并在Xilinx U200板卡上执行验证。
AI.result: 在HLS-Eval基准78个任务上，对比zero-shot基线（pass@10），FPGAgent平均提升合成率16.9%、可执行率26.7%、功能正确性30.6%。最佳结果由Gemini 3.1 Pro取得，功能正确性达92.3%。消融实验证实Kernel Evolution Optimization模块（Eoh）和Functional Reflection模块（Reflect）协同作用贡献最大（完整方法vs基线：功能正确性37.2%→66.7%）。失败分析将错误归为Error_Kernel、Error_Functional、Error_Host三类。
AI.conclusion: FPGAgent是首个在公认基准上完成端到端FPGA可执行验证的任务规约到可执行HLS生成框架，显著提升了LLM辅助HLS生成的实用性，验证了端到端验证在FPGA工程中的重要价值。未来工作将聚焦于降低延迟、提升资源利用率的任务特定微调。

title: Enhancing Bug Report Templates in the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Community
comment: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We propose enhancing the bug report templates in the GitHub Issues issue tracking system used by the TianoCore open-source community with the aim of improving the bug triage and resolution process. We analyze the bug repository data and find patterns of information that are useful for bug triage and fixing. However, some of them are only occasionally included in the free-form text of bug reports. Therefore, we propose adding a few new fields to the existing TianoCore bug report template. In this study, we focus on the key TianoCore project, EDK II, which constitutes the core of the UEFI firmware across various firmware vendors and original equipment manufacturers. This study is currently a work-in-progress. So far, we have interviewed a few developers to obtain their feedback and adjust the proposed approach. We are planning more interviews with the TianoCore community to conduct A/B tests and validate our approach to achieve effective and efficient bug triage and resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文针对TianoCore EDK II（UEFI固件参考实现）从Bugzilla迁移至GitHub Issues后存在的缺陷报告结构不完整问题，提出在现有缺陷报告模板中新增两个固件特有的结构化字段（受影响的CPU架构、缺陷类别，含回归/安全/功能/新特征），并集成GPT类LLM生成可解释的咨询性建议（有效性、重复检测、优先级、分配），同时开发了基于Web的A/B测试原型，已完成4次试点访谈，对92个GitHub原生bug报告进行了人工分析验证，目前为进行中的工作。
AI.motivation: EDK II作为跨多家固件厂商的核心UEFI参考实现，其缺陷报告存在大量高优先级未分诊的开放issue。现有模板缺乏固件特有的关键诊断信号（如受影响CPU架构、是否回归缺陷等），且这些信息常被埋没在自由文本中，导致分诊和修复效率低下。固件场景下症状相同可能因架构/回归/共享包等差异对应完全不同的分诊路径。
AI.method: 1) 基于GitHub GraphQL API抓取EDK II仓库2026年6月30日快照，筛选GitHub原生`type:bug`标签的92个已关闭issue，对回归状态、架构信息进行人工编码分析（LLM辅助做一致性校验）；2) 在现有模板上新增两个结构化字段：受影响架构（多选+架构差异自由文本）、缺陷类别（多选标签：功能/回归/安全/新特征）；3) 利用LLM（TianoForge流水线）生成可解释的咨询性建议（有效性、重复性、优先级、负责人推荐）并附置信度；4) 设计Web端A/B对照实验原型（被试内设计，盲标Template 1/2，顺序随机化）。
AI.result: 人工分析显示92个bug报告中11个为回归缺陷、35个提及架构信息（其中16个以触发或根因方式使用），证明这两个字段值得结构化；4次试点访谈中3位参与者倾向增强版（带AI辅助的模板），1位资深TianoCore安全专家倾向简洁版本，对多数新增项持批评态度；A/B原型已上线（复现数据已公开于TianoShield项目和Harvard Dataverse）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的固件特定字段和可解释的AI咨询建议有潜力提升EDK II缺陷分诊效率；目前为进行中工作，后续将扩大开发者访谈规模、验证AI建议质量、并优化证据呈现顺序（先证据后模型标识）以支持快速浏览。

title: SPIDER4TianoCore: Enhancing Patch-Propagation for the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Ecosystem
comment: ACM International Workshop on Firmware Testing and Analysis (FTA) 2026, Co-located with ISSTA 2026
summary: We propose and demonstrate SPIDER4TianoCore, a packaged Python command-line tool that provides integration-stage patch-status evidence for the TianoCore/UEFI firmware supply chain. Given an upstream pre-patch and post-patch pair and prepared downstream targets, the tool reports Vulnerable, Already Patched, Not Applicable, or Uncertain with supporting evidence for maintainer review. Our work is inspired by SPIDER's patch-propagation framing, but SPIDER4TianoCore does not itself prove that a patch is safe to propagate. We evaluate the engine on 20 prepared target/CVE pairs from eight public downstream EDK II repositories and two CVEs. The analyzers produce 10 high-confidence pre-patch matches and four high-confidence post-patch matches, conservatively abstain on six targets, and make no confidently wrong classifications relative to the recorded manual patch-state labels. These preliminary results demonstrate reproducible evidence generation for prepared targets rather than general downstream accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SPIDER4TianoCore，一款基于 Python 命令行的工具，用于在 TianoCore/UEFI 固件供应链的集成阶段为已准备好的下游目标生成补丁状态判定证据。它接收上游 pre/post 补丁对和下游目标，针对每个目标输出 Vulnerable、Already Patched、Not Applicable 或 Uncertain 四类判定，并附带支撑证据供维护者审阅。工具受 SPIDER 的补丁传播框架启发，但本身不证明补丁可安全传播。
AI.motivation: 开源固件生态（如 TianoCore EDK II）中，上游安全补丁常因 release 分支、平台包、厂商 fork 和披露约束等因素在下游延迟传播，影响固件安全。原有 SPIDER 工具采用 Java/Ant/Z3，存在跨平台复现性问题，难以直接集成到 EDK II 工作流中，因此需要一个轻量、可复现的 Python 原生工具，在集成阶段为维护者提供保守、可审阅的补丁状态证据。
AI.method: 工具以 YAML manifest 为输入，声明上游 pre/post 补丁文件、目标函数与下游目标（含 commit 钉版）。核心流程：TargetResolver 解析目标 → Analyzers 使用归一化文本匹配与 tree-sitter C 函数归一化匹配进行比较 → VerdictClassifier 输出高置信 Vulnerable/Patched，或在函数缺失时输出 Not Applicable，否则输出 Uncertain → ReportAggregator 生成 JSON、technical Markdown、advisory Markdown 及 public-safe 渲染（隐去本地路径与标识符）。置信度 high/low 仅表示分析器是否找到精确匹配，不表示可利用性或严重性。SPIDER/Z3 条件等价分析被留作未来升级路径。
AI.result: 在两个公开 EDK II CVE（CVE-2024-38797：HashPeImageByType 越界读；CVE-2023-45234：PixieFail 类 DHCPv6 漏洞 PxeBcHandleDhcp6Offer）的 20 个 target/CVE 对上评估，覆盖 8 个公开下游 EDK II 仓库。结果：10 个 pre-patch 精确/AST 匹配全部判为 Vulnerable（10/10）；4 个 post-patch 匹配全部判为 Already Patched（4/4）；4 个分歧 pre-patch 和 2 个分歧 patched 等价目标被保守判为 Uncertain（共 6/20 弃判）；相对人工语义审阅标签无任何自信错误的分类。时间序列子集正确捕捉到一次独立 backport 事件。但作者强调识别率反映的是已准备 benchmark 的特征而非泛化准确率。
AI.conclusion: SPIDER4TianoCore 展示了在集成阶段为 TianoCore EDK II 生成可复现、可审阅补丁状态证据的可行工作流，但工具既不证明补丁可安全传播，也不是完整的补丁传播或通知系统。未来工作包括在同一 benchmark 上对比 LLM 基线、以及探索人工审批下生成代码审阅分支或 PR 草稿（不自主合并）的流程。

title: Scale, Concentration, and Entry Timing in the Shopify App Ecosystem: A Longitudinal Study of Platform Governance and Application Survival
summary: The Shopify marketplace hosts more than 16,000 active third-party applications, serving 2.7 million active merchant stores generating an estimated \$706 billion in annual sales, yet little empirical evidence exists on its structure and adoption drivers. We analyse it using a September 2025 snapshot of all 24,826 applications, a weekly panel of 7,708 applications over 366 weeks (February 2019 to March 2026), and listing histories reconstructed from the Internet Archive. Across 55 established functional categories, over half were low-concentration and 20\% highly concentrated, with larger categories consistently less concentrated. Later entrants grew faster than early movers in 88\% of the 50 analysed categories, persisting across seven years of quarterly re-estimations, with early movers on net losing detected installations whilst late movers gained them. Platform governance reshaped competition asymmetrically: Shopify's entry into chat reversed more than two years of de-concentration; the deprecation of its Product Reviews application, to our knowledge the first measured platform-owner exit from complementor category, released 191,000 installations of which at most a third reappeared as competitor adoption within a year; the 2021 reduction of the platform revenue share produced no detectable change in entry or retention. Failure is largely silent and predictable: the median exiting application peaked at 8 detected installations and disappeared from tracking within 68 weeks of launch, category leadership changed hands in 92\% of categories over seven years, and publicly observable data from an application's first six months predict exit within two years with cross-validated AUC above 0.8. App markets on Shopify remain contestable; who benefits depends on platform governance and entry conditions more than on entry timing.

AI.tldr: 本文对Shopify应用生态进行了纵向实证研究,基于2025年9月快照(24,826个应用)、2019-2026年366周的7,708个应用周面板数据,以及从Internet Archive重建的列表历史,系统分析了生态规模、类别集中度、进入时机效应、平台治理事件、应用生存与早期预警预测六大问题。研究发现:超过半数类别为低集中度(仅20%为高集中度),且类别越大越分散;在88%的类别中后期进入者增长更快(7年内季度重新估计均稳健);Shopify自有应用进入聊天类别逆转了两年多的去集中化趋势,而其退出产品评论类别后释放的19.1万安装量中至多三分之一被竞争对手吸收,2021年的收入分成下调对进入和留存无明显影响;失败普遍是静默且可预测的——退出应用中位数峰值仅8个安装、上线后68周消失,但92%的类别中领头应用发生了更替,前6个月的公开数据可预测2年内退出(AUC>0.8)。结论是Shopify应用市场仍具可竞争性,但受益者更多取决于平台治理与进入条件而非进入时机。
AI.motivation: Shopify生态已容纳超过16,000个活跃第三方应用,服务270万商家、年销售额约7060亿美元,但对其结构与采纳驱动因素的实证证据稀缺。开发者难以判断哪些类别已饱和、早期进入者能否维持优势,商家难以评估供应商依赖风险,平台则关注开放性与可持续性。本文旨在用大规模纵向数据系统回答这些问题。
AI.method: 三阶段方法:(1)RQ1描述性统计刻画规模;(2)RQ2在55个应用数≥20的类别中用Herfindahl-Hirschman指数(HHI,阈值0.15/0.25)与Top-5市场份额测度集中度;(3)RQ3在3,456个≥180天的应用中按创建日期排序,计算创建排名与近90天安装量(velocity)及近90天/累计安装比率(rate)的Spearman相关,并按FDR校正分类为强FMA/侵蚀FMA/后入优势/混合。新增纵向维度:RQ4对Shopify Inbox、Forms、Product Reviews废弃、收入分成下调四项事件做事件研究(含置换检验与excess gain剥离);RQ5用Kaplan-Meier与Cox模型分析2,247个entry-observed应用的退出;RQ6用logistic回归与5折交叉验证预测104周内退出。所有面板分析严格基于前26周可观测数据。
AI.result: 主要结果:(1)生态含24,826个应用(16,698活跃,4,213有安装),分布于231个主类别;商店年销售估计7060亿美元,美英加印澳占60.7%;74.8%活跃应用零安装,freemium占69.4%。(2)集中度均值HHI=0.190、中位数0.144;11类(20%)高集中、16类(29.1%)中度、28类(50.9%)低集中;类别越大HHI越低(逆相关);最集中类别为social proof(HHI=0.678,Instafeed占81.9%),最低为discounts(HHI=0.047)。(3)50类中45类velocity正相关、48类rate正相关,88%两类同时倾向后期进入者;37类(74%)中早期进入者中位数velocity为负而后期为正;早入者前四分位中30%仍在增长(关键区分:领导地位、评论数、评分、freemium)。(4)26个季度重估验证了进入时机结论(中位数90.5%/87.9%);53类显著去集中化、92%类别领头应用发生更替。(5)Inbox于2021年7月再发布逆转聊天类别两年去集中化,HHI回升至0.55;Product Reviews废弃释放191,290安装但仅17%-32%以excess gain形式被竞争对手吸收;Forms进入无可检测影响;收入分成下调对月新上线(262.6→261.2)与月度退出率(0.3%→0.4%)无影响。(6)退出中位数应用峰值8个安装、68周消失;2019-20队列78周退出率7.5%,2023-24队列升至11.2%;Cox模型显示freemium降低37%风险、前26周获评论降低67%风险、每晚一年进入提高28%风险。(7)Logistic模型5折CV AUC=0.81(跟踪退出)/0.84(严格定义);安装增长与首条评论为最强保护信号,类别规模是最大风险因子。
AI.conclusion: Shopify应用市场保持可竞争性,但受益者更受平台治理与进入条件而非进入时机决定。三大新贡献:第一,平台治理比开发者经济政策更能重塑竞争结构,且进退不对称——平台进入压缩竞争者空间,而平台退出释放的安装量多数并未转化为竞争对手采纳;第二,失败普遍静默且发生于早期,但类别领导权在92%类别中发生更替,说明可竞争性与高夭折率共存;第三,失败具有高度可预测性,前6个月公开数据足以识别风险应用(AUC>0.8)。政策含义:对开发者,freemium、前26周获取安装增长与首条评论是存活关键信号,平台自有产品路线图是首要风险;对平台运营者,自有应用的构建与废弃决策在数季度内重塑类别,而佣金调整对进入与留存影响微弱;对商家,应定期重新评估已安装应用(尤其在平台公告后)。未来研究需在其他平台验证治理结论、解释为何少数早期进入者免于被淘汰(需企业层面数据)、并打通采纳轨迹与货币化之间的联系。

title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration
summary: Answering developer questions about a software repository is a critical yet under-explored problem in software engineering. While existing repository understanding methods have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on surface-level code retrieval and lack the ability for deep reasoning over multiple files, complex software architectures, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose DeepRepoQA, a novel question answering (QA) framework for repository-level code understanding. DeepRepoQA builds on an agentic framework where LLM agents find answers through a systematic tree search over the repository structure. A Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) mechanism is employed to empower agents to dynamically search, navigate, and inspect code, enabling effective multi-hop reasoning over long-range code dependencies. Comprehensive experiments on the SWE-QA benchmark demonstrate substantial performance gains over strong baselines, validating the effectiveness of systematic MCTS-guided exploration for multi-hop repository reasoning.

AI.tldr: DeepRepoQA提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的智能体框架,用于仓库级代码问答,通过四个协作智能体(感知、规划、执行、评估)在代码库中进行系统化的多跳推理搜索,在SWE-QA基准上显著优于RAG和ReAct风格的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库理解方法主要依赖表层代码检索,缺乏跨文件、复杂软件架构及长程代码依赖的深度推理能力;ReAct风格智能体虽能多步推理,但单路径设计限制了探索,容易陷入检索偏差或遗漏关键证据。
AI.method: 将仓库问答建模为搜索与验证问题,采用基于MCTS的智能体框架,包含四个LLM驱动的智能体:(1)感知智能体——分析当前状态与兄弟分支生成情境报告;(2)规划智能体——提出候选动作拓展搜索前沿;(3)执行智能体——通过六种动作(基于索引的名称查找FindClass/FindFunction/FindCodeSnippet、语义检索SemanticSearch、代码查看ViewCode、终止Finish)在结构-语义索引上执行操作并筛选证据;(4)评估智能体——对动作-观察对评分并回传。代码库通过Tree-sitter解析为多层级表示(目录结构、AST、语义嵌入)。MCTS采用UCT策略进行选择-扩展-单步仿真-反向传播,使用学习到的价值估计替代多步rollout以提升效率。
AI.result: 在SWE-QA基准(720对QA,15个Python仓库)上,DeepRepoQA在Kimi K2、GLM-4.6、Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct和GPT-5.1四个骨干模型上一致优于SWE-agent和OpenHands,使用Qwen3时最大提升7.08分;在GPT-5.1上达到70.06分,超越通义灵码(69.12)接近Cursor(70.71)。消融研究显示评估智能体最重要(-3.50),MCTS次之(-2.27),感知智能体(-1.73)和语义搜索(-1.07)均有贡献。Token使用与商业工具相当。Java子集实验验证了跨语言泛化能力。LLM评判与人类专家一致性高(Pearson r=0.972, Cohen's κ=0.725)。
AI.conclusion: DeepRepoQA通过将仓库级问答重新表述为MCTS引导的规划问题,实现了系统化、可验证的多跳推理,在准确性、完整性和推理维度上显著超越RAG和单路径智能体基线,同时保持高效的计算开销,为构建更强大的软件工程助手奠定了基础。

title: Mutation Testing of Simulink Cyber-Physical System Models: Challenges and Solutions in Practice
comment: Accepted for publication at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026), Munich, Germany, October 12-16, 2026. 7 pages
summary: Several experience reports illustrate that mutation testing is capable of supporting a shift-left testing strategy, especially in industries where late bug discovery incurs very high costs and risks. In the context of cyber-physical systems, a shift left implies that engineers need to test the design models used to simulate, prototype, and analyse the feasibility of the system under design. In this paper, we analyse the challenges we encountered and the lessons we learned when incorporating mutation testing in the context of DUCO, a company producing ventilation systems for buildings. The engineers within DUCO have years of experience with model-based engineering centered around Simulink and StateFlow, including unit tests for their models. During a pilot project with our tool prototype MUT4SLX we learned that equivalent mutants, requirement traceability, and mutation testing for Stateflow represent particular challenges not yet reported in the academic literature.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了在工业环境中将基于模型的变异测试工具 MUT4SLX 应用于 Simulink 和 Stateflow 信息物理系统模型的试点项目实践，重点揭示了等效变异体、需求追溯和 Stateflow 变异测试三大尚未在学术文献中充分讨论的挑战。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键的信息物理系统（如楼宇通风系统）中，晚期缺陷发现成本高昂。DUCO 公司虽已采用基于模型的工程实践并对单元测试进行结构覆盖率度量，但仍存在缺陷在后期才被发现的问题。作者旨在通过 MUT4SLX 工具的工业试点，探索变异测试在 Simulink/Stateflow 模型层面落地的实际挑战与解决方案，以推动"左移"测试策略。
AI.method: 研究采用工业试点方法：与楼宇通风系统制造商 DUCO 合作，在 EFFECTS 研究项目（2021–2024）框架下，对三个生产模型（M1：Simulink 饱和求和；M2：Simulink 缩放 PID 控制器，255 个块；M3：Stateflow 加热控制器）运行 MUT4SLX 的全部 28 个 Simulink + 18 个 Stateflow 变异算子，使用 MATLAB R2025b 在 Intel i7-12700H 笔记本上执行测试。结合 DUCO 在更大模型集上的内部使用反馈，通过持续讨论提炼实践挑战。
AI.result: 三个模型共生成 459 个变异体，250 被杀死、209 存活，变异得分分别为 M1 82.0%、M2 41.0%、M3 95.7%。M2 的 21 个测试用例中，最强单用例得分 40.1%，完整套件仅 41.0%，存在严重冗余；M1 虽达 100% 判定/条件覆盖仍有 16/89 个变异体存活。M2 执行 324 个变异体耗时 3.6 小时。DUCO 内部更大规模使用显示三轮连续试验后测试套件质量提升 7.5%。研究发现三个学术文献中尚未充分报道的挑战：等效变异体识别、需求追溯支持、Stateflow 变异测试的针对性处理。
AI.conclusion: 基于 Simulink/Stateflow 的模型变异测试在工业中技术上可行（MUT4SLX 当前 TRL 5、CRL 4），能揭示结构覆盖率无法发现的测试弱点，但落地需解决等效变异体的人工甄别负担、与需求追溯的集成以及 Stateflow 特有的决策逻辑变异处理等问题；DUCO 的实践表明变异测试可有效补充现有基于覆盖率的单元测试策略。

title: Cross-Stack Validation of Language-Model Training: A Clinical Fine-Tuning Case Study
summary: Neural network training has an oracle problem: a run can converge normally and yield a usable model while the software beneath it computes something other than specified. Almost all such work runs on one stack, so there is rarely anything independent to check against. We study whether independently implemented training stacks can serve as differential oracles for a whole fine-tuning pipeline, rather than the operators and inference paths that prior differential testing targets. We define a trajectory-level protocol -- a shared specification, cross-check points spanning arithmetic, model loading, data rendering and the learning trajectory, and a separation of independence of the stack, the orchestration and the language runtime -- and apply it to a LoRA adaptation of Qwen3-0.6B over 168,574 clinical question-answer pairs under PyTorch and under numbat, an independent framework written in Zig, driven natively and through its C interface from six languages. Across 42 paired evaluations spanning a full epoch the two stacks' held-out cross-entropy differs by 0.134% on average, and four implementations end the epoch within 0.15% of one another. The comparison exposed 17 faults that single-implementation development had missed, two of them notable for software engineering. The fault with the largest effect on the trained model lay outside the numerical kernels: a mismatch in how clinical text was rendered moved held-out loss 0.15, some 500 times more than the arithmetic faults found beside it. And four faults were reachable only from a language whose memory model differs from the first two implementations: a scheduler migrating work across threads, a collector blind to device memory, an ownership discipline needing a primitive the interface lacked. Implementation diversity has several axes, and the runtime is one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨栈差分验证协议，用于端到端训练管道的验证。研究以Qwen3-0.6B的LoRA临床领域微调为案例，在PyTorch和独立的Zig框架numbat上运行相同规范，在42个配对评估点上，两者的留出交叉熵平均仅差0.134%，四个实现在完整epoch结束时相互差距在0.15%以内。研究揭示了17个单实现开发遗漏的缺陷，其中最具影响力的缺陷是临床文本渲染不匹配（非数值错误），造成留出损失变化是算术错误的约500倍；另有4个缺陷只能通过运行时多样性（不同语言的内存模型）暴露。结论是"独立性"不是一个单一属性，而是包含栈、编排、运行时三个维度。
AI.motivation: 神经网络训练存在"预言机问题"——训练可正常收敛并产出可用模型，但底层软件可能计算了与规范不符的内容。几乎所有训练工作都在单一软件栈上运行，缺乏独立参照。以往的差分测试主要针对算子或推理路径等单元，而非完整训练管道。本文旨在探索：独立实现的训练栈能否作为完整微调管道的差分预言机？学习轨迹本身能否作为差分信号？
AI.method: 1. 协议设计：在轨迹级别定义共享规范、四级交叉检查点（L1算术→L2模型加载→L3数据渲染→L4轨迹）和三种独立性分离（栈独立性、编排独立性、运行时独立性）。2. 工作负载：Qwen3-0.6B + rank-stabilised LoRA（rank 16），在168,574个临床问答对上微调1个epoch（10,536次更新）。3. 实现对比：PyTorch 2.11 + transformers + peft vs. 独立的Zig框架numbat，并通过C ABI从Zig/Python/Go/Rust/TypeScript/C六种语言驱动。4. 评估：每250步在固定512个留出样本上评估交叉熵，共42个配对评估点；同时比较梯度范数分布。5. 可行性测量：8个实现在同一加速器上一对一执行500次更新以测量每步耗时和token吞吐。
AI.result: 1. 轨迹一致性：L1阶段两栈对未训练模型报告留出损失均为3.672389（六位精度一致）；42个评估点上平均绝对差0.134%，最大单差0.316%，偏差符号变化12次（无系统性偏差）；梯度范数中位数一致到0.1%。2. 四个实现结束epoch时差距在0.15%以内（2.1635–2.1668）。3. 发现17个缺陷，其中最严重的不是数值缺陷而是数据渲染缺陷（Fault 1：未使用模型对应的聊天模板），使留出损失偏移0.15，约为算术缺陷影响的500倍。4. 4个缺陷（Fault 14–17）只能通过运行时多样性暴露，包括Go调度器迁移goroutine导致线程局部状态错乱、Go GC无法感知设备内存导致性能下降2.6×、Rust所有权模型与接口不兼容、Windows WDDM内存分页导致静默降速。5. 可行性：numbat框架达到457 tokens/s（PyTorch参考为305），六种语言绑定在框架的4.1%以内，运行第二实现的成本与第一实现相当。
AI.conclusion: 1. 独立实现的训练栈可作为完整微调管道的可行差分预言机，学习轨迹是有效的差分信号。2. "实现独立性"不是一个属性，而是至少包含三个维度——栈（数值）、编排（训练循环与接口）、运行时（调度、内存管理、所有权），且这三者所能暴露的缺陷类别互不重叠。3. 对实践者的建议：最便宜的步骤是L1（在训练前比较未训练模型的留出损失）；其次是L3（比较几条记录的渲染token序列），这是本研究中最严重缺陷的藏身之处。4. 最具影响力的缺陷往往位于语义边界（数据渲染）而非数值内核。5. 限制：缺陷表是重建而非受控重注入测量；轨迹证据主要由单一标量（交叉熵）+梯度范数承载；缺乏随机基线（未测单栈种间变异）；无可比性能声明。

title: Towards LLM-Enhanced Android Taint Analysis
summary: Taint analysis is a fundamental technique for detecting sensitive data leaks in Android apps. However, traditional static tools, such as FlowDroid, still face well-known challenges due to the complexity of accurately modeling the Android framework. In this paper, we investigate whether off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) can effectively reason about taint flows in Android apps. Our preliminary approach relies on an agentic interaction strategy, enabling the LLM to iteratively explore code and reason about data flows. We conduct an initial evaluation on the DroidBench benchmark against FlowDroid, where our approach outperforms the baseline: Gemini-3 Flash achieves an F1-score of 0.96, compared to 0.55 for FlowDroid. In particular, we observe improvements in challenging categories such as inter-component communication (0.95 vs. 0.17), implicit flows (0.94 vs. 0.00), and reflection (1.00 vs. 0.50), where FlowDroid typically struggles. On a small set of real-world apps, the LLM-based approach also identifies additional potential data leaks not reported by FlowDroid. These preliminary findings suggest that LLM reasoning may effectively complement traditional static taint analysis, motivating future research on hybrid LLM-enhanced taint analysis pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨利用开箱即用的大语言模型（LLM）通过代理式交互策略对Android应用进行污点分析，相比传统静态分析工具FlowDroid，在DroidBench基准和真实应用中均表现出显著优势，特别是在组件间通信（ICC）、隐式流、反射和原生代码等传统工具的薄弱场景中。
AI.motivation: 传统Android静态污点分析工具（如FlowDroid）依赖人工维护的框架模型，在处理反射、动态加载、组件间通信（ICC）和不完整代码等场景时存在显著局限；而LLM在代码理解和推理方面展现出强大能力，因此作者探究LLM能否无需任务特定训练即可有效推理Android污点流。
AI.method: 提出基于代理式LLM的Android污点分析方法：将LLM作为分析代理，通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）与JADX-MCP和Ghidra-MCP等逆向工程工具交互，迭代探索反编译代码并推理source-to-sink污点流；为缓解非确定性，每个应用重复运行N次，仅保留出现在多数运行中的流作为有效结果。实验使用Gemini 3 Flash（闭源）和Qwen3.5-27B（开源）两种模型，通过Claude Code和Gemini CLI编排。
AI.result: 在DroidBench基准（190个测试用例，19个类别）上：Gemini 3 Flash F1达0.96（Precision 0.96, Recall 0.95），Qwen3.5-27B F1为0.88，均显著优于FlowDroid的0.55（F1）；类别分析显示LLM在ICC（0.95 vs 0.17）、隐式流（0.94 vs 0.00）、反射（1.00 vs 0.50）、原生代码（1.00 vs 0.00）等FlowDroid薄弱场景提升尤为明显，但动态加载和不可达代码两类两者均表现不佳。在5个真实Android应用评估中，LLM方法发现了FlowDroid未报告的17个额外流，其中16个经人工验证为真实数据泄露。
AI.conclusion: 初步研究表明LLM推理能够有效补充传统静态污点分析，特别是在传统建模困难的复杂场景中；然而两者捕获的是部分不同的污点流集合，因此未来工作应聚焦于设计混合分析流水线——由传统分析器处理常见情况，LLM选择性地应用于更具挑战性的场景——以平衡效果、可扩展性和计算成本。

title: Observability and Fault Injection for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems in Software Engineering
summary: Large Language Model-based multi-agent systems are increasingly explored for software engineering tasks, but they remain difficult to inspect, debug, and evaluate under controlled failures. We present llmmas-otel, a lightweight and framework-agnostic tool that combines OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing with fault injection for LLM-based multi-agent systems in software engineering workflows. The tool instruments agent executions with trace-aligned telemetry across workflow phases, agent steps, inter-agent communication, tool calls, and LLM invocations, and supports targeted fault injection at selected interaction points. This makes it possible to compare baseline and faulty executions in a reproducible way and inspect the effects through aligned traces and run artifacts. We describe the motivation, architecture, implementation, current capabilities, and initial validation of the tool on a minimal demo workflow and a real LLM-based multi-agent system for software development.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为 llmmas-otel 的轻量级、框架无关的工具，将基于 OpenTelemetry 的分布式追踪与故障注入相结合，用于在软件工程工作流中对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）进行可观测性和受控故障实验分析。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统在软件工程任务中应用日益广泛，但失败率高、调试困难。现有工作主要集中在失败分类、归因和可观测性建议上，缺少一个可在现有工作流上注入受控故障并与基线进行结构化对比的运行时工具层。
AI.method: llmmas-otel 围绕现有 LLM-MAS 工作流进行包装，通过装饰器和上下文管理器标记会话、阶段、Agent 步骤、A2A 通信、工具调用和 LLM 调用等关键边界，并使用 OpenTelemetry 生成具有一致属性词汇的分布式追踪。同时提供基于规则的故障注入层，支持在 A2A、工具和 LLM 调用边界上注入延迟、丢弃、截断、超时、限流、网络错误、格式错误等多种故障，使基线和故障运行在相同的追踪结构下保持可比。
AI.result: 在最小化 Planner→Coder 示例和真实的 ChatDev 系统上，使用 30 任务 ProgramDev 基准进行验证。结果表明，故障延迟会被显著放大：示例工作流中 LLM 延迟平均放大 1.053 倍、A2A 延迟放大 1.295 倍；而在 ChatDev 中，LLM 延迟平均放大 48.1 倍（中位数 13.9），A2A 延迟平均放大 59.2 倍（中位数 6.6），证明局部扰动在多阶段、消息密集型工作流中会产生级联效应。
AI.conclusion: llmmas-otel 提供了一个可复用的运行时基础设施，将可观测性与故障注入统一在同一追踪结构中，使基线和故障执行可重复、可比较地运行与检查，可作为 LLM-MAS 可靠性与评估研究的实用基础。未来工作将扩展故障类型与注入面，并增加配对运行差异分析、追踪摘要、根因排序等高层分析功能。

title: Ockhamareto: Pareto-Gated Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Concise Unit-Test Generation with Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce \textbf{Ockhamareto}, a single-shot GRPO framework for unit-test generation and selection, based on the principles of \emph{Ockham's Razor} and \emph{Pareto Optimality}. Ockhamareto has two principal components: (i)~a \emph{Pareto-gated Bonus} that rewards only rollouts non-dominated in~(mutation, $-$\#tests) space, and (ii)~\emph{Token-level Segment Credit}, which attributes each test's marginal mutation kills back to the tokens of its unit-test block. On the \emph{UnLeakedTestBench~(ULT)}, Ockhamareto \emph{strictly Pareto-dominates} the strongest RL baseline~(\emph{MIST-RL}). Furthermore, it dominates on {\em each and all} optimization objectives, catching more bugs ($49.9\%$ vs $31.3\%$ mutation score at $N{=}5$), using \emph{fewer} tests ($2.60$ vs $4.67$ on average), thereby achieving $3.4\times$ the per-test trade-off improvement. The advantage is found in all four benchmarks~(\emph{HumanEval+}, \emph{MBPP+}, \emph{CodeContests}, \emph{TestGenEval-Lite}): Ockhamareto leads both mutation and coverage metrics on every one, always with the smallest suite. Ockhamareto also outperforms the state-of-the-art at all model scales, adding $+30$--$35$~pp mutation at 4B, 9B, and 27B model sizes. We also show that the knee point of the optimal trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness on the Pareto front is not correlated with obvious more easily computed proxy metrics, such as function size. This finding motivates the Pareto front computation; it is needed to identify this crucial engineering trade-off for each function under test.

AI.tldr: 提出Ockhamareto，一种基于GRPO的单次生成单元测试生成与选择框架，通过Pareto门控的简洁性奖励和Token级段信用分配两个核心机制，在保证测试有效性的同时显著减少测试套件规模。
AI.motivation: 现有RL测试生成方法（如MIST-RL）采用多轮生成，虽能实现逐测试信用分配，但需多次顺序LLM调用，且只能优化每个新增测试的边际价值，而非整体套件的"有效性-规模"权衡。这导致生成的测试套件存在大量冗余测试。Ockhamareto旨在通过单次生成同时实现：①整体套件简洁性的显式建模；②测试套件内部的细粒度信用分配。
AI.method: ① Pareto门控简洁性奖励（套件级）：在每个GRPO组中，仅对(mutation, -#tests)空间中非被支配的rollout给予简洁性奖励b_i = W_P + W_N·rank_i，无需预设标量化权重；② Token级段信用（测试级）：将每个测试的边际变异击杀数映射到该测试的token区间（通过分词器的offset mapping），作为per-token优势偏移叠加在标量GRPO优势上，保持零均值以不影响轨迹级GRPO；③ 单次生成采样K=8个完整pytest套件，在沙箱中执行并按per-test首次击杀数计算奖励；④ 使用LoRA微调Qwen3.5系列模型（4B/9B/27B）。
AI.result: 在UnLeakedTestBench（ULT）上：49.9% mutation score vs MIST-RL的31.3%，测试数仅2.60 vs 4.67，每测试效率提升3.4倍；在HumanEval+、MBPP+、CodeContests、TestGenEval-Lite四个分布外基准上均领先所有指标且套件最小；在4B/9B/27B三个规模上均带来+30~35pp mutation提升，Ockhamareto-4B（49.9%）超过base 27B（30.5%）；消融实验显示两个组件互补且均必要；Pareto前沿分析显示knee点中位数为3个测试（范围1~14），且与代码行数、圈复杂度等静态指标无显著相关。
AI.conclusion: Ockhamareto证明了通过原则性的奖励设计，单次GRPO框架能够同时提升单元测试生成的故障检测能力和简洁性，并能在所有模型规模上一致生效。该框架将简洁性从后处理选择问题转为学习目标本身；其段信用机制可视为过程奖励模型在测试生成领域的精确、可执行类比。经验性Pareto前沿的构建对于揭示每个被测函数的具体"有效性-规模"权衡是不可或缺的。

title: Quantifying the Relationship Between Team Dysfunctions and Performance in Capstone Projects
summary: This paper investigates the association between team dysfunctions and performance in the context of an engineering Capstone program. Capstone programs are considered fundamental in assessing the readiness of engineering and computer science students for professional practice, evaluating not only technical knowledge but also essential competencies such as teamwork, communication, design, and organization. Despite the recognized importance of team dynamics in such settings, their relationship with project performance remains insufficiently understood. Using survey data collected from student teams, we quantify team dynamics based on Lencioni's model of the five dysfunctions of a team, with all measures reverse-coded so that higher values indicate more positive team behaviors (i.e., lower dysfunction). The results indicate a weak-to-moderate relationship between team dynamics and performance. Each dysfunction score was computed as the sum of three corresponding survey items. All items were coded such that higher values indicate more positive team behaviors (i.e., lower dysfunction). Therefore, each score ranges from 3 to 9, where higher values reflect healthier team dynamics. This study analyzes empirical evidence on team effectiveness in project-based learning environments and offers insights for the design of Capstone programs. In particular, it highlights the importance of goal alignment and focus on deliverables while emphasizing that team dynamics should be considered alongside technical and contextual factors.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Lencioni的五种团队功能障碍模型，对某工程Capstone项目中40个学生团队进行问卷调查，将团队动力学分值与项目成绩（六个能力维度）进行相关性分析。结果显示团队动力学与项目绩效之间存在弱至中度的正相关，其中"对结果的忽视"（结果导向）维度与平均成绩的相关性最强且唯一显著（r=0.323, p=0.042），而模型中作为基础的"信任缺失"维度与绩效无显著关联。研究为Lencioni模型在项目式学习环境中的适用性提供了部分实证支持，并强调目标一致性与成果导向的重要性。
AI.motivation: Capstone项目作为工程与计算机科学教育的重要环节，团队效能被视为项目成功的关键因素。然而，Lencioni的五种团队功能障碍模型虽被广泛应用，其在学术项目式学习环境中的预测效力缺乏充分的实证验证，特别是各功能障碍维度与可量化的项目绩效之间的关系尚不清晰。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查法，在学期中期收集40个学生团队（每队3-4人）的数据。问卷包含15个问题（采用三级Likert量表），对应Lencioni五种功能障碍各3题，每项功能障碍得分范围为3-9（分数越高代表越健康的团队动力）。个体得分在团队层面聚合。同时收集六个能力维度（技术执行、组织、沟通、团队合作、设计、创业精神）的最终成绩作为绩效指标。使用Pearson和Spearman相关系数分析功能障碍得分与绩效之间的关系，并构建团队健康指数（五个维度的均值）与综合平均成绩进行比较。
AI.result: 1. 描述性统计：团队动力学得分普遍偏高，"恐惧冲突"得分最高（M=8.36），"对结果的忽视"得分最低（M=6.72）；平均成绩为8.02（SD=1.31）。2. 总体相关性："对结果的忽视"与平均成绩呈中等正相关且唯一显著（r=0.323, p=0.042），团队健康指数相关性次之（r=0.276, p=0.084）；其余维度均无显著相关性。3. 各能力维度层面：团队动力学各维度与"团队合作"成绩相关性最强（如"回避问责"r=0.423），与"技术执行"、"设计"和"创业精神"相关性较弱，表明问卷主要捕捉人际关系和协作层面而非纯技术绩效。4. 综合来看，团队动力学与绩效之间存在弱至中度的正相关，Lencioni模型的预测效力有限且维度间贡献不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，Lencioni的五种团队功能障碍模型在Capstone项目环境中仅获得部分支持。"对结果的忽视"（即成果导向）是与绩效关联最强的维度，提示目标对齐和成果聚焦对项目成功更为关键，而作为模型基础的"信任缺失"未显示出显著效应。教育层面建议：教师应强调目标对齐、明确期望和共同交付责任，同时团队动力学应与技术及情境因素综合考量。局限性包括：自报告偏差、得分集中在高分区间限制了变异性、单机构样本限制普适性、相关分析无法推断因果关系。未来研究将扩展至多队列纵向数据并评估有针对性的教学干预效果。

title: Aging of Prompt Engineering Techniques Across LLM Versions
summary: Prompt engineering and prompt engineering techniques (PETs) have become an integral part of software engineering for AI systems. However, new LLMs are released frequently and it remains unclear how the effectiveness of prompt engineering techniques changes across successive generations of Large Language Models (LLMs). To this end, we conduct a partial replication of the study by Khojah et al. (2025). We evaluate five techniques - Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Contrastive Chain-of-Thought (CCoT), and an adapted version of Program-of-Thought (PoT) - on six instruction-tuned models grouped into three version pairs: GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o, Qwen2 7B Instruct/Qwen2.5 7B Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct/Mistral-Large. We use a cleaned subset of the CodePromptEval dataset with 218 context-rich Python functions and 19,620 total generations assessed via pass@k-based functional correctness to evaluate model pairs on function-level code generation tasks. We show that prompt engineering "ages" in a model-family-specific way: Newer GPT models exhibit diminishing or even negative marginal gains from structured prompting, suggesting that instruction-following and reasoning scaffolds are increasingly internalized, whereas Qwen models continue to benefit substantially from Few-Shot and CCoT. Mistral models show mixed behavior with persistent gains from CCoT but attenuated benefits from CoT and PoT. Our results imply that effective prompting strategies must be adapted per model family and generation rather than transferred unchanged. This motivates future work on adaptive, model-aware prompting and broader, multi-dimensional code quality evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文对Khojah等人(2025)的研究进行部分复制，评估了五种提示工程技术（Zero-Shot、Few-Shot、CoT、CCoT、PoT）在三个LLM模型家族（GPT、Qwen、Mistral）共六个指令调优模型上的表现，研究提示工程技术效果如何随LLM版本迭代而变化。结果表明提示工程的效果呈"模型家族特异性老化"：GPT新模型对结构化提示的增益递减甚至为负，Qwen持续受益，Mistral表现混合。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM快速迭代，新版本发布频繁，但提示工程技术（PETs）的有效性如何随模型版本变化尚不清楚。现有研究多聚焦于单一模型或单一提示策略，缺乏跨代际、跨模型的系统性比较。作者旨在填补这一空白，理解模型设计改进是否会降低提示敏感性。
AI.method: 采用部分复制方法：(1)数据集：清洗后的CodePromptEval子集（218个Python函数任务）；(2)五种PETs：Zero-Shot、Few-Shot、CoT、CCoT、改编版PoT；(3)六个指令调优模型组成三对版本：GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o、Qwen2 7B/Qwen2.5 7B Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct/Mistral-Large；(4)每提示生成3次输出，共19,620次生成；(5)使用pass@k（k=1,2,3）功能正确性评估；(6)温度设为0.2，token上限1024。
AI.result: (1)复制与原研究对比：本研究的pass@1率平均低6.5个百分点（最大差异Few-Shot达8.0个百分点）；(2)基线性能：GPT-4o最高43.38%，Qwen2最低35.59%，差距约7.79个百分点；(3)Few-Shot：Qwen2.5 (+7.9%)和Mistral-Large (+0.8%)改进，GPT-4o (-7.4%)下降；(4)CoT：Mistral-Large (-13.8%)和GPT-4o (-0.8%)退化，Qwen2.5 (+1.9%)微增；(5)CCoT：三对模型均正增长（Qwen +11.5%, Mistral +5.6%, GPT +1.1%），表现最稳定；(6)PoT：效果因架构而异，Mistral-Large (-12.1%)大幅退化；(7)pass@k饱和效应：GPT-4o从pass@1到pass@3仅+1.13%，而Qwen2.5达+5.95%。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程"老化"具有模型家族特异性，不存在跨代统一的"最优"提示策略。GPT新模型因指令遵循与推理能力被内部化，结构化提示增益递减；Qwen仍需显式提示支持；Mistral处于中间状态（CoT/PoT衰退，Few-Shot/CCoT仍有价值）。实践启示：采用新模型时需重新评估提示策略，而非沿用既有方案；未来研究方向包括自适应模型感知提示策略、多维度代码质量评估以及理解指令调优与架构选择如何与提示工程长期效果交互。

title: Causal Explanations of Process Monitor Predictions
