AI.method: 1) 设计统一的特权状态接口：基于刚体几何 + 位姿 + 末端执行器状态的 token 化方案，使单个物理编码器可跨异构任务运行；2) XP-JEPA 目标函数：对视觉与物理两个模态的历史表示使用共享的动作条件预测器 g_ψ 推进，并将每个预测同时匹配到两个模态的未来表示（共 4 项损失，含 2 项模态内自预测 + 2 项跨模态预测）；3) 部署时丢弃物理分支，仅保留视觉编码器与预测器；4) 通过平行四边形恒等式可将该目标分解为表示对应项与预测演化项之和。
AI.result: 在包含 22 个配置的多任务 Meta-World 套件上：相对 rollout drift 由 0.361 降至 0.104；六类交互任务的平均控制成功率从 53.6% 提升至 78.2%。在 Push-T、OGBench-Block、Two-Room、Reacher 四个单任务环境中，forecastability 在全部四个环境中一致提升。消融实验显示：直接状态回归（Regress）虽将位置 R² 由 0.978 提至 0.991，但控制成功率仅 53.7%，说明单点内容可解码性 ≠ 可预测性；配对扰动（Shuffle）下控制骤降至 16.6%，表明正确的视觉-物理对应关系是控制成功的关键。
AI.conclusion: 跨预测物理接地通过将视觉潜在转移约束于对应的物理轨迹，可获得更可预测的潜在动态，从而提升 rollout 式规划的控制性能。该增益无需测试时特权输入。论文进一步揭示：表示的 forecastability 与 decodability 是相互独立的属性，前者依赖于跨模态预测耦合而非单纯对齐；forecastability 是控制的有用但不充分条件。局限：仅在仿真中验证，依赖训练时配对的特权轨迹，使用固定刚体状态模式。

title: Physics-Integrated Operator Learning via Gaussian Splatting Representations
summary: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for spatiotemporal PDE systems, but purely data-driven formulations often accumulate substantial errors during long-horizon autoregressive prediction and may fail to exploit available governing-equation structure. Existing approaches incorporate physics primarily through residual-based training objectives or PDE-specific architectural constraints, which can introduce optimization difficulties or limit architectural generality. In this work, we introduce a representation-level approach to physics integration in which a feed-forward Gaussian splatting (FFGS) representation serves as a continuous interface between discretized solution fields and governing operators. The FFGS representation reconstructs the state as a continuous Gaussian field with closed-form spatial derivatives, allowing available physical PDE operators to be integrated directly within the learned evolution map without introducing a physics-residual loss. We evaluate the framework across two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, including advection, diffusion, nonlinear self-advection, and reaction dynamics. Over long-horizon autoregressive rollouts, the proposed framework reduces relative $\ell_2$ error by $1.5\times$--$2.2\times$ compared with the strongest purely data-driven baseline across the benchmark suite, while consistently improving spectral fidelity. The framework also remains effective when the governing equations are partially known, demonstrating robustness to incomplete physics. These results demonstrate that continuous field representations can provide a practical interface for incorporating known physical structure into generic neural-operator surrogates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于前馈高斯溅射（FFGS）表示的物理集成神经算子框架，通过将离散解场重建为具有闭式空间导数的连续高斯场，在表示层面而非损失函数层面整合PDE物理信息，避免了物理残差损失带来的优化困难。在五个2D/3D基准问题（平流、扩散、Burgers、Allen-Cahn等）上，相对ℓ₂误差比最强纯数据驱动基线降低1.5×–2.2×，谱保真度也持续提升，并可扩展到部分已知物理（系数从数据中辨识）的场景。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的神经算子在长时程自回归预测中误差累积严重；现有物理集成方法（物理残差损失或特定PDE架构约束）存在优化困难或架构通用性受限的问题。需要一种在表示层面整合物理、通用于不同PDE且不依赖残差损失的方案。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：(1) Stage 1训练FFGS编码器（卷积U-Net）将离散场映射为各向异性高斯基元集合，通过局部渲染重建连续场，其一阶/二阶空间导数具有解析闭式解；(2) Stage 2冻结FFGS，构建复合更新算子 G ≈ N_θ(u) + Φ^FFGS_Δt(u)，其中Φ^FFGS基于FFGS闭式导数评估已知PDE项并经RK4积分得到嵌入物理项，N_θ为通用神经算子（ClassicFNO/FNO+FiLM）。对FFGS导数施加低通谱滤波以抑制高频重建误差；自回归rollout训练时对Φ^FFGS使用stop-gradient。扩展到部分已知物理时，通过FFGS导数构建线性回归从轨迹数据辨识未知系数。
AI.result: 在5个基准（2D Adv、2D Adv-Diff、2D Burgers、2D Adv-Allen-Cahn、3D Adv-Diff）上200步自回归rollout中，相对ℓ₂误差相比最强基线降低1.5×（3D Adv-Diff）至2.2×（Burgers），PSNR提升3.3–6.6 dB，谱误差最低；系数辨识在Adv-Diff上速度误差0.34%、扩散误差2.84%；FFGS导数残差验证场重构精度10⁻³量级，梯度2.5×10⁻³–1.2×10⁻²，拉普拉斯6×10⁻³–5×10⁻²；消融证实嵌入物理项与神经算子项互补，且低通滤波对稳定性关键；推理开销与ResNet相当，快于3D ResNet。
AI.conclusion: 连续场表示（FFGS）可作为通用神经算子与已知/部分已知PDE结构之间的实用接口，通过闭式空间导数实现表示层面的物理集成，无需物理残差损失或PDE特定架构；嵌入物理项与神经算子项互补是性能提升的关键；当前局限在于高斯基元容量固定、对特定方程族特化、谱截止需手动选择，未来方向包括自适应表示、跨方程条件化及数据驱动的谱范围选择。

title: ALPHABET: A Laplace-Pole History Aggregator with Banked Exponential Transport
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables; includes technical appendix
summary: Can a sequence model remain competitive with only a few thousand parameters and an explicitly auditable prediction interface? We introduce ALPHABET, a compact linear-time model that compresses temporal history into stable complex pole modes: a direct bank synthesizes its modal states back into the feature trajectory, an independent cascaded bank analyzes the transformed trajectory without resynthesis, and an affine head reads only modal energies and lag moments from both banks. We characterize the temporal information this descriptor retains: for a stationary, fully observed feature process, each mode energy is a frequency-localized measurement of the second-order spectrum, the continuum of such measurements identifies the spectrum, and almost every mode separates any fixed finite set of spectrally distinct classes. On a Gaussian control with matched low-lag statistics, the learned descriptor approaches the Bayes oracle where raw autocovariances remain at chance. Across the fixed 82-task registry, ALPHABET attains mean rank 3.97 in the complete ten-family comparison. At the common-width D=64 runtime anchor, its 6,437 parameters deliver 5.02 times faster inference and 3.93 times faster complete training steps than the nine baselines on average.

AI.tldr: ALPHABET是一个仅约6,437参数的紧凑线性时间序列模型，通过两组稳定拉普拉斯极点（complex pole modes）的bank将时间历史压缩为模态能量与时滞矩（lag moments），并由仿射头读取。该模型在82个任务上以极小参数量实现与9类基线可比的精度，并在D=64条件下获得约5×的推理加速和约3.9×的完整训练步加速，同时提供可审计的逐极点（per-pole）决策分解。
AI.motivation: 现代序列模型（LSTM、Transformer、SSM/Mamba等）虽然强大，但体量大、速度慢且不透明——研究者无法明确说出其保留的状态编码了何种时间信息。本文质疑是否能在仅几千参数、预测接口明确可审计的条件下保持竞争力，并借鉴经典模型约简的思想：为预测构造一个紧凑、可审计的"预测接口"，而非还原每个输入token。
AI.method: 架构：① 边缘提升（DWConv+SiLU）将原始输入映射为实值特征轨迹；② 直接bank（Direct bank）：将特征投影到M个复数模态，通过稳定Laplace极点λm=−αm+iωm进行零阶保持（ZOH）的区间感知模态动力学演化，并将模态状态合成回特征空间（H⁽¹⁾）；③ 级联bank（Cascaded bank）：对H⁽¹⁾再做一次独立的模态动力学（不再合成）；④ 模态矩读取（Modal moment readout）：每个bank返回每个模态的7维描述符——log(1+能量)与τ∈{1,2,4}处的复数时滞矩经radial-log映射（rlog），共14M维特征；⑤ 仿射头线性映射到K维logits。训练采用矩阵指数Stiefel参数化保证半正交性，使用Triton核+CUDA Graph实现并行前缀扫描。理论分析证明：模态能量是矩阵值谱的Poisson核局部化测量；连续族刻画二阶谱；几乎所有admissible模式能分离有限个谱不同的类别；在平稳遍历条件下仿射决策随序列长度一致收敛；同时给出与序列长度、输入幅度、掩码模式无关的预测接口范数界。
AI.result: 在82任务固定注册集上对10个模型族完整对比：ALPHABET平均排名3.97（14次Top-1，43次Top-3）。在D=64同宽锚点（B=32，T=512），6,437参数下实现推理平均5.02×、完整训练步3.93×加速（vs. 九基线平均）。在矩匹配谱控制实验（白噪声vs.稀疏MA(5)，低阶lag 0–4统计量完全相同，仅在lag 5处有差异ε）：原始自协方差基线处于随机水平，而ALPHABET描述符随ε从.567上升至.991；ε=0.4时5.7k参数描述符达.856（vs. LRU .787、S4D .750），序列长度T从128增至1024时Bayes归一化超额精度从91.3%升至99.7%。结构消融（17 UCR任务）：双扫描比单扫描+3.33pp、比无合成+1.67pp、比仅能量MLP+5.48pp、比固定极点+1.67pp。极点归因审计：删除top-8极点比随机删除多损26.9pp精度；级联bank占63.5%归因贡献。腐蚀审计：对幅度×0.5/×1.5与半速率重采样领先最优基线9–10pp，但对加性白噪声（σ=0.1/0.2）反而落后1.6/4.3pp——与理论预测的"宽带噪声在模态统计中引入能量底"的失败模式一致。
AI.conclusion: ALPHABET证明竞争性的时间序列预测不需要大型或不透明的骨干：两组稳定Laplace极点bank将时间历史压缩为一组模态统计量，其谱含义由理论严格刻画，预测可被精确分解为逐极点贡献。在受控评估设置下，ALPHABET比所有评估基线显著更小、更快。审计表明这种透明度是功能性的而非名义上的，紧凑性、速度与可审计表征三者可同时实现。局限：①理论域固定于平稳、等步长、全观测特征过程；②加性噪声下表现下降（明确失败模式）；③所有消融对比Holm校正后均无p<.05，两扫描优势为任务依赖而非普遍必需；④优化不一定能找到理论保证的分离模式——通用性结果为存在性而非构造性。

title: PhysicsBench: A Unified Leaderboard for Generative and Predictive Models in Engineering Design and Simulation
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables. Leaderboard: this https URL | Data: this https URL
summary: Generative and predictive artificial intelligence models are increasingly used to generate geometry and to predict physical fields and scalar quantities in engineering design and simulation. Yet these models are typically evaluated in isolation, on academic datasets at unconstrained scales, with inconsistent metrics and procedures. We present PhysicsBench, a unified benchmark and leaderboard that evaluates generative and predictive models under one standardized procedure. PhysicsBench spans seven generation and prediction tasks across 1D, 2D, and 3D domains and ranks 66 models on nine datasets, comprising industrial-scale CAD/CFD/FEA simulations and public references, expanded into 28 configurations. One procedure and ranking apply to both families, each ranked within its own tasks. Evaluation spans realistic, limited data scales from S to XL rather than the unlimited training sets common in academic benchmarks. A common metric suite captures geometric fidelity with distributional distances, physical-field and scalar accuracy, and engineering-specific field- and shape-validity. BenchRank debiases correlated metrics and ranks by PageRank over a head-to-head dominance graph, so every reported quality metric is also ranked, with computational cost in a separate efficiency view. Across tasks, an architecture's large-scale academic standing weakly predicts its small-data ranking. The top model changes with data scale in six of the seven tasks, and no model leads more than one task. PhysicsBench turns "state-of-the-art" from a self-reported claim into an openly published foundation for model selection.

AI.tldr: PhysicsBench 是一个面向工程设计与仿真领域的统一基准测试与排行榜，使用标准化流程对生成式与预测式 AI 模型在工业级 CAD/CFD/FEA 数据上进行跨任务、跨数据规模的评估与排名。
AI.motivation: 现有工程设计领域的 AI 模型评估通常在孤立环境下进行，依赖学术数据集、不受限制的训练规模、不一致的指标和流程，导致难以公平比较。工业实践中高保真仿真样本极其有限，但学术基准普遍假设大数据条件，与工程师实际面临的场景脱节。缺乏统一的跨家族排行榜，使得"最先进"更多是自我宣称而非可验证的结果。
AI.method: 提出 PhysicsBench，包含七大任务（1D 标量预测、2D 图像生成/标量预测/场预测、3D 几何生成/标量预测/场预测），涵盖九个数据集的 28 种配置；在受控的 S/M/L/XL 四级数据规模下评估 66 个模型。采用统一的训练-推理-度量-排名流程。核心创新是 BenchRank 排名算法：通过 Spearman 相关性去偏指标权重，基于加权头对头优势图构建 PageRank 中心性得分，并加入可行性门控与裁剪几何均值聚合。引入工程有效性度量（场预测的 MAC、符号一致性、极值一致性；几何生成的流形-Δ 和均匀性-Δ）。提供质量视图与效率视图两种排名方式。
AI.result: 核心发现：不存在通用最优模型，七个任务中无模型在多个任务上领先；六个任务中最佳模型随数据规模变化；架构的大规模学术排名与其小数据表现弱相关。展示了多种数据规模交叉现象，如 2D 生成中 VAE 在最小规模领先而 DDPM 在更大规模接管，3D 生成中 DeepSDF 在小数据下数据高效但在 DrivAerNet 非水密网格上崩溃。小模型（如 Point Transformer-Small）在小数据下常优于全容量版本。在 3D 场预测中 GeoFLARE 在 DrivAerML 上各规模领先。BenchRank 排名对超参数扰动具有高度鲁棒性（平均 Kendall τ=0.98，95% 情况下 Rank-1 稳定）。
AI.conclusion: PhysicsBench 将"最先进"从自我宣称转变为基于统一标准化流程和公开可复现结果的开放排名，为工程 AI 模型选择提供基于任务与数据规模的决策支持，而非寻找单一万能冠军。承认存在统计覆盖不均、部分数据集许可证限制（CC BY-NC）、3D 场预测中部分模型仅在 DrivAerML 上评估等局限。未来工作包括扩展数据集覆盖、多通道场预测、几何可制造性指标，以及向智能体式推荐方向发展。

title: The Sharp Tail of Uniform Stability
summary: Uniform stability controls how much one training example can change the loss at any test point. A new logarithmic-free upper bound shows that a $\gamma$-uniformly stable algorithm with loss in $[0,L]$ has generalization gap at most $O \left(\gamma\log(1/\delta) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\delta)}{n}}\right)$ with probability $1-\delta$. Whether an actual bounded-loss learning algorithm can realize the linear dependence on $\log(1/\delta)$ has remained open. The known construction realizes it only for auxiliary weakly dependent random variables whose pointwise range grows with $n$. The known learning lower bound holds only at constant probability. We close this gap. For every $n$, stability level $\gamma$, and loss bound $L$, we construct one deterministic $\gamma$-uniformly stable learning problem whose tail satisfies, simultaneously for $1\le p\le c n$, $\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,\gamma p+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}.$ The construction is ordinary bounded absolute-loss regression with constant labels. Its key is a multiscale collection of rare Rademacher features. A coordinatewise ramp is stable in sup norm, while an odd symmetrized maximum converts a unique extreme feature into a gap of order $\gamma p$ without violating the loss bound. Geometrically spaced ramps put all confidence levels into the same problem. Together with the logarithmic-free upper bound, this determines the optimal high-probability and moment dependence of uniform stability up to universal constants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了均匀稳定性（uniform stability）算法的泛化能力的高概率尾部行为。作者建立了首个具有有界损失的均匀稳定学习算法，其泛化间隙以Ω(γ log(1/δ))的速度增长，从而填补了此前上界与下界之间的关键空白，确定了均匀稳定性的最优高概率与矩依赖关系（精确到常数因子）。
AI.motivation: 均匀稳定性是算法稳定性的核心概念，其期望型泛化界简单且最优（O(γ)），但高概率版本的精确形式长期未确定。近期Nguyen-Cung与Nguyen（2026）的结果给出了无对数冗余的上界 O(γ log(1/δ) + L√(log(1/δ)/n))。然而，此前的下界要么要求函数点值范围随n增长（Bousquet et al., 2020），要么仅在常数概率下成立（Liu and Lu, 2020）。是否存在一个具有统一损失界L的有界损失学习算法，能实现线性log(1/δ)依赖，一直是公开问题。本文旨在彻底解决这一最小化-最大化下界缺口。
AI.method:
作者构造了一个确定性的γ-均匀稳定的有界绝对损失回归算法（标签恒为零），其核心是"多尺度罕见Rademacher特征集合"机制。具体包括：
1. **多尺度斜坡（ramp）振幅**：对每组k定义振幅 a_{kj}(S) = min{γr_k, (γ/2)(S_{kj}-t_k)_+}，其中 r_k 几何级数间隔，从而保证各尺度上的稳定性（ℓ∞变化≤γ）。
2. **奇对称最大值（odd symmetrized maximum）**：H_a(x) = max_j a_j x_j - max_j(-a_j x_j)，将单个极端特征转化为Θ(γp)的经验偏差，同时保持损失范围在[0,L]内。
3. **几何间隔的尺度族**：将所有置信度水平 e^{-p}（p ≤ cn）编码进同一个有限维问题中，而非为每个p构造不同问题。
4. **记忆组件**（b_{J(S)}Σ）处理常数置信度与饱和情形；U项提供标准的√(p/n)采样尾部。
5. 通过Paley-Zygmund不等式的分块论证获得Rademacher和的单侧反集中界。
关键技术贡献在于：单一特征的点值范围由斜坡封顶控制（稳定），但通过指数级（1/q_⋆ ≍ e^{Θ(n)}）的冗余坐标复制，使至少一个坐标的罕见大偏差事件概率达到 e^{-p_k/2}，并通过ℓ_2-利普希茨的奇对称最大值在样本上产生持续的经验偏差。
AI.result:
作者证明了主要定理（Theorem 1）：对每个 n、L>0 和 0≤γ≤L，存在有限输入空间上的分布 P 和确定性的γ-均匀稳定绝对损失回归算法，对所有 1≤p≤c_0 n 满足：
ℙ(G_S ≥ c_1 min{L, γp + L√(p/n)}) ≥ e^{-p}。
推论（Corollary 2）给出矩尖锐性：‖G_S‖_p ≥ c_2 min{L, γp + L√(p/n)}。
结合 Nguyen-Cung 与 Nguyen（2026）的上界 ‖R(A_S) - R_S(A_S)‖_p ≤ 33pγ + L√(2p/n) 和截断界 L，最终得到关于均匀稳定性的最小-最大律：
sup_{P,A,ℓ} ‖G_S‖_p ≍ min{L, γp + L√(p/n)}，对所有 2≤p≤c_0 n 成立，
上界和下界常数均为通用常数。这一结果将公开问题完整封闭。
AI.conclusion: 本文在均匀稳定性的高概率泛化理论上取得了决定性进展。它给出了首个有界损失均匀稳定学习算法，能以Ω(γ log(1/δ))的速度实现泛化间隙，并通过单一构造同时实现所有 p ≤ cn 范围内的完整尾部曲线。最优性体现在与近期对数自由上界的精确匹配——二者在所有置信度上相互吻合（精度至通用常数）。结论的实际意义在于：仅凭均匀稳定性条件本身无法获得优于 γ log(1/δ) 的高概率界；要获得更尖锐的保证，必须利用额外结构信息（如曲率、数据依赖的稳定性、算法随机性或表征约束）。该研究也阐明了指数级特征维度是这一机制的内在代价：在大偏差事件的指数衰减概率下，多项式级冗余不足以达到所需的尾部行为。

title: A mesh-free multiresolution deep energy method with phase-field modeling of brittle fracture
summary: Phase-field modeling of brittle fracture removes the need to track cracks explicitly by recasting their evolution as the minimization of an energy functional. In return it requires a discretization dense enough to resolve a localization band whose width is set by a regularization length and whose path is not known in advance. We propose a mesh-free discretization in which a single neural network represents the displacement and phase fields and is trained by minimizing the incremental energy directly. The coordinates enter the network through a multiresolution feature encoding built from $C^1$ quadratic B-spline grids, so the finest scale the representation can express is set by choice rather than reached through slow training, and the energy is estimated by stratified Monte Carlo integration on points redrawn at every optimizer iteration. This pairing proves critical, since the crack fails to advance both when the integration points are held fixed and when the encoding is too coarse to represent the band, while each ingredient tolerates a wide range of settings once the other is in place. Because the representation is globally $C^1$, the second- and the fourth-order fracture energy densities run on the identical discretization. Across six problems, from single-edge-notched tension and shear to a thick-walled ring on a single spline patch, the computed load-displacement curves follow staggered finite element references at matched regularization length, with peak loads within about 1% on the single-edge-notched tests and within 8% where the crack pattern changes topology. On a public benchmark dataset of random multi-crack configurations the method classifies the active or dormant state of 90% of the seeded cracks in twenty zero-shot runs, where the deep Ritz baseline of the dataset authors fails.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无网格多分辨率深度能量法,通过单个神经网络表示位移和相场,坐标通过C¹二次B样条特征编码进入网络,能量通过每步重采样的分层蒙特卡洛积分估计。该方法在六类问题(SEN拉伸/剪切、分支、en-echelon聚结、孔板形核、厚壁环、随机多裂纹基准)上与有限元参考解吻合,峰值载荷误差约1%(SEN)至8%(拓扑变化),在公开基准数据集上零样本正确分类90%的预置裂纹活性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于网络的相场断裂求解器存在两个核心问题:(1)神经网络偏向平滑函数,无法表示宽度O(l)的损伤带;(2)固定积分点集会被优化器利用来在点之间降低能量,出现"零能模式"。已有方法通过引入有限元形状函数或自适应细化来补救,但又将网格重新引入本应无网格的离散化中。作者旨在同时解决这两个问题,保持无网格性质。
AI.method: 采用单一神经网络表示位移(u,v)和相场(ϕ),坐标通过多层C¹二次B样条特征网格编码输入。最细层间距h=0.26l,设定可表示的最小尺度(分辨率上限)。能量通过分层蒙特卡洛积分估计,三层采样:均匀Sobol序列+裂缝层(基于ϕ_n-1)+过程区层(基于损伤指示因子),每步迭代重采样(n_r=1)。本质边界条件通过提升函数精确施加,弯曲几何通过NURBS精确映射+域掩码处理。不可逆性通过单边二次罚项实现,不含历史场。采用Ambati混合式应变能公式(各向同性退化+谱分解驱动)。支持二阶和四阶断裂能密度,后者仅需多一次自动微分求Laplacian。
AI.result: 六类问题的量化结果:(1)SEN拉伸:97.6N vs 参考98.7N(误差1.1%);(2)SEN剪切:66.42N vs 66.35N(误差0.1%),并重现软化谷和第二峰;(3)分支:Y形对称分叉,峰值59.3N vs 参考(误差8%);(4)聚结:三裂纹阶梯状连接,峰值195.4N(误差5.8%);(5)孔板:Kirsch解析解吻合,RMS误差3%峰值;(6)厚壁环:与Si等结果一致,峰值3.91kN。在公开Hamdi-Lejeune基准上10个随机构型(11-17裂纹)双载荷共20次零样本运行,正确分类252/280(90%)的预置裂纹活性,Dice分数0.739(拉)/0.824(剪),优于数据集作者训练的UNet(0.680)和FNO(0.733),且其深度Ritz基线在该数据集上失败。鲁棒性测试:剪切SEN四随机种子峰值66.3±0.3N(散布0.5%);基准构型四种子峰散布≤2%。消融研究证实:固定积分点或过粗编码均使裂纹无法扩展,两者缺一不可。计算成本:每载荷增量约为有限元的10倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过多分辨率C¹编码与每迭代重采样积分的耦合,在保持无网格特性的同时解决了网络相场断裂求解的两个核心缺陷,使二阶和四阶模型可在同一离散化上运行。二阶和四阶SEN峰值误差约1%,拓扑变化情形误差约8%。在标准基准上击败了现有的网络和代理模型基线。局限:成本仍高于成熟有限元(约一个数量级);参数大部分(87-98%)分配给全局特征网格而非活跃损伤区;仅限二维准静态;混合公式在变分上不一致;正则化长度固定未考察尖锐裂纹极限。核心优势(光滑全场表示+无固定点集的积分)可自然扩展至多场耦合问题。

title: Steering Recurrent Reasoners at Inference Time with Readout Feedback
summary: Recurrent models, which repeatedly update latent states with shared computation blocks, have emerged as powerful architectures for solving complex reasoning tasks. Existing inference-time methods scale computation by running more steps or sampling more trajectories, but ignore information revealed within each trajectory. Here we show that recurrent models can be improved at inference time by using their own readout probabilities to steer latent dynamics without retraining. We introduce Readout Feedback (RoFB), a test-time intervention that converts intermediate predictions into token-wise pairwise coupling forces injected into the latent dynamics. Across three recurrent models (AKOrN, ItrSA++, TRM) on Sudoku and Maze, RoFB yields clear gains in four of six model-task pairs, achieving performance unattainable by merely running more steps or selecting from multiple trajectories, at comparable or lower computational cost. These results suggest that closed-loop steering of latent dynamics can serve as a complementary inference-time control mechanism for recurrent reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出Readout Feedback (RoFB)，一种在推理时将模型的中间读出概率转化为潜在动力学的token对耦合力的测试时干预方法，无需重训练。在三种循环推理模型（AKOrN、ItrSA++、TRM）和数独、迷宫任务上的6对组合中，4对实现了显著性能提升，且计算成本相当或更低。
AI.motivation: 现有的循环推理模型推理时计算方法（增加步数、多轨迹采样投票）以被动方式利用迭代结构，忽略了单条轨迹内中间预测所揭示的信息。需要一种能主动引导单条潜在轨迹的机制，在冻结模型权重的前提下释放未充分利用的推理时能力。
AI.method: 核心观察：成功的推理轨迹在接近正确解时，token在潜在空间中按类别形成聚类结构（同类对齐、异类分离）。RoFB据此设计：(1) 在每个选定推理步骤，将模型的读出概率向量之间的距离通过非增函数h转化为标量耦合项J̃；(2) 该耦合项作为外力注入潜在动力学，投影到流形切空间以保持约束；(3) 通过门控函数g（warmup + 基于最大熵的置信检查）在"漫游阶段"开启反馈，漫游阶段后关闭；(4) 所有模型权重保持不变，仅在测试时干预。实验中采用纯排斥耦合h(d)=-d，仅应用于待填空位token。
AI.result: 在6对模型-任务组合中，4对（AKOrN×Sudoku +6.4%、AKOrN×Maze +3.1%、ItrSA++×Maze +4.2%、TRM×Sudoku +5.8%）获得显著提升；2对（ItrSA++×Sudoku、TRM×Maze）几乎无变化。提升幅度在相同或更低计算成本下达成了基线仅靠增加步数或投票无法达到的性能。例如ItrSA++×Maze上，单轨迹RoFB以约100倍更低推理计算超越基线64轨迹。符号翻转实验证实耦合方向对有效对是关键的（翻转后性能下降9–40%）。额外每步开销仅+0.8%–+9.8%。
AI.conclusion: RoFB证明冻结循环推理模型中存在未充分利用的推理时能力，可通过读出信号的闭环控制释放。该方法作为推理时计算的新维度，与延长轨迹和多轨迹投票互补。当前证据限于小规模循环推理模型与两类谜题基准，向LLM的直接迁移仍属未来工作。缺乏事先预测RoFB有效性的诊断方法也是重要未来方向。

title: Robust Data-Collection Policy Learning for Low-Variance Online Policy Evaluation
summary: In reinforcement learning policy evaluation, classic on-policy methods often suffer from high variance when estimating policy performance. To mitigate this issue, behavior policy search has been proposed to learn data-collecting policies tailored to reduce online evaluation variance. However, these approaches do not account for uncertainties in the transition functions. In practice, simulator transitions often differ from the real world due to modeling errors or approximation limitations. As a result, behavior policies trained in simulation may still yield high variance when deployed in real environments, leading to costly reliance on real-world evaluation samples. In this work, we propose a double-loop gradient-based algorithm for learning behavior policies that are both efficient and robust to transition uncertainty. Theoretically, we derive novel transition-variance gradient expressions and establish global convergence guarantees for the algorithm. Numerically, we demonstrate that our method is less sensitive to transition perturbations than existing approaches, providing supportive evidence for its practical utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双重循环梯度算法（DRVG），用于在强化学习策略评估中学习既高效又对转移函数不确定性具有鲁棒性的行为策略，理论上推导了新的转移-方差梯度表达式并证明了全局收敛性，实验表明该方法对转移扰动的鲁棒性优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 经典在线策略评估方法因高方差而可靠性不足；现有的行为策略搜索（BPS）方法在模拟器中训练时未考虑转移函数的不确定性，导致在真实环境中部署时仍可能产生高方差，需要大量昂贵的真实世界样本。
AI.method: 将鲁棒行为策略搜索形式化为极小极大优化问题：内层最大化在对抗性转移下寻找最坏情况评估方差，外层最小化该对抗方差。提出了双重循环鲁棒方差梯度算法（DRVG），包括用于内层转移优化的"On-Transition Variance Gradient"算法（Algorithm 1）和用于外层行为策略搜索的"Double-Loop Robust Variance Gradient"算法（Algorithm 2），其中外层采用投影梯度下降。还提供了带KL散度正则化的版本以平衡鲁棒性与现实性。
AI.result: 理论方面：推导了评估方差关于转移参数的解析梯度表达式（on-transition和off-transition两种情况），并建立了带KL正则化的版本；证明了内层算法的收敛性（Lemma 4.2）；在linear-softmax参数化下证明了方差目标函数的Lipschitz连续性、平滑性和凸性（Lemma 5.2）；证明了最坏情况函数Φ(θ)的Lipschitz性和凸性（Lemma 5.3）；证明了双重循环算法的全局收敛速率为O(1/√n)（Theorem 5.4），匹配凸优化中投影梯度下降的最优速率。实验方面：在Garnet MDP和库存管理两类环境中验证，相比on-policy Monte Carlo、BPG和ROS等基线方法，所提方法在转移扰动下表现出最小的方差增加，且在共享对抗转移下取得更低的评估方差。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功统一了方差缩减与转移鲁棒性，提出了首个具有全局收敛保证的针对对抗转移下方差最小化行为策略搜索的算法。理论上推导了新颖的转移-方差梯度表达式，建立了内层对抗优化和整体双重循环的收敛保证。实验上证明该方法对转移扰动具有更强的鲁棒性，为不确定性下的可靠策略评估提供了有前景的方向。

title: From Relaxed Indexability to Exact Indexability: A $t$-Step Approach for Partially Observable Restless Bandits
summary: Whittle index policies offer a scalable method for restless multi-armed bandits, but under partial observability even determining the indifference subsidy at a single belief requires solving an infinite-horizon belief-state problem with no closed-form value function. Liu [10] addresses this difficulty by linearizing the unknown decision boundary, leading to a linear system and a closed-form approximate Whittle index. However, the resulting threshold uses only a one-step active--passive comparison and does not account for longer-horizon continuation values. We extend this framework to a \emph{$t$-step lookahead threshold policy}. For each subsidy $m$, the threshold is defined by the active-minus-passive advantage under $t$-step finite-horizon value iteration. At $t=1$, the threshold is $m$-independent and recovers the linear threshold of Liu [10]; for $t>1$, it becomes subsidy-dependent through the induced first-crossing structure and tracks the exact decision boundary more closely. The proposed algorithm does not require indexability as an input and includes an indexability verification. Under the original Whittle indexability, we prove that the $t$-step approximate Whittle index converges geometrically to the exact Whittle index, \[ |\widehat W_t(\omega)-W(\omega)|=O(\beta^t). \] Numerically, all 2,715 tested three-state instances are verified as indexable according to the proposed criterion. The P95 index error decreases from $2.18\times10^{-2}$ at $t=1$ to $8.93\times10^{-4}$ at $t=8$. In an exact-comparable instance with $\beta=0.9999$, $t=2$ already recovers the exact Whittle-index ordering. Moderate-depth threshold policies also outperform the one-step baseline and remain close to the optimal dynamic-programming benchmark, while runtime grows mildly with $t$.

AI.tldr: 本文针对部分可观测静默多臂老虎机（RMAB）问题中Whittle索引难以计算的问题，提出了一种基于t步前瞻阈值策略的近似Whittle索引算法。该方法将Liu [10]的一步主动-被动比较扩展到有限视界值迭代，并通过一阶交叉结构捕捉更长期的连续价值，理论上证明了在Whittle可索引性条件下，t步近似索引以几何速率O(β^t)收敛于精确Whittle索引。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测的静默多臂老虎机（RMAB）问题中，即使在单一信念下确定Whittle索引所需的"无差异补贴"也需要求解无穷视界信念状态问题，且无闭式值函数。Liu [10]通过线性化决策边界获得了一步近似的闭式Whittle索引，但该阈值仅基于单步主动-被动对比，忽略了更长视界的连续价值，导致索引精度有限。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种"t步前瞻阈值策略"框架。对于每个补贴m，阈值定义为在t步有限视界值迭代下的主动优势减去被动优势。当t=1时，该阈值与m无关，恢复Liu [10]的线性阈值；当t>1时，阈值通过一阶交叉（first-crossing）结构变得依赖于补贴，从而更精确地追踪真实决策边界。算法不要求预先输入可索引性，并内嵌了可索引性验证步骤。
AI.result: 理论上证明：在Whittle原始可索引性条件下，t步近似Whittle索引以几何速率O(β^t)收敛到精确Whittle索引，即 |Ŵ_t(ω) - W(ω)| = O(β^t)。数值上，全部2,715个测试的三状态实例均依据所提出的可索引性判据被验证为可索引的。P95索引误差从t=1时的2.18×10⁻²下降到t=8时的8.93×10⁻⁴。在β=0.9999的精确可比实例中，t=2即可恢复精确的Whittle索引排序。中等深度的阈值策略也优于一一步基线，并接近最优动态规划基准，同时运行时间随t的增长较为温和。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的t步前瞻阈值策略为部分可观测RMAB提供了一种可扩展且具有收敛性保证的近似Whittle索引计算方法。该方法无需可索引性作为前提，能够自动验证可索引性，且索引误差随前瞻深度t以几何速率收敛，在实践中以适度的计算开销即可获得高精度索引排序。

title: PRQ-KMeans: Projection Residual Quantization for Semantic ID Tokenization
summary: Semantic identifiers (SIDs) represent entities as hierarchical token sequences for generative retrieval and recommendation. Residual-quantization tokenizers construct these sequences by selecting a codeword at each level and passing a residual to the next. We view this process as progressive commonality removal: each token captures a component shared within its group, while later tokens should model the remaining differences. This view reveals three limitations: a corpus-wide shared component can consume first-level capacity, hard assignment ignores graded similarities to nearby codewords, and full-codeword subtraction can leave variation along the selected-codeword direction in the next residual. We therefore develop our solution in the post-hoc setting, where residual construction is not constrained by input reconstruction. Specifically, we propose PRQ-KMeans, which removes the global-mean component, refines centroids with Top-k similarity-weighted updates, and replaces full-codeword subtraction with a projection residual that removes each representation's selected-centroid component. Experiments on a large-scale industrial search dataset and four public recommendation benchmarks show that PRQ-KMeans achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated tokenizers, including gains of up to 7.4% in HitRate and 11.8% in MRR on the industrial dataset.

AI.tldr: PRQ-KMeans 是一种后置（post-hoc）层次化语义标识符（SID）分词器，针对残差量化中存在的"残留分量遗留"问题，提出用投影残差替代完整质心减法，以实现从全局到局部的渐进式共性消除（progressive commonality removal）。
AI.motivation: 残差量化将层次 SID 构建视为逐步的共性消除过程，但传统 RQ-KMeans 存在三大局限：(1) 语料库全局共享分量消耗第一级码本容量；(2) 硬分配忽略了与邻近码字的渐进相似性；(3) 完整质心减法会在残差中遗留沿选中质心方向的"残留分量"（residual carryover），迫使下一级码本重复建模已被当前层级表示过的信息。
AI.method: PRQ-KMeans 在后置场景下提出三项关键设计：(1) 全局分量去除——在拟合第一级码本前，先减去每个表征在全局均值方向上的投影；(2) Top-k 软质心细化——基于余弦相似度的 softmax 权重，让每个表征对 k 个最近质心进行加权更新；(3) 投影残差——硬分配后减去表征在所选质心上的自身投影（而非完整质心向量），得到与所选质心正交、且欧氏变化最小的残差。
AI.result: 在工业级电商搜索数据集（OneSearch）上，PRQ-KMeans 三级码本将 Order HitRate/MRR 较 RQ-KMeans 提升 7.4%/11.8%，Click HitRate/MRR 提升 6.4%/8.9%，ICR 由 55.52% 升至 58.45%，L2/L3 前缀利用率分别由 47.88%/3.61% 升至 57.78%/3.99%。在 Sports、Toys、Clothing、LastFM 四个公开基准上均取得最佳或并列最佳。在五级混合设置中，PRQ-OPQ 较 RQ-OPQ 在 Order/Click 各指标提升 0.6%–1.9%。消融实验表明投影残差是贡献最大的组件。
AI.conclusion: PRQ-KMeans 通过显式控制跨层级残差传递的成分，实现了从全局到局部的渐进式共性消除，在工业搜索与多个公开推荐基准上均达到最优整体性能，验证了在层次 SID 构建中精确管理层级间信息传递的重要性。

title: A Data-dependent Early Stopping Rule using Rademacher Complexity with L1-norm
summary: Training neural networks requires balancing the trade-off between fitting the training data and achieving robust performance on unseen inputs. This ability, commonly referred to as generalizability, is determined by the gap between the empirical risk on the training set (``empirical loss'') and the expected risk over the data distribution (``generalization error''). Existing approaches typically estimate the generalization error numerically, requiring gradient descent training and an ``early stopping'' strategy. In this work, we introduce an analytic framework that estimates the optimal time of early stopping without the need for training. Several works in the literature also give such analytical estimations, but they are generally based on random matrix theory and often make assumptions on the distribution of the data or the eigenvalue distribution of the covariance matrix. In contrast, our work is based on Rademacher complexity (RC) without needing such probabilistic assumptions. For both theoretical and numerical reasons, it is more relevant to express RC with the L1- norm rather than with the L2-norm. We focus on the case of linear models and the problem of linear regression. Thanks to the ``linear probing'' method, our results can, however, be successfully applied to nonlinear neural networks, as illustrated in the classification MNIST example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于L1范数Rademacher复杂度（RC）的数据依赖型早停规则，无需实际执行梯度下降训练即可解析地估计最优早停时间，避免了对数据分布或协方差矩阵特征值的概率假设。
AI.motivation: 现有的早停方法通常需要数值化估计泛化误差并依赖梯度下降训练；已有的解析方法多基于随机矩阵理论，需对数据分布（如高斯分布）或协方差矩阵特征值分布（如Marchenko-Pastur分布）作概率假设。本文旨在构建一个不依赖此类假设的解析框架。
AI.method: 方法以线性回归模型和线性模型为对象，将早停时间t*定义为总体损失上界L_D*的首个局部最小点。基于Rademacher复杂度理论，利用L1范数（而非L2范数）以消除对分布相关常数M的依赖，推导出L_D*导数的解析形式，并构造符号不变区间T_1。通过数据依赖准则Φ(t)>0定义t^+作为t*的下界估计。t^+通过求解Φ(t)=0或近似公式t_approx+=(1/λ_1)ln(Γ(0)/Ω(0))计算，其中Γ/Ω类比于信噪比。在过参数化场景下，结合"线性探针"方法推广至非线性神经网络。
AI.result: 在多个数值实验中（高斯分布示例和MNIST分类3-5、0-1任务），所提方法得到的解析早停时间t^+与数值化早停时间t_test高度吻合，且L1范数版本显著优于L2范数版本。例如MNIST 3-5分类中，t^+=342、t*=357、t_test=356；0-1分类中t^+=t*=415、t_test=418。L_D*(t+)+ε严格小于L_D*(∞)+ε，证实早停策略有效。方法对高斯、均匀、Pareto等不同数据分布均适用，在欠参数化（m≤n）设置下效果良好，且n/m比值越大效果越优。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个数据依赖的早停解析规则，基于L1-Rademacher复杂度，无需梯度下降训练且不依赖数据分布的概率假设。在欠参数化线性模型场景下表现优异，并通过线性探针技术有效扩展至非线性神经网络（MNIST分类）。未来工作方向包括直接应用于非线性模型、处理向量输出(y∈R^q)以及含随机噪声的输入数据。

title: Causal Analysis for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Transitioning from bespoke time series models towards time series foundation models changes the relationship of model and application from one-to-one to one-to-many. This shift introduces concentration risk as many, potentially high-risk, forecasting applications are exposed to the same biases and failure modes of a single time series foundation model. At the same time, this centralization allows for economies of scale in model development and validation. In this study we investigate how biases and failure modes of time series foundation models can be identified before deployment. We propose a causal analysis framework to investigate the ability of a time series foundation model to preserve time series patterns. To achieve this, we intervene on parameterized synthetic time series generators and measure the corresponding change in model output under ceteris paribus conditions. We apply our causal analysis framework to Chronos-2 and TimesFM-2.5 and test them across six distinct time series patterns. We find safe configurations for trend and harmonic oscillation patterns. The results also indicate a bias in both models towards overestimating persistence, sudden failures for both models against the regime switch pattern and failure for TimesFM-2.5 against the energy-release pattern. Our review of the original works for both models indicates that the findings might be explained by the data used for pretraining. We conclude our study with suggestions for further model development, recommendations for application-specific model selection, and a discussion of limitations and further research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的因果分析框架，通过对参数化合成时间序列生成器进行干预并测量模型输出变化，在ceteris paribus条件下识别模型偏差和失效模式。该框架被应用于Chronos-2和TimesFM-2.5，测试了六种时间序列模式（随机游走、AR(1)、谐波振荡、状态切换、能量释放、分形布朗运动）。研究发现两种模型对趋势和谐波振荡模式表现良好，但都倾向于高估持续性，且在状态切换和能量释放模式上出现失效。
AI.motivation: 时间序列建模从定制模型向基础模型的转变带来了"一对多"的应用关系，导致集中风险——许多高风险预测应用暴露于同一基础模型的偏差和失效模式之下。虽然这种集中化带来了开发与验证的规模经济，但也削弱了部署方对模型内部机制的洞察力。因此亟需在部署前系统性地识别基础模型的偏差与失效模式。本文借鉴药物开发中"体外-体内"两阶段测试以及汽车工程中零部件测试的理念，填补时间序列基础模型因果分析的方法论空白。
AI.method:
1. **因果分析框架**：基于Pearl因果框架，定义生成器G_θ（参数化合成时间序列生成器）、轨迹y、模型M、参数统计量δ。通过do(θ_i=α)干预目标参数并保持其他参数和噪声不变，实现ceteris paribus条件。建立剂量-响应关系。

2. **实验配置**：
   - 固定T=200, H=200, n=50次噪声实现
   - 六种生成器：随机游走带漂移（干预μ）、AR(1)（干预β）、谐波振荡（干预λ）、固定驻留时间状态切换（干预τ）、能量释放（干预κ）、分形布朗运动（干预Hurst指数H）
   - 模型：Chronos-2和TimesFM-2.5
   - 通过比较轨迹参数统计δ(y)和模型输出参数统计δ(M(y))识别偏差与失效模式
AI.result:
1. **随机游走**：Chronos-2比TimesFM-2.5更好地保留了漂移量级，TimesFM-2.5存在向零的偏差。
2. **AR(1)**：两种模型输出均退化为接近平坦的轨迹，对低β值持续高估自相关——存在高估持续性的偏差。
3. **谐波振荡**：两种模型在整个干预范围内均能很好地保留波长λ——安全配置。
4. **状态切换**：两种模型均出现失效，Chronos-2在τ≥50失效，TimesFM-2.5在τ≥25更早失效；Chronos-2低估、TimesFM-2.5高估驻留时间。
5. **能量释放**：Chronos-2在全程基本保留阈值模式；TimesFM-2.5在κ≥25开始平滑，κ≥50完全丧失模式。
6. **分形布朗运动**：两种模型均高估Hurst指数H，对H<0.5的锯齿模式平滑严重——确证持续性高估偏差。

总结：Chronos-2在大多数模式上优于TimesFM-2.5。两者均存在高估持续性的偏差，且对结构断裂和阈值模式表现不佳。训练数据偏向趋势和周期性模式可能是根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 本文的四个贡献：1）首次形式化了针对时间序列基础模型的因果分析框架；2）展示了Chronos-2和TimesFM-2.5在六种生成器上的剂量-响应关系；3）发现两种模型均存在高估自相关和长期依赖持续性的偏差，以及对状态切换和能量释放模式的失效模式；4）为面向应用的模型选择提供了具体建议（如随机游走、状态切换、能量释放模式推荐Chronos-2）。研究局限在于固定的生成器配置、有限的干预范围和单一噪声尺度。未来工作可扩展到更多生成器与模型，开展领域特定实验，并通过真实数据集进行体内验证。提议用参数化合成生成器替代固定的经验训练分布以保障安全使用边界。

authors: Maria Luisa Marques de Sa Faquetti
title: A Structural FHMM for Interpretable Disease Trajectories in T2DM
summary: In this work, we propose a structural variant of the Factorial Hidden Markov Model (FHMM) for the analysis of disease trajectories in patients with Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). The model represents a patient's latent health state as a combination of multiple independent, simultaneously evolving components, associated with comorbidities and lab results. This structured latent representation facilitates the identification of clinically meaningful patient states and clustering of common disease trajectories. We evaluate the proposed approach using The IQVIA Medical Research Data incorporating data from THIN, a Cegedim database of anonymized electronic health records (EHR), identifying patients with a first-ever prescription for a non-insulin antidiabetic drug (NIAD) between January 2006 and December 2019. The model identifies multiple clinically coherent latent components corresponding to known patterns of diabetes-related complications and reveals heterogeneous progression pathways, including distinct microvascular-dominant and multi-organ trajectories associated with elevated comorbidity burden and mortality. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework captures meaningful longitudinal structure in EHR data and provides interpretable insights into the evolution of T2DM and its comorbidities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化因子隐马尔可夫模型（Structural FHMM），用于分析2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者的疾病轨迹。该模型将患者的潜在健康状态表示为多个独立、同时演化的隐马尔可夫链的组合，分别关联共病和实验室检查结果，从而在电子健康记录（EHR）数据中实现可解释的疾病进展建模。利用IQVIA/THIN数据库中的88,201名T2DM患者数据，该模型识别出8个临床上一致的潜在组分（如骨质疏松进展、心血管进展、视网膜病变进展等），并通过聚类揭示了异质性的进展路径，包括以微血管为主和多器官受累的不同轨迹，且与较高的共病负担和死亡率相关。
AI.motivation: T2DM是一种高度异质性的慢性疾病，其并发症众多且进展路径复杂。传统的单一隐马尔可夫模型难以捕捉多维度、动态的患者健康状态，且现有方法（如深度生成模型或聚类方法）在可解释性或时间动态建模方面存在不足。因此，需要一种能够联合建模多种共病和实验室指标随时间演化的可解释框架，以支持风险分层和及时干预。
AI.method:
1. **数据来源**：使用IQVIA Medical Research Data (THIN数据库) 中2006-2019年间首次接受非胰岛素降糖药（NIAD）处方的88,201名成人T2DM患者数据，按性别和年龄（<65 vs ≥65）分层分析。
2. **模型架构**：提出结构化FHMM，包含M条独立的隐马尔可夫链，每条链有K个有序状态。施加以下结构约束：
   - 状态值随健康恶化单调递增，最后一状态为吸收态；
   - 转移矩阵为带状（带宽d），限制每次最多跳跃d个状态；
   - 发射概率的条件均值关于各隐状态分量单调（通过累积和参数化η+≥0, η−≥0实现），并施加组Lasso惩罚以强制单调方向。
3. **初始状态建模**：使用基于Gamma分布的Softmax参数化，依赖于用药史、年龄、吸烟和饮酒状态。
4. **推断算法**：采用结构化平均场变分近似，将推断复杂度从O(K^M T)降至O(K²MT)；针对二元共病输出，使用二阶近似降低计算成本。通过EM算法最大化证据下界（ELBO）。
5. **轨迹分析**：对每位患者拟合变分参数后，计算各时间点隐状态期望，应用K-means聚类（通过Davies-Bouldin指数和预测强度确定簇数），并分析簇间转移动态。
AI.result:
1. **模型选择**：FHMM(8,4)₂（8条链、每链4状态、带宽2）在大多数性别-年龄组中表现最优（BIC/AIC），始终优于等效规模的HMM(27)₈。
2. **潜在组分识别**：在女性<65亚组中识别出8个临床可解释的潜在链，包括骨质疏松进展、心血管进展、心梗进展、代谢综合征进展、高血压进展、视网膜病变进展、血管进展和心肾进展。
3. **患者聚类**：识别出13个临床轨迹簇，呈现明显的死亡风险分层。其中簇7（病态肥胖）和簇8（晚期肾病）代表最严重的终末期状态。
4. **进展路径**：发现两种主要进展模式——以微血管并发症为主（如视网膜病变、高血压）的轨迹，以及由肺、肝、肾及心肺受累驱动的多器官轨迹。转移图显示病情通常单向进展，簇6和簇7为常见的终末吸收态。
5. **临床验证**：模型结果与已知的T2DM并发症临床模式（如心肾综合征、骨质疏松与慢性肝肾疾病的共现）一致。
AI.conclusion: 结构化FHMM能够有效地将T2DM的多重共病建模为多个并行演化的潜在疾病过程的相互作用。该方法无需预设疾病分组即可从纵向数据中联合学习有意义的共病模式，提供了比静态聚类和深度生成模型更可解释的结果，比传统HMM更灵活地表示异步、叠加的并发症。其潜在结构对应于临床上可识别的糖尿病并发症类型，揭示了微血管主导和多器官两种主要进展模式。该框架在风险分层、个体化治疗和真实世界临床决策支持方面具有应用潜力。未来工作可扩展至更多共病、改进缺失数据处理和药物特征工程。

title: When Does Self-Supervised Pretraining Help Tabular Models? A Study of Label Scarcity and Missing Data
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach for tabular data, yet its efficacy under extreme label scarcity and test-time missingness remains under-explored. In this paper, we evaluate a mask-and-recover SSL pretraining objective against training from scratch and classical baselines across 14 diverse classification tasks. First, while SSL outperforms training from scratch on average and remains competitive with state-of-the-art tree ensembles (achieving ~0.8954 AUC vs. Random Forest's 0.9015 at 10% labels), the SSL-vs-scratch gains exhibit high inter-task variance and lack significance (p = 0.626 at both 5% and 10% labels). Second, contrary to the hypothesis that missing-value imputation objectives universally benefit datasets with native missingness, SSL yields the most reliable improvements on clean datasets, while frequently degrading performance on datasets with high inherent missingness. Third, despite this training variance, SSL-pretrained models achieve a higher average AUC than scratch-trained models under both test-time missingness completely at random (MCAR) injection (+0.0245 AUC, positive on 11 of 14 tasks) and structured missingness shifts (MNAR, +0.0418 AUC, positive on 8 of 14 tasks), though neither difference remains statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons (adjusted p = 0.118 and p = 0.518, respectively). Fourth, comparing our mask-and-recover objective against three established tabular SSL baselines (VIME, SCARF, SubTab) under an identical encoder architecture, we find no significant difference from any of them (adjusted p = 0.459, p = 1.000, p = 1.000), indicating our findings reflect general properties of tabular SSL rather than idiosyncrasies of one particular pretext task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对表格数据自监督学习（SSL）在极端标签稀缺和测试时缺失场景下的有效性进行了系统实证研究。作者在14个OpenML分类任务上评估了一种"掩码-恢复"SSL预训练目标，对比从零训练和经典基线。核心发现包括：(1) SSL平均略优于从零训练且与树模型竞争，但差异不显著且方差大；(2) SSL在干净数据集上提升最稳定，而在原生高缺失率数据集上常出现退化（"缺失vs干净悖论"）；(3) SSL预训练模型在测试时MCAR和MNAR缺失下退化更平缓，但经多重比较校正后不显著；(4) 与VIME、SCARF、SubTab在相同编码器下无显著差异，表明结论具有一般性；(5) 多种子消融发现一致性损失、组掩码、掩码可见性均无可靠效应，警示单种子消融的不可靠性。
AI.motivation: 尽管表格数据上SSL预训练近年受到关注，但其实证有效性在两个真实场景下仍未被充分研究：(1) 标签极度稀缺（仅1%–20%标注）；(2) 测试时特征缺失（MCAR/MNAR注入）。此外，现有工作主要在干净完整数据上评测，SSL重建目标与原生缺失数据集以及测试时分布偏移缺失之间的交互仍是开放问题。论文旨在通过受控的多数据集、多假设检验、多种子实验，给出"SSL何时真正有帮助"的细致回答。
AI.method: 采用双分支MLP表格编码器（数值分支+类别嵌入分支，融合为128维表示），SSL使用"掩码-破坏-恢复"范式：伯努利掩码率ρ=0.3，生成两个增强视图，损失为两视图重建损失（MSE仅在掩码数值上+按特征加权的类别CE）加上一致性损失（余弦距离），并可选基于Spearman层次聚类的组掩码。预训练50轮后，用AdamW在{1%,5%,10%,20%}标注子集上微调30轮。数据集为14个OpenML分类任务。在相同编码器下复现VIME/SCARF/SubTab进行控制对比。使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验+Holm-Bonferroni校正，对MCAR+30%和MNAR（70%分位数以上）进行鲁棒性评测。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 标签稀缺下，10%标签时SSL平均AUC=0.8954，与Random Forest的0.9015仅差约0.006，但SSL vs Scratch增益不显著（5%与10%下p=0.626，校正后p=1.000），且到20%标签时增益符号反转。(2) 缺失vs干净悖论：SSL在干净数据集上最稳定，原生高缺失数据集上常退化（ΔAUC方差大）。(3) 测试时鲁棒性：MCAR下SSL平均+0.0245 AUC（11/14任务正向，原始p=0.0295，校正p=0.118）；MNAR下+0.0418 AUC（8/14任务正向，原始p=0.1726，校正p=0.518），均未达显著。(4) 与VIME/SCARF/SubTab在相同编码器下均无显著差异（校正p=0.459/1.000/1.000）。(5) 多种子消融（n=3预训练种子，4个原生缺失任务）发现一致性损失、组掩码、掩码可见性均无可靠效应；最初单种子观察到的"一致性损失有害"效应在多种子平均后消失（Wilcoxon p=0.625）。
AI.conclusion: SSL预训练在标签稀缺下平均与树集成竞争但优势不稳健，且高度依赖数据集；其最大价值可能体现在测试时分布偏移下的鲁棒性而非绝对精度上。研究方法学上的重要发现是：在小样本表格SSL研究中，单种子消融容易产生虚假显著模式，必须进行多预训练种子平均才能得出可靠结论。"缺失vs干净悖论"的根因仍是开放问题。未来工作需要更大、更多样的原生缺失数据集，以及针对数据集自适应的SSL设计来充分发挥其潜力。

title: Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation
summary: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely concerned in the fields of machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Traditional UDA learning usually assumes that the label spaces of the source and target domains are exactly the same and only needs to solve the problem of sample distribution drift existing between two domains. However, in real world applications, the label spaces between two domains may be different. In this case, there are both sample distribution drift and class spatial difference between domains, namely Universal Domain Adaptation (UniDA) learning scenario. At present, existing works rarely offer theoretical analysis for universal domain adaptation. In this paper, we provide an upper bound of the generalization error for universal domain adaptation. According to the proposed generalization error bound, we propose a novel UniDA algorithm called Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation (JAUA), which aligns the joint distributions by minimizing the distribution discrepancy calculated by Chi-Square divergence. Furthermore, we propose a progressive pseudo-labeling method to assign the pseudo labels to unlabeled target samples. The experiment results on six public image datasets demonstrate the superiority of JAUA in handling the UniDA problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JAUA算法，首次为通用域适应（UniDA）提供基于卡方散度的目标域泛化误差上界，通过联合分布对齐与渐进式伪标签方法在六个公开图像数据集上验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督域适应（UDA）假设源域和目标域标签空间完全相同，而真实场景中两域标签空间往往存在差异（即通用域适应UniDA）。现有UniDA方法缺乏理论分析，尤其是泛化误差界的理论支撑。
AI.method: 1) 基于卡方散度（Chi-Square Divergence）推导UniDA的目标域泛化误差上界（Theorem 1）；2) 通过最小化该上界建立优化模型，采用Representer定理获得分类假设h的闭式解（Theorem 2给出唯一最小值条件）；3) 使用核函数近似联合分布密度比，通过投影矩阵W_s和W_t对齐联合分布，用最速下降法求解；4) 设计渐进式伪标签方法，利用SVM置信度逐步分离公共类与未知类样本。
AI.result: 在Office-31、Office-Home、Visda、Domainnet、ImageCLEF和PACS六个公开数据集上与24种基线方法对比，JAUA在H-score指标上均达到最优（如Visda上HOS达62.0%，Office-31上达91.1%，Domainnet上达58.1%）。消融实验表明未知类样本识别（R^tu_u）和源域公共类误分类项（R^sk_u）是两个最关键组件。
AI.conclusion: JAUA首次为UniDA提供了理论泛化误差界，并通过联合分布对齐与渐进式伪标签策略有效解决了样本分布漂移和标签空间差异两大挑战。未来工作将进一步探索目标域未知类样本的类内结构，对未知类进行细分以提升模型泛化能力。

title: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
summary: Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighting improves learning efficiency across regimes, especially with limited network capacity. Based on these findings, we propose WarpSAC, a regime-aware family of off-policy RL algorithms. WarpSAC uses Sample Weight Decay for efficient exploitation and provides two variants: WarpSAC-L (Norm ON, clipped double-Q) for data-limited CPU-scale training, and WarpSAC-A (Norm OFF, single-Q) for data-abundant GPU-parallel training. WarpSAC improves normalized score--step AUC over FlashSAC by 4.5% across nine CPU-scale environments and 23.1% across fourteen GPU-parallel environments. It increases UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 success rate from 19.8% to 96.4%, improves mean normalized wall-time AUC on MuJoCo Playground by 19.1%, and achieves 36.4% faster sim-to-real deployment on Unitree G1 than FlashSAC. These results show that scalable off-policy RL should adapt its stabilizers to the available data regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WarpSAC，一种基于 FlashSAC 的"数据体制感知"(regime-aware) 离策略强化学习算法族。其核心思想是：传统 off-policy RL 稳定器（参数投影归一化、clipped double-Q、均匀回放）的效用取决于数据体制（数据受限 vs. 数据充裕），应据此匹配而非统一继承。WarpSAC 始终启用年龄偏差回放权重 (Sample Weight Decay, SWD)，并根据体制选择其他两个轴：数据受限 CPU 规模使用 WarpSAC-L（Norm ON + clipped double-Q），数据充裕 GPU 并行使用 WarpSAC-A（Norm OFF + 单 Q）。在 8 个基准族 67 个任务上系统验证了假设，显著优于 FlashSAC，并在 Unitree G1 上实现了 35 分钟的 sim-to-real 部署。
AI.motivation: 现代 GPU 加速仿真器和大并行环境使 off-policy RL 能在高吞吐量下获得多样经验，但经典 off-policy 稳定器（参数归一化、clipped double-Q、均匀回放）是为"数据受限、回放覆盖窄"的场景设计的。在数据充裕体制下，这些保守机制可能限制值函数拟合、引入不必要的悲观偏差并增加计算开销。现有可扩展 off-policy 流水线几乎都默认继承这些稳定器。作者由此提出核心问题：这些稳定器在何种数据体制下收益大于其限制？
AI.method: 1. 控制变量实验设计：基于 FlashSAC 主干，固定优化器、环境接口和网络，仅沿三个轴独立变化——(A) 回放权重（uniform vs. SWD）、(B) 参数投影归一化（ON/OFF）、(C) 评判网络数量（clipped double-Q vs. single-Q）。2. SWD（Sample Weight Decay）：基于过渡年龄的线性衰减权重 w(i)=max(w_min, 1-A(i)/T_decay)，对策略相关的近期样本加权的回放机制；不修改 UTD 或更新规则，可在 GPU 上精确实现，在 CPU 上用桶近似。3. 数据体制感知配方：SWD 作为体制无关核心，WarpSAC-L（SWD + Norm ON + double-Q）用于 CPU 数据受限场景，WarpSAC-A（SWD + Norm OFF + single-Q）用于 GPU 并行数据充裕场景；"Norm OFF"中间消融变体用于对照。4. 评估涵盖 8 个基准族（MuJoCo、DMC 困难任务、HumanoidBench、MyoSuite、MuJoCo Playground、IsaacLab、MJLab、ManiSkill）和 Unitree G1 sim-to-real 部署。
AI.result: 1. 数据体制依赖性得到验证：参数归一化在回放覆盖窄时有益，在数据充裕时限制值拟合；clipped double-Q 在高吞吐量操作任务中可安全放松；年龄偏差回放权重 SWD 在两种体制下均有效，尤其在网络容量受限时。2. 量化提升：相对 FlashSAC 的归一化 score–step AUC，CPU 规模 9 个环境提升 4.5%，GPU 并行 14 个环境提升 23.1%；UnitreeG1TransportBox-v1 成功率从 19.8% 升至 96.4%；MuJoCo Playground 归一化 wall-time AUC 提升 19.1%。3. Sim-to-Real：在单 A800 GPU 上，Unitree G1 端到端 sim-to-real 训练-部署闭环仅需约 35 分钟，较 FlashSAC (≈55 分钟) 缩短 36.4% 的 wall-clock 时间。4. 机制分析：CPU 规模下 SWD 在小模型上带来最大收益（humanoid-run 单块时提升 2×+）；GPU 并行下关闭归一化在小容量时显著改善性能，表明限制函数类带来的稳定性收益被表达力损失所抵消。
AI.conclusion: 1. 提出可扩展 off-policy RL 的"数据体制感知设计原则"：稳定器效用不是算法的固有属性，而是回放覆盖与受保护函数类之间匹配程度的函数——应将可扩展 off-policy RL 视为体制匹配问题而非稳定器堆叠问题。2. WarpSAC 通过体制感知选择稳定器配置实现跨体制 SOTA：WarpSAC-L 服务 CPU 数据受限训练，WarpSAC-A 服务 GPU 并行训练。3. 在 8 个基准家族、67 个任务以及 Unitree G1 sim-to-real 上均取得对 FlashSAC 的一致增益，且常通过"移除"而非"添加"保守组件来获得提升。4. 局限与未来：当前为离线选择两种变体，未来可探索在线体制自适应机制；后续可研究其他经典稳定器（熵权重、目标网络延迟、梯度裁剪、回放比调度）是否同样具有体制依赖性。

title: Where Entropy Is Measured Matters: Policy Geometry in Bounded Continuous-Control PPO
summary: Many continuous-control policies are optimized as unbounded Gaussians and then mapped into bounded actions. We show that where entropy is measured changes the policy geometry learned by proximal policy optimization (PPO). In an 80-muscle MyoLeg task, a clipped Gaussian executes 89.07% of actions within 5% of a bound. A same-state decomposition shows that this is not due to variance alone: setting variance to zero still leaves 83.83% of actions near a bound, while 82.12% of state-conditioned means lie outside the executable interval. Replacing clipping with a tanh map does not remove the high-variance regime. For latent Gaussian entropy H(u), the entropy loss has zero gradient with respect to the mean and a constant variance-increasing gradient. For executed-action entropy H(a), the transform Jacobian adds an inward gradient on the mean. Across three matched MyoLeg seeds, near-boundary occupancy is 71.42%, 29.76%, and 18.83% under latent entropy, no entropy, and executed-action entropy. A 38-dimensional Dog-Stand replication with an independent CleanRL-based PPO implementation reproduces the ordering in mean geometry, which also survives shared-state evaluation and boundary margins from 1% to 10%. Direct mean penalties can match or exceed the centering produced by H(a), showing that interior means are not unique to executed entropy. However, matched mean geometry can coexist with substantially different variance and return. Entropy measurement space is therefore a coupled mean-variance design choice, and task return alone does not characterize bounded-policy geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究PPO在有界连续控制中，熵的度量空间（潜在高斯空间 vs. 执行后动作空间）如何影响所学策略的几何形状（均值放置与方差）。在80维MyoLeg和38维Dog-Stand两个任务上证明：执行动作熵H(a)通过Jacobian产生朝向边界的内拉力，显著降低均值外推；而潜在熵H(u)对方差不约束均值。同时表明任务回报无法表征有界策略的几何特性。
AI.motivation: 连续控制中常用高斯策略配以裁剪/squash映射到有界动作空间，但PPO通常在高斯潜在空间度量熵，对有界执行映射的几何影响缺乏机制性理解。实践中出现策略过度靠近边界而回报尚可的现象，需要分解均值放置与方差的贡献并厘清熵度量子空间的作用。
AI.method: 1. 四格同状态分解 P11/P10/P01/P00 分离均值与方差对边界占用的贡献；2. 在MyoLeg（80肌肉，SB3 PPO）和Dog-Stand（38维，CleanRL PPO）上仅改变熵度量空间（潜在/无/执行后），分析梯度差异；3. 冻结buffer梯度诊断量化H(a)对均值的内拉力；4. 直接均值惩罚（tanh²、L2）作为机制对照；5. 共享状态审计与边界裕度扫描作为鲁棒性检验。
AI.result: MyoLeg：H(u)/无熵/H(a) 边界占用 71.42%/29.76%/18.83%；82.12% 状态条件均值在[0,1]外。Dog-Stand独立复现序列，P10排序在18/18状态集-种子对和48个任务-度量-裕度-种子单元中均成立。H(a)熵-均值力与μ余弦约+0.979 (MyoLeg) / +0.987 (Dog)。直接L2惩罚可获得相近均值几何但log σ差0.600、回报差129点。
AI.conclusion: 熵度量空间是耦合的均值-方差设计选择：H(u)提高相对方差但对均值无约束，H(a)通过Jacobian添加内拉均值正则项并改变方差梯度。任务回报不足以刻画有界策略几何，应同时报告均值放置、方差和占用三个独立维度。

title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 42 pages, 14 figures, 10 tables. this https URL
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) plays a vital role in enhancing the reliability of deep learning model predictions, especially in scenarios with high-dimensional output spaces. This paper addresses the dual nature of uncertainty -- aleatoric and epistemic -- focusing on their joint integration in high-dimensional regression tasks. For example, in applications like medical image segmentation or restoration, aleatoric uncertainty captures inherent data noise, while epistemic uncertainty quantifies the model's confidence in unfamiliar conditions. Modeling both jointly enables more reliable predictions by reflecting both unavoidable variability and knowledge gaps, whereas modeling only one limits transparency and robustness. We propose a novel approach that approximates the resulting joint uncertainty using a low-rank plus diagonal covariance structure, capturing essential output correlations while avoiding the computational burdens of full covariance matrices. Unlike prior work, our method explicitly combines aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties into a unified second-order distribution that supports robust downstream analyses like sampling and log-likelihood evaluation. We further introduce stabilization strategies for efficient training and inference, achieving superior UQ in the tasks of image inpainting, colorization, optical flow, and depth estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于高维回归任务的不确定性量化（UQ）新方法，通过低秩加对角协方差结构联合建模偶然不确定性（aleatoric）和认知不确定性（epistemic），避免了完整协方差矩阵的计算负担，并在图像修复、彩色化、光流和深度估计等任务中实现优越性能。
AI.motivation: 在医学图像分割或恢复等高维输出场景中，深度学习预测的可靠性至关重要。现有方法通常仅建模偶然不确定性或认知不确定性中的一种，限制了透明度和鲁棒性；同时在高维输出空间中完整协方差矩阵计算成本过高。因此需要一种能够联合建模两类不确定性且计算高效的统一框架。
AI.method: 1. 提出将偶然不确定性和认知不确定性联合建模为统一的二阶分布（二元高斯分布）；2. 采用低秩加对角（low-rank plus diagonal）协方差结构来近似联合不确定性，捕捉输出间的关键相关性同时避免完整协方差的高计算成本；3. 引入稳定化策略以保证训练和推理的高效性，支持采样和对数似然评估等下游分析。
AI.result: 在图像修复（inpainting）、彩色化（colorization）、光流（optical flow）和深度估计（depth estimation）四个任务中实现了优越的不确定性量化性能，验证了所提联合建模框架在多种高维回归应用中的有效性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的低秩加对角协方差结构联合不确定性建模方法，成功地将偶然与认知不确定性整合到统一框架中，在保持计算效率的同时提升了下游分析的鲁棒性，为高维回归任务中的不确定性量化提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案。

title: From Numerical Simulators of PDEs to Neural Emulators and Back
summary: Simulation is central to modern engineering and science, but the cost of numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a bottleneck whenever fast or many-query evaluations are required. Neural emulators trained on solver-generated data promise significant speedups, yet they are usually framed as opaque alternatives to the very methods that produce their training signal. This thesis argues the two paradigms are more alike than different: neural architectures mirror classical discretizations, their errors are amenable to the same spectral analysis, and insight flows profitably in both directions. We approach the relationship by disentangling the multiple roles a solver plays in the emulator learning pipeline. Mode-wise Fourier analysis then provides a common language in which solver errors, architectural inductive biases, and training objectives can all be read off simultaneously. Taken together, this allows synthesizing three contributions. (1) APEBench, a comprehensive benchmarking suite for autoregressive neural emulators of PDEs that uses fast differentiable pseudo-spectral solvers in JAX. (2) Progressively Refined Differentiable Physics, an investigation of the effect of unconverged solvers on surrogate training. (3) Neural Emulator Superiority, an analysis of the influence of numerical errors and architectural inductive biases.

AI.tldr: 本文是Felix Koehler的博士论文，论证数值PDE求解器与神经模拟器本质相似：通过模式级傅里叶分析这一统一框架，揭示神经架构与经典离散化方法的对偶关系，并提出三大贡献——APEBench基准测试套件、渐进精化可微物理(PRDP)方法、以及神经模拟器优越性(Emulator Superiority)分析。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将神经模拟器视为替代数值求解器的不透明黑箱，但论文认为两者实为高度相似的范式。核心动机在于：（1）求解器在模拟器训练管线中扮演多重角色却被混淆；（2）神经架构与经典离散化方法存在结构性同构；（3）需要统一的分析语言（傅里叶谱分析）来理解训练误差、归纳偏置与训练目标的交互作用。这填补了物理模拟与机器学习交叉领域中对求解器-模拟器关系系统性理解的空白。
AI.method: 方法体系建立在三个支柱之上：（1）基于JAX的快速可微伪谱求解器Exponax（ETDRK方法）与Picardax（有限差分），实现批量并行训练数据生成；（2）模式级傅里叶谱误差分析，将FTCS、BTCS等数值方案的乘子与学习模型的乘子进行可比较的解析；（3）五角色分解框架（训练数据源、评估参考、混合组件、结构类比、基线比较器）解构求解器在管线中的多重身份。训练采用(T,B)分类法系统化展开策略，PRDP通过双层优化视角自适应调整求解器迭代次数。
AI.result: 三大实证成果：（1）APEBench提供46个PDE配置、覆盖1D-3D，900 GPU小时完成完整实验套件，发现无万能架构、感受野与依赖域匹配至关重要；（2）PRDP在Navier-Stokes训练中减少62%训练时间，最高累积节省86%求解器迭代；（3）优越性分析证明：神经模拟器在多步自回归展开时能超越训练数据源，CNN类局部架构展现状态空间优越性，所有架构展现自回归优越性。Lyapunov指数提供混沌系统评估的物理下界。
AI.conclusion: 数值求解器与神经模拟器本质相似：归纳偏置可隐式正则化结构化数值误差，混合求解器无需完全收敛因网络无法利用额外精度，结构上类似合适数值方法的架构表现最佳。局限在于限定于周期均匀笛卡尔网格上半线性PDE。未来方向包括PDE基础模型、计算最优数据生成（结合求解器精度与模型容量权衡）、扩展至非结构网格，以及利用Enzyme等编译器级自动微分将传统Fortran/C++求解器迁移至现代加速器。论文建立的傅里叶谱分析框架作为统一语言使精确对话成为可能。

title: Persistent Cross Entropy
summary: Persistent entropy is the Shannon entropy of a persistence-based probability measure defined on a persistence diagram. However, its cross-entropy version is not naturally defined because two persistence diagrams generally have different event spaces. To bridge these event spaces, we combine a similarity function with persistence weighting to define an induced probability. The induced probability reflects information from one diagram on the event space of the other diagram and assigns unexplained probability mass to the unexplained event. Using the induced probability, we extend cross entropy to persistence diagrams, called persistent cross entropy (PCE). We establish the main properties of both the induced probability and PCE and prove stability theorems for both. Through three numerical studies, we show that PCE distinguishes diagrams with the same persistent entropy, separates causal directions in dynamical systems without constructing a joint persistent diagram, and can be used as a directional topology loss for knowledge distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了持续同调交叉熵（Persistent Cross Entropy, PCE），通过结合相似度函数与持续权重构造诱导概率，将Shannon交叉熵扩展到具有不同事件空间的持续图中，并证明了其稳定性。实验表明PCE能够区分具有相同持续熵的图、在不构建联合持续图的情况下分离动力学系统的因果方向，并可作为知识蒸馏中的定向拓扑损失。
AI.motivation: 持续熵（Persistent Entropy）是持续图上的Shannon熵标量摘要，但其交叉熵版本因两个持续图具有不同事件空间而无法自然定义。现有的对称持续图距离方法（如Bottleneck、Wasserstein距离）在因果方向分析中需要构造联合持续图，缺乏直接的方向性度量。论文旨在弥合这一差距，定义一个无需对齐事件空间即可直接产生方向比较的拓扑度量。
AI.method: 1. 使用出生-持续性（birth-persistence）坐标表示持续图点。2. 定义相似度函数 k（高斯核）将两点之间的接近度映射到 (0,1]。3. 通过持久性权重函数 g（如 g(t)=t/(1+t)）衡量每个点对另一个图的解释力 α_u(D)=Σ k(u,v)g(ℓ_v)。4. 计算解释力差异 δ_Y^X(u)=α_u(D_Y)-α_u(D_X)，并通过高斯型权重 w_Y^X(u)=exp(-δ²/2τ²) 将质量从 D_X 转移到持续图上的各点。5. 未解释的质量汇聚到一个额外的"未解释事件"∂ 上，构造 D_X∪{∂} 上的诱导概率 p_X^Y。6. 定义持续交叉熵 H(p_X, p_X^Y) 及熵增量 ΔH_Y^X = KL(p_X∥p_X^Y) = (1/2τ²)E[δ²]。7. 证明了三个主要稳定性定理：未解释质量的平方稳定性、诱导概率的全变差稳定性、熵增量的Wasserstein稳定性以及联合局部稳定性。
AI.result: 1. 双环实验：构造了五个持续熵均约等于1.500的点云，PCE值分别为1.752、2.281、2.997、3.977，成功区分了持续熵无法区分的不同特征组成。2. 弹簧-质量因果分析：在9×9耦合参数网格（81种设置）上，PCE的熵增量在四种耦合状态分离中达到R²=0.560（最佳），未解释质量在两个单向因果方向分离中达到R²=0.993（最佳），均优于瓶颈距离、Wasserstein距离、Betti曲线、持续性景观等基线方法，且无需构建联合持续图。3. 知识蒸馏：在CIFAR-100上以ResNet56为教师、ResNet20为学生，EM-PCE相对TopKD在最终准确率和最后10个epoch均值上分别提升0.50和0.606个百分点（seed=7），PCE也提升了0.25和0.223个百分点；训练过程中未解释质量从0.2494降至0.00756，表明学生持续图逐渐更好解释教师持续质量。
AI.conclusion: PCE提供了一个原则性的方向性拓扑度量，成功将交叉熵框架扩展到持续图空间。其理论稳定性保证（基于1-Wasserstein距离）以及实验验证（区分相同熵的图、因果方向识别、拓扑感知知识蒸馏）表明该方法在拓扑数据分析中具有广泛适用性。非线性/混沌系统的因果分析仍有挑战，需进一步研究。EM-PCE变体（去除未解释事件并重归一化）在知识蒸馏中表现最佳。

title: SeisMamba: Low-Latency Single-Station Seismic Magnitude Estimation for Spatially Distributed Earthquake Early Warning
summary: Rapid earthquake magnitude estimation is central to earthquake early warning, yet many operational systems depend on dense regional seismic networks and region-specific calibration. This creates a spatial coverage barrier for high-risk areas with sparse sensing infrastructure. Single-station learning offers a lower-cost alternative, but existing models often face an accuracy--latency trade-off and may degrade under regional distribution shift. We present SeisMamba, a lightweight Mamba-based architecture for low-latency magnitude estimation from minimally processed three-component seismic waveforms recorded at a single station. SeisMamba combines hierarchical convolutional encoding, sparse selective state-space modelling, multi-scale feature fusion, and an auxiliary temporal prediction head to support efficient long-sequence waveform analysis. On the STEAD benchmark, SeisMamba achieves the best MSE, RMSE, and $R^2$ among tested baselines while requiring only 0.55 ms for a batch of 32 waveforms on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, making it about three times faster than transformer-based baselines. We further conduct a Chile--Taiwan regional hold-out experiment as a diagnostic test of cross-region deployment, where SeisMamba retains useful performance on geographically unseen seismic regions. These results suggest that selective state-space waveform modelling provides a promising accuracy--latency backbone for spatially distributed, low-cost earthquake early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeisMamba，一种基于Mamba选择性状态空间模型的轻量级单台站地震震级估计架构。在STEAD基准上取得最佳MSE/RMSE/R²，同时推理速度约为基于Transformer基线的3倍（0.55 ms/batch），并在智利-台湾区域留出测试中保持了有用的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有地震预警（EEW）系统依赖密集区域台网和区域特定校准，在监测基础设施稀疏的高风险地区形成空间覆盖障碍。单台站学习方法虽有低成本优势，但现有模型面临精度-延迟权衡问题，并在区域分布偏移下性能下降。本文旨在解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: SeisMamba架构包含四个组件：(1) 层次化一维残差卷积编码器（4个阶段，逐步降采样并增加通道宽度），用于提取局部波形形态特征；(2) 稀疏放置的Mamba选择性状态空间块（仅在选定分辨率插入，非每层都使用），以线性时间复杂度建模长程依赖；(3) 多尺度特征融合，将各编码器阶段的池化描述符拼接；(4) 双输出头——标量头预测最终震级，辅助时序头预测时间分辨的震级轨迹（P波到达前为零，到达后为事件震级）。训练损失为标量与时序MSE的加权和（0.75:0.25）。输入为30秒三分量ENZ波形，100 Hz采样，仅做1-40 Hz零相位带通滤波。
AI.result: 在STEAD基准上：SeisMamba取得MSE=0.0628、RMSE=0.2506、R²=0.9443（均为最优），MAE=0.1566（接近最优0.1467），推理时间0.55 ms/batch（T4 GPU），约为EQTransformer（1.70 ms）和AMAG（1.58 ms）的1/3。区域留出实验（智利-台湾，5478条记录）：R²=0.8518，MAE=0.2808，延迟0.58 ms，表明存在性能下降但仍保留有用预测能力。消融研究验证了稀疏Mamba放置优于密集放置，多尺度融合和深度增加均带来改进。
AI.conclusion: 选择性状态空间建模是单台站震级估计的有效主干，在精度-延迟权衡上优于基于注意力的模型，且学习的波形表示在地理未见区域具有可迁移性。SeisMamba适合空间分布式低成本EEW部署，但区域波形偏移问题尚未完全解决，仍需更广泛的区域适配和完整的EEW系统验证。辅助时序头作为可观测性机制而非完整的不确定性估计器。

title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed to resolving the task. Recent methods rely on comparative evidence from other trajectories or resampled continuations, or on separately constructed step-level learning signals, to refine credit. However, a completed rollout already records how information and errors flow between agent actions. We introduce Influence-Aware Policy Optimization (IAPO), which represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph over trainable agent actions, with user and tool observations serving as evidence. IAPO converts support-use and failed-use structure into routing weights that redistribute the same trajectory-level advantage. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: {\tau^2}-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench. BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn further shows that these gains do not compromise multi-turn function-calling performance. This work advances the understanding of credit assignment in multi-turn user interactions and provides a principled approach to training service agents from sparse outcome feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出 IAPO（Influence-Aware Policy Optimization），通过在已完成 rollout 中构建类型化的影响依赖图，将原本统一分配给所有动作 token 的轨迹级优势按"支持使用"与"失败使用"依赖进行重路由。在 Qwen3-4B/8B 上，于 τ²-Bench、UserBench、AgentChangeBench 三个服务智能体基准均优于 GRPO、GiGPO、InfoPO 等基线，同时不损害 BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn 上的函数调用能力。
AI.motivation: 多轮服务智能体任务中存在"演化状态"信用分配难题：用户目标逐步澄清、工具响应逐步揭示信息，最终奖励无法指明哪些早期动作真正决定了任务成败。现有方法（跨 rollout 比较、单独构造步级信号）在自由形式的多轮用户-工具交互中难以适用。
AI.method: 1. 在已完成 rollout 中，由冻结标注器（如 Qwen3-32B）抽取类型化影响依赖图 G=(V, E⁺, E⁻)，其中 E⁺ 为支持使用边（后序动作使用了前序动作提供/引发信息），E⁻ 为失败使用边（后序动作复用了前序错误输出或需回退）。用户消息与工具返回作为证据但不获得策略梯度。2. 基于出/入边数量计算图特征 φ⁺ 和 φ⁻，再经长度加权标准化、clip、重归一化为有界权重 m⁺、m⁻。3. 符号条件路由：正优势 rollout 使用 w⁺=m⁺·exp(-β⁺ψ⁻) 按支持加权并折扣已修复错误步骤；负优势 rollout 使用 w⁻=m⁻ 仅按错误证据路由。最终 A_{i,ℓ}=Â_τ·w_i，仍保证质量守恒、符号保持、无信息图时均匀回退至 GRPO。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，τ²-Bench 域宏平均 pass@1 由 GRPO 的 29.61% 提升至 42.18%（+12.57pp），其中 Telecom 域提升 +18.19pp；UserBench 与 AgentChangeBench 各 split 均提升 +3.45 至 +5.09pp；BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn 与 GRPO 基本持平（39.36% vs 39.04%）。Qwen3-4B 上同样优于各基线，平均得分 31.31% 对比 GRPO 27.81%。跨标注器（Qwen3-32B、Gemma4-31B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3-235B-A22B、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、Qwen3.5-27B）一致性强（边 F1≈0.87，路由 Spearman ρ 0.73–1.00）。消融显示 β⁺=0.05、c=0.25、保守负分支为默认最优配置。
AI.conclusion: 已完成的 rollout 内部依赖结构本身就是一种有效且零额外成本的信用分配信号。IAPO 在不改变奖励、采样过程、组归一化或裁剪损失实现的前提下，仅改写轨迹级优势到 token 的映射，即可为多轮服务智能体训练提供更精细的信用，且具备良好的域外泛化与函数调用能力保留，确立了"rollout 内依赖结构"作为稀疏结果多轮智能体训练实用信用源的可行性。

title: Delayed Optimizer-State Transport Shapes Short-Horizon Training Decisions
summary: Adaptive optimizers retain gradient history in moment variables, allowing a local change in loss weighting to alter later updates. We examine whether this delayed transport is large enough to change prospective short-horizon decisions. On committed future-minibatch sequences, we differentiate eight-step AdamW trajectories through the complete model--optimizer state and select exposure-matched Math--Code loss schedules before independent evaluation. Across 12 unused 0.3M Transformer histories, full transport lowers token-disjoint loss relative to an optimizer-aware immediate derivative in 10/12 histories (mean benefit $4.71\times10^{-4}$; exact one-sided sign test, $p=0.0193$). The two controllers act equally often but select different schedules in 60/96 windows. Crossed checkpoint--future-path tests attribute this reordering to the interaction between optimizer state and near-future data, while an independent Ising--CNN experiment shows that deleting moment-state transport destroys accurate response prediction. Full-transport scores also concentrate exact-rollout winners in larger candidate libraries, focusing finite-amplitude evaluation on a shortlist. On these committed short paths, optimizer memory and near-future data order are therefore actionable components of the training state, providing a mechanism-based criterion for when finite-horizon rather than one-step intervention is required.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应优化器（如AdamW）的动量记忆在短视域训练决策中的作用。通过对完整模型-优化器状态进行八步轨迹微分，作者证明延迟的优化器状态传输能够实质性改变前瞻性锁定的调度选择，并为有限幅度评估提供机制化准则。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化器通过动量变量保留梯度历史，局部损失加权变化会影响后续更新。但这种延迟传输是否足够大以改变短视域的前瞻性决策尚不清楚。已有研究表明优化器记忆会导致顺序效应，但缺乏前瞻性、锁定决策下的量化证据。
AI.method: 1) 建立源-传输-读出分解：将局部损失权重扰动的影响分解为注入B_s、经由Jacobian乘积Φ(t,s+1)的传输、以及最终投影C_{y,t}。2) 在Math-Code Transformer（0.3M/1M参数）和Ising-CNN（252K参数）两个系统上进行前瞻性测试，固定未来minibatch序列后选择暴露匹配的八步调度，锁定动作后独立评估。3) 对比全传输得分与优化器感知的即时导数、记忆删除诊断、中性训练和VGA基线。4) 使用交叉检查点-未来路径设计分离状态与未来驱动贡献。5) 对大候选库使用全传输得分形成短名单，再进行精确有限幅度rollout重排序。
AI.result: 在12个0.3M Math-Code历史中，全传输在10/12个历史上优于优化器感知即时控制器（均值收益4.71×10⁻⁴，精确单侧符号检验p=0.0193），在96个窗口中两者均干预但仅36个选择相同调度。交叉设计显示状态-磁带-调度交互贡献71.9%的得分方差。Ising-CNN中删除动量状态传输使NRMSE从0.002升至0.692。Binder锚定测试中绝对偏差从0.02435降至0.01880。全传输在等预算下赢家召回率为Ising 48/54、Math-Code 108/108。1M尺度下局部响应仍准确但闭环一致性降低（9/12）。
AI.conclusion: 在已提交短路径上，优化器记忆和近未来数据顺序是可操作的训练状态组成部分。完整状态导数既可作为训练动力学的机制探针，也可作为有限干预的筛选得分。提供了基于机制的准则来区分何时需要有限视域干预而非单步干预。未来路径边际化、更长视域和更大模型是该局部描述扩展性的直接检验方向。

title: Bandit Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints: Learning Compressed Exchange Policy
summary: We study adversarial bandit maximization of monotone submodular functions under a matroid constraint. For a rank-$k$ matroid on $n$ elements, we give a randomized oracle-polynomial algorithm that makes one feasible value query per round and has expected $(1-1/e)$-regret $\widetilde O(n^{1/3}k^{2/3}T^{2/3})$. This is the first sublinear-regret algorithm for adversarial bandit submodular maximization under general matroid constraints. Technically, we view the problem as learning an exchange policy for the Poisson base walk. This connects the problem to contextual bandits and gives an information-theoretic sublinear-regret guarantee, but directly learning the exponentially many policies requires exponential time and space. We therefore introduce \emph{balanced fractional exchanges}, which compress the policy mixture into a single fractional base while retaining the exchange information needed by the Poisson analysis. This leads to an polynomial time algorithm with the same regret guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在一般拟阵约束下对抗性匪徒（bandit）单调次模最大化问题。针对秩为 k 的 n 元素拟阵，提出了第一个多项式时间的次线性 (1-1/e)-遗憾算法，每轮进行一次可行值查询，期望遗憾为 Õ(n^{1/3} k^{2/3} T^{2/3})。核心技术创新是引入"平衡分数交换"机制，将指数级数量的比较器策略压缩为单一分数基，从而在保留泊松分析所需交换信息的同时实现多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: 在线次模最大化在影响力传播、传感器部署等场景中具有重要应用。然而，在严格可行查询的对抗性匪徒模型下，对于一般拟阵约束，此前没有已知的次线性 (1-1/e)-遗憾算法，甚至有猜想认为该目标不可达。本文旨在解决这一长期开放性问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 将 Ganz Rozenman 等人 (2026) 的泊松过程基础游走扩展到一般交换分布，并引入"留一法"交换增益来量化近似误差；(2) 提出"平衡分数交换"概念，证明对任意基和分数基，可通过多项式规模的传输流构造满足行和（删除元素均匀）和列和（插入边际为 x/k）约束的交换矩阵；(3) 将次模匪徒问题归约为关于基多面体的线性匪徒问题，并设计使用一次可行查询的留一法无偏估计器，通过熵镜像下降控制遗憾。
AI.result: 主要结论（定理 1.1/5.11）：存在随机化的 oracle-多项式时间算法，每轮进行一次可行值查询，满足 (1-1/e)·max_O ∑f_t(O) − E[∑f_t(S_t)] = Õ(n^{1/3} k^{2/3} T^{2/3})。该结果否定了 Wan 等人 (2023) 关于一般拟阵约束下无法实现次线性遗憾的猜想，且 T 的依赖阶与均匀拟阵和分拟阵的已有结果匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在严格可行查询的对抗性匪徒模型下，为一般拟阵约束的单调次模最大化问题提供了多项式时间的次线性 (1-1/e)-遗憾保证。平衡分数交换技术建立了次模优化与线性匪徒之间的新联系，是一种独立于次模结构本身的通用组合压缩工具，对相关在线学习问题具有潜在影响。

title: Data Leakage Inflates Generalizability of Power Outage Prediction Models
summary: Power outage prediction models are increasingly used in assessments of climate-driven infrastructure risk, yet current evaluation practices obscure whether these models generalize to the novel conditions such applications require. We identify three common methodological choices in power outage prediction models that influence their ability to generalize across spatial, temporal, and event-based settings. We compare the predictive performance impacts of different methodological decisions using publicly available data for the U.S. East Coast from 2018 to 2023 and feature sets derived from weather reanalysis and land-cover data, and embeddings from a GeoAI foundation model (Prithvi WxC). Specifically, we assess model performance under multiple test selection strategies, including unfiltered random splits, leave-one-state-out, and leave-one-event-out designs, which increasingly approximate real-world deployment conditions. While random train-test splits yield strong performance, we show that these results are inflated by spatial and temporal autocorrelation. Under spatial and temporal holdout experiments, predictive accuracy degrades substantially, with models often failing to outperform a simple null baseline. Incorporating GeoAI foundation model embeddings yields limited and inconsistent improvements, primarily for spatial generalization, and does not resolve poor event-level transferability. These findings suggest that, given current data availability and evaluation practices, publicly trained outage prediction models offer limited and uncertain operational value. Progress will likely require improved data coverage, more realistic evaluation protocols, and a shift in focus from marginal modeling advances toward addressing structural data constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了电力中断预测模型中数据泄露导致的泛化性能虚高问题。通过对比随机划分、空间留一州和时间留一事件三种测试策略，发现随机划分下模型表现良好，但在更接近真实部署的空间和时间留出测试中性能大幅下降，甚至无法超过简单的零模型基线。GeoAI基础模型（Prithvi WxC）嵌入仅带来有限且不一致的改进。论文指出当前公开数据训练的电力中断预测模型在运营决策中价值有限，未来进展需依赖数据覆盖、评估协议的改进而非边际建模改进。
AI.motivation: 气候驱动的电力中断风险评估日益依赖机器学习预测模型，但现有评估实践（尤其是随机划分）因时空自相关导致数据泄露，使泛化性能被高估。论文旨在揭示当前评估实践是否能让模型泛化到实际部署所需的全新条件，警示盲目信任此类模型可能带来运营风险。
AI.method: 使用美国东海岸2018-2023年公开数据，构建XGBoost模型。在三个维度上系统变化实验设计：(1) 输入特征——ERA5再分析气象数据（可选配NLCD树密度）、或Prithvi WxC基础模型2560维嵌入；(2) 输出变量——绝对断电客户数（CoP）或相对百分比（pCoP）；(3) 测试集划分——随机80-20、空间留一州（13个州）、时间留一事件（28个事件）。通过简单的离群点检测（移动平均+3标准差）筛选事件，使用5折交叉验证调整模型超参数。
AI.result: 随机划分下，模型达到约33-49% R²，看似表现良好；空间留一州测试中，绝对指标MAE从约1,800升至2,300，相对指标MAE从约0.06升至0.061，且多州模型性能低于零模型基线；时间留一事件测试中，绝对指标预测完全无法超越零模型，相对指标下仅飓风事件有小幅提升。Prithvi WxC嵌入仅在空间泛化中提供轻微改进，但在事件级迁移中表现不佳。飓风事件比冬季风暴和其他事件类型更可预测。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于公开数据的电力中断预测模型在真实部署条件下泛化能力有限，操作价值存疑。性能衰减源于数据泄露（时空自相关）和结构性数据约束，而非模型架构本身的限制。GeoAI基础模型嵌入未带来实质性改进。未来进展需要：改进数据覆盖、采用更严格的评估协议、加强公用事业公开报告标准。论文建议将研究重点从边际建模改进转向解决结构性数据约束问题。

title: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Longitudinal Patient Representation and Scalable Insight Generation in Oncology
summary: Precision oncology necessitates a longitudinal model of patient state that captures cancer evolution and treatment over time, integrating multimodal observations. We introduce the oFM, a foundation model developed on a real-world oncology cohort of 1.67 million cancer patients that integrates clinical trajectories with DNA, RNA, and H&E pathology. Patient-level partitions were reserved for training, validation, and testing, with over one million patients used for training. The oFM encodes daily clinical and molecular episodes and, along with pathology images, integrates them over time to produce a patient state embedding. We evaluate frozen oFM embeddings against expert-curated clinical and molecular baseline features. In prognostic benchmarks, the oFM improved AUC for treatment response, progression-free survival, and overall survival (0.774 vs. 0.563 for overall survival). Across 11 comparative-treatment cohorts, the oFM embeddings achieved a three-fold higher pooled and scale-normalized treatment-benefit AUTOC than baseline features with improved benefit ranking in 9 of 11 cohorts, and provided stronger prognostic discrimination within both treatment arms. We also evaluated a mechanism discovery framework that interprets downstream models built on oFM embeddings by linking their predicted outcomes to clinically and biologically grounded mechanisms through an evidence-grounded temporal graph, enabling evaluation in clinical and drug-development applications.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了oFM（oncology Foundation Model），一个基于167万癌症患者真实世界数据训练的纵向多模态基础模型，融合临床轨迹、DNA/RNA分子数据和H&E病理图像生成患者状态嵌入。oFM在预后预测和治疗获益预测任务上显著优于专家策展特征基线，并配套提出机制发现框架以提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有肿瘤决策系统依赖静态临床变量和生物标志物，忽略了癌症的动态演化行为，且单模态基础模型无法捕捉跨时间的生物学变化。精确肿瘤学需要一个能整合多模态纵向数据的患者表征模型，以同时支持预后（prognostic）和预测性（predictive）生物标志物的开发。
AI.method: 模型采用分层架构：(1) 情景编码器（Episode Encoder）基于微调的GatorTron-base-2k + FoNE（傅里叶数值嵌入）将每日临床/分子事实编码为1024维向量；(2) 轨迹编码器（Trajectory Encoder）为两层Transformer，通过RoPE处理不规则时间间隔，融合情景与病理嵌入（PRISM2/Virchow2）。训练分三阶段：Stage I用TSDAE重建单日情景；Stage II/III冻结/解冻情景编码器，训练轨迹编码器，结合掩码重建、I-JEPA式学生-教师潜在预测（含干预条件）和Cox生存监督（含VICReg正则化）。下游采用两阶段UV-Cox线性探测评估；机制发现通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）+留一事实归因+检索增强生成（RAG）构建时序因果DAG。
AI.result: 在39-40个肿瘤×治疗分层（n≥20/层）中，oFM对OS（0.774 vs 0.563）、PFS（0.688 vs 0.544）和治疗应答（0.585 vs 0.513）的宏平均AUC均显著优于基线，在95%/95%/78%的分层中胜出。在11个比较治疗队列中，oFM的t_AUTOC/SD达4.61（基线1.38，未通过排列零假设1.85），9/11队列获益排序更优，且对照组和实验组C-index均提升（证明信号为预后性而非治疗泄露）。在T-DXd多瘤种机制发现案例中，模型成功恢复PD-L1阴性、低CNV负荷、脑转移等已知耐药机制，并发现APOB过表达等新假设。
AI.conclusion: oFM是首个将纵向临床史、DNA/RNA分子数据和H&E病理统一整合的肿瘤基础模型，其冻结嵌入在预后和预测性基准上一致超越专家策展特征基线，证明捕捉了常规静态特征无法恢复的信息。配套的机制发现框架通过将预测归因至临床/分子事件、稀疏潜在特征和证据支撑的时序假设，为下游模型提供了可解释层。需外部前瞻验证，但结果支持纵向多模态建模作为肿瘤诊断和治疗开发可扩展、可解释应用的基础。

title: Single State Update Predictive Coding training for Time Series Forecasting and Anomaly Detection
summary: Predictive Coding (PC) is a neural learning paradigm that enables parallelizable neural network layer updates. However, the main bottleneck of PC Networks (PCN) is the sequential backwards error propagation. To tackle this, we introduce a training technique that pairs a Generative PCN with a support Encoding PCN. The two PCNs are trained in parallel to match their neural activations, without sequential propagation. We apply this to time series anomaly detection and show that our approach results in more stable, continuous, online learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Guided Predictive Coding"的预测编码（PC）训练方法，通过将生成式PCN（G-PCN）与编码式PCN（E-PCN）配对并行训练，消除PC网络中顺序反向误差传播的瓶颈，实现了单次统一的并行状态更新，适用于时间序列异常检测的稳定在线学习。
AI.motivation: 预测编码网络（PCN）虽具有可并行的逐层更新优势，但其状态更新仍需从输出层向输入层顺序传播的误差信号，导致更新传播速度慢且存在梯度消失问题，限制了PC在边缘设备在线学习等实时场景中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 构建G-PCN（生成式）和E-PCN（编码式）两个PCN配对训练；2. 定义两类能量函数：内部能量ℐ（G-PCN状态与激活值之间）和引导能量𝒢（两网络激活值之间）；3. 四步训练流程：并行前馈初始化→基于𝒢和ℐ_L的并行状态更新→基于ℐ的G-PCN状态更新（统一为单次迭代）→并行权重更新；4. 通过最小化𝒢使E-PCN匹配G-PCN的表示作为支持网络（teacher），G-PCN以真实数据x^t为参考（student）进行更新。
AI.result: 在MNIST数字移动序列的异常检测实验中，与需要5次推理步骤的Vanilla PC相比，Guided PC（仅单次状态更新）在引入方向反转或数字变化等异常后，能更快恢复到将新行为视为正常状态，而Vanilla PC出现发散；但当前实现的训练时间与Vanilla PC相当（Guided PC: 7.3±73.4ms vs Vanilla PC: 7.2±85.2ms），尚未充分利用并行化潜力。
AI.conclusion: Guided PC训练技术有效消除了PC顺序状态更新的瓶颈，增强了训练稳定性，单次统一状态更新步骤使其在边缘设备在线学习场景中具有应用潜力；未来需进一步优化实现以释放并行计算优势。

title: Parameter-Level Attribution of Symmetry in Trained Networks Though Parameter-Wise Functional Sensitivity
summary: When a network has learned a function with a known symmetry, can that symmetry be moved through the parametrisation---is there a motion in parameter space realising the group action in function space? We formulate this as a lifting problem for the realisation map $\Phi:\theta\mapsto f_\theta$, and show that a smooth parameter-space action exists only if the tangent space to the function's symmetry orbit lies within the image of $\mathrm d\Phi_\theta$, whose columns are the \emph{functional sensitivities} of individual parameters. This condition is also sufficient for pointwise first-order lifting. Relaxing it in least squares yields two local parameter directions: one following the symmetry orbit, one descending towards the equivariant subspace, with residuals measuring what the parametrisation cannot reach. On a rotationally invariant classifier we find these directions induce their predicted function-space motion, but only locally: recomputed directions track the orbit and reduce the equivariance defect, while directions held fixed depart from both after training. The same holds for Hamiltonian neural networks trained on a rotationally symmetric potential, even though the architecture does not explicitly enforce the symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"函数敏感性"框架，研究神经网络是否能在参数空间中实现学习函数的对称性变换。通过将对称性提升问题形式化为实现映射的微分提升条件，利用最小范数最小二乘求解得到每个参数对对称性的贡献方向，以及指向等变子空间的方向。在旋转不变分类器和哈密顿神经网络上验证了局部方向能产生预测的函数空间运动，但仅在局部有效。
AI.motivation: 神经网络通常学习具有隐含对称性的函数，但这些对称性如何在参数层面编码并不清楚。已有方法（如参数空间关联分析）侧重统计相关性，而非学习映射的局部微分几何。本文旨在从参数-级别区分的角度，分析哪些参数编码了学习函数的对称性，以及参数空间的运动能否在函数空间中实现群作用。
AI.method: 1. 定义函数敏感性 S_i*(x;θ) 为第 i 个参数对输出映射的偏导数，其张成参数化可达的切空间 T_θ。2. 形式化微分提升条件：函数空间对称性轨道切空间必须包含在 Im(dΦ_θ) 中，这是平滑参数空间作用存在的必要条件，也是逐点一阶提升的充分条件。3. 通过最小二乘松弛求解两个局部参数方向：c*（沿对称性轨道）和 b*（指向等变子空间），残差衡量参数化无法达到的部分。4. 采用截断伪逆和敏感性归一化规范以保证数值稳定性和重参数化不变性。5. 在环形分类器（MLP）和 ASRNN 哈密顿神经网络上对比"重计算"与"固定"参数轨迹。
AI.result: 在环形分类器实验中，重计算的参数轨迹忠实跟踪预测的函数空间运动：c* 沿轨道运动并近似保持等变缺陷，b* 减少等变缺陷。固定方向在初始化后表现相似，但在训练后偏离预期。ASRNN（学习墨西哥帽势的哈密顿神经网络）上获得类似结果，即使架构未显式强制旋转对称性。这表明局部微分提升条件在训练后仍能识别对称性编码，但方向本质上仅局部有效。
AI.conclusion: 函数敏感性提供了一个区分单个参数作用的微分框架，能够对对称性生成元进行参数级归属。该框架诊断等变性，揭示参数空间中对称性提升的局部性。提升条件仅在一阶意义下成立，平滑参数空间作用的全局存在需要额外的可积性条件。实验证实了重计算的局部方向可作为训练后网络对称性结构的诊断工具。

title: Optimal Alternating Regret for Online Learning and Games
summary: We settle the minimax-optimal alternating regret, a regret notion motivated by alternating learning dynamics in games, for both online linear optimization (OLO) and online convex optimization (OCO). For OLO over the probability simplex $\Delta_d$, we give an algorithm with $O(\log d)$ alternating regret that remains a constant for any time horizon $T$, and a matching lower bound. Our constant regret bound significantly improves previous results with $O(\log ^{2/3}d \cdot T^{1/3})$ regret [Cevher, Cutkosky, Kavis, Piliouras, Skoulakis, Viano, NeurIPS 2023, Hait, Li, Luo, Zhang, COLT 2025]. As a result, we obtain alternating learning dynamics with $O(\log d /T)$ convergence to Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games and $O(\log d /T)$ convergence to coarse correlated equilibria in two-player general-sum games. This is the first uncoupled learning dynamics with $O(1/T)$ convergence to CCE in two-player general-sum games, while all prior works suffer additional $\log T$ factors. For general OCO over a $d$-dimensional compact convex set, we give an algorithm with $O(d\log (1+T/d))$ alternating regret, improving the previous best of $\widetilde{O}(d^{2/3}T^{1/3})$. We also prove a matching lower bound of $\Omega(d\log (1+T/d))$, showing that the $\Omega(\log T)$ factor is unavoidable.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了在线凸优化（OCO）和在线线性优化（OLO）中交替遗憾（alternating regret）的极小极大最优界。对于单纯形上的OLO，作者提出了AA-Hedge算法，实现了与时间步T无关的常数级O(log d)交替遗憾，并给出了匹配的下界。对于一般OCO，作者提出了连续AA-Hedge算法，实现了O(d log(1+T/d))的交替遗憾，并证明了匹配的下界Ω(d log(1+T/d))。作为应用，首次在两人一般和博弈中获得了O(1/T)收敛到粗相关均衡（CCE）的非耦合交替学习动力学。
AI.motivation: 交替学习动力学在两人博弈（如扑克AI）中表现优异，但其理论解释长期缺失。交替遗憾作为刻画交替学习动态的 regret 概念，其最优界尚不明确：在OLO/单纯形设置中，先前最佳为O(log^{2/3} d · T^{1/3})；在一般OCO中，先前最佳为Õ(d^{2/3} T^{1/3})。核心问题是确定交替遗憾的极小极大最优界，并由此推断博弈中的最优收敛速率。
AI.method: 1. **AA-Hedge算法（Algorithm 1）**：在Hedge算法基础上引入对已知损失向量c_{t-1}的偏差项β(c_{t-1,i}-θ_t)²，通过寻找最优中心化参数θ_t构造策略分布，并在每步对策略进行修正以保证可行性。2. **势函数分析**：定义势函数Φ_t，证明其在η≤1/8, β=η/4条件下单调不增，从而得到常数级O(log d)交替遗憾上界。3. **连续AA-Hedge算法（Algorithm 2）**：将AA-Hedge推广到一般凸集，使用参考测度μ和KL散度作为势函数，得到O(d log(1+T/d))上界。4. **下界构造**：(a) 对单纯形构造自适应对手证明Ω(log d)；(b) 对2维欧几里得球构造块结构对手证明Ω(log T)；(c) 通过在d维空间中并行运行d/2个2维块的下界证明Ω(d log(1+T/d))。
AI.result: **主要结果**：(1) OLO在单纯形Δ_d上：AA-Hedge算法达到O(log d)交替遗憾，且与时间T无关；下界为Ω(log d)，因此极小极大最优为Θ(log d)。(2) OCO在d维紧凸集上：连续AA-Hedge达到O(d log(1+T/d))交替遗憾；匹配下界为Ω(d log(1+T/d))。(3) 博弈应用：两人零和博弈中交替学习以O(log d/T)收敛到纳什均衡；两人一般和博弈中以O(log d/T)收敛到粗相关均衡（CCE），这是首个非耦合O(1/T)收敛到CCE的学习动力学（之前所有工作都有额外的log T因子）。(4) 对多面体上的OLO，AA-Hedge达到8 log N的常数交替遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全解决了OLO和OCO中交替遗憾的极小极大最优性问题。关键贡献包括：(i) AA-Hedge算法及其势函数分析，揭示了交替设置中如何充分利用已知的前一步损失信息；(ii) 匹配的上下界确立了交替遗憾的精确最优率Θ(log d)（OLO）和Θ(d log(1+T/d))（OCO）；(iii) 作为应用，首次实现两人一般和博弈中O(1/T)收敛到CCE的无耦合交替学习动力学，解决了该领域的长期开放问题。技术核心在于通过中心化参数θ_t和对损失向量的二次正则化项，巧妙地抵消了t-1时刻损失带来的额外遗憾项，从而在对抗性设置中实现亚√T甚至常数的遗憾。

title: $(\text{DNN})^2$: Doubly Non-Negative Relaxations for Deep Neural Networks
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, accepted and to be presented at 64th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control: CDC 2026
summary: Existing linear program (LP) and semidefinite program (SDP) relaxations for rectified linear unit (ReLU) neural network (NN) verification yield overly-conservative safety guarantees due to significant relaxation gaps. While the completely positive program (CPP) formulation closes this gap, it is NP-hard to solve. Its cheapest tractable relaxation, the doubly non-negative program (DNN), retains critical constraints as an SDP, but one whose size exceeds the reach of interior-point methods at practical scale. While Burer-Monteiro (BM) factorization has been applied to make SDP-based verification scalable, no such result exists for the strictly tighter DNN formulation. A key obstacle is that additional non-negativity constraints in the DNN cause dual multipliers for optimality certification to be non-unique, making standard certification methods inapplicable. We propose a novel eigenvalue maximization procedure that searches the non-unique multiplier space for a valid certificate, i.e. a global optimality guarantee. Experiments demonstrate that our approach $(\text{DNN})^2$ produces bounds consistently tighter than the standard SDP method, often matching the exact solution, and that our certification procedure confirms global optimality when a valid certificate exists. These results are a key step toward providing tight, certifiable, and computationally scalable verification guarantees needed to deploy neural network controllers and perception modules in safety-critical autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 (DNN)² 方法，通过 Burer–Monteiro 分解实现 DNN 验证松弛的可扩展优化，并设计了一种特征值最大化过程来在 LICQ 失效时搜索全局最优性证书，从而为 ReLU 神经网络验证提供更紧且可认证的安全保证。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LP 和 SDP 松弛在 ReLU 神经网络验证中存在显著的松弛间隙，导致安全保证过于保守。虽然 CPP 公式能完全闭合间隙但难以求解，标准 SDP 的 DNN 松弛虽更紧但因规模过大无法用内点法求解，且 LICQ 失效使得最优性认证困难。
AI.method: 1) 将 DNN 松弛重写为广义锥规划问题（锥为 PSD 锥与非负锥的交集）；2) 采用秩-2 Burer–Monteiro 分解将 SDP 转化为低维 NLP 以实现可扩展求解；3) 针对 LICQ 失效导致 KKT 乘子不唯一的问题，提出通过求解以最小特征值为目标的 SDP（公式 10）在可行乘子空间中搜索满足 S⪰0 的证书。
AI.result: 在 100 个 ReLU 神经网络上的实验表明：(DNN)² 产生的边界持续紧于标准 c-SDP，在 95% 的验证实例中匹配精确的 MILP 解；认证程序可靠地区分全局与局部最优；BM 分解的 NLP 求解比直接 DNN 内点法具有更有利的线性扩展性（k=11 时 DNN 因内存耗尽失败）。
AI.conclusion: DNN 松弛（作为 CPP 层级中最粗的 SOS 层级）比标准 SDP 更紧且经常是精确的，即使以秩-2 BM 分解形式求解也是如此。所提出的证书机制在 LICQ 失效下仍能可靠识别 BM-DNN 的全局最优解，为可扩展的紧致神经网络验证提供了有前景的途径。

title: LION: A Clifford Neural Paradigm for Multimodal-Attributed Graph Learning
summary: Recently, the rapid advancement of multimodal domains has driven a data-centric paradigm shift in graph ML, transitioning from text-attributed to multimodal-attributed graphs. This advancement significantly enhances data representation and expands the scope of graph downstream tasks, such as modality-oriented tasks, thereby improving the practical utility of graph ML.
