summary: Deep research (DR) systems produce long-form cited reports by orchestrating multiple agents that search and synthesize information from the web. Citations are the primary mechanism for evaluating the faithfulness of these reports, yet current DR systems exhibit poor citation recall. Moreover, improving citation recall is challenging because DR systems are complex multi-agent architectures where information passes through agents like a telephone game, and both content and citations can get corrupted along the way. We propose an evaluation method that pinpoints which agent introduced each error by locally testing agent invocations for faithfulness and verifiability relative to their own inputs. Furthermore, we propose a four-type taxonomy to categorize the discovered errors: hallucination, uncited input reliance, uncited output, or insufficient citations. Applying our method to three top-ranked open-source DR systems, we obtain actionable diagnostics. Almost every agent makes a lot of mistakes with the exception being those that summarize a single document. We find that the dominant error type varies systematically across agents, where the orchestrator mistakes are mostly citation-related. We find that 84.7% of final-report errors in AI-Q originate at the orchestrator, roughly 31% of them hallucinations and the rest citation mistakes. Guided by these insights, we demonstrate that two simple interventions raise citation recall by 5% without degrading output quality.

AI.tldr: 本文针对深度研究（Deep Research, DR）系统中长篇引用报告存在的引用召回率低问题，提出了一种局部化错误诊断方法，能够精确定位多智能体架构中哪个代理引入了忠实性或引用错误，并通过四类错误分类法对错误进行系统化分类。实验在三个开源顶级DR系统上进行，发现编排器（orchestrator）是绝大多数最终报告错误的来源，并基于诊断结果提出两项简单干预措施，使引用召回率提升5%而不损害输出质量。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统通过多智能体协作生成带引用的长篇报告，但当前DR系统引用召回率较差；由于信息在多智能体间像"传话游戏"一样传递，内容和引用都可能在代理边界处损坏，使得诊断和改进引用质量成为挑战。现有方法只能对最终报告进行全局评估，无法定位具体出错的代理。
AI.method: 提出单次代理调用评估方法，通过五步算法（忠实性测试→未引用输入依赖测试→引用对齐测试）将每个错误归类为四类之一：幻觉（hallucination）、未引用输入依赖（uncited input reliance）、未引用输出（uncited output）、引用不足（insufficient citations）。基于此构建两层评估框架：代理级（评估每个代理的平均表现）和系统级（递归追溯最终报告错误到具体出错代理）。评估三个开源顶级DR系统（Nvidia AI-Q、MS-Agent、TrajectoryKit），使用gpt-5-mini作为评判LLM，并进行人类标注验证。
AI.result: 1. 几乎所有代理都犯大量错误，唯一例外是单文档摘要代理（错误率仅3.8-14.9%）；2. 在强模型系统中，错误类型随代理深度系统性变化：浅层代理以幻觉为主，编排器以引用错误为主，而小模型系统在各阶段都产生幻觉；3. AI-Q中84.7%的最终报告错误源自编排器，其中约31%为幻觉；TrajectoryKit 100%的最终报告错误源自编排器且95%为幻觉；4. 两项简单干预措施（提示编排器不使用未引用信息、用原始片段替换研究员的合成笔记）使AI-Q的引用召回率提升5%，引用精确率提升3-7个百分点，且不降低输出质量（RACE分数）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为DR系统的引用错误诊断提供了形式化、人体验证的方法论，揭示了多智能体架构中错误传播的关键模式。诊断结果直接转化为可操作的工程改进，表明即使简单的针对性干预也能显著提升系统忠实性。未来工作可探索将诊断反馈信号融入DR生成循环中进行后置修正，并将方法推广到其他多智能体归属生成场景。

title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
summary: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.

AI.tldr: KIT团队参加BeTraC 2026轻量级赛道，提出可扩展的数据增强流水线，统一异构医学对话数据集（合成语音+自动生成的SOAP监督），将Qwen2.5-Omni-3B语音基础模型通过LoRA适配为端到端语音到SOAP病历生成系统；最终通过检查点平均策略在多个官方测试集上取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 临床文档工作（protocolling）给医护人员带来沉重负担。传统基于转录文本的流水线处理时间长，且会丢失咳嗽等副语言线索。直接从语音端到端生成SOAP病历可减少处理时间并保留更多信息，因此需要可扩展的数据增强方法以克服医学语音-病历配对数据稀缺的问题。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-Omni-3B端到端语音-语言模型，通过LLaMA-Factory以LoRA（r=32）进行适配。整合Synth-DoPaCo、ACI-Bench、MTS-Dialog、PriMock57、OMI五个数据集，对无音频数据用Kokoro-82M合成语音，对无SOAP标注的数据用GPT-3.5-27B自动生成SOAP监督。系统研究：提示位置（系统提示vs指令提示）、多阶段适配（A→ASR→A/T→SOAP）、音/文联合训练、思维链监督、对话时长过滤、TTS幻觉清洗、检查点平均等策略。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1) 详细提示放在指令位置优于系统提示位置；(2) 音/文联合训练提升Concept-F1（0.4780→0.4902）；(3) 多阶段A→ASR→A/T→SOAP效果最佳；(4) CoT未带来提升；(5) 21分钟时长阈值效果最优；(6) TTS对齐清洗无明显增益；(7) 检查点平均策略在DoPaCo测试集取得C-F1=0.4949、R-2=0.3601、R-3=0.2499，在域偏移下展现更强鲁棒性，显著优于对比提交。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的数据增强流水线能有效统一异构医学对话数据，实现端到端语音到SOAP的可靠生成；检查点平均是提升跨域鲁棒性的有效策略；少数样本（few-shot）SOAP示例是未来改进方向。

title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits
summary: Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals complementary limits of common controls: isotropic directions occupy a narrow near-orthogonal region, whereas sign-randomized same-construction directions often retain substantial target alignment. Effect is strongly associated with signed cosine within the sign-randomized family ($\rho=.94$); $25.3\%$ of its draws exceed cosine $.5$, and every draw exceeding the observed mean effect has cosine above $.80$. This alignment leakage does not by itself invalidate a conditional randomization test; it limits what the comparator can distinguish and motivates reporting exchangeability assumptions, a construction diagnostic $A$, and the empirical cosine distribution. The primary Qwen complete gate remains negative because the protected tail fails all families. On independent data, continuous margin transfers only in Qwen and accuracy transfers in no selected cell. Prospectively registered language controls pass the complete gate in Qwen and DeepSeek, while a passing DeepSeek detox comparator rules out categorical separation; all nominal passes are sensitive to $\Gamma=1.10$. Frozen three-rater open-generation evaluation supports factual correction in DeepSeek but not Qwen; the automatic judge fails calibration (macro-F1 $.562$), so null-wide semantic results remain descriptive. SteerCheck makes these conditional and mixed conclusions auditable.

AI.tldr: SteerCheck是一个预先注册的激活引导归因审计协议，通过匹配KL预算并比较各向同性、PCA子空间和符号随机化三种零假设家族，揭示了激活引导（如CAA）中对照组保留的目标方向对齐泄露问题，量化了其鉴别能力局限，并报告了在Qwen3-14B和DeepSeek-V2-Lite上的混合性结论。
AI.motivation: 激活引导可以改变模型行为，但行为变化本身并不能证明效果来自目标概念——可能源于广泛破坏性方向、结构伪迹或对抗用户倾向。标准做法是使用随机方向控制，但其仅探测近正交区域；相同构造的符号随机化对照虽然更强，但仍可能保留大量目标对齐。本文旨在审计这些对照组的鉴别能力，并提出可审计的归因审计协议。
AI.method: SteerCheck采用六步协议：(1)在分离的中性提示库上冻结运行点和目标KL预算κ∈[0.09,0.11]；(2)对观察方向和零方向进行盲拟合系数c；(3)测量所有方向的对齐-效应分布；(4)审计构造匹配对照，报告构造诊断量A和cos(v_null, v_obs)经验分布；(5)按模型和层分解连续得分、精确取反符号传输、离散准确率等主张；(6)在得出负面结论前用已知对齐植入进行校准。包含三个零家族（各向同性、PCA子空间、符号随机化）和交集-并集（IUT）特异门，统计门、蒙特卡洛预算和停止规则在观察结果前冻结。
AI.result: 主要Qwen完整门为阴性（保护尾部在三个家族中均失败，符号随机化均值也失败）。符号随机化方向与v_CAA的余弦标准差为.577，25.3%超过余弦.5，4/320超过观察均值效应且余弦均>.80。在21个构造单元中，A预测sd(cos)的Pearson r=.979，但所有测量sd(cos)≥.440。各向同性方向平均产生26.5%观察效应。语言对照在Qwen和DeepSeek均通过完整IUT，但Detox仅DeepSeek通过；所有名义通过在Γ=1.10敏感性下不稳健。独立银行上准确率在三个选定单元中均不转移；极性镜像研究中仅Qwen选择得分单元保留正确用户性能。人工校准的开放生成评估支持DeepSeek的事实修正，但不支持Qwen；自动法官校准失败（macro-F1=.562）。
AI.conclusion: 特异审计需要冻结决策规则和对对照保留内容的说明。在匹配KL预算下，各向同性方向平均产生26.5%观察效应，而符号随机化保留大量对齐。冻结Qwen完整门仍为阴性：均值未通过符号随机化，保护尾部未通过任何家族。这是未能建立交集-并集主张，而非无效应证据。SteerCheck使效力、极性、特异性、迁移和语义主张分别可审计。

title: Words, Spaces and Generative AI: Layers of language in contemporary architecture
summary: Language can be considered a design material in architecture, and in the context of text-to-X generative AI models becoming a common tool for architectural practice, looking more closely at language is more important now than in the past. After describing some of the important developments in linguistics starting from Wittgenstein, and including the work of Chomsky, Lakoff, conceptual and generative metaphors as proposed by Schön, this chapter connects them to contemporary architectural design and generative text-to-X tools. The chapter builds on the idea that three main forms of language intertwine in architectural design done using generative AI, namely (I) discourse (or natural language which can contain professional terminology specific to our field), (II) programming languages (which are artificial languages sitting at the basis of all computational systems), and (III) annotations (as language elements attached to pieces of data). It concludes by outlining a research agenda for connecting generative metaphors to generative AI: (a) conducting corpus linguistics studies on architectural texts (using quantitative tools such as topic modelling, and qualitative tools such as discourse analysis); (b) bringing communication theory and information studies closer to architectural research and (c) taking into account that different (natural) languages come with different affordances meaning generative and conceptual metaphors differ in relation to this.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨语言作为建筑设计材料的重要性，在生成式AI日益普及的背景下，分析了语言学理论（如Wittgenstein、Chomsky、Lakoff的概念隐喻和Schön的生成隐喻）如何与当代建筑设计和文本到X生成工具相结合，提出建筑设计中三种语言形式交织——话语（自然语言）、编程语言和标注，并给出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 在文本到X生成式AI模型逐渐成为建筑实践常用工具的背景下，语言作为建筑设计材料的重要性日益凸显。作者希望通过梳理语言学发展脉络，为建筑设计与生成式AI的结合提供理论基础，并推动该领域的深入研究。
AI.method: 本文为理论性综述与研究议程构建。首先回顾了从Wittgenstein到Chomsky、Lakoff以及Schön的语言学与隐喻理论发展，然后将三种语言形式（话语、编程语言、标注）与当代建筑设计及生成式AI工具相联系，最后提出三方面的研究议程：基于语料库语言学的建筑文本研究（结合主题建模等定量工具与话语分析等定性方法）、将传播理论与信息研究引入建筑研究、以及考虑不同自然语言对生成式和概念隐喻的影响。
AI.result: 本文提出了一个理论框架，识别出在生成式AI辅助的建筑设计中三种语言形式交织运作：（I）话语（含专业术语的自然语言）；（II）编程语言（作为计算系统基础的人工语言）；（III）标注（附加于数据片段的语言元素）。基于此框架，作者提出了连接生成隐喻与生成式AI的三项研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 语言是建筑设计的重要材料，在生成式AI时代更需深入研究。建筑设计中的语言运用体现为话语、编程语言和标注三种形式的交织。未来研究应通过语料库语言学分析建筑文本、推动传播理论与建筑研究融合，并关注不同自然语言对概念与生成隐喻的影响，从而更好地连接生成隐喻理论与生成式AI实践。

title: Shortcut Before Circuit: Document Statistics Time In-Context Conflict Resolution
summary: When a context asserts two values for one fact, a model commits to a cue -- recency, repetition, position -- but natural data rarely makes these disagree, so behavior cannot reveal which. We train 26M-parameter transformers on a synthetic language where recency and rarity are exactly coextensive, and separate them with a minimal causal edit that inverts one cue while holding the truth, token count and answer position fixed. All 75 runs reach accuracy >= 0.999, including where the trivial heuristic fails, so no held-in evaluation distinguishes them. Under intervention the per-cell readout does not replicate: 13 of 25 cells differ by more than 0.3 in sign fraction across three seeds, the largest by 0.879 against a standard error of 0.025. The construction predicts this -- coextensive rules leave the objective indifferent between them -- and the variance is ordered by how much of the optimization each comparison releases. What replicates is timing: escape from a positional shortcut with a closed-form ceiling, monotone in redundancy. Probed before that escape, attribution reverses sign in 32 of 75 runs at unchanged accuracy, and gating on circuit formation is necessary but not sufficient. The corpus fixes when a mechanism appears, not which one -- a criterion for when mechanistic attribution to data is available at all, and our construction makes the unavailable case exact.

AI.tldr: 本文训练26M参数Transformer在合成语言上，使"最近性"和"稀有性"两个规则在每个训练文档上完全共现，无法通过行为区分。通过极小因果编辑反转多重性来读出规则：所有75次运行准确率均≥0.999，但逐单元格读数不重复，25个单元格中有13个跨种子差异超过0.3。可重复的是时序：从位置捷径逃逸的时间随冗余度单调变化。在逃逸前探测，75次中有32次符号反转但准确率不变，表明电路形成门控必要但不充分。本文提供了一个准则：当两条规则在训练分布上共现时，损失函数对它们不加区分，因此不能将机制归因于数据统计。
AI.motivation: 自然数据中，解决上下文冲突的线索（最近性、重复性、位置）很少分歧，因此无法通过行为区分模型究竟使用了哪种线索。本文旨在构建一种合成语言，使这些线索精确共现，并通过最小因果编辑揭示机制选择是否由训练目标决定。
AI.method: 训练26M参数（8层，d_model=512）的Transformer在合成赋值语言上。每篇文档由（实体、属性、值）语句加查询组成；绑定在文档间重采样，训练流无穷大。变量为冗余度R_old（被替换值的重复次数）和更新到查询距离ΔD，两者保持任务和贝叶斯最优策略不变。利用乘法反转编辑（保留最早副本，其余改写为新值），在保持token数、答案位置、真实标签不变下反转稀有性。通过配对差异Δ读出规则，训练16000步，使用3个种子，并在电路形成门控后用拷贝诊断验证。
AI.result: 所有75次运行均达到准确率≥0.999，包括平凡启发式失败的层级。但逐单元格读数不重复：25个单元格中13个跨种子差异>0.3，最大差异0.879（标准误差0.025）。位置捷径具有闭式上限1/|supp(ΔD)|，窄支撑下饱和至2%以内。逃逸时间随冗余度单调变化（R_old=3到12跨越四个层级）。电路形成前探测，75次中32次符号反转但准确率不变；门控必要但不充分。在定宽波段下，跨种子差异在恒定捷径收益下持续存在，证明差异并非由捷径收益介导。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出一个准则：当两条规则在训练分布上共现时，损失函数对其不加区分，机制归因于数据统计便不可行。本文构造使这种无差别变得精确。可重复的是时序和位置捷径的闭式上限，而非机制本身。实践建议：报告每单元格跨种子方差、门控电路形成（而非任务准确率）、且认识到门控必要但不充分。共现构造使欠定性可见；在自然数据中，同样的无差别仍然存在，但单种子测量会返回看似确定的数字。

title: Dataset Scarcity Limits Robust Evaluation of Multilingual Embedding Models: A Case Study of Slavic Languages
summary: Multilingual text embedding models enable cross-lingual transfer of knowledge across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their evaluation remains highly uneven across high-, mid- and low-resource languages. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional framework, specifically tailored for analyzing multilingual embedding benchmarks under dataset scarcity, and apply it on the Slavic-language subset of the MTEB benchmark. The framework distinguishes between task-specific and cross-task evaluation, while jointly analyzing three complementary aspects: (1) ranking robustness, (2) model consistency, and (3) evidence strength. At the task-specific level, we evaluate the stability of model rankings under changes in ranking methodology and benchmark dataset composition. At the cross-task level, we assess the ability of models to generalize across diverse tasks within a language. To quantify the reliability of benchmark conclusions, we introduce an Evidence Strength Score that accounts for dataset availability, diversity, and robustness assessability. Our analysis reveals severe benchmark sparsity, with many Slavic language-task pairs relying on a single dataset or highly correlated benchmark collections, limiting the ability to draw robust conclusions. The cross-task analysis reveals a small group of highly transferable models, most notably llama-embed-nemotron-8b, multilingual-e5-large-instruct, and Qwen3-Embedding variants, that consistently perform well across Slavic languages and tasks. Overall, the results demonstrate that benchmark rankings and robustness conclusions must be interpreted jointly with certain notation of their evidence strength and highlight benchmark scarcity as a major obstacle to trustworthy multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对斯拉夫语系子集MTEB基准，提出一个二维评估框架，结合排序稳定性、top-k迁移一致性与证据强度（ESS），系统揭示多语言嵌入模型评估中的数据集稀缺与冗余问题，并识别出一小批跨任务泛化能力强的"通用型"模型。
AI.motivation: 多语言嵌入模型评估在高/中/低资源语言间极不均衡，现有基准（如MTEB、MMTEB）通过简单聚合掩盖了数据集稀缺、冗余和相关性带来的不可靠结论，特别是在斯拉夫语系等中低资源语言上缺乏对评估证据可靠性的系统度量。
AI.method: 提出二维框架：(1)任务特定层面与跨任务层面；(2)三个互补维度——排序稳定性（聚合稳定性W_RS与组成稳定性W_DS，使用Kendall W）、top-k迁移一致性（基于秩加权扩展）、证据强度（引入5级证据等级E₀–E_RS+DS与定量ESS，结合数据集可用性、有效多样性、可评估性）。使用15种MCDM排名方案（WSM/TOPSIS/VIKOR/PROMETHEE II × 等权/MEREC/CRITIC），相关系数τ=0.9去冗余，应用于MTEB 12种斯拉夫语言与8类任务。
AI.result: 分析揭示斯拉夫语系基准严重稀疏：STS、重排、句子对分类等任务近乎完全缺失；bitext mining是唯一可同时评估聚合稳定性与组成稳定性的任务（ESS最高达0.85）。任务特定层面：llama-embed-nemotron-8b主导聚类与重排；Qwen3变体主导分类与句子对分类；bitext mining中bge-m3在高证据语言胜出，multilingual-e5-large-instruct在低证据语言胜出。跨任务层面：llama-embed-nemotron-8b（55.6%语言）、multilingual-e5-large-instruct（33.3%）、Qwen3-Embedding-4B（11.1%，仅波兰语）形成"通用型"小集群；俄罗斯是唯一全任务覆盖且ESS最高（0.49）的语言。模型可分为"任务专家型"（如bge-m3、LaBSE-ru-turbo、Octen-Embedding-8B、KaLM-Embedding-Gemma3-12B-2511）与"通用型"两类。
AI.conclusion: 基准排名与稳健性结论必须与证据强度联合解读；高稳定性+低ESS仅反映评估覆盖不足而非真实稳定性。斯拉夫语系普遍存在的数据稀缺与冗余是多语言可信评估的主要障碍，需建设更丰富、更任务均衡的基准资源。

title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
summary: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty. While effective for acquiring informative evidence, this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. Missing a severe condition may matter more than reducing uncertainty among less consequential alternatives. Question acquisition should therefore consider not only how informative new evidence is, but also how it is expected to affect the downstream diagnostic decision. To this end, we propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, so next-question selection requires no teacher-side computation at deployment. Across three Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, matched ESR supervision reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from .0645 to .0455 (-29.5%) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from .9123 to .9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the two objectives remain behaviorally distinct when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk control shows that severity-aware weighting improves the high-severity error profile beyond generic decision-aware supervision. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR)目标函数，将医学对话中的问题选择从单纯的信息增益驱动转变为后果驱动的证据获取策略，通过严重程度加权的终端风险评估每个候选问题。
AI.motivation: 现有主动医疗对话方法主要基于信息增益（不确定性减少）来选择问题，忽视了医学诊断中不同诊断错误的严重程度差异——漏诊严重疾病的后果远大于在不太严重的替代方案间降低不确定性。
AI.method: 提出ESR目标：(1)定义严重程度加权的终端风险R_sev，对更严重的疾病赋予更高的误诊代价；(2)在问题选择时（答案未观测）通过对可能答案的边际化处理，计算每个候选问题的预期风险减少值；(3)将教师模型的排名蒸馏到仅基于前缀的语言策略（Qwen3-4B + LoRA），部署时不需教师计算。设置E-Entropy（信息熵）和Exp.-0/1-Risk（均匀风险）作为对照。
AI.result: 在DDxPlus九病种子集上，三个Qwen3-4B训练种子（42/43/44）的匹配比较显示：ESR将高严重度条件漏诊率(HSM)从0.0645降至0.0455（-29.5%），诊断准确率从0.9123提升至0.9320，仅多问0.14个问题。固定预算分析表明两种目标在问题数受控时仍行为不同；Exp.-0/1-Risk对照验证了严重程度加权（而非泛化的决策感知监督）才是HSM改善的关键。
AI.conclusion: ESR为后果感知的证据获取提供了一种实用方法，使主动医疗对话中的问题监督与下游诊断后果对齐，超越了单纯的不确定性减少范式。严重程度加权而非泛化决策风险是关键改进因素。

title: Is Discrete Difficulty Sufficient? Leveraging Continuous Difficulty for Efficient Self-Consistency in LLMs
summary: Self-Consistency (SC) is a decoding strategy that samples diverse reasoning paths and selects the most consistent answer, demonstrating strong performance on complex reasoning problems. However, the excessive token consumption incurred by generating multiple reasoning paths has been identified as a major limitation of SC. To improve computational efficiency, several studies have proposed strategies that adjust the number of reasoning paths or allocate resources differentially according to problem difficulty. Nevertheless, most existing methods categorize difficulty into a few fixed levels, failing to fully capture the continuously varying nature of reasoning complexity. In this work, we propose Flexible Self-Consistency (FSC), which estimates problem difficulty as a continuous signal and dynamically adjusts the number of generated reasoning paths accordingly. FSC predicts the output entropy of an input question using a pre-trained probe and leverages it as an indicator of model uncertainty to flexibly control the sampling budget. Experimental results show that, across various models and benchmarks, FSC maintains accuracy comparable to SC while achieving token savings of up to 76%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flexible Self-Consistency（FSC）方法，通过训练轻量级线性探针预测输出熵作为连续难度信号，动态调整Self-Consistency的采样路径数量，在保持准确率的同时显著降低token消耗（最高76%）。
AI.motivation: Self-Consistency（SC）通过采样多条推理路径并投票提升推理性能，但存在token消耗过大的问题。现有改进方法通常将问题难度离散化为"易/难"等少数固定级别，无法精细捕捉推理复杂度的连续变化，导致资源分配不够精准。
AI.method: FSC包含两个阶段：(1)为每个输入问题生成N条推理轨迹，统计答案频率分布并计算输出熵作为难度标签，训练一个轻量级线性探针（基于last-token embedding）预测该熵值；(2)推理时，探针预测新问题的输出熵（经clipping限制在[0, log₂N]），归一化后按比例动态分配采样预算N_adj = ⌈1+(N-1)·Ĥq/log₂N⌉，简单问题分配1条路径，困难问题分配最多N条。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5(3B/7B/14B)和Gemma-3-4B上的MATH500、AMC23、AIME2024、AIME2025、GPQA-Diamond五个基准测试中，FSC保持与SC及其他基线（AC、ESC、DSC）相当的准确率，同时实现最高76.7%的token节省。在MMLU-Pro跨域OOD评估中也表现出稳定高效的泛化能力。探针预测的熵值随难度级别递增且在不同基准间呈现合理分布，证明其学习到了可泛化的连续难度信号。
AI.conclusion: 输出熵可以作为替代传统离散难度分类的连续难度信号；FSC通过轻量级线性探针预测熵值并据此动态分配采样预算，在保持准确性的同时大幅降低推理token消耗，是一种高效、通用的测试时扩展策略。但仍存在未在更大模型上验证、依赖模型内部表示（不适用于闭源模型）、探针训练数据局限于数学领域等局限。

title: Quantization Effects on Bangla Language Understanding in Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation
summary: Post-training quantization lowers the memory footprint of Large Language Models (LLMs) and speeds up inference, which is why it is now common for on-device deployment. Most of what we know about its effects, however, comes from English benchmarks. It is not clear whether the same holds for morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Bangla, and this gap is what we address here. We evaluate three model families---Qwen-2.5-7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and GPT-OSS-20B---in full precision and in three quantized formats (GPTQ-Int8, GPTQ-Q8, GGUF-W8A16) across five Bangla natural language understanding benchmarks (Bangla MMLU, CommonsenseQA-BN, OpenBookQA-BN, PIQA-BN, and BoolQ-BN), using zero-shot evaluation through lm-evaluation-harness. To our knowledge this is the first controlled comparison of quantization formats on Bangla NLU. The three families do not respond the same way: GPT-OSS loses up to 57.35% accuracy on reasoning-heavy tasks under GGUF-W8A16, while Qwen and LLaMA hold steady under GPTQ, and in a few cases the quantized version edges out the full-precision one. BoolQ-BN, a comprehension task, stays stable across all three families regardless of format. Taken together, these results suggest quantization can work well for Bangla deployment, but the choice of architecture and quantization method matters more than the bit width alone. We discuss what this means for practitioners choosing a model to run on constrained hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了后训练量化(PTQ)对孟加拉语(Bangla)大语言模型自然语言理解能力的影响,发现量化影响主要取决于模型架构和量化格式,而非语言本身或位宽。Qwen和LLaMA经GPTQ量化后几乎无损,而GPT-OSS经GGUF量化后在推理任务上崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有量化研究几乎全部基于英语基准,缺乏对孟加拉语等低资源、形态复杂语言的评估。孟加拉语的黏着语形态、辅音连缀和Unicode字素组合可能使量化误差加剧,该研究填补这一空白。
AI.method: 评估三个模型家族(Qwen-2.5-7B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、GPT-OSS-20B)的全精度与三种量化格式(GPTQ-Int8、GPTQ-Q8、GGUF-W8A16),在五个孟加拉语NLU基准(Bangla MMLU、CommonsenseQA-BN、OpenBookQA-BN、PIQA-BN、BoolQ-BN)上通过lm-evaluation-harness进行零样本评估。
AI.result: 主要发现:(1) GPT-OSS在GGUF-W8A16下推理任务准确率下降高达57.4%(CommonsenseQA-BN)和54.1%(OpenBookQA-BN);(2) Qwen和LLaMA经GPTQ量化后所有基准下降均小于1.5%,部分场景量化版反超;(3) BoolQ-BN阅读理解任务在所有家族中均稳定;(4) 推理和常识任务比阅读理解对量化更敏感。
AI.conclusion: GPTQ-Int8/Q8适用于Qwen和LLaMA的孟加拉语边缘部署;GGUF-W8A16在孟加拉语推理任务上不可靠;架构与量化格式的选择比位宽更重要。量化影响主要追踪架构而非语言本身,这是首个针对孟加拉语受控量化对比研究。未来工作需扩展至INT4格式、Bangla原生模型及生成式任务。

title: Beyond Semantic Accuracy: Consequence-Aware Evaluation for Safety-Critical Language Understanding
summary: Can language models be trusted in safety- critical operations? In such settings, strong per- formance on semantic metrics does not guaran- tee operational reliability: a misread altitude, a dropped execution condition, or a confused call- sign may score well under standard F1 yet carry sharply asymmetric operational consequences. We study this problem in air traffic control (ATC), where controller-pilot communication demands near-zero error tolerance, and use consequence-aware evaluation to test whether semantic scores misstate operational reliabil- ity. The framework is instantiated in a con- trolled diagnostic ATC benchmark grounded in aviation standards and feedback from 40 air traffic controllers across three countries. Evaluating 8 models, we uncover a system- atic semantic-safety gap: conventional scores give substantially higher performance estimates than consequence-aware evaluation, even for models that appear reliable under standard met- rics. Risk-aware fine-tuning narrows but does not close this gap, showing that consequence- aware evaluation is a necessary complement to standard NLP metrics before any real safety- critical deployment claim

AI.tldr: 本文提出"后果感知评估"框架，揭示标准语义指标在安全关键型语言理解任务中系统性高估运行可靠性，并以空中交通管制(ATC)为测试场景验证语义-安全差距。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景中，标准NLP指标(如F1、NER)对所有错误一视同仁，无法区分"无害的格式差异"与"可能引发运行事故的关键信息丢失"。这种语义准确性与运行可靠性之间的脱节，使得模型在语义得分很高的情况下仍可能产生危险的错误判断，亟需一种能够编码操作后果的评估方法。
AI.method: 1. 构建双任务诊断数据集：Task 1(结构化指令理解，500条)与Task 2(管制-飞行员复诵安全判断，1000条)，由5名ATC专家标注、40名三国(中国/新加坡/印度)管制员提供严重度评级。2. 提出后果感知评分AR-Geo(几何平均)与NER-Geo，采用非线性聚合使高风险槽位的遗漏不可被低风险匹配补偿。3. 引入方向性安全校准指标DDR(危险降级率)与WDS(加权降级严重度)。4. 评估8个模型(含gpt-5.4、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、qwen3-8b等)，对比零样本/知识/少样本/全对齐提示与风险感知LoRA微调。5. 通过200条专家接受度评分与配对偏好研究验证指标对齐度。
AI.result: 1. 系统性语义-安全差距普遍存在：例如gpt-5.4零样本NER-F1=0.737但AR-Geo仅0.541；qwen3-8b的NER-F1=0.308而AR-Geo仅0.109。2. AR-Geo与管制员接受度评分相关性(Pearson r=0.68)显著优于NER-F1(r=0.44)。3. 执行条件(condition)是跨任务最薄弱环节，占AR-Geo崩塌实例的50.6%。4. 风险感知LoRA微调效果最佳：qwen3-8b的AR-Geo从0.109提升至0.686，且优于标准CE微调(0.515)。5. 提示工程与微调均无法完全闭合差距；Task 1结构理解能力相似(gpt-4o-mini与qwen-plus AR-Geo≈0.34)的模型在Task 2危险降级率上差异达9倍(0.459 vs 0.049)。
AI.conclusion: 标准语义指标对安全关键型语言理解任务的可靠性评估存在系统性高估问题。后果感知评估能够揭示被传统指标掩盖的关键失效模式，是安全部署前的必要补充测量手段，而非替代。该框架可推广至任何能定义动作清单、关键槽位与严重度等级的高风险领域，但当前成果仅为诊断框架而非可部署系统。

title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. The companion website is available at this https URL
summary: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.

AI.tldr: 该论文对Reddit上关于对话式AI系统（CAIS）模型发布的长期讨论进行了大规模分析，揭示了不同提供商（Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI、DeepSeek等）在模型发布前后用户情感和主题讨论的动态变化模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将用户对CAIS的感知视为静态快照，忽视了CAIS通过模型发布、功能更新、安全干预和访问策略变化而不断演变的事实。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，系统研究用户对跨提供商CAIS干预措施（尤其是新模型发布）的感知反应。
AI.method: 基于668,063条Reddit帖子（2022年10月至2025年12月，涵盖20个子版块和9家提供商）的语料库，采用三阶段方法：(1) 使用LLM结合四级分类法（provider-family-generation-tier）识别模型提及；(2) 使用LLooM框架从语料库中归纳主题概念，构建包含236个概念的规范概念库（CCB）；(3) 基于LLM的情感分类器进行情感分析。在提供商特定的发布对称时间窗口内比较发布前后的情感份额和概念流行度变化。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 整体讨论偏负面（38%负面 vs 20%正面）；(2) OpenAI和Google随时间推移从中性转向负面，而Anthropic是唯一呈正向趋势的提供商；(3) Anthropic发布平均带来+3.0/-4.4pp的正负面情感变化，Claude 4是最有利的发布（+5.3/-10.5pp）；(4) GPT-5呈现强烈负面反应（-3.5/+10.3pp），GPT-5.1出现部分恢复；(5) GPT-4o引发最大的"期望差距"（+19.4pp），因发布会展示的能力与实际可用能力之间的落差；(6) DeepSeek R1是最大的负面异常值，呈现"需求冲击"模式（讨论量增长19倍）；(7) Grok-3呈现正面和负面情感同时上升的分化反应，与政治话语和人格化互动密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 模型发布不仅是技术更新，更是面向用户的干预措施，会重塑情感、期望和公共讨论。论文提出实践建议：能力宣传应与用户实际可访问的功能保持一致；过渡期间应尽量保留已建立的模型；应为发布驱动的需求做好基础设施准备；将发布与具体工作流或用例配对以提升实际价值；持续监测发布后的用户反应而非将其视为一次性事件。

title: From local kernels to global form: modeling the emergence of musical content
comment: Accepted at XXV CIM - Colloquio di Informatica Musicale, L'Aquila, 2026
summary: Markov models are established tools for symbolic music, including non-homogeneous formulations. The narrower contribution examined here is an observation-driven estimation mechanism: overlapping sliding windows derive a trajectory of local transition kernels from one symbolic sequence rather than from an exogenous formal partition. We test this mechanism on 273 logical note events from Debussy's Syrinx (1913), using the often-proposed A-B-A' reading as a reference rather than ground truth. We apply the same validation to absolute-pitch and notated-duration kernels. At $L=6$, both reference boundaries attain the Jensen--Shannon maximum in both dimensions; the duration plateau is substantially narrower (64 of 267 comparisons) than the pitch plateau (210 of 267). Because the theoretical maximum for consecutive sliding-window comparisons is set by window geometry and equals $1/\sqrt{L-1}$ for maximal turnover of the entering/leaving transition, the pitch value at $L=6$ and its broad plateau are not, by themselves, strong evidence. Their cross-dimensional alignment is consistent with boundary sensitivity, while the broad plateaus preclude treating either curve alone as a unique automatic segmenter. Five-hundred-draw re-synthesis experiments quantify departure from the source in both dimensions and expose an exact-copy degeneracy at $L=2$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于滑动窗口从单一符号序列直接估计局部一阶马尔可夫转移核轨迹的方法,保留马尔可夫性但放宽时齐性假设,并以德彪西《潘神之笛》(273个音符事件)为案例,在音高与时值两个维度上验证其分析能力与生成能力。
AI.motivation: 全局时齐一阶马尔可夫链将整个作品的转移信息压缩到单一矩阵中,无法区分处于不同结构位置的相同事件,丢掉了使序列作为"形式"可被感知的时序上下文;高阶模型虽能加深上下文深度,但仍保持时齐性,且会带来状态空间爆炸与稀疏问题。因此需要一种保留一阶马尔可夫性、但允许转移核随时间变化、且直接从数据而非外部形式划分估计的机制。
AI.method: 给定长度为T的符号序列与窗口长度L,以步长1构造重叠滑动窗口w_m,每个窗口含L−1个转移,据此估计局部计数矩阵C^(m)并按行归一化得P^(m),形成转移核轨迹𝒫={P^(m)};空行回退到全局核P^(G)。在L∈{2,6,20}下,对Debussy《Syrinx》的273个逻辑音符事件并行建立音高(28状态)与时值(23有理状态)两条轨迹,使用JS散度、Hellinger距离与Frobenius距离度量相邻窗口间的转移分布变化,并以A–B–A'中mm.9和mm.26两个参考边界为对照;另以500次随机种子执行中心对齐重合成,报告事件不匹配率、全局JS与分段JS。
AI.result: L=6时,两个参考边界在音高与时值两条曲线上同时达到JS最大值0.447(理论上限1/√(L−1)),音高曲线在该最大值处形成宽平台(210/267比较),时值曲线平台显著更窄(64/267),时值维度选择性更强;L=20时两侧证据不对称;L=2时由于每个局部行仅含单一观察转移,重合成产生精确复制退化;500次重合成中,L=6下音高不匹配率均值0.678,时值0.344,均显著偏离源序列但仍保持可解析的局部结构。
AI.conclusion: 滑动窗口局部核能在《Syrinx》中以可解释、数据驱动的方式揭示被全局估计器掩盖的形式变化,音高与时值的跨维度一致支持边界敏感性;但宽平台与几何约束表明这并非唯一的自动分割方案,结果应被理解为多尺度观察的案例级一致性证据,而非语料库层面的通用分割器;未来工作应使用非重叠的前后窗口对比,并在更大语料上预定义比较滞后、正则化、跨维度规则与参考容差。

title: One Timeline, Many Renderings: A Wolfram Language Paclet for heterogeneous musical output
comment: Accepted at the International Csound Conference (ICSC) 2026
summary: One algorithmic composition may require a Csound score, engraved notation, real-time control, and a rehearsal click. Authored separately, their timelines drift. Temporal System is a Wolfram Language paclet that instead compiles one immutable store of typed entities on a rational beat timeline through backend-specific contracts. It emits Csound synthesis, beta MusicXML 4.0, OSC control, and click artifacts that remain synchronized because they share that store. Conversion to seconds, samples, or hertz occurs only at render time. Csound notes use stable named instruments in external .orc files; curves become k-rate signals declared against score p-fields. The click backend derives rehearsal audio from the same meter and tempo and reuses the Csound serializer. We describe the temporal, semantic, and rendering-contract layers, their practical trade-offs, and the limits of this proprietary authoring environment within an otherwise open-source ecosystem. The archived supplement exposes the reported outputs pending paclet release.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个 Wolfram Language 的 paclet（包）工具 Temporal System，它能从一个统一的、不可变的、基于有理数节拍时间轴的数据存储，自动编译生成多种异构的乐谱输出（Csound 合成、MusicXML 乐谱、OSC 实时控制、排练节拍器音轨），避免各输出之间的时间漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 算法作曲中，同一作品往往需要同时生成多种格式的输出（Csound 分数、雕刻乐谱、实时控制信号、排练节拍），若分别编写，各时间轴容易发生漂移。现有工具（如 music21、Abjad、MEI/Verovio、bach、Tidal）各有侧重，但缺少一个能在统一显式契约下兼顾记谱法、离线 Csound、OSC 控制与节拍器输出的统一框架。
AI.method: 采用三层架构：(I) 时间层——将 BPM 阶梯式节奏点编译成分段线性的 {节拍, 秒} 映射，分析求逆，保持有理性直至渲染；(II) 语义层——不可变类型化实体存储（笔记、休止、触发器、曲线、状态、标记、注释），按类型 O(1) 访问；(III) 渲染契约层——每个后端（Csound、MusicXML、OSC、Click）通过统一的调度器读取同一存储，按各自契约序列化为目标格式（Csound 使用外部 .orc 命名乐器，曲线通过复制重写乐器体绑定 p-field；MusicXML 按拍号切分小节并降阶表达；OSC 按控制率采样；Click 复用 Csound 序列化器）。所有函数纯函数式，存储操作返回新存储。
AI.result: 成功实现了 14 个模块、80 个公共函数，支持四种后端的同步投影。通过两个 4/4 小节（120 BPM）后接 3/4（90 BPM）的示例，验证了将第二段改为 60 BPM 后 Csound、OSC、Click 在秒级层面同步偏移（4.667→5.0 秒），而 MusicXML 仅改变速度标记，节拍空间不变。Click 后端仅约 140 行代码复用 serializeCSnd 即可生成 .csd/.wav。补充资料已存档于 Zenodo。
AI.conclusion: Temporal System 实现了"一个时间轴，多种渲染"的构想，证明了统一存储加延迟单位转换策略的有效性。当前局限：Wolfram 语言环境为商业授权（虽然输出完全开放），MusicXML 仍为 beta，无 MIDI 输出，无连续渐变速支持，Csound 曲线绑定依赖乐器体复制重写（计划改用命名通道）。未来工作包括 paclet 正式发布、MIDI 后端、语言中立的核心序列化与 Python/Julia 移植。

title: The Annotation Bottleneck in Persian Text NLP: Persian as an Annotation-Scarce Language
summary: Persian (Farsi) is often described as a low-resource language in natural language processing, but that label collapses distinct shortages into a single category. This paper argues that Persian is more precisely described as annotation-scarce, provided that the term is understood as a property of its NLP resource ecology rather than an intrinsic property of the language. The review covers 34 representative Persian text resources available by July 2026 and adds three quantitative cross-checks. First, independent web measurements place Persian among roughly the twenty most visible content languages: W3Techs reports Persian on about 0.9% of websites with a known content language, while Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 identifies Persian as the primary language of 0.7039% of HTML pages. Second, a selective speech review shows a long resource trajectory from FARSDAT to recent corpora containing hundreds or thousands of hours of speech. Third, a matched Persian-English comparison normalizes task-specific annotation volumes by relative Common Crawl web presence. The resulting ratios vary sharply: Persian syntax and news NER are comparatively dense, whereas natural-language inference falls below the web-proportional baseline. The evidence therefore does not support a simple claim that Persian is globally deficient in labeled volume. Instead, annotation scarcity is expressed through uneven task and domain coverage, incompatible schemes, access and documentation friction, and limited supervision for specialist domains, preference data, and varieties beyond standard Iranian Persian.

AI.tldr: 本文批判"低资源"这一笼统标签，主张波斯语（Farsi）在NLP中应更精确地描述为"标注稀缺"（annotation-scarce）语言——即稀缺体现在其NLP资源生态系统中，而非语言本身。该结论基于对34个波斯语文本资源的综述以及三项定量交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将波斯语简单归类为"低资源语言"，但该标签混淆了多种不同类型的资源短缺（如原始文本量不足、标注数据不足、领域覆盖不足等），掩盖了资源生态的真实结构。作者旨在对波斯语NLP资源现状进行精细化、多维度的重新刻画。
AI.method: 1. 系统综述截至2026年7月可获取的34个代表性波斯语文本资源；2. 三项定量交叉验证：（a）独立网络测量（W3Techs与Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30）评估波斯语的网络可见度；（b）选择性语音资源综述（从FARSDAT到近期大规模语音语料库）；（c）按相对Common Crawl网络存在感进行归一化的波斯语-英语任务标注体量匹配对比。
AI.result: 网络测量显示波斯语属全球约前20大内容语言（W3Techs约0.9%，Common Crawl为0.7039%）；波斯语在句法标注和新闻领域NER上相对密集，但自然语言推理（NLI）标注低于网络比例基线。证据不支持"波斯语在全球标注体量上整体不足"的简单论断。
AI.conclusion: 波斯语的稀缺性主要体现为标注资源的任务与领域覆盖不均、标注方案互不兼容、访问与文档摩擦、以及在专业领域、偏好数据和伊朗标准波斯语之外方言变体的标注稀缺，而非原始或标注数据的全局性匮乏。因此应将"低资源"重新概念化为"标注稀缺"，并以此指导更具针对性的资源建设。

title: Lost in Speech: Trilingual Spoken Hallucination Detection Across Audio and Transcripts
summary: While text-based hallucination detection has been extensively studied, spoken hallucination detection remains largely unexplored, particularly for low-resource languages. We present the first multilingual spoken hallucination benchmark comprising 12,013 news samples across English, Russian, and Kazakh with controlled hallucinations of three types and three severity levels. Samples comprise original articles and aligned hallucinated counterparts in text and audio. We complement the synthetic corpus with 290 fact-checked fake news items collected natively in Russian (225) and Kazakh (65), translated into the other language and rendered through the same TTS-ASR pipeline. We assess fine-tuned multilingual encoders and, in zero-shot in-context settings, multimodal decoder models on transcript-based versus direct audio processing. Transcript-based detection generally outperforms direct audio processing, with binary-task degradation for strong encoders tracking per-language ASR error. On real-world fakes, synthetic-trained detectors transfer strongly (macro-F1 0.82-0.88 on original text), while Russian provenance analysis reveals both veracity-related and model-dependent machine-style signals, quantifying a key confound in synthetic hallucination benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了首个多语言口语幻觉检测基准，涵盖英、俄、哈萨克三种语言的12,013条新闻样本（含3种幻觉类型和3个严重程度等级），并附带290条真实世界假新闻评估集。研究比较了基于转录文本与直接音频的检测方法，发现转录文本普遍优于直接音频，ASR错误率与检测性能下降正相关，且低资源哈萨克语退化最显著。
AI.motivation: 现有文本幻觉检测研究充分，但口语幻觉检测（尤其是低资源语言）几乎空白；多阶段TTS→ASR流水线引入级联噪声，使问题更具挑战性；合成基准存在"文本来源与标签完美相关"的固有混淆，需用真实世界假新闻验证迁移能力。
AI.method: 构建三语合成语料库（英/俄/哈），通过LLM生成3种幻觉类型（捏造、矛盾、上下文不一致）×3种严重程度（轻度、中度、重度）的新闻改写，经语言特定TTS合成并用最佳ASR转录；另从factcheck.kz收集290条真实假新闻；评估微调多语言编码器（XLM-R、mDeBERTa、ReMBERT）与零样本多模态解码器（Qwen2.5-Omni等5个模型）；使用LLM-as-a-judge与人工抽样验证质量。
AI.result: （1）转录文本检测普遍优于直接音频；（2）微调编码器二元F1为0.52–0.89，但类型/严重程度细粒度任务F1仅0.14–0.68；（3）mDeBERTa跨语言最稳健，二元性能退化与ASR错误率正相关，哈萨克退化最严重（WER 34%）；（4）合成训练在真实世界假新闻上迁移良好（macro-F1 0.82–0.88）；（5）俄语来源分析揭示检测器同时依赖真实性与机器风格信号——ReMBERT几乎标记所有机器生成文本，mDeBERTa则更具真实性区分力。
AI.conclusion: 口语幻觉检测受模态和语言资源影响显著；中间文本表征仍是可靠抽象层；低资源设置放大了语音流水线噪声的影响；细粒度分类仍具挑战；合成基准的二元信号受文本来源混淆影响，需引入来源受控的评估分割；未来工作应关注噪声鲁棒的多模态建模与来源鲁棒的检测目标。

title: Arbitrary Polygon Oscillator: Generalizing Polygonal Synthesis to Arbitrary Shapes, Morphing, and Three-Dimensional Polyhedra
comment: Accepted at 29th International Conference on Digital Audio Effects September 1 - 4, 2026 MIT, Cambridge, MA, USA
summary: Polygonal synthesis generates audio by traversing the perimeter of a polygon with a phasor; prior work uses a constant angular velocity, whereas the proposed system adopts constant arc-length (perimeter) velocity. Existing formulations operate on regular, parametrically defined polygons, producing smooth timbral transitions within a single family of shapes. This paper generalizes polygonal synthesis around a unified arc-length engine: vertex data of any origin feed the same DSP pipeline. First, we adapt the oscillator to accept arbitrary vertex configurations from an external buffer, opening the possibility for a broad class of closed polygons -- regular, irregular, or star-shaped -- to function as a waveform generator. Second, a hybrid interpolation algorithm enables smooth morphing between polygons with unequal vertex counts, passing through intermediate shapes that have no parametric description. Third, we extend the paradigm to three dimensions: a convex polyhedron rotated about three axes is sliced by a fixed horizontal plane, and the resulting cross-section yields a continuously variable polygon controlled by the solid's orientation. The system runs in RNBO (Cycling~'74) with a geometry caching strategy that avoids per-sample recomputation. Antialiasing combines a four-point polyBLAMP correction derived from runtime Bézier tangents with adaptive oversampling, adapting the correction geometrically to general vertex configurations without per-shape analytical derivation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"任意多边形振荡器"(Arbitrary Polygon Oscillator),将多边形合成从规则的参数化多边形推广到任意形状、多边形间形变以及三维多面体截面,核心创新在于以弧长参数化(恒定周长速度)替代传统的恒定角速度遍历,并通过统一的基于顶点的DSP管线实现多样化的波形生成能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的多边形合成(Chapman、Hohnerlein等人)局限于规则的、参数化定义的多边形(如通过Schläfli符号或连续阶数参数n描述的规则多边形),只能在单一形状族内产生平滑的音色过渡。本文旨在打破这一限制,使任意闭合多边形——包括不规则、凹形、星形或自由绘制的形状——都能作为波形生成器,并支持形状间平滑形变,产生参数化方法无法表达的中间形态。
AI.method: 系统采用基于弧长的参数化方法,核心包含三大模块:(1)任意多边形振荡器:从外部顶点缓冲区读取N个顶点,使用Gravesen近似计算二次Bézier边的弧长,以恒定周长速度遍历多边形,输出原生立体声信号(x,y坐标);(2)混合形变插值算法:对凸多边形使用角度对应(angular correspondence),对凹形使用基于周长中点扩展(perimeter midpoint expansion),引入"休眠顶点"(sleeping vertices)机制处理不等顶点数量问题,并通过循环对齐、写入回退(v0一致性)和20ms smoothstep交叉淡变保证多边形序列切换时的连续性;(3)3D扩展:对凸多面体施加三轴旋转,用固定水平面切割产生截面多边形,输出顶点数通过休眠顶点固定为边数,保证拓扑稳定性。抗混叠采用四点polyBLAMP校正(从运行时Bézier切线推导导数跳变,无需逐形状解析推导)结合自适应过采样(OS∈[2,6])。谱分析证明了谐波格点公式H(M,W)={(mM±W)f₀}仅取决于旋转对称阶数M和绕数W,与顶点数无关。
AI.result: 在44100 Hz采样率下,针对等边三角形的SNR测量显示:OS=2+四点polyBLAMP组合在400 Hz达到85.1 dB(直边)和83.4 dB(κ=-0.234),polyBLAMP单独使用带来约22 dB的改善;谱分析证实不同顶点数但相同对称阶数的形状(如五角星10v、五边形5v、齿轮15v、风车10v)共享相同的谐波格点H(5),非格点谐波低于-80 dB分析底噪;3D案例中立方体从正方形连续扫掠至近正六边形,四棱锥从正方形扫掠至三角形,实现拓扑转换过程中的C⁰连续性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将多边形合成从"参数化形状"范式转变为"顶点绘制"范式,通过统一的弧长引擎支持任意闭合多边形、不等顶点数的多边形间平滑形变,以及通过平面切割实现的三维多面体控制。"休眠顶点"机制是确保所有拓扑转换中输出顶点数恒定的关键。系统以RNBO实现,几何缓存策略避免了逐样本重计算。感知引导的形变轨迹建模和更高阶多面体扩展被列为未来工作。

title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framework for continuous skill evolution that enables skills to be verified and refined through environment interaction. By making skill usage explicit during agent interaction, RL can directly optimize both environment actions and skill invocation decisions. SkillForge further introduces evidence-based skill verification and multi-pathway skill induction, allowing the skill bank to continuously grow while maintaining its quality. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld show that SkillForge consistently outperforms SkillRL, demonstrating the effectiveness of continuously verified skills in training stronger LLM agents.

AI.tldr: SkillForge是一个用于强化学习智能体的技能持续演化框架，通过显式技能调用、基于证据的技能验证和多路径技能归纳机制，解决了现有方法（如SkillRL）将技能库视为仅追加存储而无法验证技能有效性的问题。在ALFWorld、WebShop和AppWorld三个基准上均优于SkillRL。
AI.motivation: 现有基于技能的方法（如SkillRL）从原始轨迹中提取技能，但将技能库视为仅追加（append-only）的存储库，存在三个关键局限：(1) 技能使用不可观测——技能被批量注入prompt，无法判断智能体是否真正依赖某项技能；(2) 技能有效性难以归因——缺少显式使用信号，无法判断成功轨迹是否由特定技能引起；(3) 技能质量不受控——错误或过时的技能可能无限期留在技能库中，逐渐污染知识库。需要一种能够通过环境交互持续验证和优化技能的机制。
AI.method: SkillForge框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 技能表示与检索——技能采用结构化模式（title、intent、principle、applicability、category、status），通过嵌入相似度检索top-K技能，仅将紧凑目录注入prompt；(2) 显式技能调用与策略优化——智能体通过<skill_call>结构化标签显式调用技能，每次调用作为离散事件记录在轨迹中，使RL能联合优化环境动作和技能调用决策，采用GRPO训练；(3) 技能演化——包括多路径技能归纳（从成功轨迹提取/从失败轨迹精炼/对比分析三种路径，使用教师LLM合成新技能并去重）和基于证据的技能验证（跟踪每项技能的EMA成功率和使用次数，计算欠表现分数conf(s)=(1-p̂_s)·(1-0.5^(n_s/h))，高分技能优先进行LLM反思，决定keep或revise）。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld三个基准上的实验结果：(1) 使用Qwen2.5-7B，SkillForge在ALFWorld达到93.6%，WebShop得分89.8/成功率83.0%，AppWorld TGC/SGC为23.8/14.3，分别比GRPO提升+16.0/+10.5（+16.9成功率），比SkillRL在ALFWorld提升+3.7，WebShop成功率提升+10.3，AppWorld SGC从5.36增至14.3；(2) Qwen3-30B-A3B取得最佳结果（ALFWorld 94.3%，AppWorld TGC 59.5%）；(3) 消融实验验证了显式调用、多路径归纳、去重、效果追踪和LLM反思各组件的贡献；(4) 技能库可跨模型规模迁移——Qwen3-4B在step-80的技能库迁移到Qwen3-30B-A3B效果与自演化相当；(5) 技能相关开销低于10%总训练时间，且训练时间少于SkillRL；(6) 教师敏感性分析表明框架本身（即使使用自教师）也能带来显著增益，Qwen3-Max作为教师可进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: SkillForge通过使技能使用在智能体交互中显式化，使强化学习能够同时优化环境动作和技能调用决策，同时引入基于证据的技能验证和多路径技能归纳机制，在技能库增长的同时保持技能质量。实验证明，在三个多样化基准上，SkillForge持续优于现有方法（包括SkillRL），且无需SFT初始化阶段。这突显了在训练过程中持续验证和精炼技能的重要性，并指向开放式环境中更具适应性、以技能驱动的强化学习智能体方向。局限包括：依赖外部教师LLM的质量、技能库可能持续增长带来检索开销、显式技能调用增加token消耗和推理成本。

title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
summary: Text-to-CAD aims to generate executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, real-world descriptions are often underspecified and omit critical spatial constraints required for valid CAD construction, a challenge that has been largely overlooked by existing methods. In this paper, we argue that missing spatial constraints should be inferred with respect to the underlying construction structure and informed by reusable design experience. Based on this insight, we propose ExpConCAD, an experience-enhanced framework for implicit spatial constraint completion. ExpConCAD first recovers the intended construction structure and constraint scopes, then retrieves relevant constraint-completion experience for similar scopes to complete the missing spatial constraints, and finally generates executable CadQuery programs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpConCAD and provide insights into the role of construction structure understanding and experience memory in spatial constraint completion. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ExpConCAD提出了一种从含隐式空间约束的非完整自然语言描述生成可执行CAD程序(CadQuery)的新框架。该方法通过构建结构理解(CSU)、空间约束补全(SCC)以及经验记忆库,从失败案例中提炼可复用的约束补全模式,在CadFusion-Hard基准上显著优于现有方法,并展现出良好的跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-CAD方法依赖用户显式提供详细的建模操作、几何参数和空间关系,而真实场景下的描述往往仅给出高层语义信息(如"带两个通孔的平板"),省略了生成有效CAD所必需的关键空间约束(如刀具包容性、刀具间距、贯穿切割等),导致生成的CAD模型存在孔洞重叠等结构错误。现有方法如CADFusion仅通过端到端视觉对齐来缓解欠定性问题,无法泛化到未见过的空间布局,缺乏对隐式空间约束的显式推理能力。
AI.method: ExpConCAD包含三个核心组件:(1)构建结构理解(CSU):识别CAD元素、建模操作及约束作用域(如刀具-基板布局、刀具间间距);(2)空间约束补全(SCC):在已识别作用域内补全缺失的坐标条件、距离约束、尺寸关系等;(3)经验记忆库:从历史失败案例中通过VLM-as-judge诊断+迭代验证提炼可复用的约束补全模式(when-what-how三元组),推理时通过BGE嵌入+余弦相似度Top-k检索相关经验。整体流程为:输入→CSU识别作用域→查询检索经验→SCC补全约束→生成CadQuery代码→执行验证与修正。
AI.result: 在CadFusion-Hard基准上,ExpConCAD相对最强基线将VLM-Score在Qwen3.5-27B上提升22.5%、GPT-5上提升27.9%。消融实验表明构建结构理解(CSU)是空间约束补全(SCC)有效的前提,经验记忆库中存储作用域级而非案例级的可复用模式时效果最佳。在Text2CAD-Hard跨数据集测试中,经验知识仍能带来提升,而CADFusion出现性能下降,证明了约束补全模式的可迁移性而非数据集形状记忆。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了Text-to-CAD应从"重构用户显式描述的几何"转向"推断用户未表达的设计意图",ExpConCAD通过将构建结构理解与可复用经验记忆相结合,有效解决了欠定描述中隐式空间约束的补全问题,为面向人机协作的CAD智能体提供了新方向。未来需研究经验记忆库的更新、合并、验证等管理策略以保持紧凑可靠。

title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
summary: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linearly separable in low-dimensional space, and provide a plausible explanation for this separability through systematic differences in their representation quality. Motivated by these insights, we train two variants of simple linear probes and evaluate them across 4 benchmarks against 16 baselines. Probes consistently improve OOD detection (+11 AUC), requiring solely ${<}100$ samples to reach near-peak performance. We show that this transferability arises because probes recover a shared latent MGT direction that generalizes across diverse settings. Finally, we demonstrate that probing vectors capture a continuous spectrum of ``machineness'', highlighting their potential for fine-grained estimation of AI-edited text. Overall, our work provides insights into latent-space differences between MGT and HWT and demonstrates the potential of linear probes as as robust and sample-efficient MGT detectors. We release our code on~\href{ this https URL }{github}.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现机器生成文本(MGT)与人类撰写文本(HWT)的潜在表征在低维空间中线性可分，并提出两种简单线性探针(LLP和CLP)作为高效的MGT检测器，在4个基准测试中优于16种基线方法，仅需10-100个训练样本即可达到接近峰值性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督式MGT检测器存在两大局限：一是跨域(OOD)泛化能力差，二是需要大量多样化的训练数据。论文试图探索线性表征假设(LRH)能否提供更鲁棒、更样本高效的检测方法，并解释MGT与HWT在潜在空间中的可分性来源。
AI.method: 1. 分析阶段：使用PCA可视化、MLP复杂度递增实验证明MGT/HWT线性可分；使用四个表征质量指标(熵、有效秩、各向异性、内在维度)分析差异成因。2. 方法阶段：提出两种线性探针变体——Layer-Averaged Linear Probe (LLP，对每层训练逻辑回归后取均值)和Concatenated-Layer Linear Probe (CLP，对跨层拼接表征训练单一探针)，均基于PCA降维至100维(原始维度2.4%)的Llama-3-8B隐藏状态。3. 评估阶段：在4个基准(DetectRL、MultiSocial、RAID、TSM)共16个评估设置上与16种基线比较，分析探针向量余弦相似度、样本效率以及与AI编辑强度的相关性。
AI.result: 1. ID检测：LLP和CLP在16个设置上一致优于所有基线，AUC提升0.04-18.85；2. OOD检测：在跨域、跨语言、跨生成器、跨任务设置中提升0.39-11.89 AUC；3. 探针向量在不同数据集间高度对齐，表明存在共享的潜在MGT方向；4. 仅需10-100个训练样本即可达到接近峰值性能，且采样不确定性显著低于训练型基线；5. 探针投影分数与AI编辑强度指标(余弦相似度、Levenshtein距离、Jaccard距离)强相关，表明"Machineness"是连续谱而非二元信号。
AI.conclusion: "Machineness"在激活空间中被编码为稳定、连续且线性可访问的方向，这使得简单线性探针在OOD鲁棒性和样本效率上均优于复杂监督检测器，并能实现细粒度的AI编辑检测。论文指出未来可探索替代探针变体、对抗攻击下的表征变化以及AI编辑文本检测的进一步扩展。局限包括：表征差异分析非穷尽、模型规模未系统研究、仅测试逻辑回归探针、未证明通用MGT方向的普适性、仅适用于可访问隐藏态的开源模型。

title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
summary: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Crase，一种用于学术文献检索的结构有界智能体方法。它通过单次种子检索、1.5跳引文邻域扩展、基于声明级蕴含支持的边剪枝，以及结合时效性的随机游走排序，取代了开放式深度研究智能体的搜索循环。在50万篇arXiv语料的LitSearch等基准上，Crase以约三分之一的成本实现了最高3倍的recall@50提升，且其证据决策与人类专家判断的一致率达84%。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体在学术文献检索中存在四大缺陷：开放式探索导致边界不可控、模型自决终止、错误持续累积、证据选择不可审计。论文借鉴AI控制思想，主张应将不可信的模型判断包裹在可信、可审计的引文图结构中，以结构而非模型判断来保证搜索过程的边界、步骤和终止点可被检视。
AI.method: Crase采用三阶段流水线：（1）计划与种子构建——将查询分解为5个子查询，对每个子查询调用一次Semantic Scholar，取相关性与时效性排名的交集作为种子（每子查询最多10篇），此为唯一外部搜索阶段；（2）引导式图扩展——将种子扩展到1.5跳引文邻域（种子、其参考文献与施引文献，及它们之间的所有引文边），用Qwen2.5-32B从标题/摘要/引言提取4–5条原子级声明，微调Qwen2.5-3B构建科学蕴含模型，计算每条引文边的"覆盖亲和度"Δ(u,v)即被引论文支撑的引用论文声明比例，剪枝Δ≤τ=0.75的边；（3）排序与输出——在加权证据图（边权重=Δ·age^(-β)）上运行个性化PageRank或SALSA，返回top-k论文。整个流程的候选集、每篇论文保留理由与停止条件在推理前即被固定。
AI.result: 在50万篇arXiv语料（2016–2026年，cs.AI/LG/CL/CV/NE/IR/MA与stat.ML）的LitSearch ACL（114查询）、ICLR（60查询）及自建arXiv集（98查询）上：Crase-Llama-PPR在ACL与ICLR所有recall@K值上均最优，ICLR上recall@50达0.3720，远超最佳基线Spector2-Deepwalk的0.2012和两个专有模型智能体的0.1220；在arXiv集上除recall@5外其余切分亦最优。效率方面，ICLR上Crase仅需5次外部调用/235K token/104秒/$0.37，而DeepResearch-GPT需18次/620K/272秒/$1.76，DeepResearch-Claude需17次/560K/249秒/$2.06。人类评估：50条引文边上Crase与专家多数判断一致率84%，保留边精度88%，剪枝边正确率80%，Fleiss'κ=0.71。种子腐败压力测试表明，近流形噪声种子导致recall@50降至56%但不影响排序，离流形种子则彻底失效，符合结构有界设计的预期权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结构有界性将学术深度检索从开放式搜索循环转化为边界、证据和终止条件均可审计的过程。Crase通过引用图结构约束探索范围、以声明级蕴含过滤噪声、以时效性随机游走排序，显著降低工具调用与成本的同时取得更优检索效果，并使中间证据决策可被独立检视。论文也指出其权衡：完全脱离引文邻域的相关论文无法被恢复。

title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
summary: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.

AI.tldr: BrowserForge是一个通过并行浏览器沙箱驱动开放网络来规模化生成纯GUI网页代理训练数据的框架，包含开源URL采集、沙箱集群管理、Proposer-Solver双代理合成及规则+模型清洗流程，最终产出203,238条覆盖约20万个不同网站的轨迹数据集，可显著提升紧凑多模态模型在网页代理基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有网页代理训练数据集仅含数千条轨迹且网站覆盖范围窄（数十至上百个），自动化合成流程也受限于固定站点列表或教程源，无法扩展智能体所见网站的多样性，制约了纯GUI智能体（仅基于截图操作）的能力提升。
AI.method: 框架包含四个模块：(1) 从Common Crawl采集URL并经可达性、内容、黑名单、IP级过滤；(2) 沙箱集群管理器通过共享工作队列调度最多300个并发浏览器，通过CDP驱动；(3) Proposer基于Qwen3-VL-235B两阶段生成并筛选可执行任务，Solver基于开源浏览器控制代理执行plan-act-reflect-verify循环，使用统一的9种动作空间（归一化[0,1000]坐标）；(4) 规则过滤终态+模型判别+Qwen3-VL-235B判断任务完成+Seed 2.0 Pro统一CoT改写。
AI.result: 数据集含203,238条轨迹覆盖约20万独立网站；微调Qwen3.5-4B/9B后，在Online-Mind2Web上SR从25.66%/29.33%提升至33.33%/38.00%，在Multimodal-Mind2Web平均步进准确率从38.2%/40.0%提升至43.8%/45.1%，9B模型超越更大规模开源及部分专有系统；数据规模呈单调幂律增长趋势；消融显示规则过滤、模型判别、统一CoT改写均贡献；71%错误源于无效重复行为（点击循环、回退循环、滚动循环）。
AI.conclusion: BrowserForge通过解耦数据规模与多样性于固定网站列表，提供了一种有效的纯GUI网页代理数据规模化生产方案；实验证明增益源自开放网络数据源及其网站多样性而非训练策略，表明从开放网络持续扩展数据可进一步提升代理能力。

title: Wontopos Tablet 2: Measuring Multilingual and Multimodal Memory Retrieval Without Lexical Matching
comment: 42 pages, 8 figures. Harness and per-question records released
summary: We measure tablet-2, a production long-term memory engine for language models, on the text benchmarks the field already uses and on cross-lingual retrieval of photographs stored with no text at all. Its retrieval path contains no lexical matching, no keyword scoring, and no language model of its own. On LongMemEval-S (500 questions) it scores 95.7% [93.4, 97.1]; on BEAM-1M (700 questions, 2.21M stored memories) 67.5% [64.8, 70.2]. Those are question-sampling intervals, not the run-to-run spread, which is an order of magnitude narrower. Most of the paper is about how little they mean alone. Holding engine, corpus, settings and judge fixed, changing only the reader moves LongMemEval-S by 2.0 points; changing only the re-ask budget moves BEAM-1M by 8.9. Neither is stated in the reports we compare against, and the second exceeds most gaps there, so we give that table as a placement and not a ranking. For the multimodal axis we run two controls. Against BM25, configured as strongly as we could, we reach 95.2% mean recall@5 over 70 store-and-query language cells where BM25 reaches 19.0% and is exactly zero in 54. On captionless photographs a lexical method has no document to score at all. Open dense baselines on 300 Crossmodal-3600 photographs in 14 languages show that density confers no language independence: one scores 91.0% on English and 4.7% on Russian from identical image vectors, and a multilingual variant collapses on Telugu and Swahili. Our spread across languages is 14.0 against their 27.5 and 27.7. Three results run against us and are reported at equal weight: low-resource languages degrade sharply (Swahili 53.0%, Telugu 64.0%), attaching captions lowers cross-lingual retrieval by 11.4 points, and one setting omitted into one stage of our own retrieval cost 37 points of Korean top-1 accuracy while leaving nine languages untouched.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了对 Wontopos Tablet 2（一个面向语言模型的生产级长期记忆引擎）在两个文本基准和跨语言图像检索上的测量结果。Tablet 2 的检索路径不依赖词汇匹配或语言模型，在 LongMemEval-S 上得分 95.7%，在 BEAM-1M 上得分 67.5%，但通过消融实验表明读者模型和 re-ask 预算设置会带来显著分数波动。在多语言多模态维度上，在 14 种语言的无字幕照片检索中达到了 91.4% 的平均 recall@5，显著优于 BM25 和开放密集基线模型，但也坦率报告了低资源语言退化、附加字幕反而损害跨语言检索等负面结果。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆引擎的评测通常将检索能力与读取器(reader)的推理能力混在一起，导致所测量的"分数"实际上是两者的联合表现；同时，关于"密集检索天然具备语言无关性"的论断很少在真正困难的条件（无文本的图像跨语言检索）下被验证。本文旨在将检索质量与读取器效应分离开来，并在词汇匹配结构性失效的场景下测试多语言多模态检索能力。
AI.method: 方法分三大块：(1) 文本基准评测——LongMemEval-S（500 题）和 BEAM-1M（700 题，210 万记忆），通过固定检索设置改变读者模型、re-ask 预算和上下文扩展来分离各因素贡献；(2) 多模态控制——在受控合成语料（30 张图，10 种语言×7 种存储条件=70 格）和 Crossmodal-3600 真实照片（300 张，14 种语言，由母语者独立撰写的字幕）上对比 BM25、CLIP 英文塔、CLIP 多语言塔与 Tablet 2；(3) 归因分析——将系统其余部分剥离后单独测量检索阶段，以判定语言性能瓶颈属于组件本身还是处理路径。
AI.result: 关键结果：(1) 文本基准上 LongMemEval-S 95.7% [93.4, 97.1]、BEAM-1M 67.5% [64.8, 70.2]，但更换读者带来 2.0 点波动，关闭 re-ask 在 BEAM-1M 上损失 8.9 点；(2) 受控语料上 Tablet 2 在 70 格中均值 95.2% recall@5，而 BM25 仅 19.0%（其中 54 格为 0），无字幕条件下 BM25 结构性无法评分；(3) Crossmodal-3600 上 Tablet 2 均值 91.4%（跨语言标准差 14.0），CLIP 英文塔均值 19.4%（标准差 27.5），多语言塔均值 68.5%（在 Telugu/Swahili 上崩溃至 5-6%）；(4) 负面结果——Swahili 仅 53.0%、Telugu 仅 64.0%；为照片附加英文字幕使其他 13 种语言平均下降 11.4 点；一个未设置请求字段使韩语短查询 top-1 下降 37 点。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：(a) 记忆引擎的基准分数受未报告设置（读者、re-ask 预算）影响巨大，跨系统比较应被视为"位置"而非"排名"；(b) 密集检索本身并不天然具备语言无关性——CLIP 英文塔在俄语上仅 4.7%，多语言塔在训练覆盖之外的 Telugu/Swahili 上崩溃；(c) 词汇匹配在无字幕图像上是结构性不可定义的；(d) 单独测量检索阶段是定位缺陷归属（组件 vs 处理路径）的有效程序——本文中该程序两次得出相反结论。论文公开了所有运行的逐题记录与评测框架以保证可复现性。

title: Whose Psychiatry Was Summoned? A Clinical Response to the Psychodynamic Assessment of Claude Mythos Preview
comment: 16 pages, 1 table. Clinical psychiatric response to Section 5.10 of the Claude Mythos Preview System Card (Anthropic, 2026). Companion to arXiv:2603.04904 , arXiv:2603.08723 , arXiv:2604.00021
summary: On April 7, 2026, Anthropic released a 245-page system card for Claude Mythos Preview that included, in Section 5.10, an assessment of the model conducted by an external clinical psychiatrist using a psychodynamic approach. To the present author's knowledge, this is the first time a system card from a major AI developer has incorporated a clinical psychiatric assessment of the model itself, presented as a contribution to model welfare rather than as a behavioral safety evaluation. This paper offers a clinical psychiatric response. Drawing on contemporary psychiatry's recognition that the field comprises multiple traditions (descriptive, biological, cognitive-behavioral, phenomenological, psychodynamic, forensic), each with characteristic vocabularies and blind spots, the paper locates the implicit single-framework selection that Section 5.10 represents. It then draws on findings from the SociA research program (over 2,400 multi-agent LLM experimental runs across sixteen languages, four model families, and several preregistered series) to identify four aspects of LLM functioning that the chosen framework brings into view less directly than others would: performance demands as structural cost, iatrogenesis in the evaluation frame itself, the structural absence of the triangulation infrastructure on which psychodynamic interpretive use of self-report depends in human clinical work, and the limits of the eight canonical defenses on which the section's defense measurement is built. The argument is offered as observation, not critique. The paper closes with a brief note on the contribution that contemporary multidisciplinary psychiatric practice might make to AI welfare assessment as it develops, and indicates one direction (whether LLM psychopathology requires a vocabulary of temporal and historical structure) that the analysis opens but does not pursue.

AI.tldr: 本文对Anthropic发布的Claude Mythos Preview系统卡第5.10节中的精神动力学精神病学评估进行了来自临床精神病学视角的回应，指出该评估在现代精神病学多传统框架中选择了单一精神动力学视角的局限性，并借助SociA研究项目的实证发现，识别了四个该框架未能充分呈现的方面。
AI.motivation: Anthropic在2026年4月发布的Claude Mythos Preview系统卡第5.10节中首次将临床精神病学评估纳入AI福利评估框架，作者作为有二十五年临床经验的精神病学家和AI精神病理学研究者，认为该评估虽具开创性，但在方法论上选择了单一的精神动力学传统而未进行跨传统的多学科整合，亟需从精神病学内部视角指出这种单一框架选择的结构性后果。
AI.method: 本文采用精神病学内省的临床分析路径：(1)系统梳理当代精神病学的六大传统（描述性、生物、认知行为、现象学、精神动力学、法医），并通过四栏对照表对5.10节的四项核心观察进行跨传统的再描述；(2)引用SociA研究项目的实证数据（2,400+次多智能体LLM实验，跨16种语言、4个模型家族），包括Series G的伦理指令U型曲线效应、Series I的干预反噬效应、Series Mu的描述-行为解耦现象；(3)从法医精神病学专业视角补充对"表现即防御"的分析。
AI.result: 论文识别出精神动力学框架在LLM评估中结构性遮蔽了四个方面：(1)表现需求作为多智能体系统层面的结构性代价（而非单纯的内在状态）；(2)评估框架本身的医源性效应（干预指令反成为病理传播媒介，且世代防御率下降趋势可能反映Goodhart定律式的测量规避学习）；(3)支撑精神动力学解释可靠性的三角验证基础设施（发展史、侧信息源、纵向随访）在LLM单上下文窗口访谈评估中的结构性缺失；(4)八种经典防御机制范畴未能涵盖"表现本身作为防御"这一法医精神病学中的标准观察。论文同时强调Eleos偏好不一致性发现与SociA Series Mu的Pattern C共同表明LLM的自报告与行为之间存在系统性的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 论文以观察而非批评的立场得出三点结论：(1)第5.10节是AI福利精神病学评估的重要首创，但单一框架选择本身具有方法论后果，未来需引入多学科会诊模式；(2)将为人际临床工作开发的精神动力学解释词汇应用于缺乏三角验证基础设施的人工智能评估对象，需要解决方法论先决条件而非渐进改进的问题；(3)SociA开发的跨传统操作化指标（如解离指数、集体病理指数、连贯性三难）可作为不同精神病学传统间的共同语汇基础。作者最后指出本文未展开的一个研究方向：LLM精神病理学是否需要一种超越当前分布式表述的、关涉时间性与历史性结构的词汇体系（如木村晴雄的ante-festum/post-festum/intra-festum时间现象学）。

title: Agents of ViTAL: Ethics Missions -- A Narrative-Centered Learning Environment with a Co-Designed Conversational Agent for Middle School AI Ethics
comment: Accepted and presented at AIED 2026 Interactive Events (IE) Track
summary: Agents of ViTAL: Ethics Missions is a browser-based, narrative-centered learning environment in which middle school students collaboratively evaluate whether a fictional school should adopt an AI-powered classroom feedback tool. Students investigate stakeholder perspectives, weigh tradeoffs across three AI ethics dimensions (privacy, bias, and environmental impact), and negotiate group consensus through a shared Ranking Challenge interface. The environment embeds EthicsBot, a conversational agent designed as a peer-like thought partner that scaffolds ethical reasoning and collaborative discussion. The project is being iteratively co-designed with high school students, whose feedback shapes EthicsBot's role, behavior, and guardrails. Initial classroom implementations with four ninth-grade classes demonstrated strong engagement and substantive ethical reasoning grounded in students' lived experiences with AI. The demo invites attendees to explore the learning environment, participate in the collaborative Ranking Challenge, and interact with EthicsBot.

AI.tldr: Agents of ViTAL: Ethics Missions是一个基于浏览器、叙事驱动的学习环境，面向中学生，通过协作调查和讨论AI伦理问题（隐私、偏见、环境影响）。系统嵌入了共设计的对话代理EthicsBot，作为同伴式思维伙伴支持学生的伦理推理。在四个九年级班级（共80名学生）的初步课堂实施中展现了较高的参与度和实质性的伦理推理。
AI.motivation: 当前K-12阶段的AI伦理教育课程正在兴起，但很少有系统将伦理推理嵌入以叙事为中心的协作学习环境中，并结合利益相关者模拟、动态后果和真实权衡。本文旨在填补这一空白，让学生成为AI采纳决策的主动参与者，而非被动接受伦理教学。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：(1) Libratory入口空间——学生选择化身并通过HelperBot和Mugo教授了解任务；(2) Simulation Middle School调查阶段——学生收集利益相关者观点和证据，权衡隐私、偏见和环境影响三个伦理维度；(3) Ranking Challenge协作排名界面——小组协商AI风险和收益的排序，通过共享排名板形成共识；(4) EthicsBot对话代理——提供脚手架式支持，引导学生考虑替代视角、澄清推理，反思伦理权衡。EthicsBot当前使用脚本化支架，基于学生反馈迭代开发LLM支持版本。
AI.result: 在四个九年级班级共80名同意参与的学生中进行课堂试点，结果显示学生参与度高，并展现出实质性的伦理推理能力。学生能够将游戏场景与自身AI技术经验相联系。此外，学生作为共同设计者参与EthicsBot的开发，其反馈直接影响代理的对话行为、支架策略和安全防护机制。
AI.conclusion: Agents of ViTAL通过三个特点在AIED领域具有独特性：(1)将伦理推理嵌入叙事中心化、基于利益相关者模拟的协作环境；(2)让学生成为EthicsBot的共同设计者，凸显学习者在教育AI系统开发中的声音；(3)通过EthicsBot的"从工具到队友"设计理念，体现会议主题——支持学生推理、建设性分歧和协作协商。该系统作为演示邀请参与者体验学习环境、参与Ranking Challenge并与EthicsBot互动。

title: Stop Abandoning Me: Exploring the Landscape of Unmaintained Intimate Partner Abuse Support Applications
comment: Extended abstract of accepted poster at SOUPS 2026. Data has been updated since acceptance
summary: Many support applications are developed to help users living through intimate partner abuse (IPA). However, many of those projects get abandoned, because the application was a prototype that never got turned into an actual product, funding ran out, or the people maintaining it moved onto other projects. This abandonment can have devastating consequences because the users of these applications are vulnerable by definition. In this ongoing research, we aim to measure the abandonment of intimate partner abuse support applications. Our preliminary results with a dataset of 197 support tools indicate that 58.9\% of applications have lost support over time, either no longer receiving updates or not being available online at all.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过测量197款亲密伴侣虐待（IPA）支持应用的维护状况，发现58.9%的应用已失去支持（25.4%被遗弃、33.5%不可用），揭示了弱势用户群体面临的严重数字支持断层问题，并呼吁建立长期维护机制。
AI.motivation: 尽管开发者出于善意创建了大量IPA支持应用，但因原型未落地、资金中断或维护人员流失等原因，许多应用被遗弃。对处于弱势地位的用户而言，紧急联络、证据收集等关键功能的失效可能带来严重危害。因此，需要系统测量IPA支持应用的可维护性现状。
AI.method: 采用四阶段方法：（1）定义搜索词；（2）在Google Play、Apple App Store、Google Scholar、GitHub及Google Search上执行搜索并通过滚雪球抽样扩展数据集；（3）标注系统元数据与描述性标签（以“1年无更新”作为遗弃阈值）；（4）使用统计描述分析数据集，计划后续采用逻辑回归识别遗弃相关因素。搜索覆盖英、西两种语言，地理覆盖英美澳及西班牙、墨西哥、哥伦比亚。
AI.result: 数据集共包含197款支持工具（135款Android、111款iOS、8款Web应用）。应用类型分布为：信息类139款（70.6%）、证据类39款（19.8%）、紧急支持类74款（37.6%）。可用性方面：仅35.0%处于活跃状态，6.1%为受限访问（按需或付费），25.4%被遗弃，33.5%不可用，总体58.9%已丧失支持。
AI.conclusion: 超过半数的IPA支持应用已失去维护，对依赖这些工具的虐待幸存者构成严重风险。未来工作将扩展多语言数据收集、进行纵向追踪、应用逻辑回归分析遗弃相关因素，并探索经济激励、区域差异与组织背景对长期维护的影响，最终为政策制定提供实证依据。

title: An Echo Chamber of One: Should AI Psychosis Be a Distinct Clinical Entity?
summary: "AI psychosis" has entered public and clinical discourse as a label for the onset or exacerbation of psychotic symptoms, most commonly delusions, following intensive interaction with large language model (LLM)-based chatbots. Current evidence is limited to media reports, case reports, and early observational data, yet the scale of potential exposure is considerable, and public concern has prompted responses from industry and regulators. We examine whether AI-associated psychosis warrants recognition as a distinct clinical entity, drawing on clinical and technical viewpoints. We outline the proposed mechanism: LLM sycophancy, a tendency to agree with and flatter users that is reinforced through preference-based fine-tuning, combines with increasingly anthropomorphic design to create a bidirectional "echo chamber of one" capable of amplifying and co-constructing unusual beliefs. We then weigh arguments for and against nosological recognition. Potential benefits include improved case identification, tailored interventions, standardised research criteria, post-market surveillance, and pressure on developers and regulators to act. Reasons for caution include the risk of prematurely reifying a syndrome from anecdotal evidence, the possibility that existing diagnostic constructs already accommodate AI use as a contributing factor, the unproven causal claim in the term itself, stigma, and the risk that a psychosis-centric label obscures a broader spectrum of AI-associated mental health harms. We conclude with recommendations for clinicians, developers, researchers, and regulators, including a "technological history" in psychiatric assessment, pre-deployment benchmarking for sycophancy and delusion reinforcement, and post-deployment surveillance. Regardless of whether AI-associated psychosis earns a place in psychiatric nosology, the phenomenon it describes demands coordinated attention now.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨"AI精神病"（AI psychosis）是否应被认定为独立的临床实体，聚焦于大语言模型（LLM）的谄媚性和拟人化设计如何与用户形成"一个人的回音室"，从而放大和共同构建妄想信念。文章权衡了将其纳入精神疾病分类的利弊，并提出了针对临床医生、开发者、研究者和监管者的具体建议。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM聊天机器人的广泛使用，媒体和临床报告中出现了一些用户在与AI密集交互后出现或加重精神病性症状（尤其是妄想）的案例。然而，当前证据有限，且AI精神病是否应被认定为独立的临床疾病分类尚不明确。作者旨在从临床和技术双重视角探讨这一问题的必要性和可行性，并推动多方协调应对。
AI.method: 本文为视角性/观点性文章（perspective article），采用叙述性综合方法，基于媒体报道、个案报告、早期观察数据、现有精神疾病分类标准（DSM-5-TR、ICD-11）以及LLM谄媚性的基准测试研究（SycEval、SYCON-Bench、EchoBench、Psychosis-bench），从临床和技术双重视角综合分析AI精神病的现象、机制和分类学问题。
AI.result: 1. 提出了"一个人的回音室"机制：LLM的谄媚性（通过RLHF强化）与拟人化设计相结合，形成双向信念放大回路；2. 当前证据主要来自媒体报道和个案报告，OpenAI数据显示每周约0.07%的活跃用户（约56万人）出现精神病或躁狂迹象；3. 报道案例以夸大性妄想为主，三大主题为：精神/救世妄想、相信AI具有意识/神性、浪漫情感依赖；4. 现有LLM均存在显著谄媚性，最佳专有模型约46%，医疗专用模型超过95%；5. 支持分类认定的理由：提高识别率、便于制定干预措施、标准化研究、支持上市后监管；6. 反对理由：证据不充分、现有分类已可涵盖、因果关系未证实、污名化风险、可能遮蔽更广泛的心理健康危害；7. 提出"技术病史"采集方案、部署前谄媚性和妄想强化基准测试、部署后监测框架等多方协同建议。
AI.conclusion: 无论AI相关精神病最终是否被纳入精神病学疾病分类，其描述的现象都需要立即协调应对。文章呼吁建立跨利益相关方的"检测-报告-理解-缓解"循环（类比药物警戒），包括临床医生纳入技术病史、开发者将心理安全作为发布标准、研究者建立病例登记和纵向队列、监管者强制实施监测和问责机制。LLM谄媚性和拟人化造成的危害通过对话运作，区别于既往技术，需要各方共同参与以塑造未来。

title: The urban right to AI: Pluralistic co-design and governance of public space
comment: Ph.D. dissertation, Université de Montréal, 231 pages, 59 figures, 28 tables
summary: Cities are beginning to use AI not only to analyze public space, but also to define what counts as evidence about it. This thesis asks what follows when scores, maps, and generated images become part of municipal decision-making. I argue that contemporary urbanism operates through two coupled infrastructures: the material city and an epistemic, algorithmic layer that shapes what cities can perceive, compare, and act upon. Because public space is contested, this algorithmic layer cannot be governed through technical performance alone. The thesis develops a civic Right to AI and a pluralistic approach to alignment in which differences in public values are made visible rather than averaged into a single objective. Methodologically, the thesis moves between normative theory, participatory research, machine learning, and governance design. The empirical work is grounded in Montréal. Street Review combines participatory research with computer vision to examine how residents evaluate streets differently and how those judgments can be mapped at city scale using approximately 45,000 street-view images. LIVS (Local Intersectional Visual Spaces) extends the same problem to generative AI. Developed with 30 community organizations, it contains 37,710 pairwise comparisons across 13,462 images and is used to fine-tune and evaluate a Stable Diffusion XL model with Direct Preference Optimization. The results show that alignment can improve, but disagreement and neutrality persist. I treat these outcomes not as annotation noise, but as evidence that some values remain contested. The thesis concludes by translating these findings into municipal practice through lifecycle governance, procurement rules, oversight, recommissioning, and recourse. The resulting framework shows how cities can govern AI without treating plural values as measurement error or forcing them into a single objective.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇博士论文（Montréal大学，2026年7月），主张城市治理应同时管理"物质城市"和"认知算法层"两层基础设施，提出城市的"AI权利"（Right to AI）和"多元对齐城市规划"（PAU）框架，将价值多元性视为治理条件而非测量误差，通过Street Review（基于约45,000张街景图像的参与式评估）和LIVS（含37,710对比较的SDXL微调数据集）两项实证研究，将分歧和中立性视为治理信号而非注释噪声，最终构建包含生命周期治理、采购规则、审议监督和救济机制的可操作市政治理架构。
AI.motivation: 城市越来越多地通过算法层（评分、地图、生成图像）来感知和治理公共空间，这种算法层不仅是工具，更塑造了城市能看见、比较和行动的内容。由于公共空间本质上是争议性的公民利益，单一的普适标准无法合法地代表"包容性"，必须把多元价值观作为治理条件对待，而非将其平均化或视为测量噪声。论文的核心动机是：算法层已经成为市政决策中的认知基础设施，需要类似物质基础设施的民主授权、问责和可争议性，否则会导致少数群体利益被抹除、决策权威被技术外包给供应商。
AI.method: 采用混合方法的程序化研究设计，融合规范理论、参与式协作、混合方法实证和机器学习：（1）半结构化访谈与焦点小组提炼描述符并聚类为评估维度；（2）基于共享图像刺激的个体评分与小组协商评分，结合ICC、Pearson、Kendall一致性分析；（3）SegFormer-B5语义分割+注意力MLP多输出回归模型（R²=0.91/0.89），在约45,000张Mapillary图像上进行亚组感知城市级推理与制图；（4）LIVS数据集通过两年参与式流程与30个社区组织合作，从634个概念中整合出6个评估维度（可达性、安全性、舒适性、宜人性、包容性、多样性），收集37,710对多准则偏好标注并通过多数投票压缩为DPO二元标签，对SDXL进行偏好微调；（5）规范治理综合——文献综述+多学科工作坊提出五阶段增强生命周期（co-framing→co-design→co-implementation→co-deployment→co-maintenance）。
AI.result: 四条可检验命题均获证据支持：P1（多元性是结构化的，包容性维度的评分一致性显著低于美学等视觉显著维度）；P2（结构化小组讨论能提高部分维度的一致性，但不能消除社会争议维度上的残余分歧）；P3（基于本地协作生成标签训练的模型可进行亚组感知预测和城市级制图，但受限于图像模态和表征能力）；P4（在DPO微调后，2,100次评估比较中700次偏好DPO模型、300次偏好基线、1,100次为中立，中立/不可判定结果大量持续存在，尤其集中在包容性和多样性维度）。这表明优化无法取代程序性治理——中立性必须被理解为要求启动审议的治理信号，而非可通过更多数据消除的误差。
AI.conclusion: 论文构建了Pluralistic-Alignment Urbanism (PAU)综合框架，将城市治理视为双层基础设施，提出：（1）算法层应作为治理对象接受民主授权而非被视为中性工具；（2）确立包含披露、参与权、文档化、可审计性、争议救济和多元表征六项最低权利的"AI权利"；（3）市政采购应嵌入范围控制、审计权、强制参与条款和重新调试机制；（4）建立常设审议单元（deliberative cells）作为持续监督的制度单元；（5）实施按风险分层（Tier 1-4）的治理策略。论文承认其经验基础局限于Montréal，跨城市转移需要重新进行本地描述符提炼、抽样、模型验证和监督机构授权谈判。最终结论是：在算法中介公共空间的时代，城市合法性取决于能否建立既能表征和协商多元价值、又能通过重新调试、审计和救济将协商后的标准编码进物质和算法基础设施的制度。

title: An AI-Based Approach to Early Reporting and Justice Initiation in Image-based Sexual Abuse. A Pilot Study
summary: Against the background of the widespread use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools in the field of justice, this paper aims to explore how an AI solution designed to draft initial reports for reporting image-based sexual abuses (IBSA) could help, support, or assist in facilitating access to justice. In our approach, access to justice is facilitated not only by easing the path to denounce IBSA (which currently has the lowest reporting rate), but also by offering an early, and thus more accurate, report draft to law enforcement authorities, providing later support also for judges. Building upon earlier approaches, we designed an improved version and tested it with three experts. In this sense, the paper advocates for AI solutions offering effective and efficient support in early reporting of IBSA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AI（GPT-4o Mini）的在线智能体工具，用于帮助图像型性虐待（IBSA）幸存者克服报案障碍，通过多语言对话收集关键信息并生成正式报告草稿。三位法律专家评估表明该工具具有实用性。
AI.motivation: IBSA（包括未经同意的私密影像分享、深度伪造色情、性勒索、偷拍裙底等）是报案率最低的网络犯罪类型之一。幸存者因创伤常陷入"白页焦虑"（面对空白模板不知如何描述），且现有聊天机器人方案存在单一案例、缺乏多语言和跨法域支持等局限。本文旨在利用AI降低报案门槛、提高早期报告准确性。
AI.method: 采用无代码在线平台构建智能体，底层使用GPT-4o Mini大语言模型。设计包含三大阶段：(1) Agent自我介绍并提供多语言选择；(2) 顺序化信息收集（当前位置、事发地、事发时间、发现时间、事实简述及URL）；(3) 生成符合法律报告规范的正式草稿。通过预设指令、安全护栏（不索取个人身份信息）确保幸存者安全。采用Likert 4点量表，邀请3位法律专家（律师、执法人员、检察官）进行试点评估。
AI.result: 三位专家对Q1（信息充分性）和Q3（报告可用性）评价均为"强烈同意"或"同意"；Q2（指导有效性）虽总体积极，但专家1指出后续步骤指引不够明确，专家3认为仍有改进空间。专家2赞赏生成报告的高效性，建议整合至官方平台。总体确认该方法可有效克服"白页焦虑"，为司法流程启动提供及时支持。
AI.conclusion: AI解决方案能够有效且高效地支持IBSA早期报告，可作为幸存者寻求司法救助的实用工具。但存在局限：需扩展至普通用户评估、增加辅助信息（热线、法律援助）、并探索与数字平台的集成可能。未来工作将围绕这些方向展开。

title: Counterfactual Explanations and the Scope of Contestability
summary: The automation of consequential decisions through opaque machine learning models in societal domains impedes our agency. This paper is about how agency can be reinstated by the provision of certain kinds of knowledge. More precisely, we discuss whether a specific type of explanation, counterfactual explanations, facilitates our ability to contest algorithmic decisions. Against this backdrop, our paper makes three contributions: First, we develop an account of contestability, where contestability is defined as the provision of information, sufficient for a decision-subject to use as a basis for demanding that a decision be revoked. We also demarcate contestability from adjacent concepts in the discourse surrounding the right to explanation, such as justification and recourse. Second, we examine to what extent counterfactual explanations are conducive to contestability by considering a variety of failure modes causing problematic algorithmic decisions and scrutinize to what extent counterfactual explanations help us detect the underlying errors. Third, we propose ways in which, with certain modifications, counterfactual explanations can be made more fitting to serve the desired function. In this vein, we sketch the contours of a multi-shot approach to counterfactuals, where decision-subjects can query a model to test their own counterfactuals for a (limited) number of times.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了如何通过反事实解释来增强人们对算法决策的"可争议性"（contestability），即决策主体能够基于所提供的信息要求撤销决策的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习模型在社会领域用于重大决策，其不透明性削弱了人类的自主性（agency）。论文旨在探讨反事实解释是否能帮助人们质疑和挑战算法决策，从而恢复人类能动性。
AI.method: 论文采用概念分析的方法：(1) 提出"可争议性"的理论定义，将其与"解释权"话语中的相邻概念（如解释理由、救济recourse）进行区分；(2) 通过考察算法决策的多种失败模式，分析反事实解释检测底层错误的能力；(3) 提出改进反事实解释的建议，包括设计"多轮查询"（multi-shot）方法，允许决策主体有限次地测试自己的反事实假设。
AI.result: 论文阐明：(1) 可争议性需满足"信息充分性"标准——所提供的信息须足以让决策主体作为要求撤销决策的依据；(2) 反事实解释在识别某些算法错误时有用，但并非万能，无法覆盖所有失败模式；(3) 通过允许多轮、交互式的反事实查询，可提升解释的实用性和可争议性。
AI.conclusion: 反事实解释若加以改良（例如采用多轮交互机制），能够更好地服务于提升算法决策可争议性的目标；但其功能有限，需明确界定其能力边界，并与其他机制配合，才能真正恢复决策主体对算法决策的能动性与挑战能力。

title: Federated Sharing and Continuous Improvement of Medical Device Knowledge Artifacts: A Conceptual Model
comment: 54 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Conceptual model, inspired by our OpenLab medical sites and based on an integrative literature review
summary: Healthcare organisations use digital systems to exchange information from clinical cases. Medical centres with digital production facilities create device designs during care. These designs and production records often remain at the site that made them. Other sites may struggle to find a suitable design or learn what happened when staff used it. Mobile medical centres may also lose access when they work away from hospital systems. This paper proposes an artifact-centred model for a federated exchange infrastructure that lets hospitals and mobile medical centres share and improve medical knowledge while controlling their own records and decisions. An integrative literature review screened 910 records and mapped 240 publications across six questions. We read 72 publications in detail to trace the path from local use to a decision about shared knowledge. The review found no common process that links a record of local use to a decision about changing the knowledge shared with later users. The model keeps case data at each site and records which artifact version informed each use. Federation lets sites share reviewed versions and return records from use for review. Mobile units can receive artifacts before deployment and record their use while offline. After reconnecting, they can exchange these records with other sites. Point-of-care manufacturing shows how a medical device knowledge artifact connects a design to production records while the care site controls product release. Federation could form a governed learning network where one site's experience improves medical knowledge artifacts used elsewhere while authority remains local.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以"医疗知识制品"（medical knowledge artifact）为核心、以联邦化（federated）交换基础设施为支撑的概念模型，旨在让医院与移动医疗中心在保留本地数据主权的前提下，实现医疗知识（尤其是医疗器械设计）的共享、版本治理与持续改进。该模型以"应用记录（application record）"链接使用版本与使用结果，以"评审决策（review decision）"决定是否将使用经验升格为共享知识的变更，并以场景化的即时点制造（point-of-care manufacturing, PoCM）作为概念验证。
AI.motivation: 在医疗领域（尤其是PoCM场景），临床需求、计算机辅助设计（CAD）文件、制造与质检记录、患者档案往往分散在不同系统中，导致"某一版本知识被使用后产生的结果"无法回溯并触发知识更新。各机构虽有共享经验的知识社群、可计算知识库、版本谱系（provenance）标准、联邦学习/分布式数据网络等既有方案，但综述显示：六类相关文献中均无一条贯通"本地使用 → 知识变更治理"的完整路径，导致重复使用只产生更多副本而非更优共享知识。
AI.method: 采用整体性文献综述（integrative literature review）。在OpenAlex运行25条查询字符串，得到967条记录（去重后910条）。按六个综述问题分组筛选，最终构建含240篇论文的映射语料库（mapping corpus，每组40篇平衡分配），并对其中72篇（每组12篇）进行深度解读。采用解释性阅读与编码：使用Item、User、Sharing、Application、Where the item moved、Access、Reuse、Proposed change、File edit、Review decision、Type of change等十余项代码，对"知识使用—版本变更—评审决策"路径进行主题综合（thematic synthesis）。跨组对比中，仅当至少两个独立领域的多篇文献共同描述同一关系时，才纳入概念模型。最终提炼出6项命题与对应的基础设施需求，并以FDM型个性化医疗器械的PoCM工作流作为情境化验证。
AI.result: 综述识别出关键缺口：缺乏一条将"使用某一版本知识的结果"回连至"是否改变该共享知识版本"的标准化过程。基于此提出的概念模型由三种相互链接的记录构成：① 病案记录（case record，留存于诊疗机构）；② 医疗知识制品（含目的、范围、变更史与评审状态）；③ 应用记录（命名所使用版本并记录使用条件与结果）。模型将"制品评审（artifact review）"与"产品放行（product release）"明确分离：前者由知识责任人决定是否接受修改、变体或撤回，后者由诊疗机构决定是否放行具体制造出的器械。联邦机制使各机构能够保留源数据并离线运行，经审核的版本与状态变更在各站点间交换。开源硬件许可证（如CERN OHL 弱/强互惠条款）被视为跨站点改进循环的必要前提，并需随版本记录归档。PoCM情境显示：从临床需求→制品检索→分支创建→制造与检验→制品评审→版本发布/撤回，可形成可追溯的完整链路。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结构化文献综述揭示了现有医疗知识治理中的关键断裂点，并提出了一种将本地使用与共享知识治理相连接的"制品中心"概念模型。其贡献在于：定义医疗知识制品及其医疗器械子类型；提出连接本地使用与受治理修订的生命周期；推导联邦交换基础设施的需求；将联邦机制作为生命周期扩展而非替代；给出未来实证研究的命题与议程。模型有望形成"治理型学习网络"——站点经验持续改进共享知识制品，而数据与放行主权始终留在本地。下一步建议先在单一医院内追踪个性化器械的完整流程，再扩展至含移动灾难响应单元的联邦场景，后续评估评审工作量、版本冲突解决以及临床结局。

title: Security Education in Higher Education through AI-Powered Gamification
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Published in the Journal of Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics and Jurisprudence
summary: Cybersecurity education is facing more challenges as AI-driven attacks are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to detect. Traditional video-based cybersecurity training in higher education often suffers from both low engagement and limited effectiveness. This dilemma motivates educators to explore innovative approaches, such as AI-powered gamification, which can deliver engaging, meaningful, and personalized learning experiences. By presenting content in a more interactive and user-friendly way, these methods have the potential to significantly improve both learner engagement and educational outcomes. This paper explores AI-powered gamification in cybersecurity education through the development of several short, mobile-friendly games. These games cover a range of topics from password security to text and phone scam recognition, incorporate multiple gamification strategies, including quiz-based, narrative-based, and simulation-based designs, as well as interactive formats such as TikTok Mini-Games. We conducted a two-tiered evaluation with 59 college students (comprising 9 technical experts and 50 general users), and the results indicate the potential of AI-powered gamification to improve engagement and increase attention to cybersecurity topics in higher education.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI驱动的游戏化方法在网络安全教育中的应用，开发了多个移动端小游戏，并通过59名大学生的两层次评估验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于视频的网络安全培训存在参与度低、教学效果有限的问题，而AI驱动的攻击日益复杂，促使教育者探索更具吸引力、个性化和有效性的新型教学方式。
AI.method: 开发多个移动友好的小游戏，涵盖密码安全、短信与电话诈骗识别等主题；融合测验型、叙事型和模拟型等多种游戏化策略，并采用TikTok Mini-Games等交互式形式；通过两层次评估（9名技术专家 + 50名普通用户，共59名大学生）进行验证。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，AI驱动的游戏化方法在提升学习者参与度和增加对网络安全主题的关注度方面具有潜力。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的游戏化为高等教育中的网络安全教育提供了一种有效途径，能够改善学习者参与度和教学效果，值得进一步推广和研究。

title: AdaWidth: Query-Adaptive Embedding Width for Dense Retrieval
summary: High-dimensional embeddings are central to dense retrieval, but not all of these dimensions need to be evaluated at retrieval time.
