Existing methods reduce dimensions in two ways: truncating the same leading dimensions for every query, or masking a different subset for each query while still storing and accessing the full embedding. Yet queries within a single task differ widely in the number of dimensions they need for their rankings to stabilize. We introduce AdaWidth, which adapts the number of evaluated dimensions to each query within a shared prefix representation. An orthogonal prefix adapter applies a single learned rotation to queries and documents alike, concentrating discriminative signal in leading coordinates while leaving every full width inner product unchanged. A lightweight router then reads order statistics off the ranking a query has already produced, and evaluates more dimensions only for the queries whose top results would change. We further derive a prefix sufficiency analysis showing that the required number of dimensions is set by the competing documents at the retrieval cutoff: it grows logarithmically with corpus size, decreases logarithmically with retrieval depth, and remains heavy-tailed across queries. Across six retrieval tasks and five frozen encoders, AdaWidth matches the NDCG@10 of state-of-the-art dimensionality reduction using 55% to 84% fewer dimensions per query.

AI.tldr: AdaWidth提出了一种面向稠密检索的查询自适应嵌入宽度方法，通过正交前缀适配器将判别信号集中到前导坐标，并使用轻量级路由器仅对排名可能变化的查询评估更多维度，可在六个检索任务和五个冻结编码器上以减少55%-84%维度的代价匹配最先进方法的NDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 高维嵌入是稠密检索的核心，但不同查询稳定其排名所需的维度差异很大。现有方法要么对所有查询截断相同的前导维度，要么虽按查询选择不同坐标子集但仍需存储和访问完整嵌入。固定的单一宽度必须满足最困难查询的需求，导致简单查询在不必要的坐标上进行评分，造成计算浪费。
AI.method: AdaWidth包含两个组件：(1)正交前缀适配器——通过Householder反射的乘积（用WY紧致表示实现）对查询和文档施加相同的正交旋转，将判别信号集中到前导坐标，同时保持完整宽度内积不变；(2)前缀路由器——从初始窄前缀排名中提取18个基于顺序统计量的特征，使用梯度提升树预测升级增益，仅对排名可能改变的前ρ比例查询在更宽前缀ℓ处重新评分。前缀充分性分析表明所需维度随语料库大小对数增长、随检索深度对数下降。训练目标为多正样本对比损失、加权分数保持损失和几何保持损失之和。
AI.result: 在6个检索任务（FiQA、ArguAna、Quora、MS MARCO、OK-VQA、A-OKVQA）和5个冻结编码器（137M至7B参数，768至4096维）上，AdaWidth在所有共享操作点上均优于Matryoshka Adaptor、SMEC和Learning-to-Select基线。平均而言，以32/64/128保留坐标达到NDCG@10为0.431/0.534/0.576，而Matryoshka Adaptor为0.377/0.472/0.500。在64坐标处AdaWidth超越Matryoshka-Adaptor在256坐标处的表现。适配器参数仅110,592（64个Householder反射），比基线少12-64倍。预测的q90缩放形式在所有任务上得到验证（R²为0.905-0.973），b>0和c<0的符号预测成立。消融实验表明适配器贡献大部分增益（+20.94点NDCG@10），路由器在10⁵以上文档语料上额外贡献0.45点。
AI.conclusion: AdaWidth通过共享前缀表示内的查询自适应宽度分配实现了稠密检索的计算效率。其正交适配器保证完整宽度检索质量不变，仅重新组织坐标间的判别信号；路由器将前缀结构转化为每个查询的计算节省。前缀充分性分析将所需宽度与语料库大小、检索深度和适配器的有效前缀信息速率联系起来，为设计嵌入压缩方法提供了理论依据。

title: TAGR: Temporally Adaptive Generative Recommendation for Industrial Live-Streaming Advertising
summary: Live-streaming advertising is an important monetization channel on short-video and e-commerce platforms, where rapidly changing live content, promoted products, and user feedback impose strong freshness requirements on recommendation models. Existing generative recommenders designed for static domains fail at three levels: static semantic IDs (SID) cannot track evolving live ads; single-scale behavior modeling misses shifting intent; preference optimization conflicts between fresh on-policy feedback and training stability. We propose TAGR, a generative recommendation framework with temporal adaptation at three levels: live-ad tokenization, user intent modeling, and preference alignment. At the token level, Live Semantic-Collaborative ID (LSID) periodically refreshes each active ad's SID based on its current live scene and promoted products, while retaining a stable hierarchical token vocabulary for autoregressive generation. At the intent level, Intent-Aware Generation (IAG) models live-room entry histories at multiple temporal granularities as the primary intent sequence, keeps auxiliary behaviors as separate inputs, and weights next-token prediction (NTP) using post-request intent evidence and business value. At the alignment level, Intermittent On-Policy Preference Optimization (IOPO) periodically samples fresh candidate groups from the current policy and performs behavior- and value-aligned preference updates interleaved with supervised NTP maintenance to preserve learned behavior distribution. Deployed on a large-scale e-commerce live-stream advertising platform, TAGR improves live-room entry and shopping-cart click rates by 8.5% and 7.4%, respectively, and achieves a 16.1% revenue lift over the production baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and industrial viability of temporally adaptive generative recommendation for live-stream advertising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAGR框架，针对直播广告场景中内容、用户反馈快速变化的特点，在Token、意图、偏好对齐三个层面实现时间自适应生成式推荐，在快手电商直播广告平台取得显著线上收益。
AI.motivation: 直播广告中场景、商品、用户反馈分钟级变化，传统静态生成式推荐在三个层面失效：静态SID无法追踪演化的直播广告、单一尺度行为建模遗漏变化意图、偏好优化难以兼顾反馈新鲜度与训练稳定性。
AI.method: 三层面时间自适应生成式推荐框架TAGR：(1) Token层Live Semantic-Collaborative ID (LSID)周期性基于场景与商品刷新广告SID，保持分层词汇表稳定；(2) 意图层Intent-Aware Generation (IAG)采用多尺度主入口序列+辅助行为流+MF-NTP加权（行为深度意图证据×用户价值×eCPM）；(3) 对齐层Intermittent On-Policy Preference Optimization (IOPO)周期性当前策略GRPO（BA-GRPO行为对齐+VA-GRPO价值对齐），与监督NTP维护交替进行。
AI.result: 在快手电商直播广告平台（4亿+DAU）部署，HR@128离线指标全面超越OneRec v2生成式基线；10%生产流量多周A/B实验：直播进入率+8.5%，购物车点击率+7.4%，广告收入+16.1%；低价值用户收入+28.8%，冷启动直播间+18.4%；腰尾部召回覆盖显著优于传统判别式检索。
AI.conclusion: 三层面时间自适应（动态LSID、多尺度意图建模、间歇式on-policy偏好优化）可同时解决直播广告的token漂移、意图变化与偏好对齐不稳定问题；实验证明该框架在工业级非平稳环境下兼具有效性、可部署性与训练稳定性。

title: CodeHID: Learning an Addressable Hierarchical Code Index for Generative Code Retrieval
summary: Code retrieval models have predominantly relied on a flat matching paradigm that treats code snippets as independent candidates, making them less capable of distinguishing similar code candidates. Generative retrieval offers a solution by constructing a learnable index over the code corpus, guiding the retriever to better understand how code candidates are semantically organized and addressed. However, naively applying generative retrieval in the code retrieval task may result in operating over an identifier space whose prefixes do not correspond to meaningful code-semantic regions. In this paper, we propose CodeHID, a generative code retrieval framework that reformulates the code retrieval task from flat candidate matching to coarse-to-fine semantic address generation. CodeHID relies on two core components. First, Pseudo-Neighbor Guided DocID Learning constructs a globally static hierarchical index by applying multi-level residual quantization and $k$-nearest-neighbor pseudo-supervision, ensuring that semantically related code snippets share prefixes while preserving target-level separability. Second, Dual-Phase DocID Generation Guidance reliably navigates this fixed index by combining training-side ranking enhancements, using hard negatives and rank distillation, with inference-side candidate constraints and prefix-aware decoding. Extensive experiments on CoSQA and ProCQA benchmarks demonstrate that CodeHID outperforms existing sparse retrieval, pre-trained code models, dense code retrieval, and generative retrieval baselines by a large margin in most cases, achieving particularly strong improvements in rank-one retrieval metrics.

AI.tldr: CodeHID是一个生成式代码检索框架，将代码检索从平面相似度匹配重构为基于可学习分层DocID索引的粗到细语义地址生成，通过伪邻居引导的DocID学习和双阶段DocID生成引导，在CoSQA和ProCQA基准上大幅超越现有方法，尤其在Rank-1指标上提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有代码检索方法采用平面匹配范式，将代码片段视为独立候选进行相似度排序，难以有效区分功能相似但实现不同的代码候选。直接将通用生成式检索应用于代码检索，会因标识符前缀不对应有意义的代码语义区域而产生表面偏差。需要构建具有语义结构、层次化且可寻址的代码索引，并实现可靠的查询到DocID的生成导航。
AI.method: CodeHID包含两个核心组件：(1)伪邻居引导的DocID学习——在RQ-VAE多层级残差量化基础上，利用连续语义空间中的k近邻关系构建层级伪标签（结合层级相似度阈值），通过正负样本的BCE损失约束语义相关代码片段共享适当层级的前缀，同时保持目标级别的可区分性，最终构建全局静态的分层DocID空间；(2)双阶段DocID生成引导——训练侧通过硬负样本挖掘和排序蒸馏（KL散度对齐教师相关性分布与学生生成分布）增强DocID判别能力；推理侧通过查询条件检索构建候选trie进行约束束搜索，并利用前缀级词汇奖励（lexical bonus）校准解码路径。整体采用冻结GraphCodeBERT编码器+Qwen2.5-Coder解码器（LoRA微调）的架构。
AI.result: 在CoSQA和ProCQA-Python/Java三个基准上的Hit@1/Hit@3/Hit@5/MRR@20指标全面超越BM25、CodeBERT、UniXcoder、CodeSage、OASIS、CodeXEmbed等稠密/稀疏检索基线，以及DSI、NCI、GLEN、RIPOR等生成式检索基线。CoSQA上Hit@1达0.744（远超UniXcoder的0.518），ProCQA-Python Hit@1达0.597，ProCQA-Java Hit@1达0.520。在1.5B参数量级下仍优于1.3B-2B参数量级的稠密检索模型。消融实验验证了两个组件的必要性，伪邻居k=8和λ_kNN=0.03为最佳超参。Rank-1恢复分析显示，对各基线Top-5失败查询的恢复率达74.3%-84.6%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式检索为代码检索提供了有前景的寻址范式，但其有效性关键依赖于结构良好的目标空间和可靠的查询条件导航。CodeHID通过将连续代码语义邻域关系转化为离散DocID前缀共享监督，并结合训练侧排序增强与推理侧前缀引导，实现了更可靠的代码检索。未来工作可探索针对代码结构（调用、继承依赖）的量化机制，并将CodeHID扩展到持续演化的代码语料库。

title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
summary: Multimodal representations have been widely adopted in industrial e-commerce recommendation systems. Due to their strong semantic understanding and generalization capabilities, they enhance the performance of traditional sparse ID-based Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction models. Current multimodal application frameworks in the CTR prediction task typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first, pre-training a multimodal encoder on data from specific recommendation scenarios; second, extracting items' multimodal representations using this pre-trained multimodal encoder and integrating them into the CTR prediction model. However, the training objectives and data distribution of multimodal pre-training tasks often differ from those of the CTR prediction task, which limits the effectiveness of multimodal representation on downstream tasks. In this paper, we focus on how to learn Native Multimodal Representation for the CTR prediction task. One intuitive solution is to jointly train the multimodal encoder and CTR model end-to-end on the CTR task, with the expectation that the encoder can automatically learn downstream-relevant knowledge. However, we find that the end-to-end training does not bring performance improvements to existing multimodal application paradigms. Our analysis reveals that user behaviors in raw CTR data are driven by both multimodal semantics and non-multimodal factors, leading to ambiguous supervision and inconsistent encoder updates. To address this, we propose a Mine-Then-Train method that mines high-quality, multimodally interpretable training samples from CTR data and uses them to fine-tune the multimodal encoder for better alignment with user click preferences. Offline and online experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电商CTR预测任务中多模态表示与下游任务目标不一致的问题，提出了"Mine-Then-Train"框架，通过标注模型从CTR数据中挖掘高质量、可被多模态语义解释的三元组，再用于微调多模态编码器，从而学习与用户点击偏好对齐的"原生"多模态表示。该方法在淘宝展示广告系统中离线与在线实验均取得显著增益。
AI.motivation: 现有工业推荐系统广泛采用两阶段范式使用多模态表示：先在场景数据上预训练多模态编码器，再将冻结的表示融入CTR模型。然而预训练任务与CTR任务的目标和数据分布存在差异，限制了表示的有效性。一个直观的解决方案是端到端联合训练多模态编码器和CTR模型，但作者发现E2EM并未带来性能提升甚至导致退化，亟需分析原因并提出有效方案。
AI.method: 方法分为两步：(1) Mining阶段——设计多模态标注模型（基于冻结SCL编码器+SID Decode Codebook残差学习+点击相关性打分模块），用CTR端到端训练后，从CTR数据中挖掘高质量三元组（满足多模态相似度阈值、SCL相似度差距小、标注分数差距大三重约束）；(2) Training阶段——使用挖掘的三元组通过triplet margin loss微调SCL编码器，并联合SCL对比损失防止遗忘预训练知识，得到Native Multimodal Representation (NMR)。
AI.result: 离线实验：在淘宝CTR数据集上，NMRL相比含SCL的基线提升GAUC +0.22%、AUC +0.11%；单独加入标注分数可提升GAUC +0.13%。在线A/B测试（2026年初在淘宝展示广告系统部署）：CTR提升1.5%，RPM提升0.5%。消融实验表明E2EM在各种优化器、学习率、应用范围下均不及冻结SCL基线；同时揭示E2EM存在训练成本高（GPU内存最高25倍增长、步时间7倍增长）和梯度一致性差（E2EM批次内/批次间梯度相似度远低于SCL）的问题。
AI.conclusion: CTR数据中用户行为仅部分归因于多模态语义，混入价格比较、误点、位置偏差、兴趣疲劳等非语义因素，导致对多模态编码器的监督信号具有歧义性，使端到端联合训练失效。本文提出的Mine-Then-Train范式通过在数据层面隔离干净的多模态监督信号，有效对齐多模态表示与用户点击偏好，为大规模工业推荐系统中的原生多模态表示学习提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: RecGPT-Mobile-V2 Technical Report
summary: Personalized Query prediction maps implicit behavioral signals---clicks, favorites, purchases, and post-purchase exploration---to explicit retrieval intent. On-device deployment makes this task particularly challenging: behavioral trajectories are noisy and multi-scale, multiple Queries may be valid for a single trajectory, and a uniform reasoning policy either expends unnecessary computation on simple instances or allocates insufficient capacity to complex ones. We introduce RecGPT-Mobile-V2, an end-to-end framework that treats intent quality and execution efficiency as coupled objectives within a staged design. The framework transforms heterogeneous interactions into an evidence-preserving trajectory, establishes a recommendation-native foundation through domain adaptation and supervised alignment, and applies reasoning-cost optimization only after grouped rollouts meet grounding and utility criteria. The resulting teacher is distilled into a compact student deployed with low-bit execution, structured compression, and budget-aware device--cloud routing. In an aligned CoT ablation, an evidence-focused short rationale increases ROUGE-L from 0.228 to 0.315 and Jaccard from 0.174 to 0.248, while slightly outperforming the full five-stage rationale. In the controlled RL comparison, the complete reward formulation improves Query quality from 73.2% under quality-only RL to 78.6%, lowers the hard-failure rate from 3.6% to 1.6%, and reduces the median CoT length from 62 to 14 tokens. Online retrieval analysis further indicates that the Query recall channel retrieves inventory complementary to that surfaced by established recall channels. Collectively, these findings support sufficiency-oriented rather than uniformly short reasoning: retain decision-relevant evidence and allocate additional computation only when it is likely to improve the predicted Query.

AI.tldr: RecGPT-Mobile-V2 是一个端到端的移动端个性化查询预测框架，将查询意图质量与执行效率作为耦合目标，通过分层训练（领域预训练→监督微调→质量门控强化学习→蒸馏压缩）实现证据保留的行为轨迹建模，并在端侧部署中通过低比特量化与设备-云路由实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 移动端个性化查询预测面临三大核心挑战：1）行为轨迹噪声大且多尺度；2）同一轨迹可能对应多个有效查询；3）统一的推理策略要么在简单实例上浪费算力，要么在复杂实例上分配不足。此外，查询预测本质上多答案、弱监督，传统的长度奖励容易被弱质量信号利用；长思维链模型不适合移动端服务（延迟、能耗、尾延迟均受影响）。因此需要将意图质量与执行效率作为耦合而非独立的目标来处理。
AI.method: 采用分层设计的端到端框架：（1）五层行为轨迹压缩（信号过滤→去重→语义增强→意图分层→序列化）将异构交互转化为证据保留的紧凑表示；（2）紧凑混合骨干（LiteRecLLM，Gated DeltaNet + 周期性全注意力）+ 选择性适配构建推荐原生基础；（3）分层语义ID表征结合商品文本与层次化语义码；（4）五阶段CoT推理（任务理解→证据提取→候选意图→关系判断→最终决策）；（5）质量门控的GRPO强化学习，包含输入级动态预算、单边超量惩罚、乘性奖励与排序保护；（6）面向部署的师生蒸馏 + 张量粒度混合精度量化 + 设备-云路由。
AI.result: 1）行为压缩将约300个原始事件压缩至25个意图承载事件，序列化后约100-300 token；2）领域预训练使训练损失从0.6448降至0.6066（5.9%相对降幅），机器评判质量达Base+SFT的99.58%；3）证据聚焦的短CoT使ROUGE-L从0.228提升至0.315，Jaccard从0.174提升至0.248，略优于完整五阶段CoT；4）完整奖励设计（A6）将查询质量从73.2%（仅质量RL）提升至78.6%，硬失败率从3.6%降至1.6%，CoT中位长度从62降至14 token；5）查询召回通道检索的语义标签与现有召回通道的Jaccard重叠度低0.06-0.12，具有互补性；6）端侧推理平均延迟从3.00s降至0.76s（3.95×加速），P95从8.00s降至1.70s（4.71×加速）。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理应定义为"充分性导向"而非"统一简短"——保留决策相关证据，仅在可能改善预测查询时分配额外计算。实验支持以下结论：1）压缩应暴露证据而非仅缩短文本；2）领域适配是优化-保留的权衡；3）行为证据是有用CoT的核心；4）推理应条件化（直接信号几乎不需要长CoT，后购买关系与多意图消歧受益显著）；5）长度优化必须以质量为条件（质量门控是必要保障，逐输入预算提供最大单独成本削减，乘性排序保护获得最强联合端点）。RecGPT-Mobile-V2为移动端查询预测提供了一个从行为证据到可部署查询策略的统一质量-成本前沿。

title: Rethinking Semantic Alignment in LLM-Enhanced Collaborative Filtering: A Spectral Decoupling Approach
summary: Recent advances in LLM-enhanced recommendation commonly align semantic representations with collaborative embeddings in a shared space, yet how alignment affects LLM-encoded information remains unclear. In this work, we revisit LLM-enhanced recommendation from a spectral perspective and show that collaborative and semantic signals benefit from different spectral parts. While collaborative representations are dominated by smooth low-frequency components due to user-item homophily, semantic embeddings contain useful non-principal singular components. Through component-wise evaluation and training-dynamics analysis, we find that alignment increasingly concentrates learned representations in dominant collaborative and principal semantic subspaces, reducing overlap with non-principal semantic components. Controlled comparisons show that non-principal components provide inconsistent gains under alignment but consistently improve performance through component-level decoupling, while full prediction-level decoupling achieves the best overall performance. These results indicate that alignment fails to effectively exploit complementary non-principal semantic information. Motivated by these findings, we propose UniSpecRec (Unifying Spectral Signals for Recommendation), which applies signal-specific spectral filtering while preserving collaborative and semantic representations in their respective spaces. UniSpecRec combines their predictions without cross-space alignment or additional trainable parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文从谱分析(spectral perspective)角度重新审视LLM增强推荐中的语义对齐问题，提出协作信号与语义信号受益于不同的谱成分，且现有alignment范式无法有效利用非主语义成分，进而提出无参数解耦框架UniSpecRec。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM增强推荐方法通常将LLM语义表征与协作嵌入在共享空间中通过alignment进行对齐，但这种alignment对LLM编码信息的影响尚不清楚。特别是：1)协作信号和语义信号是否需要alignment来融合？2)不同谱成分对两类信号的贡献是否相同？3)alignment是否会损失有用的语义信息？
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **谱分析**：将语义矩阵S进行SVD，把奇异值分成B个band，分析非主奇异成分(non-principal components)对推荐的贡献；(2) **SAScore度量**：定义Spectral Alignment Score衡量学习到的表征O与特定子空间P的对齐程度，用于分析alignment训练过程中表征在不同谱成分上的动态变化；(3) **UniSpecRec框架**：提出预测级解耦范式，通过信号特定的谱滤波f(σ)=σ^p分别处理协作信号(低频平滑)和语义信号(增强非主成分)，并在预测层加权融合，不引入额外可训练参数，无需cross-space alignment。
AI.result: 在三个Amazon数据集(Games/Toys/Books)与三种LLM编码器(LLaMA-3.2-3B/NV-Embed-v2/Qwen3-Embedding-8B)上的实验显示：(1) UniSpecRec在所有数据集上一致优于alignment-based方法(AlphaRec/RLMRec)和interaction-only基线(SGFCF/LightGCN)；(2) 效率显著优于训练型方法(在Books上比AlphaRec快7.5倍)，且比L³AE在大数据集上更具可扩展性(快3倍以上)；(3) 跨编码器稳定性最佳，方差最低；(4) 解耦范式在MF/LightGCN/SimGCL三种骨干网络上均一致优于alignment范式，验证了该优势与具体架构无关；(5) Power filter f(σ)=σ^p优于identity/log/rational/learnable等替代方案，α最优值稳定在0.35附近，无需精细调参。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：(1) 协作推荐主要依赖低频平滑成分，而LLM语义表征的推荐效用延伸至非主奇异成分；(2) Alignment-based训练会使学习表征集中于主协作和主语义子空间，抑制有用的非主语义成分；(3) 显式的语义到协作空间的alignment并非有效集成LLM表征的必要条件。UniSpecRec通过信号特定的谱滤波和预测级解耦融合，在多个数据集、LLM编码器和协作骨干网络上实现了有效、高效且可泛化的性能提升。未来工作将探索非主语义成分所编码的具体信息以及解耦原理在多模态推荐中的推广。

title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents
summary: Agentic Web search can retrieve relevant information without establishing that the retrieved content actually supports the claims used in an answer. Existing agents typically keep search and evidence recording in a linear interaction trace and optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for intermediate grounding. We present EviGraph, a deep-search framework that separates search execution from evidence recording while using a shared policy for the trainable roles. An executor plans concise queries, a frozen evidence verifier inspects source pages and returns verbatim evidence items with an explicit polarity, and the policy maps those items to add/support graph requests that are checked by a deterministic structural validator. The resulting graph serves both as persistent working memory and as a source of dense process rewards, enabling reinforcement learning to directly supervise evidence construction rather than only the final answer. On BrowseComp-Plus, a Qwen3-8B EviGraph agent achieves 35.9% accuracy under a matched interaction budget, compared with 26.9% for the same dual-role architecture without reinforcement learning and 2.7% for a monolithic agent, while generating fewer tokens per rollout. Consistent gains on BrowseComp, GAIA, and XBench indicate that explicitly structuring and rewarding evidence recording improves agentic search

AI.tldr: EviGraph 将智能体搜索重构为"证据构建"过程，通过分离搜索执行与证据记录两个角色（共享策略），构建以源文本片段锚定、带极性标签的异构证据图，作为工作记忆和过程奖励来源。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上以 Qwen3-8B 达到 35.9% 准确率，并在多个基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体搜索系统将搜索与证据记录混在线性轨迹中，主要优化最终答案正确性，导致：(1) 检索相关性不等同于证据支持；(2) 答案级奖励易引发捷径行为；(3) 引用无法揭示具体支持某声明的源片段。需要一种能显式表示"哪些证据支持哪些声明、在何种约束下、如何共同支撑结论"的机制。
AI.method: 提出 EviGraph 框架：(1) 异构 DAG 图模式，包含文档节点、原文片段节点、原子声明节点、答案候选节点，证据边带 support/conflict 极性；(2) 双角色共享策略——执行器发出查询，冷冻验证器检查页面并返回带极性的证据条目，证据提议角色将条目映射为 add/support 图编辑请求，由确定性结构验证器校验；(3) 角色条件 GRPO 强化学习，为执行器和提议角色提供独立的过程奖励（覆盖势能、未解决冲突率、离题率、首次接受奖励），加入 KL 惩罚、规范化证据签名、每候选-标签-极性奖励上限等防奖励作弊机制；(4) 图既是持久工作记忆又是密集过程奖励来源。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus（830 题）上：Qwen3-8B 单体智能体仅 2.7%，双角色无 RL 达 26.9%，双角色+RL 达 35.9%（同时减少每回合生成 token 数）；Qwen3-32B 达 36.6%。在 LiveVQA（多模态）上 Qwen3-VL-8B 零样本达 78.0%，较无搜索版本提升 27 点。在 BrowseComp、GAIA、XBench 上 Qwen3-8B RL 版分别达 17.8%、53.4%、56.0%，均优于同规模基线。消融实验表明角色分解贡献约 24 点增益，RL 在匹配搜索次数条件下贡献额外 9 点增益。
AI.conclusion: 将检索-推理接口从线性轨迹重构为结构化证据图，使搜索代理能够显式监督证据构建而非仅优化最终答案。角色分解外部化了候选、约束和来源溯源状态，提升了执行效率和准确性；过程奖励直接对齐证据构造质量。该范式可扩展至多模态搜索，并适用于需要满足多重独立可检索约束的复杂网络研究任务。

title: Auditing Return Conditioning as a Control Knob: An Offline Diagnostic for Decision Transformer Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CONSEQUENCES '26, the 5th Workshop on Causality, Counterfactuals and Sequential Decision- Making for Recommender Systems, co-located with ACM RecSys 2026. 5 pages, 2 figures
summary: Offline return-to-go (RTG) sweeps can test whether a recommender conditioned on return is controllable, but the intervention is rarely audited. Rewriting every historical RTG token creates an increasingly synthetic context, while rewriting only the current token is more local. We test this distinction in an offline setting with a fixed window. On MovieLens 25M and MyAnimeList 2020 (MAL), we evaluate a Decision Transformer using an RTG locality ladder, a control without RTG, a logged match and score reward check, and a within-trajectory shuffled RTG ablation. On MovieLens, a $K=20$ intervention that covers the full context, applied only to real context positions, shifts the share of Crime predictions by $+23.61 \pm 2.96$ percentage points from the validation 5th to 95th percentile, whereas changing only the current slot shifts it by $+1.77 \pm 1.17$ points. The shuffled RTG model largely removes this response ($+2.08 \pm 1.20$ points at $K=20$). On MAL, the same protocol does not produce a Drama response: $K=20$ changes Drama by $-0.03 \pm 0.07$ points, and $K=1$ by $-0.01 \pm 0.01$. Genre prediction accuracy is numerically close across real RTG, no RTG, and shuffled RTG, and at $K=1$ logged match rates and matched ratings change little. Because dataset and focus-genre selection were exploratory, these magnitudes are descriptive; the cross-diagnostic pattern across locality, shuffled RTG, and the null result on MAL does not establish reward control. We propose four checks: intervention locality, a no-RTG baseline, a reward check, and RTG-content ablation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于 Decision Transformer (DT) 的推荐系统,系统性地审计了"离线 Return-to-Go (RTG) 扫描"作为可控性诊断的可靠性,提出四项互补检查并揭示 MovieLens 25M 上的响应源于合成上下文重写而非真正的局部奖励控制。
AI.motivation: 现有 DT 推荐系统常通过离线 RTG 扫描证明模型"可被回报条件控制",但该干预从未被审计:覆盖全历史 RTG 会构建合成上下文,仅改写当前槽位虽破坏更少却仍混合真实与假设回报。作者旨在区分"局部决策控制"与"对合成重写上下文的敏感度",填补离线评估中干预可靠性的空白。
AI.method: 设计 RTG 局部性阶梯(RTG locality ladder):在固定上下文窗口 W=20 内,将尾部 K 个真实 RTG 位置替换为单一目标值,K 从 1(局部)升至 20(全合成)。配合三项对照诊断:(1) 无 RTG 基线 (DT-no-RTG);(2) 同用户内 RTG 洗牌控制 (shuffled RTG);(3) K=1 时的日志匹配率与匹配奖励检查,以及状态预测 RTG 的探测探针。在 MovieLens 25M 与 MyAnimeList 2020 上,以流行为动作(genre actions)运行,3 层 Transformer、3 个种子(42/0/1)、用户级 bootstrap 1,000 次重采样评估 Crime(MovieLens)与 Drama(MAL)占比的 q95 − q05 变化。
AI.result: MovieLens:Crime 占比的 RTG 阶梯响应强烈依赖 K——K=20 全上下文改写使 Crime 占比变化 +23.61±2.96 pp,而 K=1 仅 +1.77±1.17 pp 且跨种子方差大;shuffled RTG 在 K=20 时仅 +2.08±1.20 pp,大幅削弱响应。MAL:相同协议下 Drama 始终无响应(K=20: −0.03±0.07 pp;K=1: −0.01±0.01 pp),所有 15 个类型的最大单槽位响应 < 0.024 pp。日志匹配率与匹配奖励在 K=1 时几乎不变。真实 RTG 在 HR@1/5 上比无 RTG 基线仅高 0.14 pp,shuffled RTG 接近无 RTG。RTG 可由状态预测(R² 在 MovieLens 上 0.34–0.51,MAL 上 0.74–0.76),表明通道冗余。
AI.conclusion: MovieLens 的大幅 genre 响应是聚合分布漂移而非奖励层面的用户级回报控制;MAL 为零结果。RTG 扫描应被作为敏感性分析报告,而非部署前的"回报可控性"证据。本文提出四项检查——干预局部性、无 RTG 基线、奖励检查、RTG 内容消解——构成审计离线回报条件推荐器的协议,贡献在于审计方法与跨诊断模式,而非 genre 响应本身。

title: Streaming algorithms for computing coresets and $k$-median clustering in the Hamming space
summary: Clustering is one of the most fundamental tools in data analysis, allowing large datasets to be summarized by a small number of representative points. Given a metric space $(\mathcal{X}, \mathbb{d})$ and a set $S$ of $n$ points in this space, the continuous $k$-median clustering problem asks to find a set $C$ of $k$ points that minimizes the objective function $\sum_{s\in S} \mathbb{d}(s,C)$. When $\mathcal{X} = \Sigma^\ell$ is the set of strings of length $\ell$ and $\mathbb{d}$ is the Hamming distance, the continuous $k$-median clustering problem is known to be W[1]-hard when parameterized by $k$. In this work, we present the first $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for this problem with FPT runtime $2^{\mathrm{poly}(\varepsilon^{-1},k)} \cdot n\ell \mathrm{polylog} \; n$. An additional feature of the algorithm is that it can be implemented in streaming, requiring only $\tilde{O}_\varepsilon(\ell k + k^2)$ space. As an auxiliary tool of independent interest, we show the first streaming algorithm for computing an $\varepsilon$-coreset for continuous $k$-median clustering under the Hamming

AI.tldr: 本文提出了汉明空间下连续 k-median 聚类问题的首个高效参数化近似方案（EPAS），即 (1+ε)-近似、FPT 时间为 2^{poly(ε^{-1},k)}·nℓ·polylog n 的算法，并可流式实现，仅需 Õ_ε(ℓk+k²) 空间。同时给出了连续 k-median 聚类 ε-coreset 的首个流式计算算法。
AI.motivation: k-median 聚类在汉明距离下是 W[1]-难（参数化为 k）的，且现有最佳近似算法运行时间为 ℓ^{k²} n^{O(ε^{-1}k²)}，并非 FPT 时间。此外，生物序列数据通常以流式产生，需要流式算法；而此前缺少汉明空间下连续 k-median 的 (1+ε)-近似 EPAS 及 coreset 的流式构造。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) 离线 coreset 构造——修改 Huang–Vishnoi 重要性采样框架以处理加权输入，从而获得大小与 n 无关的 ε-coreset（大小 O(ε^{-6}k log k log(k/(εδ)))）；(2) 流式 coreset 构造——通过 Karloff 嵌入将字符串映射到二进制向量（保 Hamming 距离），再用 Johnson–Lindenstrauss 终端嵌入降维，最后结合 Braverman 等人的流式 k-means coreset 与离线加权 coreset 进行二级缩小，得到 O(ε^{-2}k log k · min(log n, ε^{-4}log(k/(εδ)))) 大小的 coreset。然后使用"两级 coreset 放大"技术（一大 coreset 做验证 + 多个小 coreset 暴力枚举 k 个中心）克服小 coreset 失败概率无法通过重复降低的困难，得到 FPT 流式近似算法。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 流式 ε-coreset：空间 Õ_ε(ℓk+k² log²(1/δ))，更新时间 Õ_ε(ℓ+k² log²(1/δ))；(2) 流式 (1+ε)-近似 k-median 算法：空间 Õ_ε(ℓk+k²)，更新时间 Õ_ε(ℓ·2^{poly(ε^{-1},k)})，以高概率在流中每个点输出有效解。这是汉明空间下连续 k-median 的首个 EPAS 及首个流式 coreset 构造。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了汉明空间下连续 k-median 聚类在流式模型中的高效参数化近似问题，给出了首个 EPAS 和首个流式 coreset 算法。其核心技术——将 Huang–Vishnoi 重要性采样扩展到加权输入、维度约简下的两级放大框架——具有独立意义，并可推广至任意常数 z 的 (k,z)-聚类。

title: Instance-Optimality of Bidirectional Dijkstra on Simple Graphs
summary: We study the shortest-path problem on graphs with positive real-valued edge weights. Given a source vertex $s$ and a target vertex $t$, the goal is to calculate the length of the shortest path from $s$ to $t$. We are particularly interested in instances that can be solved in sublinear time. Recently, Haeupler, Hladík, Rozhoň, Tarjan, and Tětek proved that (a version of) the bidirectional Dijkstra's algorithm is instance-optimal on positively weighted multigraphs, both directed and undirected, considering the number of vertices and edges queried by the algorithm. However, multigraphs are not the canonical setting for the shortest-path problem. The problem is typically formulated on simple graphs without loops and parallel edges. They therefore left as an open problem whether bidirectional Dijkstra remains instance-optimal on simple weighted graphs. We answer this question, but for simple graphs, the answer is more complex, depending on the setting. We show that bidirectional Dijkstra is still instance-optimal on simple undirected weighted graphs under the order-oblivious model, where incident edges are given in a random order. In contrast, under the order-dependent model, where incident edges have a given order, we show that bidirectional Dijkstra is not instance-optimal. For simple directed weighted graphs, we show that bidirectional Dijkstra is not instance-optimal under either the order-oblivious or the order-dependent model, being off by a factor of $\Theta(m/n)$ in both cases. We further show that no algorithm can have instance-optimality ratio $o(m/n)$ under the order-dependent model, or under the order-oblivious model when $m=O(n\sqrt{n})$. On the positive side, the above results imply that bidirectional Dijkstra is instance-optimal up to logarithmic factors on all sparse directed and undirected graphs satisfying $m/n=\log^{O(1)} n$.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了关于简单图（而非多重图）上双向Dijkstra算法实例最优性的开放问题，揭示了答案因有向/无向及顺序依赖/顺序无关设置的不同而不同，并给出了各种设置下的紧致界。
AI.motivation: Haeupler等人(2023)证明了双向Dijkstra在带正权多重图上是实例最优的，但简单图（最典型的设定）的情况作为开放问题遗留。本文旨在回答这一开放问题。
AI.method: 采用查询复杂度模型（邻接表查询模型），区分顺序依赖和顺序无关两种设置；上界分析通过假设任意"好"算法访问的顶点和边数明显少于双向Dijkstra，然后通过修改少量"坏"边构造反例图G'来导出矛盾；下界分析通过精心构造的图族，使实例最优算法受限于最坏情况开销而实例智能算法可快速求解。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1)无向简单图顺序无关模型下双向Dijkstra仍是实例最优的；(2)无向简单图顺序依赖模型下实例最优性比为Θ(min{⌈m/n⌉, n^{1/3}})；(3)有向简单图在两种模型下均为Θ(⌈m/n⌉)；(4)无度数查询时，除有向顺序依赖外，双向Dijkstra在所有设置下恢复实例最优性；(5)还修复了原[15]中一个小的μ更新错误。此外，对最大度Δ参数化、对容易实例（τ<n/10）以及稀疏图（m/n=log^{O(1)}n）的结果均有紧致界。
AI.conclusion: 图的结构（多重图vs简单图、有向vs无向）和邻接表顺序模型对实例最优性有本质影响。简单图上实例最优性的退化主要源于度数查询的可用性；当不允许度数查询时，双向Dijkstra恢复了（在大多数设置下的）实例最优性。稀疏图上（m/n=polylog）双向Dijkstra仍具近乎实例最优的性能。

title: Designing Caterpillars for Graphs: Approximation and Hardness
summary: The classical Minimum Linear Arrangement (MLA) problem has been studied extensively. It is known to be NP-hard and it admits an $O(\sqrt{\log n}\log\log n)$-approximation [Feige and Lee, IPL, 2007]. MLA can be defined as follows as design problem: Given a graph $G$ with vertex set $V(G)$, design a path $H$ on the same vertex set that minimizes the linear arrangement cost $\sum_{uv\in E(G)}\textrm{dist}_H(u,v)$, where $\textrm{dist}_H(u,v)$ indicates the distance of $u$ and $v$ in $H$. We initiate the study of the generalization in which $H$ is allowed to be a caterpillar graph of maximum degree at most $\Delta$. Caterpillars are the simplest generalization of paths, having pathwidth one and interpolating between paths and stars via the degree parameter $\Delta$. We give an algorithm that lifts any $\alpha$-approximation for MLA to an $(\alpha+3-2/(\Delta-1))$-approximation for our problem, thus obtaining an $O(\sqrt{\log n}\log\log n)$-approximation for our more general problem as well. Moreover, we derive a $4$-approximation whenever MLA is polynomial-time solvable, in particular, for trees. Complementing these results, we prove NP-hardness for every constant $\Delta\geq 2$, and, in stark contrast to MLA, show it remains NP-hard on trees when $\Delta$ is part of the input.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"图中的毛毛虫设计"（Graph in Caterpillar, GiC）问题，即给定图G和度数上界Δ，寻找一棵顶点集与G相同的最大度不超过Δ的毛毛虫H，最小化G中边在H中距离之和。该问题是经典最小线性排列（MLA）问题的推广（MLA对应Δ=2的路径）。主要结果包括：(1) 将MLA的任意α-近似提升为GiC的(α+3−2/(Δ−1))-近似，从而获得O(√(log n)·log log n)近似；(2) 当MLA多项式可解时（如G为树），获得4-近似；(3) 证明对任意常数Δ≥2问题都是NP困难的，且当Δ作为输入的一部分时，即使G是树问题也是NP困难的。
AI.motivation: 经典MLA问题仅允许主机图H为路径。毛毛虫是路径宽为1的图，是路径的最简单推广，通过度数参数Δ在路径和星图之间插值。将主机图推广到毛毛虫不仅具有结构意义（最接近路径的推广类），也为网络设计提供了额外的自由度。但需要刻画其计算复杂性。
AI.method: 近似算法方面：提出Starfy算法——将MLA的线性排列按每Δ−1个顶点分段，每段选最大度顶点作中心构成星，将星中心串成脊椎，从而将α-MLA近似提升为(α+3−2/(Δ−1))-近似；并用Flatten引理将最优毛毛虫"摊平"为路径以关联MLA下界。复杂性方面：从Max Cut归约证明任意固定常数Δ≥2的NP困难性；从3-Partition强NP困难问题归约证明树上的TiC问题即使Δ作为输入参数也是NP困难的。
AI.result: （1）Starfy算法对任意Δ≥2实现O(√(log n)·log log n)-近似；（2）当MLA多项式可解时（如树、超立方、方格）得到4-近似；（3）当G为平面图时得到O(log log n)-近似；（4）证明GiC对任意固定常数Δ≥2是NP困难的；（5）证明即使G为树、Δ作为输入，TiC仍是NP困难的，与MLA的多项式可解性形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将MLA的近似结果"提升"到GiC，揭示了路径推广到毛毛虫在近似层面是"免费"的；然而复杂性层面却截然不同——MLA在树上多项式可解但TiC即使限制在树上也是NP困难的，这表明分治策略无法直接迁移。开放方向包括：对树情形改进常数比、固定Δ参数的FPT算法、以及带宽/切割宽度等其它目标函数。

title: Online and Incremental Fractional Vertex Cover on Trees
summary: In this paper we study the fractional vertex cover problem on trees in two related models: online and incremental. In the online model, the vertices of the tree are known a priori and the edges arrive one at a time. The goal is to maintain a fractional vertex cover of the tree, i.e., an assignment of fractional weights from [0,1] to the vertices such that the weights of endpoints of every edge sum up to at least one. After each edge arrival, we need to modify the fractional vertex cover to cover the new edge as well. However, we can only increase the values assigned to vertices. The problem was studied before (in the vertex arrival model) by Wang and Wong, who motivated it as a generalization of the ski-rental problem, but also (more importantly) by its close connection to the dual online matching problem. They presented a 1.901-competitive algorithm for general graphs in the vertex arrival model. We present an $\frac{11}{6} \approx 1.83$-competitive algorithm for trees in the more general edge arrival model. In addition, we study the fractional vertex cover problem in an incremental model, where we again seek a fractional vertex cover after every update, but all the updates to the tree are known to the algorithm a priori. In this model, we give a 1.5-competitive algorithm and provide a matching lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究树上在线与增量两种模型下的分数顶点覆盖问题。在线边到达模型中，作者提出RGB算法达到11/6≈1.83的竞争比，优于此前最佳结果2；增量模型中，作者提出TwoChildRule算法达到1.5的竞争比，并证明匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 分数顶点覆盖问题与对偶的在线匹配问题密切相关。此前Wang和Wong在顶点到达模型中给出1.901的竞争比，但边到达模型更具一般性，此前该模型下的最佳竞争比为平凡的2。同时，增量模型下的分数顶点覆盖问题此前未被研究。
AI.method: 在线部分：RGB算法将每条边按规则染成红、绿、蓝三色之一，并根据每个顶点邻接边的颜色组合为该顶点赋予6种不同的分数权重（1, 5/6, 4/6, 2/6, 3/6, 1/6, 0），随后通过构造分数匹配并利用弱对偶性证明竞争比。增量部分：TwoChildRule半整数算法根据父子结构局部决策，并通过预算再分配证明3/2竞争比；下界通过对分层揭示的二叉树实例构建LP，利用对偶可行解证明任何算法竞争比不低于3/2。
AI.result: 在线边到达模型：RGB算法达到11/6≈1.83的竞争比，改进此前2的平凡上界；增量模型：TwoChildRule达到3/2的竞争比，下界证明也精确为3/2，因此增量分数情形下界是紧的。整数增量情形方面，作者证明任何对称局部规则的竞争比至少为5/3，并猜想存在3/2的整数算法。
AI.conclusion: 本文在树的边到达在线模型下显著推进了分数顶点覆盖问题的状态，提出的RGB算法简洁优雅。在增量模型下，给出了分数情形的精确竞争比3/2。整数增量情形仍是开放问题，但已显示出其需要非对称或全局化设计才能达到与分数情形相同的竞争比。

title: Polynomial-time Stable Matching in Network Hypergraphs
summary: We show that there exists a polynomial-time algorithm to find a stable matching in network hypergraphic preference systems. The key connection that drives the algorithm was discovered by chatting with ChatGPT-5.6 Sol Max. We verified it independently and present the details in our own words.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：在网络超图（network hypergraph）上的超图偏好系统中，稳定匹配（stable matching）可在多项式时间内找到。核心策略是将稳定匹配问题归约为有向图核（kernel）查找问题，并利用DE图上核的多项式时间算法来解决。
AI.motivation: 经典二分稳定匹配可由Gale-Shapley算法在多项式时间内求解。Aharoni-Fleiner将其推广至超图偏好系统，借助Scarf引理证明了正态超图上稳定匹配的（分数）存在性。然而，一般超图上稳定匹配的存在性判定是NP完全的，即使在正态超图上也缺乏多项式时间算法。本文旨在推进这一算法前沿——此前已知多项式时间可解的子类包括子树超图和丛生超图，而网络超图是涵盖二分稳定匹配的更大类，被识别为下一个自然目标。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心模块：(1) 将稳定匹配问题通过Csáji的已知归约转化为有向图核问题——具体构造冲突图G_H（超边为顶点，交集非空则邻接）及其超定向D_{H,≻}（按共同顶点的偏好定向），证明稳定匹配与D_{H,≻}的核一一对应；(2) 利用Monma-Wei结果证明：当H为网络超图时，冲突图G_H是有向边图（DE图），即定向树上有向路径的弧交集图；(3) 利用定向树中的"弧Helly性质"（若一族有向路径两两共享弧，则存在一条所有路径共享的弧——Lemma 4.6）证明D_{H,≻}是G_H的团无环超定向（clique-acyclic super-orientation）；(4) 调用Pass-Lanneau-Igarashi-Meunier定理：在DE图的团无环超定向上求核可在多项式时间内完成。整体算法即"构建冲突偏好图→调用核算法→返回核"。
AI.result: 主要定理（Theorem 1.1）：给定网络超图上的超图偏好系统，存在多项式时间算法计算其稳定匹配。该算法是Biró-Fleiner存在性论证的算法加强。此外，二分稳定匹配可视为网络超图上稳定匹配的特殊情形（通过对星形树定向实现）。
AI.conclusion: 本文将正态超图族内稳定匹配的算法前沿从丛生超图推进至网络超图，方法的核心是揭示网络超图的冲突图是DE图，并借助弧Helly性质证明团无环性，从而适用现有的核计算算法。开放问题包括：(1) Scarf轴心算法本身在网络超图上是否多项式时间收敛；(2) 单模超图（unimodular hypergraphs）上稳定匹配是否多项式时间可解；(3) 更一般的正态超图情形；(4) 容量版稳定b-匹配在网络超图上的多项式时间可解性。文中特别说明：关键连接是作者与ChatGPT-5.6 Sol Max对话中发现的，并经独立验证。

title: Dynamic Edge Orientation via Random Walks: From Trees to Outerplanar Graphs and Beyond
comment: Abstract truncated to fit arXiv limits
summary: We study the \emph{fully dynamic edge orientation problem}, focusing on \emph{worst-case} time bounds. An undirected graph undergoes edge insertions and deletions, and the goal is to maintain an orientation with small {\em maximum outdegree} (hereafter, outdegree) and small worst-case update time. The outdegree of any orientation is at least $\alpha-1$, where $\alpha$ is the graph's \emph{arboricity}, i.e., the minimum number of forests into which its edge set can be partitioned. When $\alpha = O(1)$, it is long known that both the outdegree and the worst-case update time can be bounded by $O(\log n)$. Despite numerous follow-ups, no $o(\log^3 n)$ worst-case update time is known for maintaining constant outdegree, even for very basic graph families---with a notable exception, \emph{forests}. For forests, a \emph{simple folklore} algorithm maintains outdegree 2 via \emph{random walks}: When an insertion creates a vertex of outdegree 3, the algorithm repeatedly chooses a uniformly random outgoing edge until reaching a vertex of outdegree at most 1, and then flips the resulting directed path. As the underlying graph is cycle-free, the path length is easily shown to be $O(\log n)$ in expectation, and also with high probability for polynomially long update sequences. We prove that this simple random walk paradigm extends to \emph{outerplanar graphs}. Our algorithm maintains constant outdegree with $O(\log n)$ worst-case update time, where the time bound holds in expectation, and also with high probability for polynomially long update sequences. We give a \emph{tight analysis}: outdegree 4 is achievable with $O(\log n)$-length paths, while outdegree 3 incurs $\mathtt{poly}(n)$-length paths. We also extend the argument to $K_{2,t}$-minor-free graphs, for any $t \ge 2$, with the outdegree bound depending only on $t$ and with the same update time guarantees. The locality of [...]

AI.tldr: 本文研究全动态边方向问题，证明了统一的随机游走修复规则可从森林扩展到外平面图乃至 $K_{2,t}$-minor-free 图。对外平面图，算法以 $O(\log n)$ 最坏情况期望更新时间维持常数出度 4，并证明阈值 4 是紧的；同时给出阈值 3 时的多项式下界及一系列系列-平行图上的负面结果。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量动态边方向工作，对于常数出度与最坏情况 $O(\log n)$ 更新时间这一开放问题，长期未取得突破；唯一的已知例外是森林上的简单随机游走算法。本文旨在将这一"近乎无结构"的随机游走范式推广到更广泛的图族，特别是外平面图及 $K_{2,t}$-minor-free 图。
AI.method: 核心方法是一个统一的随机游走修复规则：插入边使其尾顶点出度超过阈值 $\Delta$ 时，从该顶点启动均匀有向随机游走直至首次到达出度低于 $\Delta$ 的顶点，记录游走后提取其保留下来的简单路径（有向回环擦除），并翻转该路径。上界分析分两层：Layer I 通过外部路径计数引理（在 $K_{2,t}$-minor-free 图下用 Menger 定理 + Catalan 递推给出路径计数界）配合权重论证得到阈值 48 的 $O(\log n)$ 命中时间；Layer II 对外平面图通过三角剖分的弱对偶分解、质心面递归和 ζ-权重矩母估计，将阈值锐化至紧界 4。下界方面，对外平面图阈值 3 构造了基于"楔形"递归结构的多项式下界实例，并使用带 $\Delta$ 棵根树的系列-平行图证明普适的多项式下界；阈值 2 时给出外平面图上的指数下界。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 对外平面图在阈值 4 下达到 $O(\log n)$ 期望更新时间与回退次数，并 w.h.p. 对多项式长更新序列成立（对抗自适应对手）；阈值 4 对均匀游走是紧的，因为阈值 3 时存在外平面实例使游走需要 $n^{\Omega(1)}$ 步、阈值 2 时需要 $2^{\Omega(n)}$ 步。(2) 推广到 $K_{2,t}$-minor-free 图，出度上界 $48(t-1)$，更新时间同样 $O(\log n)$。(3) 在局部唤醒 CONGEST 模型中给出几乎无损的分布式实现，轮数与消息复杂度均为 $O(\log n)$。(4) 对所有 $\Delta \ge 3$，构造树宽至多 2 的系列-平行图，说明均匀游走失效；(5) 对出度 2 给出 $\Omega(n)$ 摊销回退次数的离线下界（即使知晓未来更新序列）。
AI.conclusion: 论文将森林上的简单随机游走修复规则推广到外平面图及 $K_{2,t}$-minor-free 图，给出常数出度与 $O(\log n)$ 最坏情况更新时间的肯定回答（就出度 4 而言），并精确刻画了阈值紧界。负面结果揭示该范式不能直接推广到所有系列-平行图，且出度 3 的 $O(\log n)$ 更新时间（甚至仅靠随机游走）仍是公开问题。本文的修复规则具有显著的局部性优势，可高效应用于动态分布式网络。

title: Lower Bounds for Linear Hashing via Arithmetic Kakeya
summary: Affine modular linear hashing is one of the simplest classical hash families. For a prime $p > u$, the hash function is obtained by choosing $s,t$ uniformly from $\mathbb{Z}_p$ and mapping each key $x \in \{0,\ldots,u-1\}$ to one of $n$ bins by $h(x) = [(sx+t) \bmod p] \bmod n$. Despite its simplicity, the maximum load of linear hashing remains poorly understood. For $n$ keys hashed into $n$ bins, the best known upper bound is $O((n \log n)^{1/3})$, whereas the best known lower bound is only $\Omega(\log n / \log\log n)$. We prove a lower bound of $\exp(\Omega(\log n / \log\log n))$ for universes of size $n^{1+o(1)}$. Surprisingly, there is a key set for which this load holds not just in expectation, but for every random seed. The proof is driven by two simple reductions: one transfers lower bounds from a real version of linear hashing to modular linear hashing, and the other transfers arithmetic Kakeya constructions to real hashing. We further show that, for sufficiently large $p$, the expected maximum loads in the modular and real settings are essentially the same, giving an alternative route to an $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ upper bound. Finally, we show that any uniform subpolynomial upper bound for either setting would imply a polynomial-length arithmetic Kakeya conjecture and hence the Kakeya conjecture for upper Minkowski dimension.

AI.tldr: 本文研究仿射模线性哈希（affine modular linear hashing）的最大负载下界问题。通过两个简洁的归约（real hashing → modular hashing，以及 arithmetic Kakeya → real hashing），证明了存在一个密钥集 $X$，使得对所有随机种子 $s$，最大负载均达到 $\exp(\Omega(\log n / \log\log n))$，相较此前 $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$ 的下界实现了指数级改进。同时建立了 modular 与 real 哈希在大素数 $p$ 下期望最大负载的等价性，并证明了任何 $n^{o(1)}$ 的次多项式上界都将蕴含 arithmetic Kakeya 猜想（多项式长度版本），进而蕴含上 Minkowski 维数 Kakeya 猜想。
AI.motivation: 仿射模线性哈希是最经典的简单哈希族之一（Carter–Wegman, 1979），因其存储和计算效率高而广泛应用。然而其最大负载的精确行为长期未被理解：上界 $O((n\log n)^{1/3})$（Knudsen）与下界 $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$ 之间存在巨大鸿沟，理论上甚至可能匹配完全随机哈希的最优 $O(\log n/\log\log n)$ 界。缩小这一差距是哈希分析与组合数论交叉领域的核心问题。
AI.method: 证明通过链式组合两个归约：(1) Real→Modular 归约（定理 2.5/3.1）：利用映射 $a_s = \{s(c+1/p)/n\}$ 建立 modular 哈希函数 $h^{\mathrm{mod}}_s$ 与 real 哈希函数 $h^{\mathrm{real}}_{a_s}$ 在 max load 上的精确等价关系，并证明当 $p > n^2 u$ 时二者期望最大负载相差至多为 1。(2) Kakeya→Real 归约（定理 2.8）：若集合 $A$ 含对每个公差 $d \in [D]$ 的 $k$ 项等差数列且 $D \geq kn$，则任何包含 $A$ 的 $n$ 元集合在所有种子 $a$ 下 max load $\geq k/2$。结合 Green–Ruzsa 对 arithmetic Kakeya 集的显式构造（附录 A），得到核心下界。此外，通过全变差与 Riemann 和分析建立了 Problems 1 与 2 在大 $p$ 下的等价性（定理 3.1）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(i) 对 Problem 1（modular 哈希）：存在 $u = n^{1+o(1)}$ 的密钥集 $X$，使得对每个种子 $s$ 都有 $\mathrm{maxload}_X(h^{\mathrm{mod}}_s) \geq \exp(\Omega(\log n/\log\log n))$（推论 2.10）。(ii) 对 Problem 2（real 哈希）：得到 Kakeya 集 $X \subseteq [u]$ 满足 $\max_{a} \mathrm{maxload}_X(h^{\mathrm{real}}_a) \geq \exp(\Omega(\log n/\log\log n))$（推论 2.9）。(iii) 等价性：$p > n^2 u$ 时 modular 与 real 期望最大负载差 $\leq 1$（定理 3.1）。(iv) 条件障碍：任何 $n^{o(1)}$ 的一致上界（无论是单种子还是期望）都蕴含 polynomial-length arithmetic Kakeya 猜想（猜想 4.1），进而蕴含上 Minkowski 维数 Kakeya 猜想（推论 4.6）。下界相对于之前 $\Omega(\log n/\log\log n)$ 的结果实现了指数级改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过 modular/real 线性哈希与 arithmetic Kakeya 问题之间的两条简洁归约，证明了 modular 线性哈希的最大负载下界可指数级提升至 $\exp(\Omega(\log n/\log\log n))$，且该下界对每个种子都成立（不仅是期望）。同时严格建立了两类线性哈希在大素数下的等价性，给出了达到 Knudsen $n^{1/3+o(1)}$ 上界的替代路径。最后证明了改善上界至次多项式将蕴含深刻的 Kakeya 维数猜想，揭示了该问题的本质难度。论文在连接哈希分析与组合数论/几何测度论方面具有重要贡献。
